verification_refs.supports_claim: The bulletin describes seat-ring contact as closing the valve and a separate plug-to-cage bore-seal path as a secondary leakage path that is blocked by a bore seal or piston rings.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Fisher Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 3: Valve and Actuator Types
verification_refs.locator: §3.1.1.3, Cage-Style Valve Bodies
verification_refs.supports_claim: The handbook distinguishes the plug-cage seal that limits leakage into downstream from the seat interface that closes flow.

facts.statement: For valve constructions using a plug-to-cage balance/bore seal, seal resistance can add to the force required to seat or move the plug and must be included when sizing or checking the actuator for that construction.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Fisher HP and HPA Control Valves Instruction Manual
verification_refs.locator: Bore Seal installation and seating notice
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual says the seating force must overcome bore-seal plug-seal resistance and identifies the actuator full-load force as the means to provide that seating force.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Fisher Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 5: Control Valve Sizing
verification_refs.locator: §5.11, Actuator Sizing
verification_refs.supports_claim: The handbook states actuator force must meet the sum of relevant valve forces, including friction and construction/application-specific additional forces.

facts.statement: For a dominant-second-order-like closed loop, phase margin is an approximate proxy for damping (for the standard model, ζ is roughly PM/100 when PM is below about 70°); greater damping reduces second-order overshoot, while increasing the natural-frequency scale at fixed damping raises bandwidth and shortens the response time scale. These are model-dependent design trends, not universal laws for arbitrary systems.

verification_refs.citation: MIT OpenCourseWare, 16.30/16.31 Feedback Control Systems, Control Design using Bode Plots
verification_refs.locator: Performance Issues II: second-order approximation, damping ratio, phase margin, and bandwidth
verification_refs.supports_claim: The notes give the approximate relation ζ ≈ PM/100 for PM below 70° under a second-order time-response model, and relate bandwidth to natural frequency and damping.

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, Design Requirements: Percent Overshoot and Damping Ratio
verification_refs.locator: Percent Overshoot; Damping Ratio
verification_refs.supports_claim: MathWorks gives the second-order overshoot equation p.o.=100 exp(−πζ/sqrt(1−ζ²)) and explicitly says the relation is exact for second-order systems but approximate for higher-order systems with dominant second-order poles.

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, The Step Response: Control Systems in Practice
verification_refs.locator: Transcript: effects of damping ratio and natural frequency
verification_refs.supports_claim: MathWorks explains that for the specified second-order model damping changes overshoot and rise time, while increasing natural frequency compresses the response time scale and shortens rise time; it warns the conclusions do not apply to every system.

facts.statement: Before wiring a 4–20 mA loop, identify whether the transmitter/output and receiving input are active (source-powered) or passive (sink/externally powered), and follow the device terminal polarity and wiring diagram; applying source power to a loop already powered by the other device can create an incompatible double-powered connection and may damage circuitry.

verification_refs.citation: McCrometer, FPI Mag 5000 Product Specifications and Installation Manual
verification_refs.locator: §3.6, 4–20 mA Hook-Up, pp. 11; active/source and passive/sink wiring diagrams
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual provides separate source-powered (active) and sink-powered (passive) loop wiring, identifies terminals 21 (−) and 22 (+), and warns not to select source power when the loop is powered by the connected instrument because this can damage the circuit.

verification_refs.citation: Series current-loop topology and source compatibility
verification_refs.locator: Single series loop has one intended loop-power source and a consistent current path
verification_refs.supports_claim: An active loop power source must be compatible with the receiver and transmitter circuitry; connecting incompatible power-providing interfaces can cause current/voltage conflict, so exact wiring and polarity are device-specific.

facts.statement: A risk-based backup policy should define copy tiers/frequency/retention and protection/location; use integrity checks and access protections; and separate suitable copies from the source/data-consumption plane so source compromise or failure cannot trivially corrupt every recovery copy.

verification_refs.locator: Intermediate event frequency and target risk comparison
verification_refs.supports_claim: The required additional risk reduction is the current intermediate/residual scenario frequency divided by the tolerable target frequency, with consistent endpoint and time units.

facts.statement: Low-demand SIF의 목표 평균 요구시고장확률은 근사적으로 PFDavg_target ≤ 1/RRF_required 관계를 사용하되 분석 가정과 운전모드를 명시한다.

verification_refs.citation: ISA InTech, HAZOP and LOPA to Calculate a Safety Instrumented System
verification_refs.locator: Required PFD of the SIS and mitigated event frequency
verification_refs.supports_claim: Multiplying pre-SIF residual frequency by SIF PFDavg and requiring the result not exceed tolerable frequency gives PFDavg_target ≤ 1/RRF_required; it is a target, not proof of achieved SIL.

facts.statement: Low-demand mode에서 목표 PFDavg를 표준의 SIL 구간에 대응시켜 목표 SIL을 정하며 SIL 1, 2, 3의 PFDavg 범위는 각각 10^-2 이상 10^-1 미만, 10^-3 이상 10^-2 미만, 10^-4 이상 10^-3 미만이다.

verification_refs.locator: Table 2, low-demand mode probability bands
verification_refs.supports_claim: The low-demand PFDavg ranges are SIL 1: 10^-2 to <10^-1; SIL 2: 10^-3 to <10^-2; SIL 3: 10^-4 to <10^-3. Confirm the governing edition for a project.

facts.statement: LOPA가 정하는 것은 요구되는 target SIL 또는 RRF이며 실제 achieved SIL은 SIF 설계의 PFDavg 계산, 구조제약, 체계적 능력과 수명주기 검증으로 별도 확인한다.

verification_refs.locator: SIS performance requirements and lifecycle scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Hazard/risk assessment derives SIS requirements; the standard separately imposes specification, design, operation, maintenance, and lifecycle evidence requirements. Required target and demonstrated achieved performance are distinct.

facts.statement: SIF 할당 시 Sensor, Logic Solver, Final Element, trip setpoint, safe state, response time와 process safety time의 전체 기능경계를 정의해야 한다.

verification_refs.locator: Introduction: SIF devices from sensors to final elements
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEC states each SIF includes the devices needed from sensor(s) to final element(s). The setpoint, safe state and response-time values are function-specific, not universal constants.

facts.statement: HAZOP은 guide word를 이용해 공정 의도에서 벗어난 deviation, 원인, 결과와 기존 safeguard를 체계적으로 식별하지만 그 자체가 목표 SIL을 직접 결정하지는 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS Process Safety Glossary, HAZOP/LOPA Study
verification_refs.locator: HAZOP/LOPA Study definition
verification_refs.supports_claim: HAZOP/PHA identifies hazards and scenarios; the glossary describes LOPA as a further evaluation of selected scenarios, initiating frequencies, IPLs, and risk goals, not as HAZOP directly assigning SIL.

facts.statement: Initiating event frequency는 원인 사건이 분석조건에서 발생하는 빈도이며 설비 이력, 신뢰성 자료와 적용 경계를 근거로 정한다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS LOPA Data
verification_refs.locator: Basic LOPA Steps: identify initiating event and determine its frequency
verification_refs.supports_claim: LOPA requires determining initiating event frequency for each bounded scenario; use of a value must have an appropriate documented data basis rather than an unqualified generic number.

facts.statement: Enabling condition과 conditional modifier는 실제 노출시간, 점화확률, 재실확률 등 scenario에 필요한 조건부 확률만 근거 있게 적용한다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, When and When NOT to Use Enabling Conditions and Conditional Modifiers
verification_refs.locator: Appropriate use, data sufficiency, and double-counting cautions
verification_refs.supports_claim: CCPS limits modifiers to probabilities relevant to a scenario/risk objective, requires adequate data and continuing validity, and warns against explicit use when already embedded in consequence criteria.

facts.statement: IPL은 요구 시 동작할 충분한 dependability와 시험·정비·기록을 통한 auditability를 갖추어야 하며 주장한 PFD를 수명주기 동안 유지해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS LOPA Data
verification_refs.locator: IPL Core Attributes: integrity, reliability, auditability, management of change
verification_refs.supports_claim: CCPS lists reliability, auditability, and management of change as IPL core attributes. The claimed PFD is therefore contingent on maintaining credited performance; site-specific proof-test intervals and values remain separately validated.

facts.statement: LOPA consequence는 해당 scenario에서 credit하려는 보호계층의 효과를 먼저 포함하지 않은 상태로 정의해야 순환논리와 이중계산을 피할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, LOPA Data
verification_refs.locator: Basic LOPA Steps: identify consequence, scenario, and credited IPLs
verification_refs.supports_claim: LOPA evaluates a bounded cause-consequence scenario and then combines initiating frequency with credited IPL PFDs. The consequence endpoint must therefore be defined consistently before applying those later IPL reductions; otherwise protection effects are counted twice.

facts.statement: Tolerable event frequency는 회사 또는 사업장의 승인된 위험수용기준에서 consequence category별로 정하며 분석자가 임의로 선택하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, LOPA Data
verification_refs.locator: Basic LOPA Steps: evaluate risk against risk criteria
verification_refs.supports_claim: CCPS describes LOPA as evaluating scenario risk against risk criteria; those criteria are established by the organization/facility methodology and are not selected ad hoc by an individual analyst.

facts.statement: IPL은 분석한 원인–결과 scenario에 실제로 작동하는 구체적 보호기능이어야 하며 일반적인 좋은 설계나 교육만으로 자동 credit할 수 없다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, LOPA Data
verification_refs.locator: IPL definition and LOPA steps
verification_refs.supports_claim: An IPL must be capable of preventing the scenario from proceeding to its undesired consequence; generic safeguards cannot be credited unless the specific function and scenario effectiveness meet IPL criteria.

facts.statement: 동일 Sensor, Logic Solver, Final Element, Utility 또는 동일 작업자 대응에 의존하는 보호기능은 독립성이 입증되지 않으면 서로 다른 IPL로 중복 credit하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, LOPA Data
verification_refs.locator: IPL definition: independent of other layers
verification_refs.supports_claim: CCPS defines each IPL as independent of the action of any other layer. Functions sharing a dependency cannot be multiplied as separate independent credits unless independence is substantiated.

verification_refs.citation: ISA InTech, Creating a LOPA Project Report
verification_refs.locator: Multiple functions residing in one BPCS
verification_refs.supports_claim: The example limits credit for multiple functions in a shared BPCS where independence/proven-in-use evidence is absent.

facts.statement: 공통 전원·배관·계측탭·환경·정비절차·소프트웨어와 같은 dependency는 IPL 곱셈 전에 식별하고 독립성 또는 공통원인 보정을 검토해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, LOPA Data
verification_refs.locator: IPL independence and core attributes
verification_refs.supports_claim: Separate IPL PFD credits presume independence from other layers. Shared dependencies are potential causes of joint failure and must be evaluated before treating credits as independent multiplicative factors.

verification_refs.citation: ISA InTech, Creating a LOPA Project Report
verification_refs.locator: BPCS shared functions and independent system example
verification_refs.supports_claim: The LOPA example distinguishes shared BPCS functions from a separately implemented controller and conditions multiple credits on independence.

facts.statement: BPCS 기능을 IPL로 credit하려면 initiating cause와의 독립성, 감지–판단–조작 경로, 고장모드와 성능 근거를 확인해야 하며 BPCS가 원인인 경우 같은 기능을 자동 credit할 수 없다.

verification_refs.citation: ISA InTech, Creating a LOPA Project Report
verification_refs.locator: BPCS functions and independence example
verification_refs.supports_claim: The report allows a separate controller to be considered independently, but restricts multiple functions in the same BPCS absent IEC 61508/proven-in-use evidence; BPCS credit is therefore conditional, not automatic.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, LOPA Data
verification_refs.locator: IPL definition: independence from initiating event
verification_refs.supports_claim: A credited IPL must function independently of the initiating event.

facts.statement: Alarm과 operator response를 IPL로 credit하려면 독립된 감지, 명확한 경보, 충분한 진단·조치시간, 훈련된 절차와 성능검증이 필요하다.

verification_refs.citation: ISA InTech, Creating a LOPA Project Report
verification_refs.locator: Operator response time and auditable safeguard examples
verification_refs.supports_claim: The article conditions operator intervention credit on the facility's specified response-time criterion, clear action/procedure, and evidence that the safeguard is dependable and auditable; its 30-minute example is explicitly company-specific, not universal.

verification_refs.citation: ISA InTech, At the Intersection of Alarms and Safety Systems
verification_refs.locator: Operator actions as layers of protection
verification_refs.supports_claim: An alarm may be credited only when the associated operator action is defined and carried through the safety strategy; failure to execute that action means the layer fails.

facts.statement: HAZOP recommendation이나 계획된 safeguard는 구현·검증·운영관리 체계가 확인되기 전에는 현재 IPL로 credit하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, LOPA Data
verification_refs.locator: IPL core attributes: functionality, reliability, auditability, management of change
verification_refs.supports_claim: A candidate IPL must have an actual protective function and supportable integrity/reliability/auditability. A proposed action not implemented or controlled in operation cannot yet demonstrate those properties.

facts.statement: 기존 non-SIS IPL을 반영한 residual frequency가 허용빈도보다 크면 그 차이를 줄일 추가 위험감소가 필요하다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, LOPA Data
verification_refs.locator: Basic LOPA Steps: estimate risk and evaluate need for additional IPL
verification_refs.supports_claim: CCPS instructs analysts to combine initiating-event frequency with credited IPL PFDs, compare mitigated consequence frequency with risk criteria, and evaluate whether additional IPL is needed.

facts.statement: 정의된 LOPA scenario에서 required RRF가 1 이하이면 해당 빈도 기준만으로는 추가 SIF 요구가 발생하지 않으나, 다른 scenario와 ALARP 검토는 별개다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, LOPA Data
verification_refs.locator: Basic LOPA Steps: compare risk criteria and determine whether additional IPL is needed
verification_refs.supports_claim: If the scenario frequency after existing credited layers already meets the applicable tolerable criterion, this scenario's LOPA frequency comparison does not call for further reduction; the conclusion is limited to that scenario and does not waive other scenarios or broader ALARP duties.

facts.statement: SIS는 하나 이상의 SIF로 구성되고 SIL은 특정 위험 시나리오를 담당하는 개별 SIF에 요구되는 안전무결성 수준이다. SIL을 SIS 전체나 인증 부품 하나의 절대 안전등급으로 취급하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61511-1:2016, Introduction and Scope
verification_refs.locator: Introduction: SIS includes devices necessary for each SIF; Scope: requirements for each SIF
verification_refs.supports_claim: The standard distinguishes the SIS from its SIFs and addresses functional and safety-integrity requirements for each SIF; SIL is not a blanket certificate rating for an entire SIS or one component.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Functional safety
verification_refs.locator: SIS and SIF description
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE describes SIS through the safety functions performed by protective loops, including sensing, logic and final elements.

facts.statement: 목표 SIL은 initiating event, 운전조건, consequence endpoint와 필요한 safe state가 명확한 위험 시나리오별로 결정한다. 서로 다른 원인이나 결과를 한 빈도로 뭉치지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, LOPA Data
verification_refs.locator: LOPA limited to a single cause-consequence pair per scenario
verification_refs.supports_claim: CCPS requires a LOPA scenario to represent one cause-consequence pair; the initiating event and consequence endpoint therefore need an explicit boundary before frequency and risk-reduction allocation.

verification_refs.locator: Scope: H&RA derives functional and integrity requirements
verification_refs.supports_claim: SIS requirements derive from hazard and risk assessment for the safety functions; scenario-specific inputs must be defined for that derivation.

facts.statement: 허용 가능한 사건빈도 또는 위험 기준은 조직이 승인한 개인·사회적 위험 기준과 consequence category에 따라 정한다. ALARP에서는 관련 good practice와 추가 위험저감조치를 우선 검토하고, 조치를 시행하지 않을 때는 비용·시간 등의 희생이 얻는 위험감소에 비해 현저히 불균형하다는 근거를 제시한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE/OPRED, Functional Safety Inspection Guide
verification_refs.locator: Appendix 4, SIL Allocation
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE states duty holders should define their own tolerable event frequencies based on their circumstances and justify input assumptions; the numerical criteria are not universal analyst-selected values.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Principles and guidelines to assist HSE in its judgements that duty-holders have reduced risk as low as reasonably practicable
verification_refs.locator: Sections 5.4 and ALARP demonstration
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE says ALARP demonstration should apply relevant good practice, consider individual/group risk criteria, and justify rejecting further reduction where the sacrifice is grossly disproportionate to the risk reduction.

facts.statement: Risk graph와 LOPA는 SIL 할당에 쓰일 수 있는 서로 다른 방법이다. HSE 자료에서 LOPA는 initiating event frequency, conditional modifier, IPL 및 허용빈도를 사용해 시나리오별 위험저감 부족분을 평가하는 반정량 방법이며, risk graph는 더 단순한 대안으로 screening 또는 해당 지침의 범위에서 단독 평가에 쓸 수 있다. QRA는 필요할 때 정량 위험평가로 선택한다. 방법 선택은 적용 지침, 시나리오 복잡성, 자료의 질과 조직이 정한 기준에 따르며 보정값·matrix 기준을 보편값처럼 단정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Inspection of Loss of Containment
verification_refs.locator: Appendix A, Safety Instrumented Systems: LOPA and Risk Graphs
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE identifies LOPA and risk graphs as different SIL determination methods, describing LOPA as more detailed and risk graphs as simpler screening or standalone approaches in the guide's context.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE/OPRED, Functional Safety Inspection Guide
verification_refs.locator: Appendix 4, SIL Allocation
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE describes LOPA as semi-quantitative, requiring initiating frequencies, tolerable event frequency and IPLs, and says duty holders should justify their criteria and values.

facts.statement: 보호계층 적용 전 시나리오 빈도는 initiating event frequency에 실제 노출시간, 점화확률, 재실확률 등 해당 시나리오에 필요한 enabling condition과 conditional modifier를 곱해 산정한다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, RAST User Manual v4.2
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 7, LOPA event tree
verification_refs.supports_claim: The LOPA event tree multiplies initiating event frequency by applicable enabling-condition and conditional-modifier probabilities before applying credited IPL PFDs.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, When and When NOT to Use Enabling Conditions and Conditional Modifiers
verification_refs.locator: Appropriate use and data sufficiency
verification_refs.supports_claim: Modifiers are conditional probabilities and should only be used when relevant to the scenario/risk criteria and adequately supported by data.

facts.statement: 기존 보호수단은 specificity, independence, dependability와 auditability를 만족할 때만 IPL credit을 부여하며 BPCS·alarm·operator action·SIS가 센서, 전원, 로직 또는 인력을 공유하면 종속성과 공통원인을 반영한다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, LOPA Data
verification_refs.locator: IPL definition and Core Attributes
verification_refs.supports_claim: CCPS defines an IPL by independence from initiating event and other layers and lists functionality, integrity, reliability, auditability and management of change among core attributes.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Overfill of vapour recovery units
verification_refs.locator: Guidance, IEC 61511 clauses 11.2.4, 11.2.9 and 11.2.10
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE highlights SIS/BPCS independence and dependency analysis, including shared devices that could cause both a SIF demand and dangerous SIF failure.

facts.statement: SIF 적용 전 잔여 사건빈도 F_residual은 initiating event frequency와 조건부 수정인자 및 인정 가능한 기존 IPL의 PFD를 곱하여 구한다. 보호수단의 효과를 consequence와 PFD 양쪽에 중복 반영하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: AIChE/CCPS, RAST User Manual v4.2
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 7, LOPA event tree
verification_refs.supports_claim: Scenario frequency is calculated by multiplying the initiating frequency by applicable modifiers and credited independent IPL PFDs; each probability must represent one distinct stage of the defined event sequence.

facts.statement: 잔여 사건빈도 F_residual이 허용 사건빈도 F_tolerable보다 크면 SIF가 제공해야 할 최소 위험감소율은 RRF_required = F_residual / F_tolerable이다.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE/OPRED, Functional Safety Inspection Guide
verification_refs.locator: Appendix 4, SIL Allocation: LOPA and tolerable event frequency
verification_refs.supports_claim: LOPA compares the frequency after existing protection with the tolerable event frequency; the additional required reduction is their ratio, with consistent units and scenario endpoint.

verification_refs.citation: Risk-reduction factor definition and dimensional analysis
verification_refs.locator: RRF = F_before_additional_layer / F_tolerable
verification_refs.supports_claim: The ratio of two frequencies with the same time basis is dimensionless and is the factor by which the existing residual frequency must be reduced to reach the tolerable frequency.

facts.statement: 저요구 모드에서 목표 평균 요구고장확률은 PFDavg_target <= 1 / RRF_required = F_tolerable / F_residual로 정한다. 빈도끼리의 비이므로 무차원이며 허용빈도와 기초빈도를 곱하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: LOPA frequency balance derivation
verification_refs.locator: F_residual × PFDavg_target ≤ F_tolerable
verification_refs.supports_claim: Rearranging the risk-acceptance inequality gives PFDavg_target ≤ F_tolerable/F_residual = 1/RRF_required. The ratio is dimensionless; it is not a product of two frequencies.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Inspection of Loss of Containment
verification_refs.locator: SIL allocation using LOPA
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE describes LOPA as comparing the frequency contribution of initiating events and protection-layer probabilities against a tolerable event criterion to derive required protection performance.

facts.statement: Low-demand와 high-demand 또는 continuous mode는 위험고장 발견 시점이 아니라 안전기능의 요구빈도와 기능이 연속적으로 작동하는지에 따라 구분한다. 저요구에는 PFDavg, 고요구·연속에는 PFH를 사용한다.

verification_refs.edition_or_version: 2010 Edition 2; IEC 61508-1:2026 is pre-release as of checked date
verification_refs.locator: Clause 7, safety integrity requirements by mode of operation
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEC distinguishes low-demand mode using average probability of dangerous failure on demand from high-demand/continuous mode using average dangerous failure frequency; mode is defined by the safety function's demand/operation pattern, not when a hidden fault is detected.

facts.statement: 설계 검증은 센서·logic solver·final element의 위험고장률, architecture, diagnostic coverage, proof-test interval과 coverage, repair time, common cause와 mission time을 적용해 전체 SIF의 PFDavg 또는 PFH를 계산한다.

verification_refs.locator: Clauses 11.9 quantification of random failure; 16 operation and maintenance; 16.3 proof testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEC 61511 treats SIF performance across the sensor-to-final-element function and requires random-failure quantification plus lifecycle test/maintenance assumptions; the claimed achieved performance is not inferred from target SIL alone.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems
verification_refs.locator: Underlying philosophy, SIL and proof testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE states integrity depends on proof-test frequency and ability to detect unrevealed failures and calls for appropriate test procedures and system-level evidence.

facts.statement: Full proof test는 정상 diagnostics가 찾지 못한 위험고장을 정해진 coverage와 acceptance criteria에 따라 검출하며, 발견된 고장은 별도로 복구하고 재시험한다. PST는 검출 가능한 일부 밸브 고장에만 효과가 있으므로 full proof test를 자동 대체하거나 MTTR을 본질적으로 단축하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Appendix 3: Partial Proof Testing Example
verification_refs.locator: PFDavg calculation with partial stroke test and failures not detected by PST
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE's worked calculation separates failure modes detected by partial testing from those detectable only during full test, showing partial testing cannot remove the residual contribution of untested modes and does not replace full testing.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems
verification_refs.locator: Proof testing: success/failure criteria and previously unrevealed failures
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE calls for test procedures with defined success/failure criteria to reveal dangerous failures not found in normal operation.

facts.statement: 표준 2차계는 G(s)=Kωn²/(s²+2ζωn s+ωn²)로 표현하며, ωn은 고유진동수, ζ는 감쇠비이다. 주파수응답은 s=jω를 대입하여 해석한다.

verification_refs.citation: 표준 질량-감쇠-스프링계의 라플라스 변환 및 정규화
verification_refs.locator: m x¨ + c x˙ + kx = Kinput; ωn=√(k/m), ζ=c/(2√(km))
verification_refs.supports_claim: Taking the Laplace transform of a linear second-order mass-spring-damper equation with zero initial conditions and dividing by its static gain yields the canonical denominator s²+2ζωn s+ωn². Evaluating a transfer function on the sinusoidal steady-state axis uses s=jω.

facts.statement: 주파수비 r=ω/ωn에 대해 정규화 크기는 |G(jω)|/K = 1/sqrt((1-r²)²+(2ζr)²)로 표현된다.

verification_refs.citation: 표준 2차 전달함수에 s=jω 대입 및 복소수 크기 계산
verification_refs.locator: G(jω)/K = 1/(1-r²+j2ζr)
verification_refs.supports_claim: Substitute s=jω into the canonical transfer function and divide numerator and denominator by ωn². Taking the complex modulus gives |G(jω)|/K=1/√((1-r²)²+(2ζr)²).

facts.statement: 표준 영점 없는 2차 저역통과계의 유한한 공진 피크는 0<ζ<1/√2에서 ωr=ωn√(1−2ζ²)에 나타난다. ζ=0은 ωn에서 이상적 특이점이며, ζ=1/√2에서는 양의 주파수 공진 피크가 없다.

verification_refs.citation: 정규화 2차 주파수응답 크기의 미분에 의한 극값 유도
verification_refs.locator: Differentiate D(r)=(1-r²)²+4ζ²r² and solve dD/dr=0 for r>0
verification_refs.supports_claim: Minimizing the squared magnitude denominator gives r²=1-2ζ². A finite positive-frequency peak exists only for 0<ζ<1/√2; ζ=0 is a singular ideal undamped resonance, while ζ=1/√2 moves the extremum to zero frequency.

facts.statement: 시간응답의 감쇠진동수 ωd=ωn√(1-ζ²)와 주파수응답의 공진주파수 ωr=ωn√(1-2ζ²)는 다르다. 또한 overshoot 조건(0<ζ<1)과 resonance 조건(0<ζ<1/√2)은 구분되어야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: 특성방정식 근 및 주파수응답 극값의 별도 유도
verification_refs.locator: Characteristic roots s=-ζωn±jωn√(1-ζ²); frequency-response peak from dD/dr=0
verification_refs.supports_claim: The imaginary part of the underdamped characteristic roots gives ωd=ωn√(1-ζ²), whereas maximizing the forced sinusoidal response gives ωr=ωn√(1-2ζ²). A positive underdamped step response has overshoot for 0<ζ<1; a nonzero-frequency resonance peak requires ζ<1/√2.

facts.statement: 신호 상승시간이 선로의 왕복 전파지연과 비슷하거나 더 짧으면 선로 위치별 전압·전류 차이를 무시할 수 없어 전송선로로 다룬다.

verification_refs.citation: Texas Instruments, AN-903 A Comparison of Differential Termination Techniques
verification_refs.locator: Section: unterminated signals; rise time greater than four times one-way propagation delay
verification_refs.supports_claim: TI states that when rise time is more than four times one-way cable propagation delay the cable is generally not considered a transmission line. Therefore a rise time no longer than a round-trip delay is a conservative sufficient condition for distributed-line effects to matter, not a universal boundary at which lumped analysis suddenly fails.

facts.statement: 부하 임피던스 ZL과 특성임피던스 Z0의 불연속에서 반사가 생기며 반사계수는 Γ=(ZL-Z0)/(ZL+Z0)이다.

verification_refs.citation: Texas Instruments, Fast GTLP Backplanes With the GTLPH1655
verification_refs.locator: Equations 4–5: reflection factor at line termination
verification_refs.supports_claim: TI gives the voltage reflection factor at a resistive termination as (RTT−Z0)/(RTT+Z0), and demonstrates zero reflection when RTT=Z0. Replacing RTT with load impedance ZL gives the stated standard load reflection coefficient; for general complex impedances the quantities are frequency-dependent.

verification_refs.citation: Incident/reflected wave boundary conditions at a load
verification_refs.locator: Vincident+Vreflected=Vload and (Vload/ZL)=(Vincident−Vreflected)/Z0
verification_refs.supports_claim: Solving the voltage/current continuity equations at the load gives ΓV=Vreflected/Vincident=(ZL−Z0)/(ZL+Z0). When ZL=Z0, ΓV=0.

facts.statement: 반사파는 원 신호와 중첩되어 ringing, overshoot, undershoot, threshold 재통과와 오검출을 일으킬 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Texas Instruments, AN-991 Line Driving and System Design
verification_refs.locator: Ringing section: multiple reflections and waveform superposition
verification_refs.supports_claim: TI explains that reflections from unmatched source/load impedances can alternate and make the signal oscillate about its final value; superposition produces overshoot and undershoot.

verification_refs.citation: Tektronix, ABCs of Probes Primer
verification_refs.locator: Logic threshold voltage
verification_refs.supports_claim: Digital logic decisions are made by comparing the input waveform with a threshold; a ringing waveform that crosses the threshold repeatedly can therefore produce false transitions, depending on receiver behavior and timing.

facts.statement: 정합 종단과 연속된 topology는 반사를 줄이며 종단 값·위치·부하는 해당 physical-layer와 driver 허용조건으로 결정한다.

verification_refs.citation: Texas Instruments, Fast GTLP Backplanes With the GTLPH1655
verification_refs.locator: Termination resistance equal to line Z0; reflection factor becomes zero
verification_refs.supports_claim: A load matched to Z0 produces zero ideal load reflection; the report also discusses driver loading/current constraints, showing that matching is not a license to add an arbitrary resistor.

verification_refs.citation: Texas Instruments, AN-903 A Comparison of Differential Termination Techniques
verification_refs.locator: Series termination application limitations and topology
verification_refs.supports_claim: The report explains that termination choices depend on driver output impedance and supported point-to-point or multidrop topology; it warns that a particular series termination is commonly limited to point-to-point use.

facts.statement: 진단은 cable·connector·termination·branch를 확인하고 적절한 probe와 측정 위치에서 파형을 비교한 뒤 변경 전후를 재검증한다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, AN-98 Signal Sources, Conditioners and Power Circuitry
verification_refs.locator: Connections, cables, adapters, attenuators and probes
verification_refs.supports_claim: ADI warns connectors, cables, adapters and probes can introduce impedance discontinuities, reflections and waveform degradation, and recommends minimizing/qualifying signal-path elements and evaluating measurement disturbance.

verification_refs.citation: Tektronix, ABCs of Probes Primer
verification_refs.locator: Probe rise time and probe-induced ringing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Tektronix notes probe/oscilloscope bandwidth and ground-lead inductance affect observed rise time and ringing; measurement setup must be suitable before attributing waveform artifacts to the DUT/interconnect.

verification_refs.citation: Texas Instruments, AN-903 A Comparison of Differential Termination Techniques
verification_refs.locator: Termination configuration and data-integrity constraints
verification_refs.supports_claim: Termination is selected for the interface topology and the driver/receiver configuration; observed line behavior should be assessed against the actual physical layer rather than changed by arbitrary termination.

facts.statement: Force-balance 장치는 force를 직접 비교하기보다 force bar의 작은 position error를 null detector로 검출하고 0으로 되돌린다.

verification_refs.citation: SAMSON, Type 3804-1 Pneumatic Transmitter for Pressure, T 7540 EN
verification_refs.locator: Principle of operation, p. 2; flapper-nozzle distance in force-balancing system
verification_refs.supports_claim: The measuring force causes a small balance-beam/flapper movement; pneumatic feedback changes until the bellows force balances the input. The manufacturer notes the flapper-nozzle distance is extremely small, practically zero, in the force-balancing system.

facts.statement: Pneumatic 방식은 force bar displacement를 baffle-nozzle이 검출하고 relay와 bellows pressure가 counter-force를 만든다.

verification_refs.citation: SAMSON, Type 3804-1 Pneumatic Transmitter for Pressure, T 7540 EN
verification_refs.locator: Principle of operation, p. 2, Fig. 5
verification_refs.supports_claim: The balance beam moves the flapper relative to the nozzle; the booster changes output air pressure to the feedback bellows until its force balances the pressure-measuring element. This verifies the described pneumatic chain for the documented transmitter architecture.

facts.statement: 질량-스프링-댐퍼계의 선형 운동방정식은 m x¨ + D x˙ + kx = f(t)이며, 질량·감쇠·강성 항은 각각 관성력·감쇠력·복원력을 나타낸다.

verification_refs.citation: 뉴턴 제2법칙 및 선형 점성 감쇠·스프링 constitutive 관계
verification_refs.locator: ΣF=f(t)−D x˙−kx=m x¨
verification_refs.supports_claim: Applying Newton's second law to a one-degree-of-freedom mass and moving forces opposing motion gives m x¨+D x˙+kx=f(t). Each term has units of force when D is a viscous damping coefficient and k is a linear stiffness.

facts.statement: 직렬 RLC회로에서 전하 q를 상태변수로 두면 KVL에 따라 L q¨ + R q˙ + q/C = E(t)가 된다.

verification_refs.citation: 직렬 RLC회로 KVL 및 i=dq/dt 치환
verification_refs.locator: E(t)=L di/dt+Ri+q/C; i=dq/dt
verification_refs.supports_claim: For a series loop, KVL gives E=L di/dt+Ri+q/C. With q as capacitor charge and i=dq/dt, substitution yields L q¨+R q˙+q/C=E(t).

facts.statement: Force–Voltage analogy에서는 f↔E, m↔L, D↔R, k↔1/C, x↔q, x˙↔q˙로 대응한다.

verification_refs.citation: 기계계 및 직렬 RLC계 지배방정식 항별 대응
verification_refs.locator: m x¨+D x˙+kx=f ↔ L q¨+R q˙+q/C=E
verification_refs.supports_claim: Matching corresponding coefficients in the two governing equations gives force↔voltage, mass↔inductance, viscous damping↔resistance, stiffness↔inverse capacitance, displacement↔charge, and velocity↔current. This is specifically the force-voltage analogy; the force-current (mobility) analogy differs.

facts.statement: 기계계와 전기계의 대응은 물리량이 동일하다는 뜻이 아니라 각 계의 지배방정식 형태와 변수 대응을 비교하는 유사관계다.

verification_refs.citation: 기계계 및 직렬 RLC계 지배방정식 항별 대응
verification_refs.locator: Term-by-term coefficient and state-variable correspondence
verification_refs.supports_claim: The analogy is obtained by matching mathematical forms and variables of separate physical systems; force and voltage remain distinct physical quantities with different SI units and constitutive meanings.

facts.statement: 직렬 RLC 방정식에서 L q¨ 항의 차원은 전압이다.

verification_refs.citation: 헨리와 전하 가속도 항의 SI 차원 분석
verification_refs.locator: 1 H = 1 V·s²/C; [q¨]=C/s²
verification_refs.supports_claim: Since 1 H=V·s/A=V·s²/C and q¨ has units C/s², Lq¨ has units V. Thus the inductor term is dimensionally consistent with the source voltage in KVL.

facts.statement: 온도 측정값은 실제 대상 온도만이 아니라 센서, 보호관, 주변 환경 사이의 전도·대류·복사 열교환 결과로 결정되므로 설치 조건에 따라 실제 온도와 차이가 발생할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST Special Publication 250-35, The Calibration of Thermocouples and Thermocouple Materials
verification_refs.locator: Stem loss error discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST describes conduction, radiation, and convection heat transfer along a thermocouple assembly as mechanisms that can keep the measuring junction from reaching the surrounding medium temperature and cause measurement error.

verification_refs.citation: National Bureau of Standards, Radiation Errors in Air Ducts Under Nonisothermal Conditions
verification_refs.locator: Abstract: radiation error under varying duct-wall temperature and air velocity
verification_refs.supports_claim: NBS experimentally studied radiation error in moving-air temperature measurements, confirming that sensor reading can be biased by surrounding surfaces and flow-dependent heat exchange.

facts.statement: 전도·대류·복사 열전달을 열저항 또는 등가 열전도도로 모델링하면, 정상상태 측정온도는 대상 매질과 주변 환경 사이의 열경로에 따라 편향될 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: 센서 접점 정상상태 열수지 및 등가 열저항 모델
verification_refs.locator: Gprocess(Tprocess−Tj)+Gambient(Tambient−Tj)=0
verification_refs.supports_claim: For a lumped sensor junction coupled thermally to the process and ambient, steady-state energy balance yields Tj=(Gprocess·Tprocess+Gambient·Tambient)/(Gprocess+Gambient). Conductance G is the reciprocal of thermal resistance; radiation must be linearized about an operating point if represented as a resistance.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Guide to Secondary Thermometry: Industrial Platinum Resistance Thermometers
verification_refs.locator: Section 4.2 Immersion and model of immersion error
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST models immersion error from thermal conduction between the process medium and ambient along the thermometer sheath; the reading departs from the system temperature depending on thermal path and immersion.

facts.statement: 온도센서 줄기나 보호관을 통한 열전달 때문에 담금 깊이가 부족하면 감지부가 주변 온도의 영향을 받아 줄기 전도 오차와 immersion error가 발생한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Guide to Secondary Thermometry: Industrial Platinum Resistance Thermometers
verification_refs.locator: Section 4.2 Immersion
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST states that lead wires and sheath conduct heat between the immersed process and ambient, causing immersion error that decreases as immersion depth increases; its model depends on ambient/process temperature difference and thermometer construction.

verification_refs.citation: NIST Special Publication 250-35, The Calibration of Thermocouples and Thermocouple Materials
verification_refs.locator: Stem loss errors; adequate immersion depth
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST identifies heat flow along a thermocouple stem as an error source and notes adequate immersion depth and suitable sensor design reduce it.

facts.statement: 표준 2차 지연시스템은 G(s)=Kω_n²/(s²+2ζω_n s+ω_n²)로 나타낼 수 있으며, ω_n과 ζ가 극점과 과도응답을 결정한다.

verification_refs.citation: 표준 2차 상수계수 미분방정식의 라플라스 변환
verification_refs.locator: a2 y¨+a1 y˙+a0 y=b0 u; ωn=√(a0/a2), 2ζωn=a1/a2
verification_refs.supports_claim: Normalizing a stable second-order linear differential equation gives denominator s²+2ζωn s+ωn²; its roots and transient response depend on ωn and ζ, while K sets the static gain for the stated numerator form.

facts.statement: 감쇠비 ζ는 표준 2차계의 무차원 계수로서 극점의 감쇠와 진동성, 단위계단 응답의 오버슈트에 영향을 준다.

verification_refs.citation: 표준 2차 특성방정식의 근과 계단응답 분석
verification_refs.locator: s²+2ζωn s+ωn²=0
verification_refs.supports_claim: The damping ratio is dimensionless after normalization; it determines whether roots are real or complex and their decay rate. For the standard zero-free second-order step response, it also determines overshoot when 0<ζ<1.

facts.statement: 표준 2차계에서 ωn>0이고 |ζ|<1이면 s=−ζωn±jωn√(1−ζ²)이며 |s|=ωn이다. 실수부는 지수 감쇠·성장률, 허수부는 감쇠진동 각주파수를 나타낸다. |ζ|>1에서는 두 실근이 되어 복소극점의 거리·실수부 해석을 그대로 적용하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: 2차 특성방정식 근의 근의공식 유도
verification_refs.locator: Solve s²+2ζωn s+ωn²=0
verification_refs.supports_claim: The quadratic formula gives s=−ζωn±ωn√(ζ²−1); for |ζ|<1 this is −ζωn±jωn√(1−ζ²), whose modulus is ωn. For |ζ|>1 both roots are real, so the complex-root modulus interpretation does not apply.

facts.statement: 표준 영점 없는 2차계의 0<ζ<1 부족감쇠 단위계단 응답은 감쇠진동과 오버슈트를 보이며, ζ가 작아질수록 오버슈트가 커진다.

verification_refs.citation: 부족감쇠 2차계 단위계단 응답식
verification_refs.locator: Mp=exp(−πζ/√(1−ζ²))
verification_refs.supports_claim: For 0<ζ<1, the characteristic roots are complex with negative real part, yielding decaying sinusoidal response. The standard step overshoot ratio is exp(−πζ/√(1−ζ²)), which is positive and increases as ζ decreases.

facts.statement: 표준 2차계의 ζ=1에서는 특성방정식이 중근을 가지며, 표준 단위계단 응답은 오버슈트 없이 최종값에 접근한다.

verification_refs.citation: 임계감쇠 2차계 극점과 단위계단 응답
verification_refs.locator: (s+ωn)²; y(t)=1−(1+ωnt)e^(−ωnt) for unit DC gain
verification_refs.supports_claim: At ζ=1 the characteristic polynomial is (s+ωn)². For a standard zero-free system with positive unit DC gain, the step response is monotonic and approaches its final value without overshoot.

facts.statement: 같은 ωn을 가진 표준 영점 없는 2차계에서 ζ>1이면 두 개의 서로 다른 안정 실극점이 생기고 단위계단 응답은 오버슈트 없이 접근한다. 느린 지배극의 감쇠율은 ζ=1의 중근보다 작지만, 이를 모든 응답시간 지표의 보편적 비교로 확대하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: 과대감쇠 2차계 실극점 및 계단응답 부분분수 유도
verification_refs.locator: poles −ωn(ζ±√(ζ²−1)); positive residues for unit-step response
verification_refs.supports_claim: For ζ>1 the poles are distinct, stable and real. In the canonical zero-free positive-gain case, the unit-step response is monotonic. The slow pole has a smaller decay-rate magnitude than the repeated ζ=1 pole at equal ωn; this establishes a tail-rate comparison, not a universal comparison of every finite-time response metric.

facts.statement: 표준 2차계에서 ωn>0, ζ=0이면 단순 순허수 극점 ±jωn으로 자유응답이 지속진동한다. 이는 점근안정이나 BIBO 안정이 아니며, 공진주파수의 정현파 입력에는 이상적 선형모델 출력이 비유계로 증가할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: 무감쇠 2차계의 극점·자유응답·공진 입력 응답
verification_refs.locator: s²+ωn²=0; forced response at ω=ωn
verification_refs.supports_claim: With ζ=0 the poles are simple at ±jωn and the zero-input response is a sustained sinusoid, not asymptotically decaying. A sinusoidal input at resonance produces an output term growing linearly in time in the ideal undamped model, so bounded input can produce unbounded output and BIBO stability does not hold.

facts.statement: 표준 2차계에서 ωn>0, ζ<0이면 극점 실수부가 양수가 되어 자유응답 성분이 지수적으로 증가하고 시스템은 불안정하다.

verification_refs.citation: 감쇠비 음수인 표준 2차 특성방정식의 근 분석
verification_refs.locator: s=−ζωn±ωn√(ζ²−1) with ζ<0
verification_refs.supports_claim: For ζ<0 and ωn>0, both cases yield poles with positive real part: for −1<ζ<0 the real part is −ζωn>0, and for ζ≤−1 the larger real root is positive. Thus a natural-response component grows exponentially and the system is unstable.

facts.statement: 표준 음의 피드백에서 E(s)=R(s)−H(s)Y(s), Y(s)=G(s)E(s), 루프 전달함수 L(s)=G(s)H(s)이다.

verification_refs.citation: 음의 피드백 블록선도 합산점 및 루프이득 정의
verification_refs.locator: E=R−HY; Y=GE; L=GH
verification_refs.supports_claim: By the standard negative-feedback summing junction, error equals reference minus measured feedback; with forward transfer G and feedback transfer H, the loop transfer is GH.

facts.statement: 표준 음의 피드백에서 Y(s)/R(s)=G(s)/[1+G(s)H(s)]이고 폐루프 특성방정식은 1+G(s)H(s)=0이다. 단위 피드백이면 Y/R=L/(1+L)이다.

verification_refs.citation: 음의 피드백 폐루프 전달함수 대수 유도
verification_refs.locator: Y=G(R−HY); solve for Y/R
verification_refs.supports_claim: Solving Y=G(R−HY) gives Y/R=G/(1+GH); the characteristic equation is the denominator 1+GH=0. For H=1 and L=G, this is L/(1+L).

facts.statement: S(s)=1/[1+L(s)], T(s)=L(s)/[1+L(s)]이며 S(s)+T(s)=1이다. 민감도와 상보 민감도는 서로 다른 전달함수다.

verification_refs.citation: 폐루프 민감도 함수의 정의 및 항등식
verification_refs.supports_claim: From the definitions, S+T=(1+L)/(1+L)=1. Except at singular points and special degeneracies, S and T are not the same function.

facts.statement: 피드백 전달 H가 고정된 경우 순방향 전달 G의 미소 상대 변화에 대한 폐루프 기준입력 전달함수 G/(1+GH)의 상대 민감도는 S=1/(1+GH)이다.

verification_refs.citation: 폐루프 전달함수의 G에 대한 로그 미분
verification_refs.locator: d ln[G/(1+GH)] / d ln G = 1/(1+GH)
verification_refs.supports_claim: For H fixed, differentiating T_r=G/(1+GH) gives (G/T_r)(∂T_r/∂G)=1/(1+GH)=S. Thus |L|≫1 may reduce this relative sensitivity where the loop is well-defined, but not arbitrarily at every frequency.

facts.statement: 단위 음의 피드백에서 출력 합산점에 더해지는 외란의 전달경로는 S=1/(1+L), 측정값에 더해지는 잡음의 출력 전달경로는 −T=−L/(1+L)이다.

verification_refs.citation: 출력외란·측정잡음 합산 위치별 단위피드백 전달경로 유도
verification_refs.locator: E=R−(Y+N); Y=GE+D
verification_refs.supports_claim: Solving the stated equations gives Y=G/(1+G)R+1/(1+G)D−G/(1+G)N. For L=G and H=1, the output disturbance path is S and measurement-noise path is −T. Other injection points yield different paths.

facts.statement: 정상상태 오차는 조건을 만족할 때 e_ss=lim(s→0)sE(s)로 구한다. 최종값 정리를 쓰려면 sE(s)의 모든 극이 개방 좌반평면에 있어야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: 라플라스 최종값 정리의 극 조건
verification_refs.locator: lim(t→∞)e(t)=lim(s→0)sE(s) when poles of sE(s) lie in LHP
verification_refs.supports_claim: The final value theorem gives the steady-state limit only when the limit exists and every pole of sE(s) is strictly in the open left half-plane; right-half-plane or imaginary-axis poles invalidate this convergence condition.

facts.statement: 표준 단위 피드백에서 L(s)=L0(s)/s^n, 0<|L0(0)|<∞이고 원점 상쇄가 반영된 경우, 상쇄 후 남은 원점 극의 수 n을 Type n이라 한다. 정적 오차상수는 Kp=lim L, Kv=lim sL, Ka=lim s²L이다.

verification_refs.citation: 단위피드백 개루프의 원점 pole 차수 및 오차상수 정의
verification_refs.locator: L(s)=L0(s)/s^n and low-frequency limits
verification_refs.supports_claim: System type is the number of uncancelled integrators (open-loop poles at the origin) in the effective loop. The position, velocity and acceleration error constants are respectively the low-frequency limits of L, sL and s²L, provided those limits are defined.

facts.statement: 안정한 표준 단위 피드백에서 단위 계단·램프·포물선 입력의 정상상태 오차는 시스템 형과 정의 가능한 Kp, Kv, Ka에 따라 계산한다: Type 0 계단오차 1/(1+Kp), Type 1 램프오차 1/Kv, Type 2 포물선오차 1/Ka이며 낮은 차수 입력에 대한 Type 1·2 오차는 0이다.

verification_refs.citation: 최종값 정리와 단위피드백 오차상수를 이용한 계단·램프·포물선 오차 유도
verification_refs.locator: E=R/(1+L), apply R=1/s, 1/s² and 1/s³
verification_refs.supports_claim: Substituting unit step, ramp and parabolic inputs into E=R/(1+L) and applying the final value theorem yields the stated error-constant formulas under closed-loop stability and finite relevant constants. Type 1 and 2 systems have zero steady-state error for lower-order polynomial inputs.

facts.statement: 표준 안정 단위 피드백에서 유효 루프에 상쇄되지 않은 원점 적분기를 추가하면 시스템 형이 증가해 해당 조건의 정상상태 오차를 줄이거나 제거할 수 있다. 적분 동작은 루프 위상여유를 줄일 수 있고, 액추에이터 포화 중 오차 적분은 windup을 일으킬 수 있어 포화가 있는 설계에서는 anti-windup 처리가 필요하다.

verification_refs.citation: 단위피드백의 원점 pole 차수와 정적 오차상수 정의로부터 유도
verification_refs.locator: L(s)=L0(s)/s^n; stable closed-loop step error and Kv relations
verification_refs.supports_claim: An uncancelled pole at the origin increases the effective unity-feedback system type by one. Under closed-loop stability and finite applicable error constants, the standard error-constant relations show the corresponding lower-order polynomial-input steady-state error can decrease or become zero. The 1/s factor contributes −90 degrees of phase where defined, so it can reduce phase margin absent compensating redesign.

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, Anti-Windup Control Using PID Controller Block
verification_refs.locator: Purpose; back-calculation and clamping methods
verification_refs.supports_claim: MathWorks documents that actuator saturation can cause PID integration windup and describes back-calculation, clamping and tracking anti-windup approaches.

facts.statement: 루프 대역폭 증가는 조건에 따라 추종과 외란응답을 빠르게 할 수 있지만 성능과 안정여유의 절충이 필요하다. 시간지연은 위상을 추가로 낮춰 대역폭과 폐루프 안정성을 제한한다. 폐루프 설계에서는 제어 대역 밖의 측정잡음 민감도와 미모델 동특성도 함께 제한해야 하며, 높은 대역폭을 무조건 목표로 삼지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, PID Tuning Algorithm
verification_refs.locator: Performance, robustness and loop bandwidth
verification_refs.supports_claim: MathWorks states that larger loop bandwidth makes reference tracking and disturbance suppression faster, while controller tuning must balance performance and robustness with gain/phase margins.

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, Analyze Control Systems with Delays
verification_refs.locator: Delay-induced phase shifts and bandwidth limitation
verification_refs.supports_claim: MathWorks states that delays cause linear phase shifts that limit control bandwidth and affect closed-loop stability.

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, PID Tuning for Setpoint Tracking vs. Disturbance Rejection
verification_refs.locator: Loop gain inside and outside control bandwidth
verification_refs.supports_claim: The documented design guidance uses high loop gain inside the control bandwidth for disturbance rejection and low gain outside it to reduce measurement-noise sensitivity and sensitivity to unmodeled plant dynamics.

facts.statement: 담금 깊이와 보호관 선정은 감지부 길이, 센서 지름, 보호관 재질·형상, 유속, 목표 정확도, 대상 온도와 주변 온도 차이를 함께 고려해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: WIKA, Operating Instructions: Thermowells and Temperature Probes
verification_refs.locator: 5.1 Mounting the probe
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manufacturer instructs that, where possible, the stem should be exposed to the measured temperature, describes insufficient immersion and mounting heat conduction as error sources, and requires material compatibility checks; these factors are application- and geometry-dependent.

verification_refs.citation: NBS, A Commentary on the Instrumentation for Building Energy Monitoring and Control Systems (EMCS)
verification_refs.locator: Temperature sensor installation precautions
verification_refs.supports_claim: The NBS guidance states that thermowell immersion depth must minimize conduction loss, notes pipe geometry can require angled or tee installation, and discusses flow and insulation-related installation considerations rather than prescribing a universal depth.

facts.statement: 금속 스트레인 게이지는 피측정체의 변형을 길이, 단면적 및 비저항 변화에 따른 전기저항 변화로 변환한다.

verification_refs.citation: Micro-Measurements, What Is a Strain Gage?
verification_refs.locator: Strain gage operating principle
verification_refs.supports_claim: A bonded metallic strain gage changes electrical resistance as it follows specimen deformation; the relation follows R=ρL/A, so strain-driven changes in length, cross-section and resistivity contribute.

facts.statement: 게이지율은 기계적 변형률에 대한 상대 저항변화의 비로 GF=(ΔR/R)/ε로 정의한다.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Measuring Strain with Strain Gages
verification_refs.locator: Strain and gage factor definitions
verification_refs.supports_claim: NI defines strain as fractional length change and describes the gage-factor relation between strain and fractional resistance change; rearrangement gives GF=(ΔR/R)/ε.

facts.statement: 축방향 변형률은 포아송비에 따른 횡방향 변형률을 발생시키며, 이 효과가 스트레인 게이지의 단면적 변화와 게이지율에 기여한다.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Measuring Strain with Strain Gages
verification_refs.locator: Poisson effect and bridge configuration
verification_refs.supports_claim: NI identifies Poisson effects in strain-gage measurement and notes bridge configurations may cancel or measure them. Under the stated isotropic linear-elastic assumption, transverse strain is −ν times axial strain and contributes through the gauge's transverse dimension to resistance change.

facts.statement: 휘트스톤 브리지는 네 저항의 비가 평형조건을 만족할 때 차동 출력이 0이 되고, 게이지 저항 변화에 따라 불평형 전압이 발생한다.

verification_refs.citation: 표준 4-arm 휘트스톤 브리지 분압식 유도
verification_refs.locator: Vout=Vex(R2/(R1+R2)−R4/(R3+R4)); balance iff R1/R2=R3/R4
verification_refs.supports_claim: Equating the two divider midpoint voltages yields the standard resistance-ratio balance condition and zero differential output. Changing a gauge-arm resistance away from balance produces a nonzero differential voltage.

facts.statement: Quarter bridge는 한 개의 활성 게이지를 사용하며, 작은 변형률에서 출력 크기는 대략 Vo/Vex≈GF·ε/4이다.

verification_refs.citation: 한 arm 저항변화에 대한 Wheatstone bridge 분압식 선형화
verification_refs.locator: ΔR/R=GF·ε; linearize bridge output at R1=R2=R3=R4
verification_refs.supports_claim: Linearizing the balanced four-arm bridge equation for one active arm gives |Vo/Vex|≈|ΔR/R|/4=|GF·ε|/4; sign depends on active-arm position and wiring. Micro-Measurements independently identifies the single-active-arm arrangement as quarter bridge.

verification_refs.citation: Micro-Measurements, Strain Gage Output
verification_refs.locator: Quarter-bridge definition and output
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines a quarter bridge as one strain-gage arm and reports its output relationship for the stated gauge factor and strain regime.

facts.statement: Half bridge는 두 개의 게이지를 사용한다. 두 활성 게이지를 출력이 합산되도록 배치하면 Quarter bridge보다 감도가 높아지고, 활성·더미 구성은 주로 온도보상을 제공한다.

verification_refs.citation: Micro-Measurements, Introduction to Strain Gage Measurements
verification_refs.locator: Half-bridge circuits and temperature compensation
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes two-gage half-bridge arrangements, bridge completion/dummy gages, and temperature-related effects; the output depends on the active-gage placement and wiring.

verification_refs.citation: 두 active-arm 저항변화를 표준 bridge식에 대입한 선형화
verification_refs.locator: Additive arm changes produce twice the one-active-arm first-order output
verification_refs.supports_claim: For two active gauges with opposite-sign strain responses connected to add their bridge contributions, the first-order output magnitude exceeds the one-active-arm quarter-bridge result; a thermally matched dummy gauge can compensate common temperature resistance change but does not provide the same mechanical sensitivity as a second active gauge.

facts.statement: Full bridge는 네 개의 활성 게이지를 사용하며, 인장과 압축 게이지를 출력이 합산되도록 배치하면 가장 높은 감도와 우수한 공통 온도보상을 얻을 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Interface, The Load Cell Primer
verification_refs.locator: Half bridge and full bridge connections; temperature effect on zero and output
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manufacturer states that a full bridge has four active legs, can be arranged for additive tensile/compressive response, provides twice the output of a half bridge and four times a quarter bridge, and allows compensation of zero/span temperature coefficients.

verification_refs.citation: Micro-Measurements, Strain Gage Output
verification_refs.locator: Full-bridge output
verification_refs.supports_claim: Reports full-bridge output as four times the single-active-gage quarter-bridge output under the stated matched-gage assumptions.

facts.statement: 스트레인 게이지식 로드셀은 하중을 탄성체의 변형으로 바꾸고, 게이지 저항변화와 브리지 불평형 전압을 거쳐 전기신호로 변환한다.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Measuring Load with Bridge-Based Sensors
verification_refs.locator: Force/load measurement and bridge-based load cell signal conditioning
verification_refs.supports_claim: NI describes force/load measurement using bridge-based sensors and the bridge output/signal-conditioning chain.

verification_refs.citation: Micro-Measurements, What Is a Strain Gage?
verification_refs.locator: Strain-gage transducer and load-cell application
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes strain gages as resistance transducers used in load cells and force sensors; the mechanical-elastic and resistance/bridge stages establish the stated transduction chain.

facts.statement: 로드셀의 브리지 출력은 여자전압에 비례하며 일반적으로 정격하중에서의 감도를 mV/V 단위로 표시한다.

verification_refs.citation: Micro-Measurements, Strain Gage Output
verification_refs.locator: Output versus excitation voltage and mV/V rating
verification_refs.supports_claim: Shows bridge output proportional to excitation and explains load-cell rated output in mV/V at full-scale load.

verification_refs.citation: Interface, Load Cell Basics Sensor Specifications
verification_refs.locator: Rated output specification
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies rated output in mV/V as a load-cell specification; the ratio normalizes signal output to the applied bridge excitation.

facts.statement: 로드셀의 작은 차동 브리지 출력은 계측증폭기에서 증폭한 뒤 필터링하고 ADC로 변환한다.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Measuring Load with Bridge-Based Sensors
verification_refs.locator: Signal conditioning for load cells
verification_refs.supports_claim: NI lists excitation, amplification, filtering and DAQ acquisition as signal-conditioning elements for unconditioned bridge-based load-cell measurements.

verification_refs.citation: Purdue University / National Instruments, An Instrumentation and Data Acquisition Course
verification_refs.locator: Strain-gage signal conditioning experiment
verification_refs.supports_claim: The documented strain transducer chain uses an instrumentation amplifier and active low-pass filter before delivery to a computer data-acquisition board.

facts.statement: 온도 변화는 게이지 저항, 접착층, 탄성체 열팽창과 탄성계수를 변화시켜 로드셀의 영점과 감도에 오차를 만든다.

verification_refs.citation: Interface, Understanding Load Cell Temperature Compensation
verification_refs.locator: Temperature effect on zero and output
verification_refs.supports_claim: Interface states that temperature affects both zero balance and output; strain-gage load-cell thermal error arises primarily from the force-bearing metal's temperature-dependent modulus and from gage/material properties, and compensation is used to reduce these effects.

verification_refs.citation: Interface, Temperature Compensation of High Temperature Load Cells
verification_refs.locator: Materials and temperature effects on zero/output
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manufacturer identifies gage, adhesive and insulation materials as temperature-sensitive and defines temperature effects on zero and output; the anchor's zero/sensitivity distinction is consistent with those definitions.

facts.statement: 크리프, 히스테리시스, 비직선성과 반복성은 서로 다른 로드셀 성능오차이며 각각의 시험조건과 정의로 평가해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Interface, Load Cell Basics Sensor Specifications
verification_refs.locator: Accuracy specifications and definitions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Interface lists nonlinearity, hysteresis, nonrepeatability and creep as separate performance specifications, defines nonrepeatability under identical loading/environmental conditions, and notes hysteresis depends on loading sequence.

verification_refs.citation: Interface, The Load Cell Primer
verification_refs.locator: Load-cell performance terminology
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manufacturer guide separately describes load-cell accuracy and time-dependent creep behaviors, confirming that these terms are distinct specified characteristics rather than interchangeable errors.

facts.statement: 열전대 측정은 측정접점과 기준접점의 온도차에 대응하는 열기전력을 측정하고, 기준접점 보상과 열전대 종류별 변환을 거쳐 온도로 환산한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Thermocouple: Mercury Thermometer Alternatives
verification_refs.locator: Thermocouples measure temperature differences
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST explains that thermocouples respond to the temperature difference between junctions and require a known reference point to determine temperature.

verification_refs.citation: NIST Monograph 175, Temperature-Electromotive Force Reference Functions and Tables Based on ITS-90
verification_refs.locator: Type-specific reference functions and tables
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST provides type-specific temperature–EMF reference functions and tables used to convert measured thermocouple EMF to temperature.

facts.statement: 서로 다른 열전대 재료의 열전기 특성과 접점 간 온도차가 열기전력을 결정하며, Seebeck 계수의 온도의존성 때문에 열전대 전압-온도 관계는 일반적으로 비선형이다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST Special Publication 250-35, The Calibration of Thermocouples and Thermocouple Materials
verification_refs.locator: Thermocouple emf and Seebeck coefficient
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST identifies thermocouple emf as Seebeck voltage and its temperature derivative as the Seebeck coefficient; the type-specific reference functions in NIST Monograph 175 are nonlinear polynomial functions over specified ranges.

verification_refs.citation: NIST Monograph 175, Temperature-Electromotive Force Reference Functions and Tables Based on ITS-90
verification_refs.locator: Polynomial reference functions
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST fits type-specific polynomial reference functions to thermocouple emf versus ITS-90 temperature data, demonstrating that a single constant linear conversion does not describe the full range.

facts.statement: 열전대 전압은 측정접점과 기준접점의 온도차에 대응하므로, 절대 측정접점 온도를 구하려면 기준접점 온도를 알아야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Thermocouple: Mercury Thermometer Alternatives
verification_refs.locator: Temperature difference and reference point
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST explicitly states that thermocouples are sensitive only to differences between two temperatures and that one circuit component must be maintained at a known reference point.

facts.statement: 전자식 냉접점 보상은 기준접점 온도를 측정하고 그 온도에 대응하는 열기전력을 보상하여 측정접점 온도로 환산한다. 단자대 접점들의 온도 불균일은 보상 오차를 만들 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Cold Junction Compensation and Why It Is Needed
verification_refs.locator: Reference junctions created at DAQ terminals and CJC
verification_refs.supports_claim: NI explains that instrument terminals create additional dissimilar-metal junctions and that cold-junction compensation accounts for their temperature contribution; CJC accuracy depends on measuring the terminal/reference temperature.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Thermocouple DAQ CJC and Voltage Correction
verification_refs.locator: Measure CJC temperature and convert to voltage correction
verification_refs.supports_claim: NI states that CJC requires measuring the reference-junction temperature and converting it to a voltage correction for the measured thermocouple voltage.

facts.statement: 열전대 회로에 제3 금속을 삽입할 때 그 금속과 열전대 재료 사이 두 접점이 같은 온도이면 순 열기전력 변화가 상쇄된다. 두 접점 온도가 다르면 추가 열기전력이 생길 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Seebeck 적분식에 의한 중간금속 법칙 유도
verification_refs.locator: Added-metal contribution is the difference of two equal-temperature Seebeck integrals
verification_refs.supports_claim: The added conductor introduces two junction contributions. If both are at the same temperature, their integrated Seebeck contributions cancel; if junction temperatures differ, cancellation is not guaranteed.

verification_refs.citation: NBS Special Publication 300, Precision Measurement and Calibration: Selected NBS Papers on Temperature
verification_refs.locator: Thermocouple laws of successive/intermediate temperatures
verification_refs.supports_claim: NBS documents thermocouple circuit laws and the dependence of thermoelectric emf on junction temperatures; the equal-temperature inserted-metal result follows from the same Seebeck integral relation.

facts.statement: 열전대의 기전력은 중간온도 법칙을 만족한다: E(T1,T3)=E(T1,T2)+E(T2,T3).

verification_refs.citation: NBS Special Publication 300, Precision Measurement and Calibration: Selected NBS Papers on Temperature
verification_refs.locator: Law of Successive or Intermediate Temperatures
verification_refs.supports_claim: The NBS text states that emf between T1 and T3 is the algebraic sum of emf from T1 to T2 and T2 to T3 for the same thermocouple.

facts.statement: 열전대 전압-온도 관계는 종류별로 비선형이며, 지정 온도범위에 맞는 NIST ITS-90 기준함수 또는 표를 사용해 환산해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST Monograph 175, Temperature-Electromotive Force Reference Functions and Tables Based on ITS-90
verification_refs.locator: Type-specific ITS-90 functions, tables and temperature ranges
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST provides distinct reference functions and tables by thermocouple type and specifies their valid temperature ranges for converting between emf and temperature.

facts.statement: Thermistor 온도 측정은 감온 소자의 저항 변화, 여기·측정회로, ADC 변환과 저항-온도 환산 및 보정으로 구성된다.

verification_refs.citation: TDK Electronics, NTC Thermistor Class Library for Python/C++
verification_refs.locator: Digital readout, ADC circuit, R/T curve and trimming classes
verification_refs.supports_claim: TDK documents converting NTC resistance through a measurement circuit and ADC to temperature using B-value, Steinhart–Hart, lookup tables and software trimming.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, A Simple Thermistor Interface to an ADC
verification_refs.locator: Divider measurement, ADC conversion and vendor R/T equation
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes thermistor resistance measurement through a divider and ADC followed by conversion through the vendor's thermistor equation or lookup table.

facts.statement: NTC Thermistor는 온도가 상승하면 저항이 감소하는 음의 온도계수 특성을 갖는다.

verification_refs.citation: TDK Electronics, NTC Thermistors: General Technical Information
verification_refs.locator: Temperature dependence of resistance
verification_refs.supports_claim: TDK describes NTC resistance as decreasing with increasing temperature and provides the R(T) relation.

verification_refs.citation: Panasonic, Basic Knowledge of an NTC Thermistor
verification_refs.locator: NTC/PTC temperature coefficient
verification_refs.supports_claim: Panasonic explicitly distinguishes NTC resistance decreasing and PTC resistance increasing with temperature.

facts.statement: NTC thermistor의 제한된 온도범위에서는 B-상수 식 R(T)=R(Tref)·exp[B(1/T−1/Tref)]으로 저항과 절대온도의 관계를 근사할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: TDK Electronics, NTC Thermistors: General Technical Information
verification_refs.locator: Formula 1; stated restricted-range accuracy
verification_refs.supports_claim: TDK gives R_T=R_R exp[B(1/T−1/T_R)], defines B as a material-specific constant in kelvin, and explicitly limits the approximation's useful accuracy to a restricted range around the rated point.

facts.statement: 넓은 온도범위 또는 높은 정확도가 필요하면 Steinhart–Hart 식, 다항식, 표준표 또는 다점 보정으로 Thermistor의 비선형 저항-온도 관계를 환산한다.

verification_refs.citation: TDK Electronics, NTC Thermistor Class Library for Python/C++
verification_refs.locator: B-value, Steinhart–Hart, lookup-table and trimming classes
verification_refs.supports_claim: TDK provides B-value and Steinhart–Hart models, lookup tables using multiple points, and single-point trimming; its general technical information says the B approximation is limited-range and uses higher-order models/tables for improved R/T description.

verification_refs.citation: TDK Electronics, NTC Thermistors: General Technical Information
verification_refs.locator: Steinhart–Hart and standardized R/T tables
verification_refs.supports_claim: TDK recommends more precise Steinhart–Hart models or tables when a more accurate resistance-temperature description across the specified range is required.

facts.statement: PTC Thermistor는 온도가 상승하면 저항이 증가하며, 재료에 따라 Curie 또는 전이온도 부근에서 저항이 급격히 증가하는 스위칭 특성을 이용할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Vishay, Solutions for Current Protection: PTC-Based Limiting Analysis
verification_refs.locator: PTC resistance-temperature characteristic and Curie temperature
verification_refs.supports_claim: Vishay states that PTC resistance increases as temperature rises and can increase rapidly near the Curie temperature; the behavior is specific to the PTC material/component.

verification_refs.citation: TDK Electronics, PTC Thermistors: General Technical Information
verification_refs.locator: Positive temperature coefficient and ceramic switching behavior
verification_refs.supports_claim: TDK identifies the positive resistance-temperature coefficient and explains PTC ceramic semiconductor behavior above its characteristic reference temperature.

facts.statement: Thermistor 저항은 전압분배기, 브리지 또는 정전류 여기회로를 이용해 측정 가능한 전압으로 변환할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Thermistor-Based Temperature Sensing System—Part 1
verification_refs.locator: Thermistor circuit configurations
verification_refs.supports_claim: ADI describes voltage-divider and constant-current excitation configurations for converting thermistor resistance into measurable voltage; bridge implementations are the corresponding differential divider form.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, A Simple Thermistor Interface to an ADC
verification_refs.locator: Half-bridge/resistor-divider measurement
verification_refs.supports_claim: Demonstrates a thermistor in a half-bridge (resistive divider) circuit to measure its resistance as voltage.

facts.statement: ADC 기준전압과 Thermistor 분압 여기전압을 같은 기준에서 취하는 비율측정은 이상적 회로에서 전원 변동 영향을 상쇄할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, A Simple Thermistor Interface to an ADC
verification_refs.locator: Ratiometric divider and ADC reference
verification_refs.supports_claim: ADI derives a thermistor divider/ADC arrangement where the same VREF excites the divider and serves as ADC reference, causing the excitation term to cancel from the conversion.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Thermistor-Based Temperature Sensing System—Part 1
verification_refs.locator: Ratiometric configuration
verification_refs.supports_claim: ADI states that using the same excitation reference for the thermistor circuit and ADC removes errors associated with excitation-source variation, subject to component/reference errors.

facts.statement: Thermistor에 측정전류가 흐르면 줄열에 의한 자기발열이 발생해 주변과 열평형 온도에서 저항이 달라지고 측정오차를 만들 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: TDK Electronics, NTC Thermistors: General Technical Information
verification_refs.locator: Loaded versus zero-power characteristics; self-heating
verification_refs.supports_claim: TDK explains that current through a thermistor can heat it above ambient and distinguishes electrically loaded characteristics from zero-power characteristics; self-heating may be negligible or intentionally used depending on application.

verification_refs.citation: Murata, Basic Characteristics of NTC Thermistors
verification_refs.locator: Self-heating effect
verification_refs.supports_claim: Murata states that internally generated heat raises the NTC body temperature and changes its resistance.

facts.statement: Thermistor의 열시정수와 설치·열전달 조건은 온도 변화에 대한 동적 응답과 지연오차에 영향을 준다.

verification_refs.citation: Vishay, R.I.F.A.Q.: Thermistors
verification_refs.locator: Thermal response time definition and measurement conditions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Vishay defines response time by the time to reach 63.2% of a temperature step and specifies that the value depends on the test transition and medium (for example air versus water/oil).

verification_refs.citation: TDK Electronics, NTC Thermistors: General Technical Information
verification_refs.locator: Dissipation factor and thermal time constant
verification_refs.supports_claim: TDK defines thermal time constant and dissipation factor under specified thermal conditions; these characteristics depend on the sensor and its heat-transfer environment.

facts.statement: 연속시간 선형시불변 폐루프 시스템의 점근안정 조건은 특성방정식의 모든 근이 열린 좌반평면에 존재하는 것이다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 10: Stability Analysis—The Routh-Hurwitz Approach
verification_refs.locator: Definition of asymptotic stability and pole location
verification_refs.supports_claim: The lecture defines asymptotic stability for finite-dimensional continuous-time systems by all characteristic roots/eigenvalues having negative real part.

facts.statement: 정규 Routh 배열에서 첫 열의 부호 변화 횟수는 중복도를 포함한 특성다항식의 우반평면 근 개수와 같다. 허수축 근 특수 경우는 별도로 판정해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 10: Stability Analysis—The Routh-Hurwitz Approach
verification_refs.locator: Routh first-column sign-change theorem and special cases
verification_refs.supports_claim: The lecture states that first-column sign changes count right-half-plane poles and separately identifies epsilon and all-zero-row cases requiring special handling.

verification_refs.citation: MIT OpenCourseWare, Electronic Feedback Systems, Chapter 4: The Routh Criterion
verification_refs.locator: Routh criterion and imaginary-axis special cases
verification_refs.supports_claim: MIT OCW describes the sign-change count for right-half-plane zeros and the auxiliary-polynomial treatment for symmetric/imaginary-axis cases.

facts.statement: 실계수 특성다항식을 양의 최고차항으로 정규화하면 모든 계수가 양수인 것은 안정의 필요조건이지만 3차 이상에서는 일반적으로 충분조건이 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: 3차 다항식 s³+s²+s+2의 Routh 배열 반례
verification_refs.locator: First column 1, 1, −1, 2 has two sign changes despite positive polynomial coefficients
verification_refs.supports_claim: For p(s)=s³+s²+s+2 all coefficients are positive, but the Routh array first column is 1, 1, −1, 2, so there are two right-half-plane roots. Positivity is necessary but not sufficient for cubic and higher-order polynomials.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 10: Stability Analysis—The Routh-Hurwitz Approach
verification_refs.locator: Coefficient conditions versus Routh criterion
verification_refs.supports_claim: The lecture distinguishes simple coefficient sign conditions from the Routh test needed to count right-half-plane roots.

facts.statement: 특성다항식 P(s)=a_nsⁿ+a_(n−1)sⁿ⁻¹+…에서 Routh 배열 첫 행은 a_n,a_(n−2),a_(n−4),…이고 둘째 행은 a_(n−1),a_(n−3),a_(n−5),…이다.

verification_refs.citation: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Routh Tutorial
verification_refs.locator: Construction of the first two rows
verification_refs.supports_claim: The tutorial explicitly lays out the first row with coefficients a_n,a_(n−2),… and the second with a_(n−1),a_(n−3),… .

facts.statement: Routh 배열의 다음 행은 바로 위의 두 행으로부터 교차곱과 공통분모 정규화 방식으로 계산하며, 한 부호 convention을 끝까지 일관되게 적용한다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 10: Stability Analysis—The Routh-Hurwitz Approach
verification_refs.locator: Routh array recurrence
verification_refs.supports_claim: The lecture constructs each subsequent row from adjacent rows using determinant/cross-product terms and treats zero-pivot cases separately.

verification_refs.citation: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Routh Tutorial
verification_refs.locator: Routh row formula
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides the recursive cross-multiplication formula for new Routh-array rows.

facts.statement: 행의 첫 원소만 0이고 행 전체가 0이 아니면 첫 원소를 ε>0으로 두고 배열을 계산한 뒤 ε→0⁺ 극한의 첫 열 부호변화를 판정한다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 10: Stability Analysis—The Routh-Hurwitz Approach
verification_refs.locator: Zero in first column special case
verification_refs.supports_claim: The lecture handles a zero first-column entry with a small positive epsilon and determines the sign-change limit as epsilon approaches zero from above, distinguishing this from an entire zero row.

facts.statement: Routh 배열의 한 행 전체가 0이면 바로 위 행으로 보조다항식 A(s)를 만들고 dA(s)/ds의 계수를 0행에 대입해 배열 계산을 계속한다.

verification_refs.citation: MIT OpenCourseWare, Electronic Feedback Systems, Chapter 4: The Routh Criterion
verification_refs.locator: Auxiliary equation for an all-zero row
verification_refs.supports_claim: MIT OCW states that a row of zeros is replaced with coefficients of the derivative of the auxiliary equation formed from the row above.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 10: Stability Analysis—The Routh-Hurwitz Approach
verification_refs.locator: All-zero row and auxiliary polynomial
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes the auxiliary-polynomial and derivative-coefficient substitution procedure for a complete zero row.

facts.statement: 우반평면 근이 없고 허수축 근이 단순근이면 비점근 임계안정 가능성을 검토할 수 있으나, 허수축 중복근은 선형 자율계의 안정성을 깨뜨린다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 10: Stability Analysis—The Routh-Hurwitz Approach
verification_refs.locator: Imaginary-axis roots and marginal stability
verification_refs.supports_claim: The lecture treats symmetric/imaginary-axis roots separately. Linear-system modal solutions show simple imaginary-axis roots yield bounded non-decaying modes, whereas repeated imaginary-axis roots produce polynomially growing terms and instability.

verification_refs.citation: Jordan-form solution of a continuous-time linear system
verification_refs.locator: Repeated eigenvalue on imaginary axis produces t·e^(jωt) terms
verification_refs.supports_claim: A simple imaginary-axis pole produces bounded oscillatory natural response; a repeated pole creates polynomial-in-time terms such as t e^(jωt), so the state/output can grow without bound. Asymptotic stability still requires every pole strictly in the left half-plane.

facts.statement: 이득 K가 특성다항식에 포함되면 Routh 배열 첫 열의 각 항을 K의 식으로 구하고, 정규화된 점근안정 조건에서 이들이 모두 같은 양의 부호가 되는 엄격 부등식의 교집합으로 K 범위를 정한다.

verification_refs.citation: 매개변수 K를 포함한 Routh 배열 첫 열 조건의 대수적 교집합
verification_refs.locator: No RHP roots iff all regular first-column entries remain strictly positive after positive-leading-coefficient normalization
verification_refs.supports_claim: For each polynomial in the parameter family, the Routh criterion gives strict sign conditions on first-column expressions. Their simultaneous solution is the candidate asymptotic-stability interval; singular/boundary cases require separate analysis.

verification_refs.citation: Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Routh Tutorial
verification_refs.locator: Routh stability conditions and parameter examples
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains using first-column entries to determine the count of right-half-plane roots and hence parameterized stability conditions.

facts.statement: 계산된 이득 범위 경계는 허수축·원점 근, 중복근 또는 최고차항 소멸에 따른 차수 저하가 생길 수 있으므로 경계값에서 특성다항식과 Routh 특수행을 별도로 검사해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: MIT OpenCourseWare, Electronic Feedback Systems, Chapter 4: The Routh Criterion
verification_refs.locator: Imaginary-axis roots and zero-row special cases
verification_refs.supports_claim: The Routh method has separate treatments for zero first elements and all-zero rows, which represent boundary cases not resolved by simply applying regular strict inequalities.

verification_refs.citation: 경계 이득을 원 특성다항식에 대입하는 검증
verification_refs.locator: Check degree, zero roots and imaginary-axis factors at equality
verification_refs.supports_claim: At equality in a first-column condition, regular asymptotic-stability inequalities cease to hold; substituting the boundary parameter into the original polynomial identifies zero roots, imaginary-axis factors, multiplicity, or loss of degree that require explicit classification.

facts.statement: 모든 극점이 Re(s)<−α인지 확인하려면 s=z−α를 P(s)에 대입해 P(z−α)를 만들고, z 평면에서 Routh 판별을 적용한다.

verification_refs.citation: 복소근 평면 평행이동을 이용한 상대안정성 판별
verification_refs.locator: z=s+α maps Re(s)<−α to Re(z)<0
verification_refs.supports_claim: With s=z−α, a root s_i satisfies Re(s_i)<−α exactly when the shifted root z_i=s_i+α lies in the open left half-plane. Applying Routh to P(z−α) therefore tests the stated relative-stability bound.

facts.statement: Routh–Hurwitz 판별은 유한차수 다항식의 근을 대상으로 하므로 e^(−Ls)가 포함된 초월 특성방정식에는 직접 적용할 수 없고, Padé 근사 등 유한차수 근사나 Nyquist 같은 주파수영역 방법을 사용한다.

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, Analyze Control Systems with Delays
verification_refs.locator: Delay systems, exact response and Pade approximation
verification_refs.supports_claim: MathWorks treats exact delays separately and describes Padé rational approximation for polynomial-model analysis; a pure delay yields a transcendental characteristic equation rather than a finite polynomial.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 10: Stability Analysis—The Routh-Hurwitz Approach
verification_refs.locator: Routh criterion applies to characteristic polynomials
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines the Routh array for finite-degree characteristic polynomials, so an exact delay transcendental equation is outside the direct polynomial procedure.

facts.statement: Routh 배열은 특성다항식의 우반평면 근 개수와 안정 조건을 판정하지만 일반적으로 근의 정확한 위치, 감쇠비 또는 안정여유를 직접 산출하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 10: Stability Analysis—The Routh-Hurwitz Approach
verification_refs.locator: Routh criterion counts RHP poles without computing roots
verification_refs.supports_claim: The lecture states that Routh counts right-half-plane poles from polynomial coefficients without computing their locations; exact damping and margins require other analyses.
