verification_refs.citation: MIT OpenCourseWare, Electronic Feedback Systems, Chapter 4: The Routh Criterion
verification_refs.locator: Routh first-column information
verification_refs.supports_claim: MIT OCW notes that the first column identifies the number of right-half-plane zeros, not exact root positions.

facts.statement: 표준 단위 음의 피드백에서 개루프 KG(s)H(s)의 근궤적은 폐루프 특성방정식 1+KG(s)H(s)=0의 근이 이득 K에 따라 이동하는 궤적이다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 13: The Root Locus Technique
verification_refs.locator: Characteristic equation and varying gain
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines the root locus as the closed-loop pole locations satisfying 1+KG(s)=0 as the scalar gain varies.

facts.statement: 표준 양의 이득 근궤적은 K가 0에서 무한대로 변할 때 폐루프 극점이 s-평면에 그리는 궤적이다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 13: The Root Locus Technique
verification_refs.locator: Definition and gain range of root locus
verification_refs.supports_claim: The standard root locus describes closed-loop pole locations as positive gain varies from zero to infinity.

facts.statement: 표준 proper 전달함수의 n개 근궤적 가지는 개루프 극점에서 시작해 m개의 유한 개루프 영점과 n−m개의 영점(무한대)으로 끝난다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 13: The Root Locus Technique
verification_refs.locator: Branches start at open-loop poles and end at zeros including infinity
verification_refs.supports_claim: The root-locus rules give n branches starting at n open-loop poles and ending at m finite open-loop zeros, with the remaining n−m branches tending to infinity for a proper transfer function.

facts.statement: 표준 양의 이득 실수계 근궤적에서 실수축의 한 점 오른쪽에 있는 실수 개루프 극점과 영점 수가 홀수인 구간이 실수축 근궤적이다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 13: The Root Locus Technique
verification_refs.locator: Real-axis root locus rule
verification_refs.supports_claim: States the odd-count rule for real open-loop poles and zeros to the right of a real-axis test point for positive gain.

facts.statement: n차 proper 개루프 전달함수에 m개의 유한 영점이 있으면 무한대 점근선은 n−m개이며 각도는 θq=(2q+1)180°/(n−m), q=0,…,n−m−1이다.

verification_refs.citation: MIT OpenCourseWare 2.004, Summary of Root Locus Sketching Rules
verification_refs.locator: Number and angles of asymptotes
verification_refs.supports_claim: MIT gives n−m asymptotes with angles (2q+1)π/(n−m), equivalent to the stated degree formula.

facts.statement: 근궤적 점근선의 실수축 교점은 σa=(Σpi−Σzi)/(n−m)이며 극점·영점은 중복도를 포함해 합산한다.

verification_refs.citation: MIT OpenCourseWare 2.004, Summary of Root Locus Sketching Rules
verification_refs.locator: Asymptote centroid formula
verification_refs.supports_claim: MIT specifies the asymptote centroid as (sum of poles minus sum of zeros)/(n−m).

facts.statement: 실수축 이탈·진입점 후보는 K(s)=−1/[G(s)H(s)]에서 dK/ds=0인 점으로 구하며, 실제 근궤적 구간과 중복근 조건을 확인해 유효성을 판정한다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 13: The Root Locus Technique
verification_refs.locator: Breakaway/break-in condition dK/ds=0
verification_refs.supports_claim: The lecture derives break-away and break-in candidates from dK/ds=0 and notes candidates must be checked against the root-locus conditions.

verification_refs.citation: MIT OpenCourseWare 2.004, Summary of Root Locus Sketching Rules
verification_refs.locator: Breakaway/in point equation
verification_refs.supports_claim: MIT gives the equivalent numerator-denominator derivative equation for real-axis breakaway/break-in candidates.

facts.statement: 복소 개루프 극점의 출발각과 복소 개루프 영점의 도착각은 근궤적 각도조건에서 대상 특이점의 기여를 분리하고 나머지 극점·영점 각도를 합산하여 구한다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 14: Angles of Departure and Arrival
verification_refs.locator: Angle condition at complex poles and zeros
verification_refs.supports_claim: Derives departure and arrival angles by applying the angle condition at the selected pole or zero and summing angle contributions from the other open-loop poles and zeros.

facts.statement: 근궤적의 허수축 교차점과 해당 임계 이득은 특성방정식에 s=jω를 대입하거나 Routh 배열의 경계조건으로 구한다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 13: The Root Locus Technique
verification_refs.locator: Imaginary-axis crossings from Routh
verification_refs.supports_claim: The lecture identifies imaginary-axis crossings from the characteristic equation and Routh criterion as a root-locus refinement.

verification_refs.citation: 특성방정식에 s=jω를 대입한 실수·허수부 분리
verification_refs.locator: Solve real and imaginary equations for ω and K
verification_refs.supports_claim: A characteristic root on the imaginary axis has s=jω; substituting into a real-coefficient characteristic polynomial and setting real and imaginary parts to zero yields candidate crossing frequencies and gain values.

facts.statement: 표준 양의 이득 근궤적의 설계점 s_d가 각도조건을 만족하면 이득은 K=1/|G(s_d)H(s_d)|로 계산한다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 13: The Root Locus Technique
verification_refs.locator: Magnitude condition and gain at locus point
verification_refs.supports_claim: The magnitude condition gives K|G(s_d)H(s_d)|=1 for a point on the positive-gain locus, hence the reciprocal-magnitude formula.

facts.statement: 표준 음의 피드백에서 양의 이득 근궤적의 점은 ∠G(s)H(s)=(2q+1)180°의 홀수배 위상조건을 만족한다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Washington, Lecture 13: The Root Locus Technique
verification_refs.locator: Angle condition for the root locus

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, Control System Designer Design Requirements

verification_refs.supports_claim: States that settling-time boundaries for higher-order systems are approximations based on second-order dominant systems, while damping-ratio requirements define pole-location regions; this makes the approximation conditional, not universal.

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, Model Reduction Basics
verification_refs.locator: Approximation methods discard states/poles with low effect on overall response and preserve relevant dynamics
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes approximate model reduction as discarding modes with relatively low effect on the overall response; supports checking that neglected/non-dominant dynamics actually have small effect before relying on a dominant-mode approximation.

facts.statement: P 동작의 출력 성분은 오차에 비례한다. 플랜트와 운전조건에 따라 P gain 증가는 응답을 빠르게 할 수 있지만, 특히 dead time이 큰 사례에서는 overshoot 증가와 안정도 저하를 일으킬 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) Controllers
verification_refs.locator: Parallel and standard PID equations defining proportional gain Kp
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines proportional action as the Kp term in the controller transfer function; for an error-input controller this yields a control-output component proportional to error.

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, Control of Processes with Long Dead Time: The Smith Predictor
verification_refs.locator: Increasing proportional gain Kp: response speed, overshoot and instability
verification_refs.supports_claim: In the documented long-dead-time process example, increasing Kp speeds response but significantly increases overshoot and quickly leads to instability; this fact limits that effect to plant-dependent conditions rather than asserting a universal monotonic rule.

facts.statement: RTD는 수동형 센서로, 소자에 여기전류를 공급하고 단자전압을 측정해 저항을 구한 뒤 저항-온도 관계로 온도를 산출한다.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Taking Temperature Measurements with RTDs: How-To Guide
verification_refs.locator: RTD Overview and How to Make an RTD Measurement
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that an RTD is a passive measurement device requiring supplied excitation current, that voltage is read across its terminals to determine resistance, and that resistance is converted to temperature.

facts.statement: 금속 RTD는 금속의 전기저항이 온도에 따라 변하는 특성을 이용하며, 백금은 넓은 측정범위와 정확도·안정성 때문에 가장 널리 쓰이는 RTD 재료이다.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Taking Temperature Measurements with RTDs: How-To Guide
verification_refs.locator: RTD Fundamentals
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that RTDs operate by changes in electrical resistance of pure metals with temperature, and identifies platinum as by far the most common because of its wide temperature range, accuracy, and stability.

facts.statement: NTC thermistor는 온도가 상승할수록 저항이 감소하는 열감응성 반도체 저항기이며, 저항 변화는 외부 온도 변화 또는 소자 전류에 의한 자기발열로 발생할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: TDK Electronics, NTC thermistors: General technical information
verification_refs.locator: Section 1 Definition
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines NTC thermistors as thermally sensitive semiconductor resistors whose resistance decreases as temperature increases; states resistance can also change internally through current-induced self-heating.

facts.statement: 압전 직접효과에서 기계적 압력·장력 또는 힘은 압전재료에 전하를 발생시키며, 압전식 센서는 이 기계-전기 변환을 측정에 이용한다.

verification_refs.citation: CeramTec, Basics of Piezo-Ceramic Technology
verification_refs.locator: Piezoelectric working principle and direct piezoelectric effect
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that certain crystals generate electrical charge when mechanically loaded by pressure or tension (direct piezo effect), and that charge polarity depends on crystal orientation relative to pressure.

facts.statement: 단축 선형 동작과 단락 전기조건에서 압전소자의 생성 전하는 Q=dF로 표현되며, d는 재료와 방향 인덱스에 따라 달라지는 압전 charge coefficient이다.

verification_refs.citation: CeramTec, Piezo Terminology: A Glossary
verification_refs.locator: Charge constant, piezoelectric d
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines piezoelectric d as the direct-effect ratio of generated charge to applied force and gives Q=d·F for a short-circuited piezoceramic element (E=0).

verification_refs.citation: PIEZO.COM, Piezo Terminology & Glossary
verification_refs.locator: Charge coefficient direction indices d33, d31, d15
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that charge coefficients carry direction indices identifying force and electrode orientations, so d is not a time derivative and its component depends on the selected material axes and loading geometry.

facts.statement: 직접 압전효과는 기계적 하중으로 전하를 발생시키는 센싱 원리이고, 역압전효과는 전기장 인가로 기계적 변형을 일으키는 구동 원리이다.

verification_refs.citation: CeramTec, Basics of Piezo-Ceramic Technology
verification_refs.locator: Direct and inverse piezoelectric effect
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines direct effect as charge generation under mechanical pressure/tension and inverse effect as controlled deformation under an electric field.

facts.statement: 전하출력 압전소자의 기본 등가회로는 생성 전하원과 소자 정전용량 Cp, 절연·누설을 나타내는 병렬저항 Rp로 모델링할 수 있으며 실제 입력회로에는 케이블과 계측기 임피던스도 포함해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: PIEZO.COM, Electronics Overview
verification_refs.locator: Piezo charge and voltage generator equivalent circuit
verification_refs.supports_claim: Models a piezo charge generator with piezo capacitance Cp and internal resistance Rp in the equivalent circuit.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Transducer Interfacing Handbook, Chapter 1
verification_refs.locator: Piezoelectric transducer as a circuit element and charge-amplifier interface
verification_refs.supports_claim: Shows the piezoelectric sensor capacitance and charge source connected to an amplifier input; sensor cable and input network are part of the measurement circuit and affect high-impedance charge measurement.

facts.statement: 이상적인 개방회로 근사에서 압전 전압은 V=Q/C이며, 단순 전압입력 측정의 감도와 주파수응답은 센서·케이블·입력의 등가 정전용량과 누설저항에 좌우된다.

verification_refs.citation: PIEZO.COM, Electronics Overview
verification_refs.locator: Voltage from charge and piezo capacitance; RC time constant
verification_refs.supports_claim: Gives V=Q/Cp for the voltage-generator model and explains that charge decay depends on the sensor RC time constant.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Transducer Interfacing Handbook, Chapter 1
verification_refs.locator: Capacitive sensor and cable loading in piezoelectric voltage measurement
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes the piezoelectric transducer as a high-impedance capacitive source whose cable and input capacitances load the voltage measurement and affect its response.

facts.statement: 압전소자 출력전하는 유한한 절연저항·입력저항 경로로 시간에 따라 감소하며, 전기적 시정수 τ=RC 때문에 무기한 정하중의 영구 측정에는 한계가 있다.

verification_refs.citation: PIEZO.COM, Electronics Overview
verification_refs.locator: Electrical time constant and charge decay
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that charge on a piezo sensor decays over time at a rate determined by its RC time constant.

verification_refs.citation: Kistler, Piezoelectric pressure sensor: charge (PE) vs. voltage (IEPE) output
verification_refs.locator: Application limits of charge-output and IEPE sensors
verification_refs.supports_claim: Distinguishes quasi-static-capable charge-output sensors from IEPE sensors that are not suitable for quasi-static measurement, consistent with finite charge-decay limits and circuit time constants.

facts.statement: 이상적인 charge amplifier의 출력 변화는 ΔVo≈−ΔQ/Cf이며, feedback capacitor Cf가 전하-전압 변환이득을 정한다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, CN0350 Circuit Note
verification_refs.locator: Charge amplifier feedback capacitance equation
verification_refs.supports_claim: Gives output voltage change ΔV=Δq/Cf for charge delivered to the feedback capacitor; the inverting charge-amplifier polarity supplies the negative sign.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Transducer Interfacing Handbook, Chapter 1
verification_refs.locator: ΔQ=−CfΔEout
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explicitly derives ΔEout=−ΔQ/Cf for the piezoelectric charge amplifier.

facts.statement: Charge amplifier의 Rf는 Cf를 통한 전하 방전·직류 귀환 경로를 제공하고, 저주파 차단은 1차 근사에서 fc≈1/(2πRfCf)이며 RfCf가 클수록 차단주파수는 낮아진다.

verification_refs.citation: Texas Instruments, Application Report SLOA033: Signal Conditioning Piezoelectric Sensors
verification_refs.locator: Feedback resistor and capacitor; low cutoff frequency
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that Rf bleeds charge off Cf and that Rf and Cf set the amplifier's low cutoff frequency; its single-pole feedback model gives the standard RC cutoff relation.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Practical Design Techniques for Sensor Signal Conditioning, Section 5
verification_refs.locator: Charge amplifier low-frequency cutoff f=1/(2πRC)
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies the lower cutoff frequency as 1/(2πR1C1) for the charge-amplifier feedback network.

facts.statement: 전하출력형 압전센서는 외부 charge amplifier가 전하를 전압으로 변환하고, IEPE형은 센서 내장 전자회로가 전압출력을 제공하며 conditioner가 통상 정전류로 센서에 전원을 공급한다.

verification_refs.citation: Kistler, Signal Conditioning in Measurement Technology: An Overview
verification_refs.locator: Signal conditioning for sensors with charge output and sensors with IEPE
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that piezo sensors without integrated electronics provide charge output requiring a charge amplifier, while IEPE sensors have built-in electronics and their conditioner supplies constant current and compliance voltage.

verification_refs.citation: Kistler, Piezoelectric pressure sensor: charge (PE) vs. voltage (IEPE) output
verification_refs.locator: PE and IEPE output architecture and sensitivity
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines PE as external charge-amplifier output and IEPE as integrated electronics converting charge to voltage, powered through a current coupler.

facts.statement: 압전센서의 전하감도는 입력 단위당 전하(pC/N 또는 pC/g)로, conditioner를 거친 전압감도는 입력 단위당 전압(mV/N 또는 mV/g)으로 표시하며 두 값은 센서와 전하-전압 변환이득을 구분한다.

verification_refs.citation: PCB Piezotronics, Introduction to Charge Mode Accelerometers
verification_refs.locator: Range and charge-to-voltage conversion examples
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies charge accelerometer sensitivity in pC/g, conditioner conversion in mV/pC, and resulting system sensitivity in mV/g as their product.

verification_refs.citation: Kistler, Piezoelectric Force Load Cell Type 9323AA
verification_refs.locator: Metrological characteristics and electrical properties
verification_refs.supports_claim: Reports force-sensor charge sensitivity in pC/N.

verification_refs.citation: Dimensional analysis of charge sensitivity and charge-amplifier gain
verification_refs.locator: (pC/measurand) × (mV/pC) = mV/measurand
verification_refs.supports_claim: Multiplying sensor charge sensitivity by charge-amplifier conversion gain yields voltage sensitivity in mV per same measurand, e.g. mV/N or mV/g.

facts.statement: 압전 힘 측정사슬은 적용 힘에 비례하는 센서 전하를 생성하고, charge amplifier 또는 conditioner가 이를 읽을 수 있는 전압·디지털 힘값으로 변환하며, 교정된 측정사슬의 감도와 범위로 힘을 산출한다.

verification_refs.citation: Kistler, Piezoelectric Force Measuring Chains with IO-Link, Type 9395A
verification_refs.locator: Description and factory calibration
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes force transducer charge passing through an insulating cable to a charge amplifier, which outputs measured force as analog voltage or digital IO-Link; states that the complete chain is calibrated in the selected force range and supplied with a certificate.

verification_refs.citation: Kistler, Piezoelectric Dynamic Measurement in Semiconductor Manufacturing
verification_refs.locator: Dynamic force measurement chain
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that the piezoelectric sensor measures force and a charge amplifier converts the sensor charge into an electrical signal corresponding to process force.

facts.statement: 압전 압력센서에서는 압력이 다이어프램을 통해 압전소자에 전달되어 비례 전하를 만들고, charge amplifier가 이를 전압으로 변환한다. 높은 고유진동수의 설계는 동압·압력맥동 측정에 활용된다.

verification_refs.citation: Kistler, Piezoelectric Pressure Sensors Type 601C
verification_refs.locator: Description, diaphragm/crystal operation and dynamic pressure applications
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that pressure acts on the diaphragm and compresses the piezoelectric crystal, which produces charge proportional to pressure; the charge amplifier converts it to voltage, and high natural frequency makes the sensor suitable for dynamic pressure and pressure pulsation measurements.

facts.statement: 압전 가속도계의 관성질량에는 F=ma에 따른 힘이 작용하고, 압전소자는 그 힘에 비례하는 전하를 발생시켜 가속도를 전기신호로 변환한다.

verification_refs.citation: Kistler, Vibration Standard for Accelerometers Type 8076K
verification_refs.locator: Description: seismic mass, F=ma, charge output
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes a seismic mass preloaded against a quartz element; force on the element is proportional to acceleration by F=ma, and the piezoelectric element generates charge proportional to force and therefore acceleration.

facts.statement: 압전 가속도계의 사용 주파수 범위는 charge amplifier의 저주파 응답 한계와 센서의 기계적 고유진동수·공진에 의해 제한되며, 공진 접근 시 감도가 급격히 변하므로 요구 정확도에 맞는 평탄 응답 구간을 사용해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: PCB Piezotronics, Introduction to Charge Mode Accelerometers
verification_refs.locator: Low Frequency Response and High Frequency Response
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that low-frequency response and time constant are set by the charge amplifier/converter, while the accelerometer's mechanical natural frequency limits the upper measurement band and sensitivity rises rapidly near resonance.

facts.statement: 가속도계의 설치면 상태, 결합강성, 추가 질량과 규정 체결토크는 장착 공진 및 사용 가능한 고주파 응답을 바꿀 수 있으므로 제조사 설치조건을 적용해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: PCB Piezotronics, Guidelines for Mounting Test Accelerometers
verification_refs.locator: Frequency response and mounting surface/added mass effects
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that stud mounting to a smooth surface yields the highest mounted resonant frequency, added mass lowers the sensing-system resonance and affects usable frequency range, and mounting torque should follow the datasheet.

verification_refs.citation: Kistler, Mounting/Installing an Accelerometer
verification_refs.locator: Mounting surface, high-frequency response and mounting torque
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains mounting-surface effects on transmissibility and recommends model-specific surface, orientation, and mounting torque instructions for higher-frequency measurements.

facts.statement: 전하형 압전센서는 고임피던스이므로 케이블의 움직임이 triboelectric 전하 잡음을 더할 수 있고, 커넥터·입력의 오염이나 습기로 절연저항이 낮아지면 누설·baseline drift와 저주파 응답 저하가 발생할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: PCB Piezotronics, Signal Conditioning Basics
verification_refs.locator: Charge-mode sensors: cable motion and contamination/insulation resistance
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that high-impedance charge sensors require low-noise cable to reduce motion-generated triboelectric charge; contamination can reduce insulation resistance, causing loss of low-frequency response and baseline drift.

verification_refs.citation: PCB Piezotronics, TN-17 Accelerometer Selection Considerations: Charge and ICP Sensors
verification_refs.locator: Cable and connectors; clean, dry high-impedance circuits
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that cable motion generates triboelectric static charge indistinguishable from sensor charge, and moisture/contamination lowers resistance, causing low-frequency response loss and baseline drift.

facts.statement: 압전센서의 감도와 절연특성은 온도에 의존하며, 특정 압전재료·구조에서는 온도 급변이 pyroelectric 전하 또는 열팽창에 의한 과도출력을 만들 수 있으므로 센서 종류와 conditioner 응답을 함께 확인해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: PCB/Endevco, Design and Selection Criteria of High Temperature Accelerometers
verification_refs.locator: Temperature sensitivity and transient temperature effects
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that accelerometer sensitivity varies with temperature, temperature changes can cause extraneous outputs, and some piezoelectric materials produce pyroelectric output under rapid temperature changes; the effect depends on sensor construction and signal chain.

verification_refs.citation: PCB/Endevco, Model 7221A Piezoelectric Accelerometer Data Sheet
verification_refs.locator: Electrical resistance over operating temperature and thermal transient sensitivity
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides insulation resistance values at room and elevated temperature, temperature response specifications, and thermal-transient sensitivity for a specific piezoelectric accelerometer, supporting the stated model-dependent qualification.

facts.statement: 가속도계의 transverse sensitivity는 감지축 이외 입력에 대한 교차응답을 만들 수 있고, mounting-surface 변형(base strain)은 원치 않는 출력·비선형성·zero shift를, 센서 질량에 의한 mass loading은 시험 구조물의 동특성 변화를 일으킬 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: PCB Piezotronics, Acceleration Sensing: Shock and Vibration Measurement Paper
verification_refs.locator: Base strain, transverse sensitivity and mounting deformation
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines base strain as undesired output caused by deformation of the accelerometer mounting surface and explains its relation to high transverse sensitivity, nonlinearity and zero shift.

verification_refs.citation: PCB Piezotronics, Accelerometer Limitations in Pyroshock Measurements
verification_refs.locator: Modification of structural response by accelerometer; mass loading
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that an accelerometer's mechanical impedance and mass modify the response of the structure to which it is attached, producing mass-loading measurement error.

facts.statement: 압전 측정사슬은 예상 신호 수준·주파수대역과 동적범위에 맞춰 charge conditioner의 측정범위와 high/low-pass filter, ADC 입력범위·성능, anti-aliasing filter 및 sampling rate를 함께 선정해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Kistler, Laboratory Charge Amplifiers LabAmp with Data Acquisition
verification_refs.locator: Measurement ranges, frequency range, adjustable filters, integrated ADC
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides piezoelectric measurement ranges, high- and low-pass filter adjustment, frequency range and integrated 24-bit DAQ/sample-rate specifications, demonstrating these parameters form an integrated conditioner/DAQ configuration.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Anti-Aliasing Filters and Their Usage Explained
verification_refs.locator: Nyquist rate, pre-ADC analog low-pass filter and transition band
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that sampling rate must exceed twice the highest frequency of interest and that an analog low-pass anti-alias filter before the ADC limits out-of-band energy; practical transition-band behavior informs selection of a higher sampling rate.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Dynamic Signal Acquisition Fundamentals
verification_refs.locator: Dynamic range, accuracy/flatness, signal aliasing and synchronization
verification_refs.supports_claim: Treats dynamic range, frequency-response flatness, anti-aliasing and synchronized sampling as key DSA performance/design characteristics that must fit the measurement application.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Acquiring Current and Voltage Waveforms
verification_refs.locator: ADC input range, saturation, sample-rate and Nyquist selection
verification_refs.supports_claim: Warns that the signal must remain within ADC input range to avoid saturation and instructs selection of sampling rate consistent with the Nyquist criterion.

facts.statement: 압전 측정사슬의 교정·성능검증은 실제 적용되는 센서, 케이블, conditioner와 DAQ 경로를 대상으로 적절한 범위까지 수행하고, 감도·주파수응답·위상·절연저항·IEPE bias(해당 시) 및 시스템 측정불확도를 추적·기록해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Kistler, Piezoelectric Force Measuring Chains with IO-Link, Type 9395A
verification_refs.locator: Complete measuring chain including cable, charge amplifier, output and factory calibration
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes sensor charge transmitted through a high-insulation cable to the charge amplifier, analog/digital chain output and calibration of the complete measurement chain in the selected range.

verification_refs.citation: PCB Piezotronics, Calibration of Industrial Accelerometers
verification_refs.locator: Back-to-back calibration, sensitivity, frequency response, output bias and transverse sensitivity
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes calibration against a traceable reference sensor to determine sensitivity, frequency response and output bias voltage, and pre-calibration testing of transverse sensitivity.

verification_refs.citation: PCB Piezotronics, Accelerometer Calibration Service MCS-A001-61
verification_refs.locator: Amplitude and phase response calibration service
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists traceable amplitude- and phase-response calibration over the specified frequency range for an accelerometer.

verification_refs.citation: PCB/Endevco, Model 7221A Piezoelectric Accelerometer Data Sheet
verification_refs.locator: Calibration data and electrical resistance/isolation specifications
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies supplied calibration data (sensitivity, capacitance, transverse sensitivity, frequency response) and separately specifies sensor resistance/isolation across operating temperatures; those electrical properties are relevant verification items rather than implying that all are calibrated in every service.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Calculating Absolute Accuracy or System Accuracy
verification_refs.locator: Accuracy calculation across cascaded filter/isolation/DAQ components and uncertainty
verification_refs.supports_claim: Instructs users to identify all connected system components, calculate component accuracy, and combine them into system accuracy including noise uncertainty; the example includes cable-connected signal-conditioning/filter modules and DAQ.

verification_refs.citation: PCB Piezotronics, Calibration of Industrial Accelerometers
verification_refs.locator: Final calibration determines output bias voltage
verification_refs.supports_claim: Includes output bias voltage in the final calibration test for the applicable accelerometer type; the record scopes bias verification to architectures where an IEPE/ICP bias is present.

facts.statement: 힘 평형식 압력전송기에서 차압이 유효면적 A에 작용해 감지력 F_sensed=ΔP·A를 만들며, 평형점에서는 feedback counter-force가 감지력과 같아진다.

verification_refs.citation: ABB, Deltapi N Differential Pressure Transmitter: Operating Instruction, Principle of Operation
verification_refs.locator: Principle of Operation
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes differential pressure applied across a diaphragm capsule producing a force on the transmission bar, and output pressure rising in the feedback bellows until its force balances the capsule force and equilibrium is attained.

verification_refs.citation: Pressure definition p=F/A applied to differential pressure over effective sensing area
verification_refs.locator: F=ΔP·A for uniform differential pressure over effective area
verification_refs.supports_claim: From pressure as normal force per unit area, a uniform pressure difference ΔP acting over effective area A yields resultant sensing force F_sensed=ΔP·A; the transmitter's force-balance condition sets this equal to its feedback counter-force.

facts.statement: D 동작은 오차 변화율에 비례하는 항이며, 플랜트에 따라 위상여유·응답속도와 과도응답을 개선할 수 있다. 이상적인 미분은 고주파 센서잡음을 증폭하고 setpoint step에서 derivative kick을 만들 수 있으므로 실장에서는 필터링 또는 derivative-on-measurement 구조를 검토한다.

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) Controllers
verification_refs.locator: Filtered derivative term Kd*s/(Tf*s+1)
verification_refs.supports_claim: Gives the derivative transfer term and practical first-order derivative filter in continuous-time PID representations.

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, Expanding Beyond a Simple Derivative: Understanding PID Control Part 3
verification_refs.locator: Derivative amplifies high-frequency sensor noise; low-pass derivative filter
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that ideal derivative action amplifies high-frequency sensor noise and that a low-pass filter in the derivative path reduces this effect.

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, Specify PI-D and I-PD Controllers
verification_refs.locator: Discontinuous setpoint input and derivative-induced control-signal spike
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that for nonsmooth or discontinuous reference signals, the derivative component can create a large control-signal spike; PI-D/I-PD and 2-DOF structures can mitigate setpoint influence.

verification_refs.citation: MathWorks, Design Compensator Using Automated Tuning Methods
verification_refs.locator: Derivative action provides additional freedom for phase margin and response time
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes derivative action as providing the tuning algorithm additional freedom to achieve adequate phase margin and faster response time, supporting a conditional transient-shaping benefit rather than a universal overshoot guarantee.

facts.statement: 정지 유체의 압력수두는 밀도와 높이에 의존하며, 밀도가 일정한 액주에서는 ΔP=ρgΔh이다. 따라서 차압식 레벨은 밀도가 일정하다는 가정 없이 높이만 직접 측정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Yokogawa, Y/11, Y/12, Y/13, Y/14 and Y/15 Series Differential Pressure Transmitters, User's Manual
verification_refs.locator: §7.4, pp. 7-5–7-6; liquid specific gravity GL and level head x are used to calculate span
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual calculates level-measurement span as x·GL (converted to pressure using g), making the density and liquid-head dependence explicit.

facts.statement: 개방탱크의 DP 범위 계산은 액주수두와 설치 기준고도를 반영하며, 송신기 고도 차이에 따라 LRV에 zero suppression 또는 elevation이 생길 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Yokogawa, Y/11, Y/12, Y/13, Y/14 and Y/15 Series Differential Pressure Transmitters, User's Manual
verification_refs.locator: §7.4(1), p. 7-5; open tank span, zero suppression, and differential-pressure range
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual gives open-tank span and zero-suppression calculations from level heights and specific gravity, and shows low-pressure side open to atmosphere.

facts.statement: 밀폐탱크에서 탱크 기상압을 고압측과 저압측에 공통으로 전달하는 구성에서는 공통 기상압이 DP 계산에서 상쇄되며, dry-leg 범위는 개방탱크와 같은 방식으로 산정할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Yokogawa, Y/11, Y/12, Y/13, Y/14 and Y/15 Series Differential Pressure Transmitters, User's Manual
verification_refs.locator: §7.4(2), p. 7-6; Closed Tank (Dry Leg)
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual states that tank pressure is introduced to the low side and also applied to the high side, so tank pressure need not be included in the calculation; it directs use of the open-tank calculation method.

facts.statement: 밀폐탱크 wet-leg 구성에서는 저압측 기준액의 액주수두가 측정 DP에서 차감된다. 정수 기준과 동일한 단위계에서 LRV 항은 고압측 최소 액주수두에서 저압측 wet-leg 기준수두를 뺀 값이다.

verification_refs.citation: Yokogawa, Y/11, Y/12, Y/13, Y/14 and Y/15 Series Differential Pressure Transmitters, User's Manual
verification_refs.locator: §7.4(3), p. 7-6; Closed Tank (Wet Leg), zero elevation and range equation
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual gives zero elevation y·GL−d·GS and DP range (y·GL−d·GS) to (x·GL+y·GL−d·GS), showing the wet-leg head is subtracted.

facts.statement: Wet-leg 구성의 0% 차압은 계기 및 탭 고도와 기준액 수두에 따라 음수가 될 수 있다. Yokogawa 매뉴얼의 예에서는 LRV가 −23.73 kPa이므로 해당 배치에 zero elevation이 적용된다.

verification_refs.citation: Yokogawa, Y/11, Y/12, Y/13, Y/14 and Y/15 Series Differential Pressure Transmitters, User's Manual
verification_refs.locator: §7.4(3), p. 7-6; worked wet-leg example, zero elevation −23.73 kPa
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual derives a negative zero elevation and a negative DP range for its stated dimensions and densities; this verifies that negative LRV is possible, not universal.

facts.statement: 차압 범위의 LRV와 URV는 0%·100%의 가변 액주수두뿐 아니라 설치고도와 impulse-line 고정수두를 부호를 포함해 반영한다. 같은 밀도·고정배치에서 Span은 가변 레벨 구간에 따른 압력차이다.

verification_refs.citation: Yokogawa, Y/11, Y/12, Y/13, Y/14 and Y/15 Series Differential Pressure Transmitters, User's Manual
verification_refs.locator: §7.4(1) and (3), pp. 7-5–7-6; open-tank and wet-leg range formulas
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual calculates LRV/URV from liquid level, specific gravity, and fixed wet-leg head, while Span is calculated separately from the variable level interval.

facts.statement: 밀폐탱크 dry-leg 방식은 저압측 impulse line을 기상부에 연결해 기상압을 전달하며, 저압측 도압관의 액체수두가 무시될 만큼 기상 상태를 유지해야 범위 계산에서 추가 액주항을 생략할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Yokogawa, Y/11, Y/12, Y/13, Y/14 and Y/15 Series Differential Pressure Transmitters, User's Manual
verification_refs.locator: §5.2.2, p. 5-2 and §7.4(2), p. 7-6; Closed Tank (Dry Leg)
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual shows the closed-tank dry-leg connection and states that common tank pressure is applied to both sides so its calculation follows the open-tank method.

facts.statement: 정상적으로 고압측−저압측을 측정하는 DP 구성에서 dry-leg 저압측에 응축액 액주가 생기면 저압측 압력이 증가하여 측정 DP가 감소한다. 액주 크기와 탭 구성에 따라 레벨 지시오차가 생길 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Yokogawa, Y/11, Y/12, Y/13, Y/14 and Y/15 Series Differential Pressure Transmitters, User's Manual
verification_refs.locator: §7.4(2), p. 7-6; dry-leg arrangement and DP calculation; §7.5, p. 7-6 on collected condensate causing pressure measurement error
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual describes the dry-leg low-side route and warns that collected condensate in the pressure detector causes pressure error. The stated DP sign follows from adding liquid head to the low-pressure side in ΔP=PH−PL.

verification_refs.citation: Differential pressure sign derivation with added low-side liquid column
verification_refs.locator: ΔP_measured=PH−(PL+ρgΔh)=ΔP_nominal−ρgΔh
verification_refs.supports_claim: For an added positive liquid head on the low-pressure side, subtracting that higher low-side pressure reduces the measured high-minus-low differential pressure.

facts.statement: LRV가 양수인 DP range는 zero suppression, LRV가 음수인 DP range는 zero elevation으로 부른다. 이는 트랜스미터 자체의 물리적 설치 위치가 아니라 0% 공정조건에서 계산된 입력값의 부호에 관한 명칭이다.

verification_refs.citation: Yokogawa, Y/11, Y/12, Y/13, Y/14 and Y/15 Series Differential Pressure Transmitters, User's Manual
verification_refs.locator: §7.4(1), p. 7-5 (zero suppression); §7.4(3), p. 7-6 (zero elevation)
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual labels a positive open-tank lower-range offset as zero suppression and a wet-leg range offset as zero elevation, including an explicit negative example; terminology is tied to calculated range, not transmitter mounting location.

facts.statement: 설치 고정수두를 제거하고 실제 액주 차압을 ΔP=ρ_actual·g·h_actual로 두면, 교정밀도 ρ_cal로 환산한 지시높이는 h_ind=ΔP/(ρ_cal·g)=(ρ_actual/ρ_cal)h_actual이다. 따라서 실제 밀도가 교정밀도보다 큰 조건에서는 지시높이가 실제높이보다 크게 계산된다.

verification_refs.citation: Yokogawa, Y/11, Y/12, Y/13, Y/14 and Y/15 Series Differential Pressure Transmitters, User's Manual
verification_refs.locator: §7.4, pp. 7-5–7-6; range calculations use liquid specific gravity and liquid head
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual makes the measured pressure range proportional to liquid specific gravity and height; it supports the linear density/head model used in this derivation.

verification_refs.citation: Hydrostatic pressure and transmitter density-conversion relation
verification_refs.locator: ΔP=ρ_actual·g·h_actual; h_ind=ΔP/(ρ_cal·g)
verification_refs.supports_claim: Substitution yields h_ind=(ρ_actual/ρ_cal)h_actual, so for positive level actual density above calibrated density causes an over-reading, assuming fixed heads are removed and density is uniform.

facts.statement: 고정 측정 탭 간격 H에서 하부 중액의 높이를 h_i, 상부 경액 밀도를 ρ_L, 하부 중액 밀도를 ρ_H라 하면 공통 고정수두 C를 제외한 DP는 g[ρ_L·H+(ρ_H−ρ_L)·h_i]에 비례한다. 따라서 계면 이동에 따른 span은 gH(ρ_H−ρ_L)이며 밀도차가 작을수록 span이 작다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Rosemount, Technical Data Sheet: Interface Measurement (Pressure), 00816-0100-3207
verification_refs.locator: pp. 1–2; interface calibrated endpoints and span guidance
verification_refs.supports_claim: The datasheet computes endpoint DP from lighter/heavier fluid specific gravities over a fixed level, states that span increases with tap distance or specific-gravity difference, and requires the overall level to remain above the upper tap.

verification_refs.citation: Hydrostatic sum for two immiscible liquid layers between fixed taps
verification_refs.locator: ΔP/g=ρ_H·h_i+ρ_L·(H−h_i)
verification_refs.supports_claim: Summing the two hydrostatic column heads and collecting terms gives ρ_L·H+(ρ_H−ρ_L)·h_i; the endpoint difference is H(ρ_H−ρ_L).

facts.statement: 동일한 액주 높이에서도 운전밀도 변화는 정수압 차압을 바꾸므로, 교정 시 가정한 밀도와 운전밀도가 다르면 레벨 환산값에 오차가 생긴다. 따라서 범위 산정·밀도보정에는 해당 운전조건의 대표 밀도를 사용해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Yokogawa, Y/11, Y/12, Y/13, Y/14 and Y/15 Series Differential Pressure Transmitters, User's Manual
verification_refs.locator: §7.4, pp. 7-5–7-6; specific gravity GL assumed not to vary during level measurement
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual explicitly assumes tank liquid specific gravity does not vary during measurement and uses it in pressure-range calculations, showing that range calculation depends on representative liquid density.

verification_refs.citation: Hydrostatic pressure relation for uniform-density liquid
verification_refs.locator: ΔP=ρ·g·h at fixed h and g
verification_refs.supports_claim: At fixed liquid height h and gravity g, a change in density changes the hydrostatic pressure difference proportionally, which changes the pressure-to-level conversion if calibration density is unchanged.

facts.statement: DP 계면 측정에는 탭 간격, 두 상의 밀도와 wet-leg/reference head 등 기준조건이 정의되어야 한다. 상부 저압 탭이 계속 액체에 잠겨 고정 액주를 유지하는 구성에서는 전체 액면 변화에 따른 압력 성분을 보정할 수 있지만, 상부 탭 노출이나 기준수두 변화는 이 계산조건을 깨뜨린다. 두꺼운 에멀전층은 명확한 2층 계면 모델의 전제에 맞지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Rosemount, Technical Data Sheet: Interface Measurement (Pressure), 00816-0100-3207
verification_refs.locator: pp. 1–2; operating assumptions and application considerations
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires overall level to remain at or above the low-pressure tap, specifies endpoint assumptions for the two specific gravities and stable reference height/density, and warns that changing wet-leg height or density creates measurement errors.

verification_refs.citation: Two-layer hydrostatic interface model assumptions
verification_refs.locator: Piecewise hydrostatic head assumes two identifiable layers with defined densities and an interface height
verification_refs.supports_claim: The two-layer pressure equation requires identifiable phase densities and a boundary height; a finite emulsion/transition region does not satisfy the sharp two-layer model without an additional mixture-density/transition model.

facts.statement: Thermistor 선정 시 요구 측정온도 범위, 감도, 장기 안정성, 사용환경과 패키지·구조를 함께 검토한다. 소자 형식별 온도 범위·내습성·안정성 사양이 다르므로 해당 부품 데이터시트의 정격과 적용조건을 확인해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: TDK, NTC Elements: Product Overview
verification_refs.locator: Product overview; available NTC constructions, temperature ranges and application/environment distinctions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes multiple NTC constructions and available operating temperature ranges and highlights media resistance and long-term stability as product-dependent characteristics.

verification_refs.citation: TDK, NTC thermistors for temperature measurement B57871L*, L871 datasheet
verification_refs.locator: Operating limits, reliability data and notes on liquid/solvent exposure and condensation
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies device-specific reliability and operating conditions, self-heating limit, humidity exposure results, and restrictions on liquid ingress/condensation; supports checking the selected package's data sheet against service conditions.

facts.statement: Thermistor 회로에서 직렬 배선·접촉저항은 측정 저항에 더해지고, 누설 경로는 분압·여기전류를 바꾸며, 습기·응결로 인한 절연저하와 배선 잡음은 측정 전압·저항값에 오차를 만들 수 있다. 영향 크기는 센서저항, 배선·입력 임피던스와 회로구성에 의존한다.

verification_refs.citation: Texas Instruments, Thermistor Temperature Transducer to ADC Application, SLOA052
verification_refs.locator: §3 and §9; thermistor measurement input impedance and noise on sensor wiring
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that amplifier input current affects the thermistor signal, requires high input impedance, and that sensor wiring is subjected to electrical/magnetic noise that can interfere with the measurement.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Design Note 379: Easy Drive ADCs Simplify Measurement of High Impedance Sensors
verification_refs.locator: Thermistor-to-ADC input current, common-mode error and remote wiring noise discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Shows that ADC input current and common-mode voltage can create thermistor resistance measurement error and notes grounding may be needed to reduce noise pickup on remote sensor wiring.

verification_refs.citation: TDK, NTC thermistors for temperature measurement B57871L*, L871 datasheet
verification_refs.locator: Cautions on water ingress, liquids and condensation
verification_refs.supports_claim: Warns against water ingress and condensation unless the specific thermistor is specified for those conditions; combined with the circuit leakage path, moisture-related insulation leakage can perturb resistance/voltage measurement.

verification_refs.citation: Two-wire resistance and voltage-divider circuit relations
verification_refs.locator: R_measured=R_thermistor+R_lead+R_contact; leakage changes equivalent resistance; divider output depends on equivalent resistance
verification_refs.supports_claim: Series lead/contact resistance is part of a two-wire resistance measurement, while parallel leakage changes equivalent resistance and thus the divider voltage; the magnitude depends on the circuit and parasitic values.

facts.statement: RTD 측정값과 응답은 감온소자만으로 정해지지 않는다. 삽입 깊이·thermowell 구조와 열질량, 공정 유속·열전달, 설치에 따른 stem conduction이 측정 정확도와 응답시간에 영향을 준다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Temperature Measurement, Control Key to Plant Performance, ISA Automation Basics
verification_refs.locator: p. 2; thermowell dynamics table showing time constants vary with fluid velocity, annular clearance and fill; sensing-element time constants by construction
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides comparative response time constants for RTD construction and thermowell configurations across different process velocities, annular clearances and fill materials, demonstrating that installed thermal path affects response.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Rosemount X-well Technology: Accuracy and Installation FAQ
verification_refs.locator: FAQ: accuracy compared with standard thermowells and surface sensors
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that incorrect thermowell installation and small line sizes can cause stem conduction error and reduce temperature measurement performance.

verification_refs.citation: OMEGA, PRTXI/PRTXS RTD Temperature Sensor Installation Instructions
verification_refs.locator: §3.1 Installation Instructions; immersion length and process flow velocity
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that RTD immersion length can significantly influence accuracy and that insertion depth, flow velocity and process pressure are installation parameters to consider.

facts.statement: RTD transmitter 또는 signal-conditioning module은 제품 사양에 따라 RTD 여기·2/3/4선식 입력·저항-온도 선형화·절연·진단 및 표준 아날로그/디지털 출력 기능을 제공할 수 있다. 지원 기능은 장치별 사양으로 확인한다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, 3B34 Isolated, Linearized RTD Input Data Sheet
verification_refs.locator: Product features and overview; isolated 2/3/4-wire RTD input signal conditioning
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies RTD input, sensor excitation and lead compensation, linearized output vs sensor temperature, isolated/nonisolated module variants, and 0–20 mA or 4–20 mA outputs.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Rosemount 3144S Temperature Transmitter Digital Manual
verification_refs.locator: Supported sensor types and wiring §1; diagnostics §3; CVD sensor matching and HART/4–20 mA output
verification_refs.supports_claim: Documents 2-, 3-, and 4-wire RTD input support, sensor characterization using Callendar-Van Dusen coefficients, RTD measurement and loop diagnostics, and conversion to 4–20 mA/HART output.

facts.statement: RTD의 2선식·3선식·4선식은 요구 불확도, 배선거리, 비용, 단자 수, transmitter 위치와 유지보수성을 함께 고려하여 선정한다. 2선식은 단순·저비용이나 선로저항 오차가 포함되고, 3선식은 선로 균형·보상에, 4선식은 높은 정확도와 장거리 측정에 유리하지만 추가 배선·단자가 필요하다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, CN-0383 Circuit Note: RTD Measurement Configurations
verification_refs.locator: RTD 2-wire, 3-wire and 4-wire configuration discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that two-wire is simplest but includes uncompensated lead resistance and suits short leads; three-wire compensation reduces lead error; four-wire nearly eliminates lead resistance error and offers best performance, while three-wire uses fewer terminals.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Temperature Measurement, Control Key to Plant Performance, ISA Automation Basics
verification_refs.locator: p. 2; lead-wire error, long run/accuracy tradeoffs and integral transmitter maintenance discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains lead resistance error in two-wire RTDs, the equal-wire resistance assumption for three-wire, and recommends four-wire or integral mounting for high-accuracy or long cable runs; it also discusses maintenance advantages of integral-mounted transmitters.

facts.statement: 열전대 측정접점은 접지형·비접지형·노출형으로 구성할 수 있다. 접지형은 일반적으로 sheath와의 열접촉이 좋아 빠르게 응답하지만 전기적 ground loop·잡음에 취약할 수 있고, 비접지형은 sheath와 전기적으로 절연되지만 응답이 상대적으로 느릴 수 있다. 노출형은 빠른 응답에 유리하나 공정에 직접 노출되어 보호·환경 적합성을 확인해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Temperature Measurement, Control Key to Plant Performance, ISA Automation Basics
verification_refs.locator: p. 2; grounded and ungrounded thermocouple junction configuration tradeoffs
verification_refs.supports_claim: States grounded junctions have improved thermal conductivity and quickest response but are more susceptible to electrical noise; ungrounded junctions respond slightly slower and reduce electrical-noise susceptibility.

verification_refs.citation: OMEGA, Thermocouple Junction Types and Probe Selection
verification_refs.locator: Junction type selection and thermocouple response-time sections
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines grounded, ungrounded and exposed junctions; describes exposed junction as fastest, ungrounded as electrically isolated from sheath with slower response than grounded, and notes exposed-junction environmental/temperature constraints.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Rosemount 214C Temperature Sensor Product Data Sheet
verification_refs.locator: Thermocouple time response and immersion specifications by grounded/ungrounded construction
verification_refs.supports_claim: Reports distinct measured response times for grounded and ungrounded thermocouple constructions under the same stated flowing-water test method, supporting a construction-dependent response tradeoff.

facts.statement: 열전대 측정접점이 공정온도를 추종하는 정확도와 응답은 thermowell, 삽입 깊이, 유속과 열전달, 배관으로의 stem conduction, 복사환경 및 센서·보호관 사이의 열접촉에 영향을 받는다. 열용량이 커지고 열전달 경로가 같다면 응답시간은 일반적으로 증가한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Temperature Measurement, Control Key to Plant Performance, ISA Automation Basics
verification_refs.locator: p. 2; thermowell time constants under changes in process velocity, annular clearance, and fill material

facts.statement: 열전대의 Seebeck 전압은 보통 mV 또는 그보다 작은 수준이므로 입력 offset·잡음·공통모드 및 접지전위차가 측정에 영향을 줄 수 있으며, 리드 절연저하·누설도 오차 경로가 된다. 신호처리기는 설계에 따라 차동 입력, 냉접점 보상, 종류별 선형화, 단선감지, 필터링·절연, 4–20 mA 또는 디지털 출력을 제공할 수 있다. 차폐·접지방식은 설치환경과 입력회로에 맞춰야 한다.

verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes thermocouple EMF as millivolt-range, identifies EMI-induced noise and insulation issues along the leads, and explains need for signal-conditioning and cold-junction compensation.
