verification_refs.citation: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Enterprise Performance Life Cycle Framework Practices Guide: Data Conversion, v1.0
verification_refs.edition_or_version: EPLC Practice Guide v1.0; archived guide; accessed 2026-10-11
verification_refs.locator: pp. 1–3: risk/data criticality; data amount/type/quality and dependencies; parallel vs one-time cutover; archive vs continued operation; cost and schedule planning
verification_refs.supports_claim: The guide asks projects to determine whether parallel operation is required or a one-time cutover will be used and whether the legacy system will be archived or kept running; it also lists data criticality, dependencies, risk, costs and schedule among planning inputs. This IT guide is an example, not an OT-wide normative selection algorithm.

facts.statement: HHS EPLC Data Conversion 가이드는 데이터 변환 전에 system backup을 만들고, 표본 변환과 필요 시 full mock conversion을 실시하며, 정확성·완전성 문제를 조정한 뒤 전환일을 계획·공유하도록 안내한다. 온라인 서비스를 중지한 채 변환을 수행할지 검토하고, 여건상 변환 후 문제가 있으면 직전 backup으로 복귀할 수 있도록 설명한다. 이는 해당 IT 가이드의 예시이며, OT cutover의 universal freeze·승인·연락망·go/no-go 목록이나 공정 안전조건을 규정하지 않는다. 현장 cutover readiness 기준은 공정 위험과 승인 절차에 따라 별도 정한다.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Enterprise Performance Life Cycle Framework Practices Guide: Data Conversion, v1.0
verification_refs.edition_or_version: EPLC Practice Guide v1.0; archived guide; accessed 2026-10-11
verification_refs.locator: pp. 2–3: backups, sample and mock conversion, validation, planning/communicating conversion date, optional online service shutdown, pre-conversion restoration contingency
verification_refs.supports_claim: The guide describes incremental/pre-conversion backups, sample/mock testing, validating accuracy and completeness, planning and communicating conversion, considering service shutdown for online systems, and possible reversion to the pre-conversion backup. This is IT practice guidance and does not define OT process-safety cutover approvals.

facts.statement: HHS EPLC Data Conversion 가이드는 전환된 data의 format·completeness·accuracy를 검증·조정하고 중복 요소를 제거하며, 전환상 문제를 해결하도록 안내한다. 이는 해당 IT 데이터 변환 가이드의 사후 data validation/evaluation 범위다. OT 시스템의 성능·alarm·통신 안정화 기간이나 기존 제어시스템의 보존·격리·폐기 기준을 이 가이드가 정하지 않으므로, 해당 운영·decommission 기준은 현장 위험·기록보존·복구 요구와 별도 변경 절차로 정한다.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Enterprise Performance Life Cycle Framework Practices Guide: Data Conversion, v1.0
verification_refs.edition_or_version: EPLC Practice Guide v1.0; archived guide; accessed 2026-10-11
verification_refs.locator: p. 3, §3 Validating/Evaluating Data Conversions
verification_refs.supports_claim: The guide directs validation/reconciliation of converted data for format, completeness and accuracy, elimination of duplicate elements, and resolution of migration issues. It does not specify OT alarm/communications/performance stabilization or legacy control-system decommission criteria.

facts.statement: 미국 OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119 적용 공정에서는 like-for-like replacement를 제외한 공정 화학물질·기술·설비·절차 및 covered process에 영향을 주는 시설 변경을 서면 MOC 절차로 관리해야 한다. 변경 전 기술적 근거, 안전·보건 영향, 운전절차 수정, 변경 필요기간과 승인요건을 검토하며, 영향받는 운전·정비·계약 인력은 재가동 전에 변경 내용을 통지받고 교육받아야 한다. 이 조항은 적용 대상 공정에 한정되고 긴급변경용 일반 면제·단축 승인 절차나 공통 backup·통신 체크리스트를 정하지 않으므로, 긴급조치 절차는 해당 규정과 사업장 요건에 맞춰 별도 정한다.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. Occupational Safety and Health Administration, 29 CFR 1910.119, Process Safety Management of Highly Hazardous Chemicals
verification_refs.edition_or_version: Current e-CFR text as displayed by OSHA; accessed 2026-10-11
verification_refs.locator: §1910.119(a) applicability; §1910.119(l)(1)–(3) MOC; §1910.119(i)(2) pre-startup review
verification_refs.supports_claim: OSHA requires written MOC procedures, except for replacements in kind, for specified changes affecting covered processes; requires consideration of technical basis, safety/health impact, procedure modifications, duration and authorization before a change; and requires affected operating, maintenance and contract employees to be informed/trained before startup. The requirement is scope-specific and does not establish a general emergency-change shortcut for all OT systems.

facts.statement: Migration·upgrade 시 target 구성의 호환성은 해당 제조사의 제품별 compatibility tool/matrix와 release documentation으로 확인한다. 예를 들어 Rockwell PCDC는 선택 제품 간 compatibility 비교를 제공하고, Siemens S7-1200 G2 Migration Checker는 기존 project의 hardware·software 구성요소가 지정 TIA Portal 버전에서 지원되는지 사전 점검한다. Emerson Config600 matrix는 Config600과 S600+ binary.app 버전 조합을 제시하고 firmware upgrade 후 full system test를 권고한다. 확인 대상과 절차는 제품·버전 범위에 맞추며, 이 사례들이 모든 migration에서 OS·application·firmware·driver·protocol·database·license를 빠짐없이 하나의 보편 matrix에 넣어야 한다는 뜻은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: Rockwell Automation, Product Compatibility and Migration / Product Compatibility and Download Center
verification_refs.locator: Product Compatibility Assessment; PCDC Compare products and available versions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Rockwell directs users to PCDC to check compatibility between new and existing products in a system, compare product/features, and review release notes, firmware/software, lifecycle and dependencies. This supports a Rockwell product-scoped compatibility check, not a universal exhaustive migration checklist.

verification_refs.citation: Siemens, Migration Guideline SIMATIC S7-1200 G2, Entry ID 109986503, V1.3
verification_refs.locator: §3.1 Migration Checker, pp. 17–18
verification_refs.supports_claim: The Siemens Migration Checker is a preliminary step that checks whether existing-project hardware and software components are supported by the target TIA Portal and whether they can be migrated; it creates logs describing compatibility issues and recommendations. The guidance is specific to the stated S7-1200 G2 migration tool and TIA Portal scope.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Config600 Compatibility Matrix, D301853X012
verification_refs.locator: Table 1 and firmware-upgrade note, p. 1
verification_refs.supports_claim: The matrix pairs Config600 configuration-software versions with S600+ binary.app versions and states that a full system test is recommended after a firmware upgrade. These are product-specific combinations and a product-specific test recommendation.

facts.statement: 변경 영향검토는 적용되는 규정·사업장 기준의 필수 검토축을 다루고, 연계 OT 기능·서비스에 대한 파급을 변경별로 확인한다. OSHA PSM 적용 공정에서는 변경 전 기술적 근거, 안전·보건 영향, 운전절차 수정, 변경 기간과 승인 요건을 검토한다. NIST OT 지침은 승인된 기준선과 변경의 사전 문서화·시험·승인을 권고하며, 한 구성요소의 변경이 연결 HMI 등 다른 기능에 영향을 줄 수 있음을 예시한다. 로직, 통신, HMI, historian, 보고서, 알람, 안전기능, 절차, 교육, spare, license 등은 영향분석 후보이며 모든 변경에 적용되는 고정 체크리스트나 일률적 다학제 승인요건은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: 29 CFR 1910.119(l), Process safety management of highly hazardous chemicals
verification_refs.locator: Paragraphs (l)(1)–(5), especially (l)(2)(i)–(v)
verification_refs.supports_claim: For covered process changes within its scope, the regulation requires procedures to address technical basis, safety/health impact, operating-procedure modifications, necessary time period and authorization before change.

verification_refs.citation: OSHA Appendix C to 29 CFR 1910.119, Compliance Guidelines and Recommendations for Process Safety Management (nonmandatory)
verification_refs.locator: Appendix C, Management of Change; typical change form and complexity-dependent review
verification_refs.supports_claim: The nonmandatory guidance gives possible change-form topics such as procedures, maintenance, inspection/testing, P&IDs, training and communications, and says minor well-understood changes may use an authorized checklist while complex/significant changes may warrant broader operations, maintenance and safety review. It does not mandate the full candidate list for every change.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST describes OT configuration management and recommends an approved baseline plus documenting, testing, and approving changes before deployment. It illustrates unintended impact where disabling PLC communications may also disable associated HMI communications, supporting change-specific dependency/impact assessment rather than a universal checklist.

facts.statement: 변경 실행계획은 적용 규정·사업장 절차와 변경별 위험·운전제약에 맞춰 작성하며, 해당되는 기술·안전 검토, 실행창, 영향받는 인력의 통보, 사전시험·사후검증, backup/복구 또는 rollback 준비를 반영한다. OSHA PSM covered process 변경은 사전 검토항목과 직원 통보·교육 요건을 따른다. NIST OT 지침은 변경의 사전 문서화·시험·승인과, 운영영향을 고려한 변경시점 선정을 권고한다. 열거된 계획항목은 모든 변경에 동일하게 요구되는 보편 체크리스트가 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: 29 CFR 1910.119(l), Process safety management of highly hazardous chemicals
verification_refs.locator: Paragraphs (l)(2)–(5)
verification_refs.supports_claim: For covered process changes within scope, OSHA requires the MOC procedure to address technical basis, safety/health impact, operating procedure modifications, necessary period and authorization before change, and to inform/train affected employees before startup, with PSI/procedures updated where affected.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST recommends documenting, testing and approving OT changes before deployment and notes that many changes may only be performed during scheduled maintenance downtime to minimize impact; implementation depends on the OT environment and risk.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 1339, OT Backup Quick Start Guide
verification_refs.locator: pp. 1–2, manage backup and recovery procedures
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST says to adapt backup and recovery procedures to specific operating environments and safety requirements and integrate backup-impacting changes into organizational change management; this supports selecting recovery plan elements when they apply, not an invariant list for every change.

facts.statement: Restore는 백업 사본에서 데이터·설정 또는 시스템 상태를 복구하는 행위다. Rollback은 변경의 문제를 해소하기 위해 이전의 승인 형상이나 안정 상태로 변경을 되돌리는 절차다. Rollback을 위해 backup restore를 사용할 수 있지만 두 용어는 동의어가 아니며, 적용 방식은 복구대상과 변경·복구 절차에 따른다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: Treats OT backups as recovery resources, recommends maintaining backup inventories and testing restoration from backup data as part of contingency-plan testing. This supports the restore-from-backup meaning, not an equivalence with reversing a change.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-128, Guide for Security-Focused Configuration Management of Information Systems
verification_refs.locator: §3.2.2 Configuration Change Control, Chapter 3 printed pp. 18–19
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists rollback requirements for problems as a configuration change-control procedure element and separately addresses backup and recovery processes. This supports distinguishing a change-reversal procedure from the restoration action used to recover selected system state; the exact implementation is procedure- and context-dependent.

facts.statement: 제조사 문서는 positioner·I/P·booster package의 기능과 응답이 구성별임을 보여준다. Fisher 846은 current input을 pneumatic output으로 변환하고 pressure feedback, direct/reverse 및 full/split-range mapping, 해당 구성의 calibration과 power-off response를 설명한다. Emerson positioner 자료는 stem/shaft position feedback과 actuator pressure output을 설명하며 Fisher VBL은 positioner와 함께 급격한 입력 변화에서 actuator stroking speed를 높이는 용도로 한정된다. 따라서 선정된 모델과 package 연결부를 기준으로 mapping·feedback·calibration·failure response를 확인해야 하며, 이를 모든 package의 동일 architecture나 fail action으로 일반화하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, 846 Transducer Instruction Manual D102005X012
verification_refs.supports_claim: Documents electrical input to proportional pneumatic output; output-pressure feedback; direct/reverse and full/split-range combinations; model-specific calibration procedures; and different power-off output behavior for direct versus reverse action.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Valve Positioners product overview
verification_refs.locator: What Is a Valve Positioner?
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes a positioner as using stem/shaft position feedback and delivering pneumatic pressure to the actuator so valve position corresponds to the control-system setpoint.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Fisher VBL Volume Booster product description
verification_refs.locator: Product Description and Key Features
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that the VBL is used with a positioner on a throttling control valve to increase stroking speed, especially for large, rapid input changes, and that bypass restriction tunes response to slow signal changes.

facts.statement: Simulation 결과의 신뢰성은 intended use와 검증된 조건·영역에 연결된다. 검증 지점이나 검증 영역 밖으로 결과를 적용할 때는 별도의 공학적 정당화가 필요하며, 시뮬레이션 결과만으로 그 영역의 성능이 입증되는 것은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: Shao, Hightower, Schindel, Credibility Consideration for Digital Twins in Manufacturing, Manufacturing Letters, 2022
verification_refs.locator: Abstract; V&V is tied to intended purpose and design goals
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that verification and validation are necessary to ensure a manufacturing digital twin meets its intended purpose and design goals, and that uncertainty quantification supports credibility assessment.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. FDA, Recognized Consensus Standards database entry for ASME V&V 10-2006, Standard for Verification and Validation in Computational Solid Mechanics
verification_refs.edition_or_version: FDA page accessed 2026-10-12; ASME V&V 10-2006 entry
verification_refs.locator: Scope description concerning validation points and interpolation/extrapolation
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes validation accuracy at specified validation points and says accuracy at other points/domains, including interpolation or extrapolation, requires engineering judgment specific to the problem family. This is used only for the general scope principle, not as robotics-specific evidence.

facts.statement: 접촉식 온도계의 오차 저감은 측정 대상과 설치조건에 맞춰야 한다. 열누설 오차는 일반적으로 침지 길이가 증가할수록 감소하며, 온도 구배가 있는 유체에서는 센서 위치와 유속 변화가 대표 평균온도 지시에 영향을 줄 수 있다. 따라서 침지·위치·혼합 또는 평균센서·교정 조건을 적용별로 선택하고, 유속 증가나 차폐·단열을 보편 대책으로 단정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: BIPM Consultative Committee for Thermometry, Guide on Secondary Thermometry: Thermocouple Thermometry Part 1—General Usage
verification_refs.edition_or_version: 2021 guide; PDF currently served with 2025-12-19 date; accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.supports_claim: §5.8 explains contact-thermometer heat leaks, models relative error as dependent on immersion length, and describes error decreasing exponentially as thermocouple immersion increases within the model. §6 says calibration procedures, operating conditions and thermoelectric state should ideally match those in use. This source is specifically about thermocouple thermometry; the claim is not generalized to every sensor design.

verification_refs.citation: Hurley and Schooley, Calibration of Temperature Measurement Systems Installed in Buildings, NBS Building Science Series 153
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that thermal gradients can cause significant error in indicating the true mean temperature, that such errors often vary with medium velocity and temperature, and that sensor relocation or averaging thermocouples can be preferable to indiscriminate mixing. Also instructs that in-place calibration should avoid disturbing the sensor environment and use a standard in the same environment. This is used for the stated installation/representativeness principle, not as a universal process-plant procedure.

facts.statement: VIM의 계측학적 의미에서 instrumental drift는 측정량이나 인식된 영향량 변화 때문이 아니라 계측기의 계량특성 변화 때문에 지시값이 시간에 따라 연속 또는 점진적으로 변하는 현상이다. 전자부품 자료가 온도에 따른 offset 변화를 ‘drift’로 표기할 수도 있으므로, 검토 시 시간변화와 온도·전원 등 영향량 의존성을 구분하고 각 사양의 조건을 함께 밝혀야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: JCGM 200:2012, International Vocabulary of Metrology (VIM), 3rd edition, term 4.21 instrumental drift
verification_refs.locator: Definition and Note
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines instrumental drift as continuous or incremental change over time in indication due to changes in metrological properties of a measuring instrument; the note says it is related neither to a change in the measured quantity nor to a recognized influence quantity.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, DC Error Characteristics of an Op Amp and the Effect on High-precision Applications
verification_refs.locator: Offset voltage and temperature drift discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Uses and discusses offset voltage drift as a temperature-dependent amplifier parameter. This device/electronics usage is recorded as a conditioned datasheet parameter, distinct from the strict VIM definition rather than substituted for it.

facts.statement: Voltage-reference의 장기 출력 drift는 부품이 즉시 기능고장하지 않더라도 시스템 accuracy를 제한할 수 있다. 따라서 장기 parametric drift를 catastrophic failure와 구분하고, 실제 정확도 요구·부품 안정성·환경에 따라 부품 선정과 교정/유지관리 필요성을 판단하되 보편적인 교정주기를 단정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, AN-713: The Effect of Long-Term Drift on Voltage References
verification_refs.locator: Opening discussion, lines 4–18
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that voltage-reference long-term drift can significantly limit system accuracy, distinguishes it from initial accuracy and temperature coefficient, and describes calibration/burn-in approaches for the specific ADI example. No universal part behavior is inferred.

verification_refs.citation: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods, §8.4.2.3, Fitting models using degradation data instead of failures
verification_refs.locator: §8.4.2.3, common assumptions and degradation modeling
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that a measurable parameter can degrade over time toward a specified critical value at which failure is defined, allowing degradation behavior to be analyzed without waiting for catastrophic failures. The claim is restricted to the general parametric-degradation distinction.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Recommended Calibration Interval
verification_refs.locator: Calibration interval factors and measurement-assurance recommendation
verification_refs.supports_claim: States NIST does not generally set a single recalibration interval and identifies accuracy requirements, device stability and environmental factors as relevant inputs; recorded only to reject a universal interval.

facts.statement: Auto-zero/chopper 증폭기는 특정 설계에서 offset과 offset drift를 낮출 수 있지만 chopping 주파수 성분의 switching artifact를 만들 수 있다. Ratiometric 측정은 센서 출력과 ADC 기준에 공통으로 작용하는 excitation/reference 변동을 적절한 비율 구조에서 상쇄할 수 있으나, Vsupply와 Vref가 다르면 별도 오차가 생길 수 있다. Differential amplifier의 matched resistor network는 저항비·온도추종을 통해 CMRR을 개선할 수 있다. 각 방법은 적용 회로와 신호 대역·오차항을 확인해 선택한다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Demystifying Auto-Zero Amplifiers—Part 1
verification_refs.locator: Auto-zero amplifier characteristics, offset correction and switching artifacts
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes very low effective offset and offset drift for auto-zero topology, and explains that chopping switch charge injection creates noise transients at the clock frequency and harmonics that may affect signals in-band.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Analog Front-End Design Considerations for RTD Ratiometric Temperature Measurements
verification_refs.locator: Introduction and matched input/reference filter discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: For the documented RTD topology, ratiometric acquisition cancels excitation-current accuracy/drift when the analog input remains ratiometric to the ADC reference; matched input/reference path components are specified for that implementation.

verification_refs.citation: Texas Instruments, SBOA628: Ratiometric Data Acquisition of Remote Sensors When Vref and Vsupply are Unequal
verification_refs.locator: §1, equations 1–4 and discussion of Vsupply ≠ Vref; §2.2
verification_refs.supports_claim: Shows cancellation of Vref/Vsupply when the sensor supply equals the ADC reference in the stated ratio topology, and states that unequal voltages introduce uncancelled error requiring an adjusted topology.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, A Practical Review of Common Mode and Instrumentation Amplifiers
verification_refs.locator: Resistor mismatch and temperature tracking discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Derives differential amplifier CMRR dependence on resistor ratios, states ratio and relative temperature-drift mismatch degrade CMRR, and explains that matched networks improve ratio and tracking.

facts.statement: PCB 수준의 noise mitigation은 회로 토폴로지에 맞는 부품 배치·return-current 경로 관리·저임피던스 전원/ground와 적절한 decoupling을 통해 coupling과 supply ripple을 줄이는 방식으로 설계한다. Analog/digital partition이나 ground split은 모든 보드에 일률 적용하지 않고 전류·신호경로·기기 권고를 확인한다. 고임피던스 입력은 누설이 유의한 조건에서 청결·절연과 적절한 guard 구조를 검토한다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, What Are the Basic Guidelines for Layout Design of Mixed-Signal PCBs?
verification_refs.locator: Component Placement, Decoupling Techniques, and Ground Plane sections
verification_refs.supports_claim: Recommends signal-path-aware component placement, close decoupling, short low-impedance return paths and device-specific grounding. It distinguishes single-ground approaches for low digital current from split-ground use cases for more complex/high-current mixed-signal systems.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, AN-1142: Techniques for High Speed ADC PCB Layout
verification_refs.locator: Power distribution system and §§ Splitting Grounds
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains how low-impedance planes and appropriate decoupling reduce supply ripple; warns that indiscriminate ground splitting may increase return-path inductance and voltage noise, while some layout constraints can justify a split.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Layout for Precision Op Amps
verification_refs.locator: Leakage Effects section
verification_refs.supports_claim: States leakage into high-impedance nodes can degrade very-low-current accuracy and describes cleanliness, insulation and appropriately driven guard rings as mitigation under such conditions.

facts.statement: Clock synchronization은 schedule과 event ordering의 공통 기준을 제공하지만 queue, load, forwarding과 application scheduling을 제어하지 않으면 Determinism이 성립하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802.1AS, Timing and Synchronization for Time-Sensitive Applications in Bridged Local Area Networks
verification_refs.locator: Scope and application description
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines synchronization requirements and procedures for time-sensitive applications; it is the common-time reference layer rather than the traffic queue/schedule mechanism.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802.1Qbv, Enhancements for Scheduled Traffic
verification_refs.locator: Purpose and scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Separately specifies time-aware queue-draining procedures for scheduling frame transmission based on 802.1AS-derived timing, demonstrating that synchronization alone does not configure queue transmission windows.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802.1Qci, Per-Stream Filtering and Policing
verification_refs.locator: Scope and purpose
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines stream-based filtering and policing to mitigate disruptive transmissions, showing that traffic load/conformance is a separate concern from clock synchronization.

facts.statement: Digital Twin의 Fidelity는 목적, Model 가정, 해상도, Parameter, Boundary Condition과 Validation 범위에 따라 달라지며 실제 설비와 항상 완전히 동일하지 않다.

verification_refs.citation: Framework for a Digital Twin in Manufacturing: Scope and Requirements
verification_refs.locator: Digital twin perspectives and factors defining scope and constraints
verification_refs.supports_claim: The authors describe digital twins as fit-for-purpose representations, note that the required fidelity depends on the application and intended decision/control action, and distinguish complete from partial representations; this supports that a twin is not necessarily an exact full replica.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Digital Twins for Advanced Manufacturing
verification_refs.locator: Digital Twins for Advanced Manufacturing project description
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST describes systematic identification of digital-twin requirements, problem formulation, relevant-data management, and development, validation, and maintenance of models, supporting fidelity as tied to purpose, model scope, and validation.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, An Overarching Quality Evaluation Framework for Additive Manufacturing Digital Twin
verification_refs.locator: Digital-twin fidelity and data-quality discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that digital-twin fidelity and performance depend on measurement/reference data used in model formulation, training, validation, and verification; the source is specific to additive manufacturing, so it supports the general dependency without making its application-specific process universal.

facts.statement: Synthetic Data는 희귀상황과 위험상황을 보강할 수 있으나 Sensor Noise, Material, Lighting, Contact와 Human 행동의 Domain Gap을 실제 Data로 확인해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Hybrid real-synthetic dataset framework for robotic hazard detection in industrial environments
verification_refs.locator: Abstract, dataset framework, and validation limitations
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes industrial hazards as rare, dangerous, and difficult to reproduce; combines synthetic and real data, and reports a limited validation scope, supporting synthetic augmentation while preserving real-domain validation limits.

verification_refs.citation: Robot Learning From Randomized Simulations: A Review
verification_refs.edition_or_version: Frontiers in Robotics and AI, 2022; accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: Domain randomization parameters and sim-to-real transfer review
verification_refs.supports_claim: Reviews variation of contact/friction models, sensor noise, visual properties and illumination in robotic simulation as domain-randomization parameters, establishing representative sources of simulation-to-reality mismatch without claiming that randomization removes all mismatch.

verification_refs.citation: The Reality Gap in Robotics: Challenges, Solutions, and Best Practices
verification_refs.edition_or_version: Annual Review of Control, Robotics, and Autonomous Systems, 2025; accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: Reality-gap sources: sensor artifacts, material/lighting and human behavior modeling
verification_refs.supports_claim: Reviews sim-to-real gaps involving sensor artifacts, materials and lighting, contact/environment behavior, and the difficulty of modeling human behavior; it treats domain randomization and real-world co-training as mitigation approaches rather than guarantees.

verification_refs.citation: NIST GCR 24-054, Research Opportunities for Advancing Measurement Science for Manufacturing Robotics
verification_refs.locator: Simulation fidelity and transfer to real implementations
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that simulator fidelity in physics and behavior is not generally sufficient to extrapolate reliably to real implementations and that actual equipment/factory data are needed to reduce the gap; this supports real-domain checking within the deployment scope.

facts.statement: Localization은 Robot 또는 이동체의 위치와 자세를 기준좌표계에서 추정하는 기능이며 Map, Landmark, Odometry와 Sensor 불확실성에 의존한다.

verification_refs.citation: Robot Localization: An Introduction
verification_refs.edition_or_version: Wiley Encyclopedia of Electrical and Electronics Engineering; accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: Definition of localization, map/sensor information, noisy observations and estimate uncertainty
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines robot localization as estimating position and orientation within a map from sensor information, and notes that methods must handle noisy observations and represent uncertainty in the estimate.

verification_refs.citation: Mobile Robot Localization and Mapping with Uncertainty using Scale-Invariant Visual Landmarks
verification_refs.edition_or_version: The International Journal of Robotics Research, 2002; accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: Abstract and method overview
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes mobile-robot localization and mapping using visual landmarks and tracks landmark positional uncertainty, supporting landmarks/maps as method-dependent localization inputs whose uncertainty matters.

verification_refs.citation: ROS Enhancement Proposal 105, Coordinate Frames for Mobile Platforms
verification_refs.locator: map, odom, and base_link frame semantics
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies coordinate-frame semantics used by mobile-platform localization components, including map and odometry frames and the drift distinction between odom and a long-term global reference.

facts.statement: 소프트웨어 변경 후 회귀시험은 변경 전 정상 동작하던 기능이 유지되고 결함이 새로 유입되지 않았는지 확인한다. 시험 집합은 변경 영향과 위험을 고려해 선정하며, 변경 기능뿐 아니라 영향 가능한 인터페이스·의존 기능도 해당 범위에 포함한다. OT 변경은 NIST 권고에 따라 배포 전에 문서화·시험·승인하고, 실제 시험범위와 운전 시나리오는 시스템 위험 및 적용 사업장 절차에 맞춘다. 이는 모든 OT 변경에 동일한 고정 시험목록을 요구한다는 뜻이 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-191 Software Regression Testing, Version D
verification_refs.edition_or_version: NASA Software Engineering Handbook Version D; accessed 2026-10-11
verification_refs.locator: §2 Rationale and §3 Guidance
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines software regression testing as re-testing previously integrated/tested software after changes to check that prior functions still work and defects were not introduced. The handbook describes selecting a subset of previous tests based on changed and potentially affected areas and balancing coverage, confidence, time, and effort; this is NASA software engineering guidance, not a universal plant regulation.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: Recommends testing devices before OT deployment and documenting, testing, and approving OT changes before deployment. It illustrates that changing PLC communications can also affect associated HMI communications, supporting change-specific dependency analysis; the document does not prescribe the same regression list for every OT change.

facts.statement: 변경관리 절차는 문제가 발생했을 때 적용할 Rollback 요건을 정해야 한다. 해당 변경에 Rollback이 가능한 경우에는 적용 조건과 복귀할 이전의 승인·안정 형상을 변경별로 식별하고 실행 가능성을 검토한다. 허용시간, 데이터 처리와 세부 결정권한은 시스템 영향 및 적용 조직·사업장 절차에 맞추며, 모든 변경에 동일한 항목이나 일률적 Rollback을 요구하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-128, Guide for Security-Focused Configuration Management of Information Systems
verification_refs.locator: §3.2.2 Configuration Change Control, Chapter 3 printed pp. 18–19 (PDF pp. 30–31)
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST's security-focused configuration management guidance lists requirements for rollback when problems occur among the contents of an organization's configuration change control procedures. The guidance calls for procedures to be defined in organizational context; it does not prescribe a universal trigger/time/data/authority checklist for every operational change.

verification_refs.citation: CISA, Recommended Practice for Patch Management of Control Systems
verification_refs.edition_or_version: Current CISA recommended practice PDF; accessed 2026-10-11
verification_refs.locator: Patch-management planning section, p. 19, Rollback
verification_refs.supports_claim: For patching control systems, CISA recommends that a contingency plan be developed depending on the patch if the patching process corrupts the stable environment. This supports context-specific rollback planning for relevant changes, not mandatory rollback for all changes.

facts.statement: Sliding-stem valve에서는 packing friction이 주요 마찰원이며 deadband의 원인이 될 수 있다. Deadband와 hysteresis는 기계적 응답 특성이고, stiction을 모든 지연·진동의 단일 원인으로 단정하지 않는다. 상세한 밸브 동특성 진단은 Topic 3에서 다룬다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, 6th edition, Chapter 2: Control Valve Performance
verification_refs.locator: §2.1.1.4 Friction, printed p. 38
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that friction is a major cause of control-valve deadband and that packing friction is the primary friction source in sliding-stem valves, varying with valve style and packing arrangement. This supports a possible contributor, not an exclusive diagnosis.

verification_refs.citation: Gregory K. McMillan, Essentials of Modern Measurements and Final Elements, ISA excerpt
verification_refs.locator: §1.5 Hysteresis and Deadband, pp. 61–62
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines hysteresis and deadband by response to input direction reversal and associates these errors with mechanical elements; it cautions against treating them as the same measured quantity.

facts.statement: Balanced trim은 정적 유체 불평형력을 줄이는 기능이고, multi-stage 저소음 trim은 압력강하와 유동을 단계적으로 관리해 소음을 줄이는 별도 기능이다. 두 기능은 상호 배타적이지 않으며 한 밸브에 함께 적용될 수 있다. 상세 소음 설계는 Topic 9에서 다룬다.

verification_refs.citation: Fisher, Actuator Sizing for Sliding-Stem Valves: Force Method, Catalog 14
verification_refs.locator: §A Balanced and Unbalanced Valves, printed p. A-1
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes balanced trim as minimizing net fluid flow forces that create static unbalance and potentially enabling a smaller actuator.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Fisher TBX Steam Conditioning Valve product documentation
verification_refs.locator: Key Features: Whisper Trim III/WhisperFlo noise attenuation and Fisher Bore Seal balanced trim
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes a TBX configuration with Whisper Trim III/WhisperFlo noise attenuation trims and Fisher Bore Seal balanced trim, demonstrating that these design functions can coexist.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, 6th edition, Chapter 5: Control Valve Sizing
verification_refs.locator: §5.16 Noise Control, multistage trim and velocity management
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes documented multistage noise-control trim as distributing pressure reduction among stages and using passage geometry/expansion areas for velocity management and reduced acoustic power conversion; it does not establish one universal trim configuration.

facts.statement: Valve 제조사는 특정 erosive/wear service에 대해 ceramic 또는 hardened trim을 제공하고, 특정 trim construction에는 hardfacing 또는 hard coating 조합을 사용한다. Emerson은 D/DA valve의 ceramic trim을 very erosive service용으로, DST-G의 hardened trim을 wear resistance용으로 설명한다. 적용 가능 유체·온도범위와 보수 방법은 해당 valve/trim construction의 제조사 자료로 확인하며, 이 사례를 모든 재질의 보편적인 적합성이나 한계로 일반화하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Fisher D and DA Control Valves product documentation
verification_refs.locator: Key Features: VTC ceramic trim and tungsten-carbide options
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies ceramic trim for very erosive service and optional tungsten-carbide plug/seat components for erosive service in these product constructions.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Fisher DST-G Trim product documentation
verification_refs.locator: Product Description and Key Features: erosion control and hardened trim materials
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that hardened trim materials provide wear resistance in the DST-G construction and describes its flow-path-specific erosion-control features.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, HP Series Control Valves Product Bulletin D101635X012
verification_refs.locator: Trim Selection Guidelines, p. 29, Trim 210
verification_refs.supports_claim: Documents one S31600 CoCr-A hardfaced plug construction and states that this specific plug can be weld repaired; this is product-specific and does not support universal material limits.

facts.statement: Critical Spare 선정은 해당 부품이 중요 자산을 복구하는 데 필요한지와 그 자산의 고장 결과(안전·환경·운영·임무 영향), redundancy나 대체수단, 조달 및 수리 lead time을 고려하는 자산별 위험판단이다. NASA 시설 RCM 지침은 안전·환경·임무 결과와 redundancy를 고려하고, 높은 수리비나 과도한 spare 조달시간을 높은 criticality의 예로 든다. DOE OIG도 credible failure 뒤 critical asset을 복구하는 데 필요한 부품과 합리적 조달 lead time을 critical spare 맥락에서 설명한다. 과거 사용빈도나 구매가격 하나만으로 분류하지 않으며, 범주·가중치와 repairability·substitution·obsolescence 추가기준은 자산·사업장별로 정한다. 인용 근거가 하나의 보편 분류 알고리즘을 규정하는 것은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Inspector General, DOE-OIG-24-30, Western Area Power Administration Would Benefit From Improvements to Its Management of Critical Spare Parts
verification_refs.locator: Audit summary, critical spare definition and findings, paragraphs 3–5
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines a critical spare in relation to restoring a critical asset after credible failures and reasonable procurement lead times; describes specifying needed critical parts, identifying inventory, establishing sparing levels/reorder points, and staging spares. This is a power-administration audit context, not a universal industrial classification method.

verification_refs.citation: NASA NPR 8831.2D, Appendix G, Sample Facilities Maintenance Plan
verification_refs.locator: §Criticality and Condition; Critical Code 1–4, lines 936–943
verification_refs.supports_claim: The sample facility criticality scale considers mission/high-risk/catastrophic consequences, safety/environmental concerns, high repair costs, excessive spare procurement time, chronic repair history, and redundancy; it explicitly frames this as one example with variations, not a universal scale.

verification_refs.citation: NASA NPR 8831.2E, Chapter 7, Reliability-Centered Maintenance
verification_refs.locator: §7.4.4 failure consequences, §7.4.9 redundancy, §7.7.2.1–7.7.2.2 repair-part availability and reactive maintenance priorities
verification_refs.supports_claim: NASA RCM guidance prioritizes failure consequences including safety, environment and mission, considers redundancy, notes delays if repair parts are unavailable, and ranks repair priorities by consequence. The guide applies to NASA facilities and does not supply one spares classification formula for all plants.

facts.statement: 예비품 보충수준은 품목별 수요와 조달 Lead Time 동안의 수요, 운전·수리 중 공급완충 필요를 고려해 정할 수 있다. Reorder point는 보유·발주 재고가 설정 임계치에 도달했을 때 보충을 촉발하는 한 방법이며, 주문량은 주문비용과 보유비용의 균형을 고려할 수 있다. GAO의 미 해군 재고 사례는 reorder point에 운전요건·조달 Lead Time 요건·안전수준·수리주기 재고를 반영한다. 정확한 산식·수준·주문방식은 품목과 조직의 운영조건에 따라 정하며, 이 근거가 모든 플랜트에 공통인 min/max·MOQ·공용화 규칙을 정하는 것은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. Government Accountability Office, GAO-09-103, Defense Inventory: Management Actions Needed to Improve the Cost Efficiency of the Navy's Spare Parts Inventory
verification_refs.locator: pp. 7–8, operating requirements, repair-cycle stock, acquisition lead-time requirements, reorder point, and economic order quantity
verification_refs.supports_claim: In the Navy inventory system described, reorder-point requirements include operating and acquisition lead-time demand; operating requirements include safety reserve and inventory for parts in repair; the reorder point accounts for demand during replenishment; and economic order quantity balances ordering and holding costs. This is a documented defense-inventory example, not a universal plant formula.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Inspector General, DOE-OIG-24-30, Western Area Power Administration Would Benefit From Improvements to Its Management of Critical Spare Parts
verification_refs.locator: pp. 1–2, findings on sparing levels and locally based reorder points
verification_refs.supports_claim: Reports that WAPA had not established/documented critical-spare inventory levels and reorder points; its warehouse procedure calls for reorder points based on local requirements and the report discusses regional/financial factors. The audit supports locally scoped levels and the operational value of documented reorder points, not a universal inventory formula.

facts.statement: NASA Lessons Learned 724의 우주 시스템 예시에서는 shelf-life가 제한된 예비품을 식별해 주기적으로 조달하고, 만료된 품목은 제거·교체하도록 권고한다. 따라서 shelf-life가 있는 품목은 재고수량과 별도로 만료시점·교체계획을 관리할 수 있다. 이 자료는 특정 보관환경, 방습·방진, 정기 기능시험, firmware/license 확인 또는 FIFO/rotation을 모든 계장 예비품에 공통 요구사항으로 정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Lessons Learned Information System, Lesson 724, Spares with Limited Shelf Life
verification_refs.locator: Spares Philosophy: limited-shelf-life spares; expired shelf-life spares
verification_refs.supports_claim: The lesson says limited shelf-life spares should be identified and acquired periodically and that expired shelf-life spares should be removed and replaced. Its context is space-system maintenance and does not establish a general industrial instrumentation preservation checklist.

facts.statement: 제품 단종 대응은 공급자별 제품 lifecycle 상태에 따라 달라진다. 예를 들어 NI는 Mature, Last Time Buy, support 단계와 discontinued를 구분하고, 일부 단계에서 후속품 또는 제한된 repair/support 가능성을 안내한다. OT 구성품의 대체·변경은 승인된 baseline을 유지하고 배포 전 변경을 문서화·시험·승인하는 구성변경 통제를 적용해야 한다고 NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 권고한다. 따라서 LTB·수리·대체·migration 선택과 필요한 호환성 시험은 해당 제품 및 현장 위험에 맞춰 정하며, 이 자료들은 모든 대체품에 공통인 I/O·통신·전원 등 단일 체크리스트나 보편적 변경 순서를 제시하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Hardware Product Lifecycle Policies
verification_refs.locator: Lifecycle phase table and definitions: Mature, Last Time Buy, Standard Support, Limited Support, Discontinued
verification_refs.supports_claim: For NI hardware, lifecycle phases distinguish purchase availability, recommended replacement, last-time-buy cutoff, and support/repair availability. The page is explicitly NI-specific and is used only as an example of vendor-specific status handling.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.locator: §6.2.4.2, pp. 111–112; OT-specific recommendations on documenting, testing and approving changes before deployment
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST describes configuration management across the system life cycle and recommends approved OT baselines and documented, tested and approved changes before deployment; its OT testing guidance warns not to use live operational systems for testing. This is guidance, not a universal legal MOC procedure.

facts.statement: 점검 프로그램은 외관·전원·배선·접지·배관·누설·환경상태 같은 Routine Inspection과 기능시험, Loop Check, 인터록·알람 시험 등 기능검증을 목적과 위험에 따라 구분해 계획한다.

verification_refs.citation: ANSI/ISA-62382-2026 / IEC 62382:2024, Control Systems in the Process Industry — Electrical and Instrumentation Loop Check
verification_refs.edition_or_version: ISA page states ANSI/ISA-62382-2026 / IEC 62382:2024; accessed 2026-10-11
verification_refs.locator: ISA-105 Series, Loop Check standard description
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISA describes loop check as a separate activity that verifies electrical and instrumentation loop integrity after installation and before cold commissioning across field devices, panels, PLC/DCS and connecting infrastructure; this supports distinguishing functional loop verification from routine condition inspection.

verification_refs.citation: OSHA, 29 CFR 1910.119 Appendix C, Compliance Guidelines and Recommendations for Process Safety Management, §9 Mechanical Integrity
verification_refs.locator: §9, lines on MI program elements, equipment prioritization, external inspections, tests and inspection frequency
verification_refs.supports_claim: For covered PSM processes, OSHA lists equipment/instrumentation identification and categorization, inspections and tests, frequencies, procedures, acceptance criteria and records; it says equipment needing closer scrutiny should be prioritized using applicable data and experience, and gives external-inspection examples including grounding connections, piping, valves, sensors, alarms and interlocks. Appendix C is guidance and does not prescribe one checklist for all industries.

verification_refs.citation: NASA, Reliability-Centered Maintenance Guide for Facilities and Collateral Equipment, Table I-32, Procedure M-00016, Valve, Automatic, Inspection and Cleaning
verification_refs.locator: Appendix I, pp. I-97–I-98
verification_refs.supports_claim: The example maintenance procedure separately lists equipment identification, proper-operation check, packing leakage, pneumatic operator/tubing leakage, exterior cleaning and recording deficiencies, illustrating condition inspection and operational/function check as distinct procedure steps for this automatic-valve case.

facts.statement: 유지보수 관리 KPI는 MTBF·MTTR·가용도 외에도 PM Compliance, Schedule Compliance, Maintenance Backlog, 긴급정비 비율 등을 사용할 수 있으며, 각 지표는 목표·분모·제외조건과 데이터 수집규칙을 먼저 정의해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Society for Maintenance & Reliability Professionals, Best Practices Metrics MicroLearning and Best Practices, Metrics & Guidelines
verification_refs.edition_or_version: Current SMRP metric catalog, accessed 2026-10-11; Best Practices 7th Edition listed by SMRP
verification_refs.locator: Best Practices Metric List: Availability, MTBF, MTTR, Schedule Compliance, Planned/Ready Backlog, PM/PdM Compliance and Reactive Work; FAQ on Best Practice metric components
verification_refs.supports_claim: SMRP lists the named availability, MTBF, MTTR, PM/PdM compliance, schedule-compliance, planned/ready backlog and reactive-work indicators as its maintenance/reliability metrics. Its official Best Practices description says each metric includes definitions, objectives, formula, component definitions and qualifications, sample calculation, targets, cautions and harmonization notes; this supports defining comparable metric boundaries and data rules, not adopting one universal target.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. Department of Energy, Federal Energy Management Program, Operations & Maintenance Best Practices: A Guide to Achieving Operational Efficiency, Release 3.0
verification_refs.locator: §3.4, Table 3.1.1, PDF p. 31 (printed p. 3.4)
verification_refs.supports_claim: The guide's example O&M metric table defines equipment availability, schedule-compliance percentage as scheduled hours worked divided by total scheduled hours, and emergency-maintenance percentage as emergency-job hours divided by total hours worked. These are documented example metrics and benchmarks for that guide, not universal target values.

facts.statement: Pipe transmission loss는 diameter, wall thickness, material, frequency와 service condition에 의존한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-8-3:2010, Industrial-process control valves — Part 8-3: Noise considerations — Control valve aerodynamic noise prediction method
verification_refs.locator: Introduction; §1 scope; §5.5 Pipe transmission loss calculation; symbol table for TL(f), pipe wall thickness, downstream density and sound speed
verification_refs.supports_claim: The method calculates frequency-dependent pipe-wall transmission loss, distinguishes pipe wall thickness and downstream fluid density/sound-speed variables, and limits applicability to steel and steel-alloy pipes. It treats acoustic interaction with the pipe wall and frequency-dependent transmission; it is a scoped prediction model, not a universal model for every pipe material or service.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Handbook, 6th edition, Chapter 5, Control Valve Sizing / Aerodynamic Noise Prediction
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 5, aerodynamic noise prediction method, pipe transmission-loss discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that pipe-wall material, size and shape govern transmission and that the prediction compares internal sound spectrum with frequency-dependent pipe transmission loss to estimate external sound.

facts.statement: Diffuser·orifice는 system pressure drop을 분담하지만 capacity, erosion과 자체 noise를 함께 검토한다.

verification_refs.citation: Valmet, Flow Control Manual, Gas and Steam Flow
verification_refs.locator: Diffusers; capacity sizing under maximum flow; separate valve/diffuser noise calculation; annular velocity and regenerated-noise limit; gas/steam velocity guidance for impurities or wet steam
verification_refs.supports_claim: Valmet describes a downstream diffuser as a fixed-area resistance that can divide pressure drop in high, relatively constant-pressure-drop service. It sizes diffuser capacity at maximum flow, calculates valve and diffuser noise separately and combines their levels, warns excessive annular velocity can limit noise reduction/regenerate noise, and says velocities should be lowered for impurities or wet steam to prevent erosion. These recommendations are conditional on the documented gas/steam and installation cases.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, D103540X012 Reference Manual, Valve with Whisper Trim I and Inline Diffuser Combination
verification_refs.locator: Figure 6-2 and adjacent inline diffuser description
verification_refs.supports_claim: The product manual describes the diffuser as a fixed restriction that increases valve backpressure, reduces the pressure drop across the valve, and can extend the applicable pressure-drop range for the named trim. It states the diffuser is effective only for the condition for which it is sized and is not effective in throttling applications.

facts.statement: Control valve noise 평가는 acoustic quantity, source mechanism, transmission path, mitigation과 field verification을 통합한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-8-1:2005, Industrial-process control valves — Part 8-1: Noise considerations — Laboratory measurement of noise generated by aerodynamic flow through control valves
verification_refs.locator: Scope and purpose
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines laboratory equipment, methods and procedures for sound-pressure measurements for compressible-fluid valve/piping configurations; results support comparison of valve performance and planning noise-abatement measures. Its scope excludes valves discharging to atmosphere.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-8-2:2011, Industrial-process control valves — Part 8-2: Noise considerations — Laboratory measurement of noise generated by hydrodynamic flow through control valves
verification_refs.locator: Publication scope and method description
verification_refs.supports_claim: Covers liquid-flow sound-pressure measurement, characteristic noise increase at cavitation onset, required equipment/procedures, and both radiated and internal-pipe pressure measurement methods under defined operating conditions.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-8-3:2010, Industrial-process control valves — Part 8-3: Noise considerations — Control valve aerodynamic noise prediction method
verification_refs.locator: Scope, calculation method and pipe-transmission-loss provisions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides a scoped aerodynamic prediction method that estimates frequency-dependent sound and includes downstream pipe transmission and external observation conditions; it does not establish the hydrodynamic method or a universal workflow.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-8-4:2015, Industrial-process control valves — Part 8-4: Noise considerations — Prediction of noise generated by hydrodynamic flow
verification_refs.locator: Publication scope and method description
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides a separate liquid-flow prediction method for resulting sound measured downstream outside the pipe; it accounts for normal turbulence and liquid cavitation and predicts as a function of frequency.

verification_refs.citation: ISA75.07, Control Valve Noise Measurement and Prediction committee scope
verification_refs.locator: Scope, items 1–3
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISA's committee scope includes laboratory and field measurement of control-valve noise, prediction or verification of generated noise, and related test-facility/documentation activities. This is scope evidence, not a claim that all field verification is mandated.

verification_refs.citation: Valmet, Flow Control Manual, Gas and Steam Flow, source and path treatment
verification_refs.locator: Noise abatement, source treatment and path treatment sections
verification_refs.supports_claim: Separates source treatments such as trim/diffuser design from transmission-path treatments such as silencers, insulation and heavier pipe schedule, linking mitigation to the identified generation/transmission mechanism.

facts.statement: Noise control은 source, transmission path와 receiver 순서로 구분하고 효과를 중복 산정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: ASHRAE Handbook—HVAC Applications (2019), Chapter 49, Noise and Vibration Control
verification_refs.locator: §1, lines 15–16; §2, lines 21–23; receiver-level discussion §2.5
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines noise-control system analysis by source, transmission path (airborne and/or structureborne), and receiver; explains that receiver sound pressure depends on source radiation, room acoustics, distance, and observation point. This supports the conceptual separation and receiver-condition dependency, not a control-valve-specific calculation rule.

verification_refs.citation: Valmet, Finding the source of all that noise
verification_refs.locator: Noise abatement overview and source/path treatment sections
verification_refs.supports_claim: Separates measures that limit noise generation at the valve/source from path-abatement measures that damp already-generated noise, and describes selecting source and path treatment combinations based on the loop.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-8-3:2010, Industrial-process control valves — Part 8-3: Noise considerations — Control valve aerodynamic noise prediction method
verification_refs.locator: Prediction method and downstream pipe transmission provisions
verification_refs.supports_claim: The prediction method treats generated aerodynamic noise, frequency-dependent downstream pipe transmission loss, and resulting external sound as linked stages. The same attenuation must not be applied again as an independent path reduction unless the method models a distinct additional treatment.

facts.statement: Vendor result는 source level, octave spectrum, external SPL, selected travel와 mitigation 조건으로 교차 검증한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-8-3:2010, Industrial-process control valves — Part 8-3: Noise considerations — Control valve aerodynamic noise prediction method
verification_refs.locator: Scope; frequency-dependent prediction; internal/external sound and pipe transmission provisions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines a scoped compressible-flow prediction method for external sound pressure, predicts as a function of frequency, and includes the downstream piping transmission model. This supports checking model/service applicability, spectrum, source-side and external quantities, and pipe reference conditions; it does not define a universal commercial report format.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-8-2:2011, Industrial-process control valves — Part 8-2: Noise considerations — Laboratory measurement of noise generated by hydrodynamic flow through control valves
verification_refs.locator: Scope and defined laboratory test conditions/data
verification_refs.supports_claim: Separately scopes hydrodynamic laboratory measurement and requires controlled operating conditions; the method's test data include measured travel along with flow, pressure and temperature, and prescribe background-noise control. It must not be confused with the aerodynamic prediction method or treated as a general prediction-report checklist.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Catalog 12, Section 3: Noise and Vibration, February 2018
verification_refs.locator: pp. 3-1–3-3, hydrodynamic prediction correction, observer distance, octave-band levels and source/path noise treatment
verification_refs.supports_claim: Distinguishes octave-band spectrum from an overall external SPL, gives reference-distance correction for the pipeline source, differentiates source/path treatment, and relates prediction corrections to valve/application terms. It supports checking the reported quantities and case configuration, not assuming every vendor uses identical report fields.

facts.statement: Small passage와 multi-stage trim은 plugging, erosion, particle tolerance와 maintenance를 검토한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Noise-Attenuation Technologies for Control Valves, D351989X012
verification_refs.locator: pp. 12–13, Whisper Trim passages and Dirty Service Trim particulate/plugging/erosion features
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes noise-attenuation trims using multiple small passages/jets and, separately, a dirty-service multi-stage design with large openings allowing particulate passage and minimizing plugging/erosion. The contrast supports checking passage/solids compatibility rather than assuming every trim has identical dirty-service capability.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher Product Bulletin 80.2:021, Fisher Dirty Service Anti-Cavitation Trim (DST), D102310X012
verification_refs.locator: p. 1 features; p. 3 principle of operation; p. 5 application information
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies that entrained particles can plug passages or cause erosion in conventional anti-cavitation trims; describes a particular staged axial/radial DST with larger openings, stated particle-passage limits, reduced clearance-flow erosion, and in-line removal for inspection. Its limits are product-specific, not universal to low-noise trims.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Fisher Dirty Service Trim product description
verification_refs.locator: Product description and key features
verification_refs.supports_claim: Confirms the named DST's particle passage rating, staged flow area design, protected seat against throttling wear, and cage-type removal/inspection feature. These are model-specific examples of the checks expected for a dirty-service multi-stage trim.

facts.statement: Prediction과 현장 measurement 차이는 입력·유동영역·배관전달·관측조건·반사·배경소음의 정합성을 순차 점검하는 진단 체크리스트로 분석한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-8-3:2010, Industrial-process control valves — Part 8-3: Noise considerations — Control valve aerodynamic noise prediction method
verification_refs.locator: Scope and method description; fluid phase, valve type, downstream piping, frequency-dependent external sound-pressure prediction
verification_refs.supports_claim: The method's stated assumptions define which flow regime, process inputs, valve configuration and downstream pipe conditions can support a meaningful comparison; it computes external sound pressure from the internal spectrum and pipe transmission. It is limited to single-phase dry gases/vapours and its listed valve/piping conditions, so mismatch or out-of-scope use is a diagnostic possibility, not proof of cause.

verification_refs.citation: ISA75.07, Control Valve Noise Measurement and Prediction, committee scope
verification_refs.locator: Scope: laboratory and field measurement, prediction or verification of control-valve-generated noise
verification_refs.supports_claim: Confirms that control-valve noise measurement and prediction/verification are distinct but related technical activities. It does not prescribe the anchor's specific diagnostic order.

verification_refs.citation: ISO 1996-2:2017, Acoustics — Description, measurement and assessment of environmental noise — Part 2: Determination of sound pressure levels
verification_refs.locator: Scope and sound-pressure determination by direct measurement or calculation from measurements
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides a measurement framework whose determined sound-pressure result depends on the measurement scenario and method. It is environmental-noise guidance, not a control-valve-specific cause hierarchy; measurement location, acoustic environment/reflection and background must therefore be checked under the applicable measurement method rather than presumed universal.

facts.statement: OT legacy system은 단순 연식만으로 즉시 교체하거나 무기한 유지하지 않고, 공정 영향과 보안·지원·부품·호환성·전문성·중단위험을 고려해 유지·보강·격리·교체·Migration 대안을 위험기반으로 판단한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.locator: §2.2, pp. 30–32 (OT differences, legacy limitations, support, lifetime, planned outages); §2.2, p. 55 (replacement parts over product life); §5.4 asset management; §6.2.4 response/recovery
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that OT may use unsupported OSs, custom applications, proprietary communications, single-vendor support and long lifetimes; changes require thorough testing and outages may require advance scheduling. It also directs consideration of replacement-part availability and identifies cases where security changes may affect OT operation or safety. These factors support a site-specific lifecycle risk decision, not a universal age threshold or mandated action.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. President's National Security Telecommunications Advisory Committee, Report to the President on Information Technology and Operational Technology Convergence
verification_refs.locator: §1.6.2, Compensating Controls are an Alternative to Patching and Tech Refresh
verification_refs.supports_claim: The report cautions that some legacy devices have no replacement available and that blanket advice to remove legacy assets is unhelpful; it supports considering compensating controls and risk-based alternatives. It does not define a universal decision matrix or require all listed factors in every assessment.

facts.statement: Fisher 3570의 action 변경 절차는 valve assembly를 service에서 분리하기 전 임시 process control을 두고, control valve를 bypass하며 positioner input signal과 supply pressure를 차단하도록 한다. 변경 후에는 adjustment procedure에 따라 동작을 확인하고 action label을 갱신한다. 이는 3570 모델 절차이며 보편적인 manual-handwheel 복귀 순서는 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson Fisher, 3570 Positioners Instruction Manual D200137X012
verification_refs.locator: Warning and Changing Positioner Action, pp. 12–13
verification_refs.supports_claim: Warns that the positioner/actuator/valve assembly must be taken out of service with temporary process control to avoid uncontrolled process pressure. The direct- and reverse-action procedures bypass the control valve and shut off positioner input and supply pressure; the steps then check operation using the adjustment procedure and update the positioner action label. The cited sequence is specific to Fisher 3570 and does not define a universal handwheel or bypass restoration process.

facts.statement: Fisher 3570의 제조사 설정은 주문된 travel·input range·action을 따른다. 이 모델에서 bias spring은 zero/시작점, range spring은 input range에 대한 전체 travel/span, relay-nozzle 조정은 steady-state output pressure를 정한다. 조정 전 명판의 input range와 valve travel을 현재 조건과 대조한다. 이는 보편적 cam·I/P·booster 설정을 뜻하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson Fisher, 3570 Positioners Instruction Manual D200137X012
verification_refs.locator: Operating Information—Initial Adjustments and Adjustment Procedures, pp. 10–11
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies the bias spring as the zero adjustment determining valve-plug starting point, the range spring as the span adjustment determining full valve-plug travel for a given input range, and the relay-nozzle adjustment as determining steady-state output pressure. The same section says the model is factory set to ordered travel/input range/action and directs checking nameplate range and travel against present conditions. These descriptions are specific to Fisher 3570 and do not define settings for other makes or I/P/booster devices.

facts.statement: Fisher 3570 positioner는 주문된 travel·input signal range·action으로 출고되며, 제조사는 operating condition 변경, 분해·재조립 또는 valve travel과 요구 input range 불일치 시 조정이 필요하다고 설명한다. 조정 전 nameplate의 input range와 valve travel을 현재 조건과 대조한다. 이는 모든 startup·shutdown 또는 ΔP 변화가 calibration을 무효화한다는 뜻은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson Fisher, 3570 Positioners Instruction Manual D200137X012
verification_refs.locator: Operating Information—Initial Adjustments, p. 11
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that the positioner is factory set for ordered travel, input signal range and action; adjustment is needed when operating conditions change, after dismantling/reassembly, or when valve travel does not match the desired input signal range. Before adjustment, check the input range and nameplate valve travel against current operating conditions. This is Fisher 3570-specific and does not state that every pressure or startup/shutdown change invalidates calibration.

facts.statement: Positioner endpoint 설정은 장치별 지침에 따른다. Masoneilan SVI II ESD는 full stroke가 nominal valve travel보다 큰 경우 표시 100%를 nominal travel에 맞추는 STOP OP 보정을 제공한다. Fisher DVC2000은 Travel Cutoff Low가 seat load 확보에 쓰일 수 있다고 설명하고 해당 모델의 0.5% 설정을 권고한다. 이 기능·수치를 다른 모델에 일반화하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Baker Hughes Masoneilan, SVI II ESD Installation and Maintenance Manual
verification_refs.locator: §Correct for Over Travel, p. 97
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that on some valves full travel exceeds nominal valve travel and describes STOP OP to make reported 100% correspond to nominal full-open travel. This is a device-specific correction procedure, not a universal requirement.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson Fisher, FIELDVUE DVC2000 Digital Valve Controller Instruction Manual D103176X012
verification_refs.locator: §Limits and Cutoff, pp. 20–21
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines Travel Cutoff Low as a device parameter that can ensure proper seat load and recommends 0.5% to help ensure maximum shutoff seat loading. The value is stated only for the Fisher DVC2000 context and is not generalized to other positioners or valves.

facts.statement: IEC 62382:2024 Annex A.4의 control-stroke 예는 중간 travel을 증가·감소 방향에서 비교해 hysteresis를 확인한다. Up/down 차이만으로 deadband 또는 stiction 원인을 단정하지 않으며, 상세 진단과 개선은 Topic 3에서 다룬다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 62382:2024, Control systems in the process industry — Electrical and instrumentation loop check
verification_refs.locator: Annex A.4, Actuators and valves, Control Stroke example
verification_refs.supports_claim: The control-stroke example checks intermediate points such as 25%, 50% and 75% open in both increasing and decreasing directions to detect hysteresis. The standard's publisher description says the standard describes what is intended to be tested rather than how to perform the test; the example does not prescribe a universal hysteresis acceptance limit. It does not establish deadband or stiction as causes of a measured directional difference.

facts.statement: Vendor-specific 기능의 편익과 공급자 종속 위험은 균형 평가하며, 중요도에 따라 데이터·설정 이동성, 인터페이스·대체 가능성, 서비스·IP·도구 접근 조건 및 전환 비용을 수명주기 동안 검토한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Government Digital Service and Central Digital and Data Office, Managing technical lock-in in the cloud
verification_refs.locator: Types of lock-in; understand technical lock-in; manage technical lock-in
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that technical lock-in is not always unacceptable: provider-specific features can create value, while portability, switching preparation, data export/open formats and exit strategy should be weighed against the benefit and cost of changing provider. It is government cloud guidance, used here for the general lifecycle trade-off principle and not represented as an OT-specific mandate.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.locator: §2.2, pp. 30–32: proprietary protocols, vendor-managed support, long component lifetime, custom applications and planned outages; §2.2, p. 55: replacement-part/supply availability
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes OT-specific supplier and lifecycle constraints, including proprietary communication protocols, support that may be available only from one vendor, vendor licensing/service restrictions, long deployed lifetimes, custom applications and replacement-part availability. These support assessing dependency and continuity risks in context; they do not require open interfaces, source-code access, or avoidance of a particular supplier.

verification_refs.citation: UK Government, Open Standards Principles
verification_refs.locator: Implications for organisations: transfer between old and new systems, data sharing and APIs
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides a public-sector IT example of using open standards and data/API portability to reduce lock-in and ease transfer. It does not define obligations for private industrial facilities or OT systems; its use is limited to the general portability mechanism.

facts.statement: Rockwell ControlLogix 5590 사례에서 controller firmware와 Studio 5000 Logix Designer는 같은 major revision이어야 하고, 호환성이 확인된 software build를 사용해야 한다. SIL 3/PLe Safety Partner 구성에서는 primary와 partner firmware revision도 일치해야 한다. 이는 해당 제품군의 호환성 조건이며 모든 OT 플랫폼에 공통인 firmware 선정 checklist를 규정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Rockwell Automation, ControlLogix 5590 Controller User Manual, 1756-UM900B-EN-P
verification_refs.locator: Controller Firmware and Logix Designer Application Compatibility; Safety Consideration for SIL 3/PLe Safety Partner
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual states that ControlLogix 5590 controller firmware and Studio 5000 Logix Designer must have the same major revision; compatible builds are tested together while unidentified pairs are not guaranteed; PCDC Compare provides compatibility information; and, for a SIL 3/PLe safety system with a Safety Partner, primary and partner firmware must match.

facts.statement: 미국 OSHA PSM 적용 공정에서는 서면 운전절차가 현재 운전관행을 반영하도록 필요한 만큼 검토·갱신하고 매년 최신·정확성을 인증해야 한다. 공정 운전자는 해당 운전절차에 대해 교육받아야 하며, 교육받은 사람·날짜·이해도 확인방법을 기록한다. 이는 29 CFR 1910.119 적용 공정의 요건이며 모든 OT 설비에 대한 일반 문서목록이나 지식관리 규칙은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: OSHA, 29 CFR 1910.119, Process safety management of highly hazardous chemicals
verification_refs.supports_claim: For covered processes, operating procedures must reflect current operating practice, be reviewed as often as necessary, and be certified annually as current and accurate. Operators must receive applicable initial training in the process and operating procedures. Training records must identify the employee, training date, and method used to verify understanding.

facts.statement: NASA NPR 4100.1F의 NASA 물자관리 사례에서는 shelf-life 품목을 비연장(Type I)과 시험으로 사용가능성을 판단할 수 있는 연장형(Type II)으로 구분한다. 기한이 있는 품목은 만료 전 사용을 관리하고, Type II 품목은 용도에 계속 적합한지 시험하는 절차를 둔다. 이 예시는 NASA 공급관리 범위이며 모든 OT spare에 공통인 분류·시험 주기를 규정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA NPR 4100.1F, Supply Support and Materiel Management
verification_refs.locator: §§3.4.1–3.4.2, Management of Shelf-Life Materiels
verification_refs.supports_claim: NASA classifies shelf-life items as Type I non-extendable or Type II extendible; Type I becomes unusable after the shelf-life date, Type II may be tested for continued intended-use suitability, and procedures manage use before expiration and testing of Type II items.

facts.statement: DoD SD-22 DMSMS Guidebook은 단종·공급부족 대응을 현 재고/승인품 사용, life-of-need buy, repair·refurbishment·reclamation, 생산·지원 연장, 단순·복합 substitute, 신규 item/source 개발 등 resolution 범주로 구분하고 정의·사례를 제시한다. 해법은 기술 관여도와 qualification 복잡도가 다르며, 이 분류는 해당 guidebook의 DMSMS 프로그램 taxonomy이지 모든 OT 설비에 대한 의무 선택목록은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: DoD, Diminishing Manufacturing Sources and Material Shortages: A Guidebook of Best Practices for Implementing a Robust DMSMS Management Program, SD-22
verification_refs.locator: Table 9, pp. 95–100 (PDF pages 97–102): DMSMS Resolution Options, Definitions, and Examples
verification_refs.supports_claim: Table 9 defines and provides examples for no solution/stock through next refresh, approved item, life-of-need buy, repair/refurbishment/reclamation, production/support extension, simple/complex substitute, and new item/source development; the text distinguishes logistics, engineering, and qualification effort among categories.

facts.statement: DoD SD-22 DMSMS Guidebook은 license downgrade를 공급자와 협의해 구버전 사용권한을 연장하는 사례와, life-of-need 기간 동안 필요한 software licensing/support를 확보하는 resolution 예시를 제시한다. 이 접근은 공급자가 해당 기간 동안 존속할 수 있다는 전제를 명시하며, license 이전·가상화·비상복구 권한을 일반적으로 보장하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: DoD, Diminishing Manufacturing Sources and Material Shortages: A Guidebook of Best Practices for Implementing a Robust DMSMS Management Program, SD-22
verification_refs.locator: Table 9, printed pp. 95–98: Life-of-need buy and extension of production or support examples
verification_refs.supports_claim: Table 9 explains that sufficient software licensing/support may be obtained for a life-of-need period subject to the vendor remaining in business; another example negotiates a license downgrade with the vendor to extend authorized use of an older product until retirement.

facts.statement: Oracle Zero Downtime Migration의 physical online migration에서는 switchover 뒤에도 new primary에서 original source standby로 redo 전송이 유지되면 original source로 minimal-downtime rollback이 가능하다. switchover 뒤 연결·동기화가 없으면 original source로 fallback할 수 없고, fallback은 수동 수행해야 한다. 이는 Oracle ZDM 절차의 제품별 조건이며 일반 OT 변경에 대한 forward-recovery checklist를 규정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Oracle, Zero Downtime Migration 26.1 User Guide, Introduction to Zero Downtime Migration
verification_refs.locator: §1.2.1 Physical Online Migration, post-switchover fallback, lines 84–91
verification_refs.supports_claim: Oracle documents that redo synchronization from the new primary to the original source standby permits rollback with minimal downtime; if post-switchover connectivity/synchronization is absent, the original source cannot be used as fallback; any fallback must be done manually.

facts.statement: ASME B16.34-2025는 적용 범위에 해당하는 신규 flanged, threaded, welding-end 및 wafer/flangeless valve construction에 대해 pressure-temperature ratings, materials, dimensions, examination, testing 및 marking을 규정한다. 선정 시 이 표준이 적용되는 valve scope와 해당 material/rating 조건을 확인하되, 이 조항을 flange·배관 전체의 보편적인 rating 표준으로 확대하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: ASME B16.34-2025, Valves—Flanged, Threaded, and Welding End
verification_refs.locator: Standard description and scope (new construction; valve-end types, material coverage, pressure-temperature ratings and related requirements)
verification_refs.supports_claim: ASME states B16.34 applies to new construction and covers pressure-temperature ratings, dimensions, tolerances, materials, nondestructive examination, testing and marking for its specified flanged, threaded, welding-end, and wafer/flangeless valve types and listed materials.

facts.statement: Emerson Control Valve Handbook §5.19의 valve-body material selection guidance는 pressure, temperature, corrosive properties 및 erosive properties of the flow media를 고려하며, erosion resistance와 corrosion resistance가 상충할 수 있다고 설명한다. 이는 valve body 선택 예시로 한정되며 trim, stem, seat, fastener 또는 모든 fluid chemistry에 대한 보편 재질 적합성 checklist를 제시하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, D101881X012
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 5, §5.19 Valve Body Materials, p. 139
verification_refs.supports_claim: The handbook says body material selection is usually based on pressure, temperature, and corrosive and erosive properties of the flow media; it notes that a material with good erosion resistance may have inadequate corrosion resistance for a particular fluid, requiring a compromise.

facts.statement: ANSI/FCI 70-2의 shutoff/leakage class는 정의된 시험조건에서 제어밸브 seat tightness의 최대 허용 누설량을 기준화하여, 사용자가 적용에 적합한 rated leakage를 선정하고 제조자 시험 결과를 비교하도록 돕는다. 이 benchmark만으로 다른 현장 운전조건의 leakage를 보증하지는 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Fluid Controls Institute, ANSI/FCI 70-2 Informational Sheet
verification_refs.locator: Why is ANSI/FCI 70-2 important?; defined test conditions and maximum allowable leakage
verification_refs.supports_claim: FCI states that ANSI/FCI 70-2 defines benchmarks for control-valve seat tightness as maximum allowable leakage under defined test conditions, supporting selection of rated leakage for an application and comparison of manufacturer offerings using a defined procedure.

facts.statement: Fisher Control Valve Catalog 12의 ANSI/FCI 70-2 class 표는 class별 maximum leakage expression과 test medium, pressure 및 temperature 조건을 제시하며, 이를 factory acceptance test 조건으로 한정하고 very-low-leakage 결과를 다른 조건으로 외삽하면 오해를 낳을 수 있다고 경고한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Catalog 12, Section 2: Leakage Specifications
verification_refs.locator: Leakage Specifications, ANSI/FCI 70-2 class table and factory-acceptance/extrapolation note
verification_refs.supports_claim: Fisher's table lists maximum leakage, test medium, and pressure/temperature for ANSI/FCI 70-2 classes; its note identifies the values as factory acceptance tests under shown conditions and warns that extrapolating very low leakage rates to other conditions can be misleading.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT 보안이 성능·신뢰성·안전 요구를 고려해야 하며, 보안위험 분류에서 기밀성·무결성·가용성의 영향을 평가하고 OT에서는 가용성이 일반적으로 가장 큰 우려라고 설명한다. 보안 요구를 배정할 때 성능과 안전 영향도 고려한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.locator: §4.3.2, pp. 59–60; Table 6, Task P-17, p. 58; OT security requirements and risk discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST says OT security must address unique performance, reliability, and safety requirements; CIA impacts are categorized and availability is generally the greatest concern for OT; allocation of security requirements should consider performance and safety impacts.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT 자산관리에서 장치·시스템·시설과 그 상대적 중요도를 식별·관리하고, 하드웨어 세부정보, 설치된 software·firmware와 version, vendor 정보, asset owner 및 운영·정비·보안 책임을 기록하며 구성 변경에 따라 inventory를 갱신하도록 권고한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.locator: §6.1.1, pp. 91–92, Asset Management (ID.AM) and OT-Specific Recommendations
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST describes identifying and managing data, personnel, devices, systems, and facilities by relative importance; tracking hardware details/location, installed software and firmware versions, vendor information, and documented asset owner and operations/maintenance/cybersecurity responsibilities; and updating inventory when components change.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT 위험평가에서 위협과 취약성, 그로 인한 피해 및 불리한 사건의 발생가능성을 식별·평가하고, 물리적·디지털 영향과 공정·안전 영향을 함께 고려하도록 안내한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST describes risk assessment as identifying threats and vulnerabilities, potential harm, and likelihood; for OT it calls out safety, physical impacts, and effects on the controlled process.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3의 OT risk management tasks는 stakeholder asset 식별·우선화, authorization boundary 결정, 처리·저장·전송 정보유형 파악과 시스템·네트워크 data flow 및 interconnection 문서화를 포함한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST's OT risk-management tasks include identifying and prioritizing stakeholder assets, determining the authorization boundary, identifying information types, and documenting data flows/interconnections to understand network behavior.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 IT·OT 장치를 관리권한, trust level, 기능 중요도, data flow, 위치 등의 기준으로 구분·분리하도록 권고하며, levels·tiers·zones를 이용한 segmentation으로 접근을 제어하면서 운전성능과 안전을 고려한다. Firewall 규칙은 인접 segment 사이의 허용 연결로 제한한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.locator: §5.2.3.1, pp. 71–73; firewall OT-specific guidance, p. 73
