verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST recommends characterizing, segmenting, and isolating IT/OT devices using criteria such as management authority, trust, functional criticality, data flow, and location; levels, tiers, or zones control access while considering operational performance and safety; firewall rules should only permit connections between adjacent segments.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 DMZ 네트워크 구조로 corporate/enterprise와 OT 사이의 direct traffic을 방지하고, enterprise와 operations-management level 간 통신은 DMZ 내 서비스를 통과하도록 구성하며 해당 서비스를 monitoring·protection 하여 OT로의 pivot을 방지하도록 안내한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.locator: §2.2, pp. 4–5; §5.3.2.2, pp. 102–105; SCADA security architecture example
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST recommends a DMZ architecture that prevents direct corporate/OT traffic; communications from enterprise to operations management pass through DMZ services, which should be monitored and protected against compromise and pivoting.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 unidirectional gateway/data diode를 하드웨어상 단일방향 전송만 허용해 반대 방향 통신을 지원하지 않는 장치로 설명하며, OT에서 enterprise 방향의 데이터 송신은 허용하고 enterprise에서 OT로의 유입 경로를 차단하는 예를 제시한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST states that a unidirectional gateway/data diode permits authorized communication in only one direction and may protect lower layers from events at higher layers; Appendix E explains that hardware prevents bidirectional data flow and gives an operational-to-enterprise example that blocks inbound traffic.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 application allowlisting을 host에서 실행이 허용된 application을 제한하는 추가 보호수단으로 설명하며, 올바르게 구성하면 비인가 application이 host에서 실행되지 않는다고 명시한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST says application allowlisting restricts which applications are allowed to execute on hosts and, when properly configured, non-authorized applications will not execute.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 가능한 경우 OT patch를 sandbox/test 환경에서 production 전에 시험하고, 환경의 scheduled maintenance window에 적용을 계획하며 대상 OT component/system의 recovery plan을 마련하도록 권고한다. OT zone·tier별 availability 차이는 patch 적용 가능성에도 영향을 준다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST recommends testing patches in a sandbox before production whenever possible, planning them for scheduled maintenance windows, preparing recovery plans, and notes differing zone/tier availability requirements may affect ability to patch.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 firewall rules가 인접 level·tier·zone 사이의 연결만 허용하도록 구성하고, inbound·outbound 통신 모두 authorized communication만 통과하도록 정의할 것을 권고한다. 관리되지 않은 lower-level outbound 연결은 위험이 될 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.locator: §5.2.3.1, pp. 72–73; OT-specific firewall guidance
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST recommends firewall rules permitting only connections between adjacent levels/tiers/zones, defines inbound and outbound authorized communications, and notes unmanaged lower-level outbound connections can represent significant risk.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT log entry에 장치 식별자와 timestamp, 발생 위치·event type·source, 관련 user/system account와 event outcome 등을 포함하도록 설명하며, 기록 항목은 장치 capability와 필요한 event에 맞게 선택한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST says logs should identify the device, timestamp, event location/type/source, associated user/system account, and outcome; available log capabilities and desired events should inform what to capture.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT 장치 간 event correlation을 위해 공통 primary time source로 내부 clock을 동기화하고 log의 timestamp 형식을 일관되게 유지하도록 권고하며, 예시 형식 요소로 timezone과 daylight-saving 표기를 든다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST explains event correlation is difficult without a shared time source, recommends synchronizing device clocks with a primary clock, and calls for consistent timestamp formats including timezone/daylight-saving notation.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT incident response plan에 역할과 책임, 대응 workflow, incident type·severity 분류, 핵심 내부·외부 연락처, 정보공유 정책, 내부·외부 communication을 포함하도록 설명한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST says an OT incident response plan includes personnel roles and responsibilities, workflow, incident type and severity classification, critical internal and useful external contacts, information-sharing policy, and internal and external communication.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 사이버 사고로 인한 중대한 운영중단에 대비해 OT 조직이 Business continuity(BCP)와 재해복구계획(DRP)을 마련하고, 복구목표에서 재가동 전 인명·환경 안전을 우선하도록 설명한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST recommends a site DRP and BCP to prepare for significant OT operational disruptions from cyber incidents and gives an example recovery objective that prioritizes human and environmental safety before restarting impaired OT operations.

facts.statement: NISTIR 8179의 criticality analysis는 조직 목표에 대한 중요도와 시스템·구성요소의 부적절한 운영 또는 손실이 목표에 미칠 영향을 기준으로 프로그램·시스템·구성요소의 우선순위를 정한다. NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT 위험관리 전략의 참고자료로 이 모델을 인용한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST IR 8179, Criticality Analysis Process Model: Prioritizing Systems and Components
verification_refs.locator: Abstract; NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 §6.1.4 references IR 8179 for OT risk-management strategy
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST IR 8179 describes a structured method to prioritize programs, systems, and components by their importance to organizational goals and the impact that inadequate operation or loss may have on those goals; NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 cites the model as criticality-analysis guidance in its OT risk strategy section.

facts.statement: Trusted recovery를 위한 NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3의 OT 복구 권고는 사이버 사고에 손상된 자산·서비스를 사고 전 상태로 되돌리고, 관련 system state·data·configuration·program을 정기 백업하며 복구계획을 조직에 적절한 주기로 시험하도록 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST describes restoring affected OT assets and services to a pre-incident state, regular backups of relevant OT state/data/configuration/programs, restoration from backups, recovery procedures, and testing plans at organization-appropriate reasonable intervals.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 위험기반 OT backup plan에 백업 대상 파일, 주기, 복제본 수, 위치(예: offline 또는 off-site)와 보존기간을 정하도록 설명하며, immutable storage는 read-only 방식의 데이터 무결성 보강 선택지로 제시한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST says risk-based backup plans should specify what files are backed up, frequency, number of copies, location such as offline/off-site, and retention; it describes immutable read-only storage as adding data integrity and suitable for program/configuration backups.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT 공급망 위험의 예로 counterfeit, 무단 생산, 악의적 내부자, tampering, theft, 악성 software·hardware 삽입과 부실한 제조·개발 관행을 들며, 이를 식별·평가·관리하고 공급자·제3자 계약, 평가, response·recovery planning도 다루도록 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST identifies counterfeit insertion, unauthorized production, malicious insiders, tampering, theft, malicious software/hardware insertion, and poor manufacturing/development practices as supply-chain risks to identify, assess, and manage; it says the category addresses supplier and third-party contracts, assessments/evaluations, and response/recovery planning.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 vendor OT hardware·software·firmware의 authenticity를 확인할 serial number, checksum, digital certificate·signature 등 식별정보를 기록·추적하고, OEM 또는 authorized reseller 경로를 고려하며 공급자를 지속적으로 평가·검토하도록 권고한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST says organizations should consider tracking serial numbers, checksums, certificates/signatures or other identifiers to verify authenticity of vendor OT hardware/software/firmware, consider OEM or authorized distributor/reseller sources, and assess/review suppliers to ensure continued best practices.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 SBOM이 software component와 상호 dependency를 식별해 보고된 software vulnerability가 특정 device에 영향을 주는지 판단하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있다고 설명한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST says SBOM information can identify software components and their dependency relationships and help an organization determine whether a device is affected by reported software vulnerabilities.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 vendor-provided OT software·firmware의 authenticity 확인을 위해 serial/checksum/certificate/signature 같은 식별정보를 기록·추적하고, 자동 code-authentication이 없으면 hash, reputable source, vendor version confirmation 또는 offline/test 환경으로 수동 확인하는 방법을 제시한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST recommends tracking identifiers to verify authenticity of vendor-provided OT components; when automated code authentication is unavailable, it lists hashes, reputable sources, vendor version confirmation, and offline/test environments as manual verification techniques.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 RBAC 같은 논리적 접근통제가 separation of duties와 least privilege를 지원하며 OT 사용자 권한을 각자의 업무에 필요한 범위로 제한할 수 있다고 설명한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST says logical access controls such as RBAC support least privilege and separation of duties and can restrict OT user privileges to only those needed for each person's job.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 identity management가 user·device·service용 식별수단과 credential을 관리하고, OT credential lifecycle의 issuance·revocation·update를 고려하며, 접근 전 person·process·device를 식별·인가하도록 설명한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST describes identity management for users, devices, and services; unique identification and authorization before access; and OT credential lifecycle considerations including issuance, revocation, and updates.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 논리적 접근통제가 시스템·데이터·네트워크 접근을 제한하며 ACL은 허용·거부 규칙, RBAC는 role·hierarchy·constraint, ABAC는 subject·object attribute에 따른 접근결정을 지원한다고 설명한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST defines logical access control; describes ACL allow/deny rules, RBAC roles/hierarchies/constraints, and ABAC subject/object attributes for access decisions.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 원격접속 요청·활성화 절차를 문서화·공유하고, 정당한 business need가 있는 경우에만 필요한 범위로 제공하며 안전·보안통제를 우회하지 않도록 한다. 필요 종료 후 권한을 제거하고 원격활동을 모니터링하도록 권고한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST says to document the request/enable process, provide remote access only when justified and limited to business need, not circumvent safety/security controls, remove access when no longer needed, and monitor remote activities.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 두 개 이상의 authentication factor를 MFA로 정의하고 OT 원격접속의 accepted best practice로 제시한다. 다만 OT component의 factor 지원 여부, 접속 유형과 보완통제를 고려해 적용 위치·요건을 정하도록 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST defines MFA as two or more factors, calls it an accepted best practice for remote access to OT applications, and says organizations should consider component support, differing authentication scenarios, access type, and mitigating factors.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 네트워크 모니터링에서 IDS·IPS와 행동 이상탐지 도구가 비정상·의심 트래픽 경보를 지원하고, OT의 정상 통신 기준선과 센서 시험·튜닝이 중요하다고 설명한다. 센서의 장애 동작(fail-safe/fail-open)과 OT 성능영향도 배치 전에 고려한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST describes IDS/IPS and BAD as monitoring aids, establishes normal-state baselining, recommends testing/tuning sensors, and calls for considering sensor failure mode and performance impact.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 취약점 식별에 자동·수동 기법과 수동·능동 스캔을 사용할 수 있다고 설명한다. 스캔은 새 취약점 포착을 위해 지속 수행할 수 있으나, OT 구성요소·통신에 미칠 영향을 오프라인 사전시험 등으로 평가한 뒤 운영환경 적용 여부를 결정한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST permits automated/manual identification and passive/active scanning, and advises testing scanning tools offline before production because they may affect OT components and communications.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 탐지 프로세스가 이상 이벤트를 적시에 식별하고 담당자에게 알리도록 역할·절차·도구를 유지·시험하며 지속 개선하도록 설명한다. OT 네트워크의 정상 상태를 이해하고 보안 담당자가 경보를 해석해 일시적 조건과 공격을 구분한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST says OT security personnel interpret monitoring alerts against normal OT state and that detection processes, procedures, and tools should be maintained, tested, communicated, and improved.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT 사고 대응에 탐지·분석·격리(containment)·제거(eradication)·복구·사후활동을 포함하고, 감염 시스템 격리나 네트워크 분리 같은 조치 전에 공정 성능·안전 영향과 대응 대안을 위험평가하도록 설명한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST lists incident response steps including containment and eradication, gives network isolation as a possible option, and requires assessing effects on OT performance and safety before choosing a response.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 원격접속에서 고유 사용자명과 복잡한 암호 사용, 기본 자격증명 변경·비활성화, 불필요해진 접근권한 제거, 원격활동 모니터링, 계획된 접속에 대한 운전원 인지 등을 고려하도록 한다. OT 환경에서 연결을 시작하거나 원격접속 장치를 식별해 비인가 사용 시 신속히 끊을 수 있는 방안도 제시하며, 원격접속 해제 기능은 OT 운전에 영향을 주지 않아야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.locator: §6.2.10, pp. 123–124; OT tailoring discussion of AC-17(9), p. 233
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST lists unique usernames/complex passwords, default credential removal, removing unneeded access, monitoring remote activity, operator awareness, OT-initiated connection, and labeled disconnect devices; it says remote access disconnect should not impact OT operations.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT에서 기준 통제를 성능·안전·신뢰성 문제로 구현할 수 없거나 기술적으로 적합하지 않을 때 동등하거나 비교 가능한 보호를 제공하는 보완통제를 고려하도록 한다. 보완통제는 잔여위험 수용과 기능 저하 간 위험기반 절충으로 선정하고, 원 통제의 구현 불가 사유, 대체통제의 보호효과 및 잔여위험 수용을 OT 보안계획에 문서화한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST defines compensating controls as alternate safeguards with equivalent/comparable protection, recognizes OT performance/safety/reliability constraints, requires risk-based decisions and documentation of infeasibility, equivalence, and residual-risk acceptance in the security plan.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT 이동식 매체 사용을 정책에 따라 제한하고, 배포·취급 표시, 안전한 보관·운송, sanitization·파기·폐기를 포함한 취급 절차를 마련하도록 한다. OT에 연결된 노드에서는 비인가 이동식 매체 사용을 허용하지 않으며, 악성코드 유입이나 정보 손실 방지를 위해 절차적 또는 기술적 통제를 사용할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST specifies policy-restricted use, labeling, storage, transport, sanitization, destruction and disposal, handling procedures, and prohibition of unauthorized removable media on OT nodes; procedural or technical solutions may be used.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT 장치의 승인된 기준 구성(baseline configuration)을 문서화하고, OT에 변경을 배포하기 전에 변경을 문서화·시험·승인하도록 권고한다. 불필요한 기능·서비스·port·protocol은 노출 저감을 위해 비활성화할 수 있지만, 필수 운전기능에 미치는 영향을 먼저 시험해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST recommends disabling unnecessary services only with care and extensive testing; documenting approved OT baselines; and documenting, testing, and approving changes before deployment.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT 구성관리 절차가 조직의 MOC(Management of Change) 관행과 정렬되어야 한다고 설명한다. 시스템 수명주기 동안 구성을 초기화·변경·모니터링·감사하고, OT에 변경을 배포하기 전 문서화·시험·승인하는 절차를 적용한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST describes lifecycle configuration initialization/change/monitoring/audit, approved baseline documentation, predeployment change documentation/testing/approval, and explicitly says OT configuration change control procedures should align with organizational MOC practices.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT 구성요소의 수명 종료 시 자산 폐기 프로그램을 두고, 폐기 전에 중요 데이터·매체를 wiping, sanitizing 또는 파기하는 방안을 포함하도록 한다. 이 프로그램의 대상에는 이동식 매체, 모바일 장치와 일반 OT 하드웨어가 포함된다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST recommends an asset disposal program and considering wiping, sanitizing, or otherwise destroying critical data and media before disposal, including removable media, mobile devices, and traditional OT hardware.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 OT 안전시스템이 주 OT와 독립적으로 구현되기도 하지만 제어·안전 기능이나 네트워크를 결합하는 구성도 있다고 설명한다. 조직은 침해위험에 맞는 충분한 분리를 확보하고, 적용하는 보안통제가 안전시스템에 부정적 영향을 주는지 평가해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST notes some OT architectures combine control and safety, calls for separation adequate to compromise risk, and says security-control impacts on safety systems should be evaluated.

facts.statement: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3은 재해복구계획 시험을 위해 tabletop exercise로 재해 시나리오를 모의할 수 있다고 설명하며, 사고대응 개선에는 현재·과거 탐지 및 대응 활동에서 얻은 교훈을 반영하도록 한다. 해당 절은 MTTD나 containment time의 보편적 산식 또는 모든 훈련에 필수인 지표를 규정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3, Guide to Operational Technology (OT) Security
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST says tabletop exercises can simulate disaster recovery events to support plan testing and says response improvements should incorporate lessons from current and previous detection and response activities.

facts.statement: NISTIR 7966은 승인된 jump server를 SSH trust relationship을 통해 다른 시스템으로 제한적으로 이동해야 하는 경우의 예로 든다. 이를 사용할 때는 접근을 정당화·승인하고 trust relationship을 문서화하며, SSH key 사용을 기록하고 공유 jump-server 계정 사용자의 권한이 종료되면 그 계정에 저장된 private key를 교체하도록 설명한다. 이는 SSH 접근관리 지침이며 모든 OT jump server의 보편 설계요건 목록은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: NISTIR 7966, Security of Interactive and Automated Access Management Using Secure Shell (SSH)
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST identifies an approved jump server as an example when limited SSH pivoting is expressly needed, and discusses justifying/approving access, documenting trust relationships, logging key usage, and rotating keys on shared jump-server accounts when user access ends.

facts.statement: 시스템 전환에서 parallel operation은 구·신 시스템의 결과를 비교하는 시험 방식으로 사용할 수 있다. 다만 두 시스템의 동시 운영에는 중복 데이터 입력과 결과 조정 비용이 발생할 수 있으므로, 이를 continuity 확보의 기본 수단으로 간주하지 말고 적용 목적·비용·대체 복구계획을 따져야 한다. 이 근거는 일반 정보시스템 전환 지침의 사례이며 OT 보편 요구사항은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: JFMIP, Parallel Operation of Software: Is it a Desirable Software Transition Technique?
verification_refs.locator: pp. 6–8, especially p. 8
verification_refs.supports_claim: The report describes parallel operation as one possible transition/testing approach, identifies duplicate data entry and reconciliation/correction workload, and says it is not a cost-effective continuity substitute where proper backup and disaster-recovery plans exist.

verification_refs.citation: GAO, Lessons Learned About Acquiring Financial Management and Other Information Systems
verification_refs.locator: Guidance item 63, p. 47
verification_refs.supports_claim: The transition guidance describes concurrent old/new system testing until design requirements are met, analysis of outputs before conversion, and full testing where parallel operation is impractical.

facts.statement: 저소음 트림의 소음저감과 유량용량 관계는 설계별로 다르다. Emerson은 전통적인 복잡형 저소음 트림에서 더 높은 소음저감이 통상 더 낮은 유량용량 및 더 높은 비용과 동반될 수 있다고 설명하지만, WhisperFlo 및 Whisper NXG 사례처럼 용량을 높이면서 소음저감을 제공하는 제품도 제시한다. 따라서 보편적인 고정 tradeoff로 단정하지 말고 해당 밸브·트림의 제조사 용량·범위 및 소음자료로 선정한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, New Valve Trim Technology Improves Noise Reduction and Flow Efficiency
verification_refs.locator: paragraphs 5–7
verification_refs.supports_claim: Emerson states traditional complex noise trims usually provide more noise reduction at lower flow capacity and higher cost, while its newer globe and rotary designs are presented as increasing flow capacity while retaining noise reduction.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Fisher WhisperFlo Aerodynamic Noise Attenuation Trim
verification_refs.locator: Product description and key features
verification_refs.supports_claim: Emerson describes aerodynamic noise attenuation and says WhisperFlo has higher capacity at conventional valve travels and port sizes than tortuous-path designs.

facts.statement: 성과지표는 목표와 연계되고 명확한 정의를 가져야 하며, 지표 집합은 핵심 우선순위를 균형 있게 포함해야 한다. 단일 성과지표에 과도하게 의존하거나 이를 보상·자원배분과 연결하면 목표와 어긋난 행동 및 지표 조작 유인이 생길 수 있다. GAO의 일반 성과측정 지침이며 정비 KPI에 대한 특정 사례나 보편 산식을 규정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: GAO-19-216, DNA Evidence Backlogs: Management Focus Needed to Further Improve Processing Times
verification_refs.locator: Appendix VII, Table 13, p. 87
verification_refs.supports_claim: GAO summarizes successful performance-measure attributes: linkage to goals, clarity, core activity coverage, and balance; lack of balance may create skewed incentives by overemphasizing some goals.

verification_refs.citation: GAO/GGD-98-162, Performance Management: Aligning Employee Performance With Agency Goals at Six Results Act Pilots
verification_refs.supports_claim: GAO describes cases where employees manipulated performance measures to make performance look better, illustrating the risk of gaming.

verification_refs.citation: GAO-26-107609, Combating Fraud: Approaches to Evaluate Effectiveness and Demonstrate Integrity
verification_refs.locator: Final Consideration and Figure 7
verification_refs.supports_claim: GAO warns that focusing on a specific metric can come at the expense of overall program integrity and that metrics tied to pay or budget can be open to manipulation.

facts.statement: Rosemount 2051 3-valve manifold의 zeroing 예에서는 LP isolation을 먼저 닫고 center equalizing valve를 열어 양측 압력을 equalize한다. 이 구성은 별도 bleed valve가 없으므로 equalizer를 bleed로 표현하거나 이 절차를 일반적인 depressurization 절차로 확대하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Rosemount 2051 Reference Manual, 00809-0100-4101
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual identifies the three-valve configuration as two isolate valves plus equalizing valve; for zeroing it closes the low-pressure isolate first and then opens the equalizer to equalize both transmitter sides.

facts.statement: ADC resolution은 구분 가능한 code step의 크기 또는 bit 수와 관련되고 accuracy는 실제 변환값이 true value에 얼마나 가까운지를 포함하므로 고해상도 ADC가 반드시 고정확도를 의미하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Texas Instruments Precision Hub, ADC Accuracy Part 1: Is accuracy different from resolution?
verification_refs.locator: Definition of resolution; system noise and accuracy discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines resolution as the smallest input change that changes output by one count, distinguishes accuracy, and explains that signal-chain noise can eclipse nominal resolution.

verification_refs.citation: Texas Instruments Precision Hub, ADC Accuracy Part 2: Total unadjusted error explained
verification_refs.locator: §§ on TUE and signal-chain contributors
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes accuracy error as a combination of offset, gain, INL, driver and reference contributions rather than nominal code resolution alone.

facts.statement: ADC quantization은 연속 입력을 유한 code로 표현하면서 생기는 discretization 성분이며 resolution을 결정하는 요소 중 하나지만 offset, gain, INL/DNL, reference error, noise를 포함한 전체 accuracy와 동일하지 않다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, ADC Glossary
verification_refs.locator: How an ADC works; quantization error
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that a continuous range of analog voltages maps to a finite number of digital codes, producing quantization error.

verification_refs.citation: Texas Instruments Precision Hub, ADC Accuracy Part 2: Total unadjusted error explained
verification_refs.locator: Offset, gain and INL definitions; TUE discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Shows that ADC system accuracy includes DC error contributors such as offset, gain and INL, so quantization is not a synonym for total accuracy.

facts.statement: Sampling system에서는 Nyquist 조건과 anti-alias filtering이 필요하며 aliasing은 대역 밖 신호가 잘못된 저주파 성분으로 접혀 들어오는 오류로 단순 quantization noise와 구분한다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Filter Basics: Anti-Aliasing
verification_refs.locator: Sampled-data aliasing and anti-alias filter sections
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines aliasing as frequency components above half the sample rate shifting into the band of interest and describes pre-ADC filtering.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, ADC Glossary
verification_refs.locator: How an ADC works; quantization error
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines quantization error as loss from mapping continuous voltages to a finite set of codes, distinct from sampling aliasing.

facts.statement: Noise의 영향은 spectral density뿐 아니라 측정 bandwidth에 의존하므로 bandwidth를 줄이면 적분 noise를 낮출 수 있지만 response time과 dynamic signal 보존 사이의 trade-off를 고려해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Practical Filter Design Challenges and Considerations for Precision ADCs
verification_refs.locator: §§ Ideal and Practical Filters; RC Antialias Filter Limitations; Filter Settling Time
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains noise attenuation by filtering, phase/group delay, and that narrower bandwidth increases settling time and can attenuate in-band signal.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Front-End Amplifier and RC Filter Design for a Precision SAR ADC
verification_refs.locator: Noise calculation and settling discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Relates integrated amplifier noise to noise spectral density over RC bandwidth and evaluates filter settling against acquisition time.

facts.statement: Analog/digital filtering은 관심 대역 밖 noise를 줄일 수 있지만 cutoff와 order를 과도하게 제한하면 response delay, phase distortion 또는 유효 transient 손실이 생길 수 있어 signal bandwidth 기준으로 설계해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Practical Filter Design Challenges and Considerations for Precision ADCs
verification_refs.locator: §§ Ideal and Practical Filters; RC Antialias Filter Limitations; Phase Delay; Conclusion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes analog/digital noise filtering, nonideal filter phase/group delay, narrower-bandwidth passband attenuation and increased settling, and tradeoffs with response time.

facts.statement: PSRR은 power-supply 변화가 회로 output 또는 input-referred error로 전달되는 정도를 나타내는 지표이며 주파수와 operating condition에 따라 달라질 수 있어 하나의 고정 수치만으로 모든 조건의 supply 영향이 제거된다고 볼 수 없다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Characterizing the PSRR of Data Acquisition μModule Devices with Internal Bypass Capacitors
verification_refs.locator: PSRR Definition; Current Method for Testing PSRR; signal-chain characterization
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines PSRR by supply-to-output disturbance and describes frequency-tone testing, frequency response and the need to test the assembled signal chain under application conditions.

facts.statement: Linearity error는 offset과 gain을 제거한 뒤에도 실제 transfer가 이상적인 직선 또는 정의된 특성에서 벗어나는 성분으로, 단순 zero/span calibration만으로 완전히 제거되지 않을 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, INL/DNL Measurements for High-Speed Analog-to-Digital Converters (ADCs)
verification_refs.locator: INL and DNL Definitions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines INL as transfer deviation from a selected straight line and states the INL specification is measured after static offset and gain have been nullified; this supports residual nonlinearity after zero/span correction.

facts.statement: Random noise는 순간값이 불규칙하게 변하는 확률적 성분이며 thermal noise, shot noise, amplifier/input noise, reference noise, conversion noise와 외부 결합 성분이 측정 bandwidth 안으로 들어오면 분산과 repeatability를 악화시킨다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Maximize the Performance of Your Sigma-Delta ADC Driver
verification_refs.locator: The Bandwidth Problem; noise sources and bandwidth, §§1–2
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists sensor/resistor, amplifier-current, thermal, shot, supply, reference, digital feedthrough and clock-related noise sources; explains bandwidth-dependent integrated noise and out-of-band aliasing into the noise floor.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, ADC Input Noise: The Good, The Bad, and The Ugly
verification_refs.locator: Input-Referred Noise (Code-Transition Noise)
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains practical ADC rms input-referred noise, resistor and kT/C noise, and characterization from repeated output-code histograms under a constant input.

facts.statement: 서로 완전히 상관된 deterministic limit는 worst-case 합산이 보수적일 수 있고 독립적인 random contributor는 RSS와 같은 통계적 결합이 적절할 수 있으므로 오차의 상관성과 분포를 확인하지 않고 모든 항을 동일 방식으로 합산하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST Technical Note 1297, §5 Combined Standard Uncertainty
verification_refs.locator: §5.1; combines standard uncertainties and covariances; RSS
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST states that combined standard uncertainty uses individual standard uncertainties and covariances as appropriate, and names the usual method RSS.

verification_refs.citation: Direct derivation from the triangle inequality
verification_refs.locator: For finite components e_i, |Σe_i| ≤ Σ|e_i| ≤ Σa_i whenever |e_i|≤a_i
verification_refs.supports_claim: The sum of absolute component bounds is a conservative worst-case bound when error signs and dependence are unknown; RSS is not a bound on every realization.

facts.statement: Voltage/current reference의 initial accuracy, temperature coefficient, noise, load sensitivity와 aging은 gain/scale error와 drift의 공통원인이 될 수 있어 ADC reference와 excitation reference를 독립적인 error contributor로 관리한다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, AN-82: Understanding and Applying Voltage References
verification_refs.locator: Reference accuracy specifications; Conclusion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Enumerates initial accuracy, temperature coefficient, long-term stability and noise as distinct reference accuracy contributors and states they affect accuracy of the finished product.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Selecting the Optimum Voltage Reference
verification_refs.locator: Voltage reference specifications and ADC application
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that ADC references establish the absolute comparison voltage, and that initial accuracy, temperature drift/hysteresis, load capability, long-term stability and noise are application-dependent contributors to system error.

facts.statement: Rosemount 2051 3-valve zero check 후 복귀 예에서는 equalizing valve를 먼저 닫고 LP isolation을 연다. 정상 측정 상태는 H/L isolation open, equalizing closed이며, 이 제조사 절차를 다른 모델의 보편 순서로 일반화하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Rosemount 2051 Reference Manual, 00809-0100-4101
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual states the normal three-valve state is both isolate valves open and equalizer closed; after zeroing it directs closing the equalizer first and then opening the low-pressure isolate.

facts.statement: Offset error는 입력이 기준값 또는 zero일 때 출력에 일정하게 더해지는 bias 성분으로, 증폭기 input offset, bias current에 의한 voltage drop, reference mismatch와 같은 회로원인으로 발생할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, An Inside Look at High Speed Analog-to-Digital Converter Accuracy, Part One
verification_refs.locator: Offset and Gain Error definitions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines ADC offset error as the analog value by which the transfer function fails to pass through zero.

verification_refs.citation: Texas Instruments, Op Amp Offset Voltage and Bias Current Limitations
verification_refs.locator: Abstract and input offset/bias current definitions
verification_refs.supports_claim: States input offset voltage adds to or subtracts from the input and input bias current through source or feedback resistance creates an offset voltage.

facts.statement: Gain error는 이상적인 transfer slope와 실제 slope의 차이로 입력 크기에 비례해 오차가 커지며 resistor ratio, amplifier gain accuracy, reference scale과 ADC full-scale path가 원인이 될 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, CN0393 Circuit Note
verification_refs.locator: Gain Error Analysis
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines system gain error as scaling with input signal and identifies amplifier gain, gain-setting resistor ratio, reference voltage, and ADC driver gain as contributors in the documented signal chain.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, The ABCs of Analog to Digital Converters: How ADC Errors Affect System Performance
verification_refs.locator: § Offset and Gain Errors
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines ADC gain error from full-scale error after offset and explains its effect on transfer slope and measurable range; notes reference contribution depends on test conditions.

facts.statement: 전자오차는 반복 가능한 systematic error와 확률적 random error, 조건 또는 시간에 따라 변하는 drift 계열로 구분해야 하며 서로 다른 오차를 하나의 'noise'로 묶으면 원인과 대책을 잘못 선택할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: JCGM 200:2012, International Vocabulary of Metrology (VIM), 2.17
verification_refs.locator: 2.17 systematic measurement error
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines systematic measurement error as a component that remains constant or varies predictably in replicate measurements.

verification_refs.citation: JCGM 200:2012, International Vocabulary of Metrology (VIM), 2.19
verification_refs.locator: 2.19 random measurement error
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines random measurement error as a component that varies unpredictably in replicate measurements.

verification_refs.citation: JCGM 200:2012, International Vocabulary of Metrology (VIM), 4.21
verification_refs.locator: 4.21 instrumental drift
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines instrumental drift as a continuous or incremental change over time in indication due to changes in metrological properties of a measuring instrument.

facts.statement: Calibration interval은 stability history, drift rate, required uncertainty, environment, usage criticality와 maintenance cost를 근거로 정해야 하며 모든 전자기기에 동일한 고정 주기를 적용할 수 없다.

verification_refs.citation: ILAC-G24:2022 / OIML D 10:2022, Guidelines for the determination of recalibration intervals of measuring equipment
verification_refs.supports_claim: The guidance states no universally applicable best interval exists; bases initial selection on risk assessment including required uncertainty, risk of limits being exceeded, use severity, environment and legal requirements; requires calibration records as historical basis, considers drift, and balances calibration costs against uncertainty and reliability risk.

facts.statement: Tolerance는 제조 시점의 component nominal value 주변 허용 편차 또는 분포를 의미하며, drift처럼 동일 component가 운전 중 시간·온도에 따라 변하는 현상과 동일하지 않다.

verification_refs.citation: Vishay, Basics of Linear Fixed Resistors, Application Note
verification_refs.locator: Characteristics: Nominal Value, Tolerance, Stability, Temperature Coefficient
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines nominal value at a reference temperature, tolerance on delivery relative to that value, and separately describes later operational deviation, temperature coefficient, and time-dependent stability.

facts.statement: Temperature coefficient는 온도 변화에 따른 component parameter 또는 circuit output 변화 민감도를 나타내며 resistor ratio, reference, amplifier offset/gain과 sensor-interface network의 temperature drift가 전체 error budget에 누적될 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, AN-0970: RTD Interfacing and Linearization Using an ADuC706x Microcontroller
verification_refs.locator: §Error Analysis, §Temperature Drift
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies ADC offset/gain and reference-resistor temperature drift in a sensor interface; explains their temperature dependence, measurement error effect, error contributors and compensation limits for the specific RTD design.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Understanding Temperature Drift in a Precision Digital-to-Analog Converter (DAC)
verification_refs.locator: Abstract; §§Overview, Offset and Gain Errors, Example Calculations
verification_refs.supports_claim: Treats converter and voltage-reference temperature effects as error-budget contributors and quantifies offset/gain temperature coefficients in a precision converter example.

verification_refs.citation: Vishay, Change Of Resistance Due To TCR Calculator
verification_refs.locator: TCR definition and resistance-change calculation
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines TCR as the relative resistance change due to heating or cooling and relates resistance change to TCR and temperature difference.

facts.statement: 여러 component tolerance가 output에 미치는 영향은 circuit sensitivity를 따라 전파되므로 worst-case 또는 통계적 방법으로 error budget을 구성하고 dominant contributor를 식별해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, CN0393 Circuit Note
verification_refs.locator: §System Accuracy Analysis, Offset Error Analysis and Gain Error Analysis
verification_refs.supports_claim: Shows resistor-ratio, amplifier, reference and ADC-driver deviations propagated through the actual gain network to input-referred and system error; calculates worst-case component sums and tabulates component contributions for comparison.

verification_refs.citation: NIST Technical Note 1297, §5 Combined Standard Uncertainty
verification_refs.locator: §5.1; standard uncertainties and covariance terms
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines a statistical combined uncertainty budget from standard uncertainties and covariance terms, distinguishing it from arbitrary tolerance bounds or unqualified RSS.

facts.statement: Error budget은 offset, gain, linearity, tolerance, temperature drift, noise, reference, ADC와 power sensitivity 등 contributor를 동일한 input-referred 또는 output-referred 기준으로 환산하여 total error와 dominant source를 평가한다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, CN0393 Circuit Note
verification_refs.locator: §System Accuracy Analysis, Tables 2–4; offset and gain propagation equations
verification_refs.supports_claim: Converts component offset, gain, resistor tolerance and reference errors through circuit gains into input-referred system error; calculates total worst-case error and shows source contributions in tables.

verification_refs.citation: NIST Technical Note 1297, §5 Combined Standard Uncertainty
verification_refs.locator: §5.1; standard uncertainties and covariance terms
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides statistical combination of standard uncertainty contributions and covariance terms where appropriate; it does not permit arbitrary mixing of unlike error bounds.

facts.statement: Aging은 장기 사용·보관·stress 이력에 따라 component parameter가 시간에 걸쳐 변화하는 현상으로 초기 tolerance와 단기 temperature drift를 통과한 후에도 장기 calibration stability를 악화시킬 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Vishay, Design Guide for Use of Precision Resistors, Technical Note TN0015
verification_refs.locator: §Load Life Stability Under Different Conditions of Precision Resistors
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines load-life stability as relative resistance change under nominal power and states that the result depends on specified ambient temperature, duration, and test method.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, AN-713: The Effect of Long-Term Drift on Voltage References
verification_refs.locator: §Long-Term Drift; controlled 1000-hour measurement example
verification_refs.supports_claim: Distinguishes long-term voltage-reference drift from initial accuracy and temperature coefficient, describes long-duration stability changes, and notes that repeated system calibration may be needed to manage it.

facts.statement: Calibration은 traceable reference와 비교하여 반복 가능한 offset/gain/scale error를 추정·보정하는 데 유효하지만 random noise, future drift와 aging을 영구 제거하는 수단은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook of Statistical Methods, §2.3 Calibration
verification_refs.locator: §2.3 opening definition and purpose
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines calibration as comparing an instrument or artifact with reference standards and states its purpose is to eliminate or reduce bias relative to the reference base.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Methods for Calibrating Gain Error in Data-Converter Systems
verification_refs.locator: Abstract; §§The Problem of Gain Error, Digitally Calibrating Gain Error
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides concrete ADC/DAC-system examples in which gain and offset terms are estimated or corrected by digital calibration or reference trimming, and describes limits and introduced errors of the selected method.

verification_refs.citation: NIST Calibration Policies
verification_refs.locator: Reporting Measurement Uncertainty; References to NIST in Advertisements
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that calibrated instrument use has additional instrument, method, operator, and environmental uncertainty beyond the certificate, and calibration results do not guarantee or predict future item performance.

facts.statement: Signal-to-noise ratio와 dynamic range는 작은 유효신호가 전자 noise floor에 묻히지 않는지 평가하는 지표이며 단순 ADC bit 수만 높인다고 front-end noise floor가 자동으로 낮아지는 것은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Understanding Noise, ENOB, and Effective Resolution in Analog-to-Digital Converters
verification_refs.locator: Abstract; §§Effective Resolution and SINAD
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines effective resolution and SINAD/ENOB in terms of signal range and RMS noise, distinguishing actual noise performance from nominal code width.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, An Inside Look at High Speed Analog-to-Digital Converter Accuracy, Part 2
verification_refs.locator: §§Relationship Between SNR/ENOB and Dynamic Range; Converter Inaccuracies in a Signal Chain; Concluding the Analyses
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines system SNR as accumulated signal-chain noise, compares front-end noise with ADC dynamic range and demonstrates that a higher-SNR ADC alone does not improve system performance when front-end noise remains.

facts.statement: EMC qualification은 장비가 외부로 발생시키는 disturbance를 제한하는 emission과 외부 disturbance 하에서 기능을 유지하는 immunity를 구분하여 평가한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-6-8:2020, Generic standards—Emission standard for professional equipment in commercial and light-industrial locations
verification_refs.locator: Scope and applicability
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines a generic conducted and radiated emission standard, separately from immunity test standards.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-4-3:2020, Radiated radio-frequency electromagnetic field immunity test
verification_refs.locator: Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines a separate immunity test for electrical/electronic equipment subjected to radiated RF fields.

facts.statement: EMC 시험은 적용 요구에 따라 conducted/radiated emission, radiated/conducted RF immunity, ESD, EFT/burst, surge 및 전원·자기장 관련 immunity 같은 시험군에서 필요한 항목을 선택하며 모든 장비에 모든 시험을 동일 level로 적용하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-4-2:2025, Electrostatic discharge immunity test
verification_refs.locator: Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines the ESD immunity method, test levels, setup, and procedure.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-4-3:2020, Radiated RF electromagnetic field immunity test
verification_refs.locator: Scope, Note 1: product committees decide applicability, test levels and performance criteria
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines radiated RF immunity and explicitly assigns applicability, level and acceptance-criteria selection to product committees, supporting the non-universal test-matrix boundary.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-4-4:2012, Electrical fast transient/burst immunity test
verification_refs.locator: Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines EFT/burst immunity requirements and test procedures.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-4-5:2014+AMD1:2017 CSV, Surge immunity test
verification_refs.locator: Scope and edition 3.1 listing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines surge immunity methods and test levels for switching/lightning transient-related surges.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-4-6:2023, Conducted RF disturbance immunity
verification_refs.locator: Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines conducted RF immunity testing and says product committees choose applicability and levels.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-4-8:2009, Power frequency magnetic field immunity test
verification_refs.locator: Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines immunity testing to 50/60 Hz magnetic disturbances and conditions applicability on the phenomenon present at the installation location.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-4-11:2020, Voltage dips, short interruptions and voltage variations immunity tests
verification_refs.locator: Scope and Note 2
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines power-supply disturbance immunity methods for in-scope low-voltage equipment and says product committees determine applicability and test levels.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-6-8:2020, Generic EMC emission standard
verification_refs.locator: Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies conducted and radiated emission requirements as generic EMC emission requirements for the stated equipment/environment scope.

facts.statement: EMC 시험구성은 적용 시험방법과 제품 요구에 따라 EUT 운전상태와 케이블 배치 등을 정한다. 전원·I/O·종단·접지·보조장비 등은 해당 방법과 설치 조건에서 관련된 항목만 기록하며, 모든 항목을 모든 시험의 보편 필수조건으로 보지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-4-3:2020, Radiated radio-frequency electromagnetic field immunity test
verification_refs.locator: Clause 6 test environment; edition summary notes added EUT and cable layout information
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies a test environment and method-specific EUT/cable setup considerations; it does not establish one universal cable arrangement for all products.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Engineering and Safety Center, Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessels, NESC-NPP-17-01
verification_refs.locator: §5.2 Qualification Testing, PDF pp. 43–44
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires qualification fixtures and environmental application methods not to induce erroneous or unrealistic conditions for the intended application; used here only for the general representativeness principle.

facts.statement: 합격기준은 시험 전에 허용 가능한 기능저하, 자동 recovery 여부, 수동 intervention 허용 여부와 시험 후 residual degradation을 정의해야 하며 결과를 본 뒤 기준을 바꾸지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Engineering and Safety Center, Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessels, NESC-NPP-17-01
verification_refs.locator: §5.1 Acceptance Testing, PDF p. 43; §5.2 Qualification Testing, PDF pp. 43–44
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explicitly requires accept/reject criteria to be formulated prior to tests and qualification procedures approved before testing; the source does not prescribe generic EMC pass/fail values.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-4-3:2020, Radiated radio-frequency electromagnetic field immunity test
verification_refs.locator: Scope, Note 1
verification_refs.supports_claim: Assigns selection of appropriate product-specific performance criteria to the relevant IEC product committees.

facts.statement: 온도 환경시험의 종류와 수준은 제품의 운용·보관 조건 및 적용 요구에 따라 정한다. 특정 cycle이나 온도 변화율을 모든 계측기에 보편적으로 적용하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. Department of Defense, MIL-STD-810H Change 1, Environmental Engineering Considerations and Laboratory Tests
verification_refs.locator: Document scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: States the standard gives an environmental-tailoring process and does not impose design or test specifications; test methods are based on system performance requirements. This supports rejecting a universal cycle/rate, not any particular profile.

facts.statement: Pass/fail 경계에 가까운 결과는 test equipment tolerance, setup repeatability와 measurement uncertainty를 고려하여 근거를 남기며 nominal reading 하나만으로 margin을 과대평가하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC TS 61000-1-6:2026, Guidelines for the evaluation of measurement uncertainty in EMC testing
verification_refs.locator: Scope and objective
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides methods and guidance for evaluating measurement uncertainty in EMC tests/calibrations and developing uncertainty budgets to improve comparability; it does not prescribe one universal decision guard band.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-4-2:2025, Electrostatic discharge immunity test
verification_refs.locator: Scope and edition summary
verification_refs.supports_claim: Includes measurement uncertainty considerations and examples of uncertainty budgets in the ESD test method.

facts.statement: Qualification에 사용하는 chamber, field probe, accelerometer, power analyzer와 functional measurement instrument는 필요한 calibration/verification 상태와 measurement range를 확인하여 test evidence의 신뢰성을 확보한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-4-2:2025, Electrostatic discharge immunity test
verification_refs.locator: Scope: test equipment, setup, procedure and calibration procedure
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies test equipment, setup, procedure and calibration for the ESD method, supporting method-specific verification of the measurement chain.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Engineering and Safety Center, Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessels, NESC-NPP-17-01
verification_refs.locator: §5.2 Qualification Testing, PDF pp. 43–44
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires instrumentation and a test plan sufficient to establish application of loads/environments and hardware responses; used as a test-evidence planning example, not as a universal instrument list or calibration interval.

facts.statement: EMC·환경시험의 표준 edition, test level, severity, dwell time, sweep range와 acceptance class는 적용 규정·제품군·프로젝트 specification에서 결정되므로 출처 없이 특정 값을 고정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61000-4-3:2020, Radiated radio-frequency electromagnetic field immunity test
verification_refs.locator: Scope, Notes 1–3
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that product committees decide applicability, appropriate test levels and performance criteria for this basic EMC method.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. Department of Defense, MIL-STD-810H Change 1, Environmental Engineering Considerations and Laboratory Tests
verification_refs.locator: Document scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explicitly characterizes environmental levels and methods as tailored to system performance requirements rather than universal test specifications.

facts.statement: Qualification은 정의된 laboratory/test 조건에서 적합성을 입증하는 활동이고, 실제 plant의 EMI noise·ground loop 진단은 `instrumentation_power_grounding_shielding_ups_ground_loop_emc` Topic이 소유하므로 두 활동을 동일 절차로 취급하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC TR 61000-1-1:2023, Application and interpretation of fundamental definitions and terms
verification_refs.locator: Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explicitly distinguishes standardized-setup EMC tests from tests or measurements performed at other locations, including where equipment is installed; topic ownership itself is an internal contract.

facts.statement: Vibration qualification은 적용 환경에 따라 sine sweep/resonance search, endurance 또는 random vibration 등 필요한 profile을 선택하며 시험 profile과 axis는 requirement에 추적되어야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60068-3-8:2003, Environmental testing—Selecting amongst vibration tests
verification_refs.locator: Scope; Clauses 5–8 and Table 2
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides guidance to collect/estimate dynamic environmental conditions and select the most applicable IEC 60068-2 vibration test method; describes selection among sinusoidal, random, and mixed-mode methods.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60068-2-6:2007, Test Fc: Vibration (sinusoidal)
verification_refs.locator: Scope and test-report requirements
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines a standardized sinusoidal vibration method and specifies severities to be used with the relevant specification.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60068-2-64:2026, Test Fh: Vibration, broadband random and guidance
verification_refs.locator: Scope and publication lifecycle
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines broadband random vibration testing against specified requirements and identifies the edition published 2026-10-08 as valid; it does not prescribe the profile for every product.

facts.statement: Humidity qualification에서 condensation이 허용되는 시험인지 비응축 조건인지 구분해야 하며, 두 조건을 동일한 환경 stress로 취급하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60068-2-78:2025, Test Cab: Damp heat, steady state
verification_refs.locator: Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies high humidity at constant temperature without condensation for the defined steady-state method.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60068-2-30:2025, Test Db: Damp heat, cyclic
verification_refs.locator: Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines high humidity combined with cyclic temperature changes that in general produces surface condensation.

facts.statement: EMC는 장비가 허용 가능한 전자기 환경에서 과도한 방해를 발생시키지 않으면서 요구 기능을 수행하는 적합성 개념이고, EMI는 기능에 영향을 주는 전자기 간섭 현상을 의미하므로 두 용어를 동일 개념으로 취급하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: European Parliament and Council, Directive 2014/30/EU on electromagnetic compatibility, Article 3(4)–(6)
verification_refs.locator: Article 3(4) electromagnetic compatibility; 3(5) electromagnetic disturbance; 3(6) immunity
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines EMC as satisfactory operation in the electromagnetic environment without intolerable disturbance to other equipment, defines a disturbance as a phenomenon that may degrade performance, and separately defines immunity; used here as technical terminology evidence, not as a blanket statement about legal coverage.

facts.statement: Filter는 random 또는 out-of-band noise 저감에는 유효하지만 steady offset, gain error, deterministic reference error를 원인 제거 없이 자동 보정하지 못하므로 오차 유형별 대책을 구분해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Design Note 9: Chopper Amplifiers Complement a DC Accurate Low-Pass Filter
verification_refs.locator: Introduction and Figures 1, 4–5 discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that some switched-capacitor low-pass filters have DC offset and poor gain linearity, and separately describes an added high-pass section that extracts AC while retaining a distinct DC-accurate low-pass output. This demonstrates that filter response and DC accuracy/correction are distinct design concerns; high-pass rejection of DC is not offset calibration when the wanted signal contains DC.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Methods for Calibrating Gain Error in Data-Converter Systems
verification_refs.locator: Abstract; The Problem of Gain Error; Digitally Calibrating Gain Error
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies voltage-reference and analog-signal-chain gain error as contributors and describes calibration or reference trimming as correction methods, not noise filtering.

facts.statement: Seat leakage acceptance와 packing fugitive-emission acceptance는 leakage path, method, unit와 governing requirement가 다르므로 별도 판정한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-4:2021, Industrial-process control valves—Part 4: Inspection and routine testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEC 60534-4 lists seat leakage test and packing test separately. The seat test specifies leakage class, test fluid, procedure and maximum allowable seat leakage; the standard also cautions that factory seat-leakage results do not predict installed operating leakage.

verification_refs.citation: ISO 15848-1:2015, Industrial valves—Measurement, test and qualification procedures for fugitive emissions—Part 1
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISO 15848-1 covers external stem/shaft seals and body joints, defines leakage under specified test conditions as concentration or leak rate, and prescribes global bagging/vacuum or local sniffing methods for its type-test scope.

facts.statement: ISO 15848-1의 저배출 성능은 규정된 형식시험 조건에서 평가된다. 이 결과만으로 개별 현장 설치 상태, stem 상태와 유지보수 후 성능을 자동 보증하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: ISO 15848-1:2015, Industrial valves—Measurement, test and qualification procedures for fugitive emissions—Part 1: Classification system and qualification procedures for type testing of valves
verification_refs.locator: Scope; §5 type test conditions; §5.1.5 leakage measurement; §5.2 test procedures
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISO states that Part 1 establishes classification and qualification procedures for type testing, and its scope evaluates external leakage of valve stem/shaft seals and body joints under defined test procedures. The test uses a rig-mounted test valve, defined temperature stabilization, pressure, mechanical cycles and recorded leakage results; this scope does not certify field installation, field stem condition or ongoing maintenance performance.

verification_refs.citation: ISO, ISO 15848-1:2015 official standard record
verification_refs.locator: Abstract; status; amendments
verification_refs.supports_claim: The official ISO record identifies the subject as a classification system and qualification procedures for type testing of valves, confirms the 2015 edition remains current, and records Amendment 1:2017.

facts.statement: Packing leakage 조치는 controlled gland adjustment, packing replacement, stem·shaft surface와 packing-box inspection을 포함하며 과도한 조임을 피한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, D and DA Valves Instruction Manual D100386X012
verification_refs.locator: p. 6, Packing Maintenance and Replacing Packing
verification_refs.supports_claim: For the documented sliding-stem valve packing, the manual sets minimum and maximum tightening torque, warns not to exceed the maximum because excessive friction may result, directs replacement when adjustment does not stop leakage, and instructs inspection of the valve stem and packing-box wall for nicks or scratches.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, 8540 Valve Instruction Manual D104709X012
verification_refs.locator: pp. 9–10, Packing Adjustment and Packing Maintenance
verification_refs.supports_claim: For the documented rotary valve, the manual says to tighten only enough to prevent shaft leakage, warns excessive tightening can damage packing-box parts and increase friction, and directs inspection of the shaft and packing-box wall for nicks or scratches during replacement.

facts.statement: Packing compression을 높이면 leakage가 감소할 수 있지만 stem·shaft friction, deadband, actuator demand와 wear가 증가할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: SAMSON, T 8000-6 EN, Packing Forms and Their Application Ranges
verification_refs.locator: pp. 2–3, Design and principle of operation; packing installation and adjustment
verification_refs.supports_claim: SAMSON explains that compressive force seals potential leakage paths; insufficient or excessively high tightening torque may cause leakage; over-tightening increases packing/stem friction and may cause premature wear, jerky stem movement, and increased actuator force. It also distinguishes spring-loaded packing, which is not to be overtightened when instructions are followed.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, 657 Actuator Instruction Manual D100306X012
verification_refs.locator: p. 10, Deadband Measurement
verification_refs.supports_claim: Emerson states that packing friction is one cause of control-valve assembly deadband and defines deadband as the range of measured signal change that does not initiate actuator response; it notes other causes also contribute.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, A11 Valve Instruction Manual D104223X012
verification_refs.locator: p. 9, Packing Adjustment and Shaft Bonding
verification_refs.supports_claim: For the specified A11 rotary valve packing, Emerson says excessive tightening accelerates wear and can produce higher rotating friction loads on the shaft. This is a model-specific corroborating example, not a universal quantitative law.

facts.statement: Local concentration reading은 측정지점의 농도이고 mass-emission rate는 flow와 species mass를 포함하므로 동일한 물리량이 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. EPA, Method 21—Determination of Volatile Organic Compound Leaks
verification_refs.locator: §3.5 leak definition concentration; §8.3 monitoring procedure
verification_refs.supports_claim: Method 21 defines a leak by a local concentration instrument reading at the component interface; it reports concentration, not a source mass-emission rate.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. EPA, Protocol for Equipment Leak Emission Estimates, Chapter 3: Equipment Leak Emission Factors
verification_refs.locator: §3.2, Alternative Approach Using the GRI Hi-Flow Sampler, p. 22
verification_refs.supports_claim: EPA describes measuring captured sample flow and THC concentration and calculating mass emission rate from their product; species-specific estimates additionally depend on gas composition.

facts.statement: Control valve의 internal leakage에는 closed trim의 plug-seat 경로와 seat-body joint 경로가 포함될 수 있다. External leakage는 process medium이 stem/shaft packing 또는 body gasket·flanged joint 등 pressure boundary를 거쳐 atmosphere로 나오는 경로이며 fugitive emission으로 불린다.

verification_refs.citation: SAMSON, T 8000-6 EN, Packing Forms and Their Application Ranges
verification_refs.locator: p. 2, Environmental requirements and Fig. 1
verification_refs.supports_claim: SAMSON distinguishes external leakage to atmosphere at the plug-stem guide, body gasket, or flanged joint from internal seat leakage between plug and seat and between seat and body; it calls external leakage fugitive emissions.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 8: Installation and Maintenance
verification_refs.locator: §8.5.3 Stem Packing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Emerson describes packing as the pressure seal around globe/angle valve stems and rotary valve shafts and recommends replacement if leakage develops around the stem.

facts.statement: Local electronics의 supply variation, ripple, regulator noise 또는 ground/reference movement는 amplifier, reference, ADC와 sensor excitation을 통해 출력에 전달될 수 있으므로 supply sensitivity와 rejection을 error path로 평가해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Optimizing Power Systems for the Signal Chain—Part 1: How Much Power Supply Noise Is Tolerable?
verification_refs.locator: Understanding and Quantifying Signal Processing Load Sensitivity to Power Supply Noise; PSRR/PSMR
verification_refs.supports_claim: Shows supply ripple coupling into ADC output spurs and noise, explains DC/AC PSRR as the device's output sensitivity to supply variation, and recommends quantifying the actual frequency-dependent coupling rather than assuming complete rejection or transfer.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Transducer/Sensor Excitation and Measurement Techniques
verification_refs.locator: Ratiometric Vs Non-Ratiometric Operation
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that a shared excitation and ADC reference can cancel common supply variation in a ratiometric bridge measurement, while non-ratiometric reference/excitation changes appear in the ADC result.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Voltage Reference Design for Precision Successive-Approximation ADCs
verification_refs.locator: Noise and Temperature Drift; Troubleshooting Reference Issues
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes how noise or droop on the ADC reference can cause conversion errors and stuck codes, and requires reference noise and drive capability to be considered in the system error budget.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Measuring Direct Current (DC) Voltage
verification_refs.locator: Ground-referenced measurements and ground-potential difference
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that when a grounded signal source is measured with a different ground reference, the potential difference can appear as measurement error; this applies to the ground-referenced subset, not every differential measurement.

facts.statement: Shop shutoff test의 결과와 field operating leakage는 fluid property, temperature, differential pressure, contamination와 cycling history가 달라 직접 동일시할 수 없다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Sourcebook—Oil and Gas
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 1, Shutoff Capability, p. 1-9
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that in-service shutoff leakage depends on factors including pressure drop, temperature, sealing-surface condition and actuator force; because shutoff ratings use standard test conditions that can differ from service, service leakage cannot be predicted accurately.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-4:2021, Industrial-process control valves—Part 4: Inspection and routine testing
verification_refs.locator: §4.3, Notes 1–2; Table 1
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines seat leakage test classes, fluid and procedure under specified conditions and explicitly notes that the standard cannot be used to predict leakage after installation under actual operating conditions.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Fisher Dirty Service Trim product documentation
verification_refs.locator: Product description and Key Features
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes particulate-bearing dirty service and a protected-seat design intended to protect seating surfaces from throttling wear; supports particulate/surface-condition relevance without asserting that every contaminant produces leakage.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valves for High-Cycle Applications brochure
verification_refs.locator: pp. 6–8, cycle accumulation, seat leak testing, performance monitoring and shutoff results

facts.statement: Balanced trim은 unbalanced force를 줄이지만 balance seal·piston ring·cage clearance와 같은 additional internal leakage path를 가질 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, 4th ed., Chapter 1
verification_refs.locator: §1, Balanced-Plug Cage-Style Valve Bodies, pp. 1-3–1-4
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes pressure acting on both top and bottom of a balanced plug to nullify most static unbalance force; separately identifies a sliding piston ring-type seal between plug and cage cylinder that virtually eliminates upstream-to-downstream leakage, evidencing a distinct secondary leakage path that is limited by the seal.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, EH and EHA Control Valves Product Bulletin D100042X012
verification_refs.locator: § C-seal and Bore Seal descriptions, p. 13
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that a metal Bore Seal blocks a secondary leakage path between plug and cage wall when shut, while piston rings block that path when the plug is not on the seat; the geometry and seal are model-specific.

facts.statement: Soft seat는 낮은 시험 누설에 유리할 수 있으나 temperature, chemical compatibility, extrusion과 wear 제한이 있고 metal seat는 harsh service 내구성과 temperature 범위에 유리하지만 허용 누설과 surface condition을 함께 검토한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, 4th ed., Chapter 1; Fisher GX Product Bulletin D103171X012
verification_refs.edition_or_version: Handbook 4th ed.; GX bulletin April 2023; accessed 2026-10-11
verification_refs.locator: Handbook §1, p. 1-2; Fisher GX bulletin, trim-material tables, pp. 7–9

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, EW Series Sliding-Stem Control Valves Product Bulletin D100023X012
verification_refs.locator: Table 20, pp. 29–30
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists a PTFE soft-seat disk temperature capability and PTFE seal variants with anti-extrusion rings for specified designs; limits apply to the named construction and do not define a universal PTFE limit.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, 4th ed., Chapter 1; Fisher EH/EHA Product Bulletin D100042X012
verification_refs.edition_or_version: Handbook 4th ed.; EH/EHA bulletin October 2025; accessed 2026-10-11
verification_refs.locator: Handbook §10B, pp. 10B-19–10B-20; EH/EHA bulletin §C-seal, p. 13
verification_refs.supports_claim: The handbook gives examples where metal seats are used in scraper and high-pressure-drop erosive services; the bulletin describes model-specific metal C-seal trim for high-temperature Class V shutoff up to a stated limit. These are application-specific examples, not a universal guarantee.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-4:2021, Industrial-process control valves—Part 4: Inspection and routine testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines seat leakage acceptance by the specified leakage class, test fluid and procedure; the acceptance is not an inherent promise based solely on whether the seat is soft or metal.

facts.statement: Gas volumetric leakage를 reference condition으로 환산할 때 absolute pressure와 absolute temperature를 사용하고 gas behavior 가정을 밝힌다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Heating Values of Natural Gas and Its Components, NBSIR 82-2401
verification_refs.locator: Appendix A3.1.7, Equation of state
verification_refs.supports_claim: States the ideal-gas equation of state as molar volume V/n = RT/p. Equating molar flow at measured and reference states yields the stated absolute-pressure and absolute-temperature conversion; a real-gas correction requires compressibility-factor treatment.

facts.statement: Foreign material, scale, polymerization product와 solid particle이 seat 사이에 끼면 일시적 또는 반복적인 shutoff leakage가 발생할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, 6th ed., Chapter 8
verification_refs.locator: §8.2.2, Be Sure the Pipeline Is Clean
verification_refs.supports_claim: States foreign material can damage valve seating surfaces or obstruct plug, ball or disk movement so the valve does not shut off properly; names pipe scale, metal chips and welding slag as examples.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, HP and HPA Valves Instruction Manual D101634X012
verification_refs.locator: Installation section, p. 8
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires cleaning foreign material from the body and pipeline and notes upstream strainer consideration for small trim passages when the medium is not clean; this supports a service-specific particle risk, not a universal strainer requirement.

facts.statement: Allowable leakage가 nominal size, port diameter, seat diameter 또는 rated capacity에 정규화될 수 있으므로 governing basis를 명시한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, 5th ed., Chapter 5: Control Valve Sizing
verification_refs.locator: §5.3 Class VI Maximum Seat Leakage Allowable; leakage class tables
verification_refs.supports_claim: The handbook presents classes II–IV as a percentage of rated capacity, class V as a water leakage volume normalized by port diameter and differential pressure, and class VI values by nominal port diameter; the governing class/table determines the basis.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-4:2021, Industrial-process control valves—Part 4: Inspection and routine testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires leakage class, test fluid and test procedure to be specified and maps each class to its maximum allowable seat leakage; measuring instrument accuracy and stabilization conditions are also specified.

facts.statement: Leakage rate는 volumetric flow, mass flow 또는 bubble count basis로 표현할 수 있으며 unit와 reference condition을 명시한다.

verification_refs.citation: ISO 15848-1:2015, Industrial valves—Measurement, test and qualification procedures for fugitive emissions—Part 1
verification_refs.locator: §3 terminology and classification definitions; stem-seal leakage expression
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines fugitive emission as external leakage under specified test conditions expressed as concentration or leak rate and permits mass-flow or volumetric-flow expressions normalized by stem diameter under its method.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 5: Control Valve Sizing
verification_refs.locator: §5.3 Class VI Maximum Seat Leakage Allowable and table footnote
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists Class VI maximum leakage as ml/min by nominal port size and gives bubbles/min as a suggested alternative only for a suitably calibrated device with specified tubing geometry and immersion depth; other apparatus may yield different bubble counts if they correctly indicate volumetric flow.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-4:2021, Industrial-process control valves—Part 4: Inspection and routine testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires leakage class, test fluid and procedure to be stated, gives method-specific maximum allowable seat leakage, and defines measuring accuracy and stabilized-flow observation for the seat test.

facts.statement: Bubble count를 volumetric leakage로 환산하려면 representative bubble volume, counting duration, test gas와 pressure·temperature condition을 확인한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 5: Control Valve Sizing
verification_refs.locator: §5.3 Class VI Maximum Seat Leakage Allowable, table and footnote
verification_refs.supports_claim: The suggested bubbles/minute conversion assumes a suitably calibrated measuring device and specifies a 1/4-inch OD tube, wall thickness, immersion depth, square cut and orientation; other apparatus may give different bubble counts if calibrated to the same ml/min flow.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-4:2021, Industrial-process control valves—Part 4: Inspection and routine testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines gas test media and temperature range, class-specific test pressure and requires stabilized flow to be observed long enough to obtain the specified measuring accuracy.

facts.statement: Leakage 시험은 test pressure, differential pressure, temperature, hold duration와 thermal·pressure stabilization 조건을 기록한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-4:2021, Industrial-process control valves—Part 4: Inspection and routine testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines leakage class/test fluid/procedure, specifies test medium and temperature range, establishes class-dependent test pressure or purchaser-specified maximum differential, requires flow stabilization and observation for the duration needed to achieve specified accuracy, and allows actual/allowed rate plus pressure to be reported by agreement.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 5: Control Valve Sizing
verification_refs.locator: §5.2 Control Valve Seat Leakage Classifications and §5.3 Class VI table footnote
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists test media, test pressures and temperatures by leakage class and explains that Class VI bubble/min alternative requires a calibrated apparatus; class data are method-specific.

facts.statement: Seat ring, plug, ball, disc와 seal ring의 contact geometry, alignment와 contact width는 sealing stress와 leakage path를 결정한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 3: Valve and Actuator Types
verification_refs.locator: §3.6 Valve Plug Guiding
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that accurate plug guiding is necessary for alignment with the seat ring and describes cage-, top/bottom-, and port-guided constructions that establish alignment when the valve closes.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, 24000CVF/SVF Valves Instruction Manual D103360X012
verification_refs.locator: Lapping the Valve Seat
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines lapping as mating plug and seat-ring surfaces to produce a close fit; when leakage is excessive, the manual directs inspection of scratches/dents and says the seating contact surface should be as narrow as possible for this product and procedure.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, EW Valve Instruction Manual D100399X012
verification_refs.locator: Figure 13 and inspection procedure, pp. 24–25
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies the plug-to-seat-ring lower seating surface and the separate C-seal-to-cage upper seating surface, and directs inspection for wear or damage that could prevent proper operation; this is a design-specific example rather than a universal trim geometry.

facts.statement: Seating force와 seat load는 contact area를 통해 sealing contact stress를 형성하며 필요한 값은 trim geometry, pressure direction, seat material과 service condition에 의존한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, Chapters 1 and 5

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Sourcebook—Oil and Gas
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 2, §§A–B, pp. 2-7–2-8; Table 2-2; Fig. 2-9
verification_refs.supports_claim: States unbalance force equals net shutoff pressure differential times configuration-dependent unbalance area, and seat load is determined by shutoff requirements with recommendations by leak class and port circumference; service severity and seat life affect selection.
