verification_refs.locator: Stress; Average Normal Stress—Axial Loading
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines stress as force normalized by geometry and gives average normal stress as resultant normal force divided by area under the explicitly stated uniform-distribution assumption; this supports only nominal average contact stress, not a uniform local seat-contact distribution.

facts.statement: Seat load가 부족하면 surface irregularity와 pressure force를 극복하지 못하여 shutoff leakage가 증가할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, HPNS Valve Instruction Manual D103466X012
verification_refs.locator: Installing Dynamic Bore Seal Trim, §7, pp. 24–25; Installing Static Bore Seal Trim, pp. 28–29
verification_refs.supports_claim: For this Fisher Bore Seal design, specifies sufficient initial seating force to overcome seal resistance and contact the seat ring to avoid excessive leakage and seat erosion; it does not prescribe a universal load for other designs.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Sourcebook—Oil and Gas
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 2, §§A–B and Table 2-2, pp. 2-7–2-8
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines shutoff pressure unbalance force as differential pressure multiplied by configuration-specific unbalance area and determines seat load from shutoff requirement and factory leak class.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, 24000CVF/SVF Valves Instruction Manual D103360X012
verification_refs.locator: Lapping the Valve Seat
verification_refs.supports_claim: Connects excessive seat leakage with the need to lap plug and seat-ring mating surfaces and directs inspection/remediation of scratches or dents affecting close fit.

facts.statement: Pressure direction은 pressure-assisted 또는 pressure-unbalanced sealing을 만들 수 있으므로 normal flow와 reverse-pressure condition을 분리하여 평가한다.

verification_refs.locator: Volume 1, Basic Valve Body Force Requirements; reverse flow special-condition calculations
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists static plug unbalance and seat-load forces as separate actuator-sizing components and directs calculation for specific conditions such as reverse flow direction rather than applying standard-table assumptions.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 5: Control Valve Sizing
verification_refs.locator: §5.11.1.1 Unbalance Force
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines shutoff unbalance force as net pressure differential multiplied by net unbalance area; the area depends on valve construction.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Baumann 26000 PTFE-Lined Control Valve product documentation
verification_refs.locator: Product description and key features: pressure-assisted seating
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies pressure-assisted PTFE seating as a feature of this specific valve model; this is evidence of a design-specific mechanism, not a universal valve behavior.

facts.statement: Single-seat와 double-seat trim은 seat 수, force balance와 leakage path가 다르며 double-seat 구조는 두 접촉면의 동시 정렬과 누설 합산을 고려한다.

verification_refs.locator: §3.1.1.4 Double-Ported Valve Bodies
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes double-ported body force balance and notes metal-to-metal seating typically provides Class II shutoff, with Class III possible; supports construction-specific force and leakage characteristics.

verification_refs.supports_claim: For double-port valves, provides separate treatment of top and bottom seat rings; if either port continues to leak, the procedure adjusts the rings until both seats touch at the same time and then retests the valve for shutoff.

facts.statement: Cavitation과 flashing이 seat·trim damage를 유발할 수 있으나 유동 regime와 방지 설계의 물리 원인은 Topic 8이 소유한다.

facts.statement: Fugitive emission 평가는 packing, bonnet·body joint와 accessory connection의 source, monitoring point, background와 measurement condition을 구분한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 5
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 5, control-valve sizing with attached reducers and fittings
verification_refs.supports_claim: Attached inlet/outlet reducers and pipe-size transitions have fitting loss coefficients and must be included in valve sizing; local valve and connected-piping geometry therefore forms part of the flow assessment.

facts.statement: MC/DC의 적용 여부와 목표 수준은 산업별 기능안전 표준, Systematic Capability, 자체 개발 코드 범위, 언어와 Functional Safety Plan으로 결정하며 모든 일반 PLC·HMI 소프트웨어에 일률 적용하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61508-3:2010, Functional safety of electrical/electronic/programmable electronic safety-related systems — Part 3: Software requirements
verification_refs.edition_or_version: Edition 2.0; IEC webstore scope summary accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: Scope and software requirements summary, lines 58–60
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEC states Part 3 applies to software forming part of a safety-related system or used to develop one, requires software safety functions and systematic capability to be specified, and grades measures and techniques against required systematic capability. This bounds the standard's software scope and does not impose MC/DC universally on every PLC/HMI program.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-189: Code Coverage Measurements
verification_refs.locator: §3.1, code coverage metric selection; §3.3, coverage criteria by software class
verification_refs.supports_claim: NASA guidance says to identify relevant coverage criteria based on software classification and system requirements; its example table has different MC/DC expectations for different software classes. This is NASA-specific guidance used as evidence of classification-dependent selection, not as an industrial universal rule.

facts.statement: Modbus TCP는 Modbus application data를 TCP/IP 네트워크에서 교환하도록 mapping한 방식이며 IP 설계, unit identifier 사용, connection 관리와 register mapping을 별도로 확인해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Modbus Organization, MODBUS Application Protocol Specification V1.1b3
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines the Modbus PDU independently from the underlying communication layer and explains that bus/network mapping can add ADU fields. It states the Modbus data model is bound to the device application and that pre-mapping is vendor/device specific.

verification_refs.citation: Modbus Organization, MODBUS Messaging on TCP/IP Implementation Guide V1.0b
verification_refs.locator: §3.1.3, MBAP Header; §4.2, TCP Connection Management; §4.4.1.3, Unit Identifier routing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies TCP/IP messaging over port 502, the MBAP Unit Identifier and its gateway/subnetwork routing role, and TCP connection establishment and management. The guide notes direct TCP servers can treat Unit Identifier as non-significant, so its use must be checked against topology and implementation.

facts.statement: HART는 기존 4–20 mA 아날로그 신호 위에 디지털 통신을 중첩하여 주 변수와 함께 설정·상태·추가 변수·진단정보를 교환할 수 있게 한다.

verification_refs.citation: FieldComm Group, HART Technology Explained
verification_refs.locator: How HART Works; Frequency Shift Keying; Two Communication Channels
verification_refs.supports_claim: The protocol owner describes the low-level FSK digital signal superimposed on the 4–20 mA wiring, simultaneous analog and digital channels, analog primary-variable transmission, and digital device status, diagnostics, and additional measured/calculated values.

verification_refs.citation: FieldComm Group, How to Develop and Register a WirelessHART Device, FCG AG10319 v1.0
verification_refs.locator: Table 2, HART Command Sets Overview
verification_refs.supports_claim: FieldComm Group identifies Universal Commands for reading device identifiers and variables and configuring HART parameters, and Common Practice Commands for calibration, range configuration, and reading/writing other device configuration parameters. This supports the configuration exchange claim while leaving device-specific functionality implementation-dependent.

facts.statement: HART multidrop 구성은 여러 장치의 디지털 통신을 한 쌍에 연결할 수 있지만 loop current 운용방식, 주소, polling, 전원과 사용 목적을 점대점 구성과 구분해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: FieldComm Group, HART Application Guide, Revision 7.1
verification_refs.locator: §2.6 Multi-Drop, p. 13
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies a single pair for multiple field devices in multidrop mode, digital transmission of process values, unique polling addresses whose range depends on HART revision, and fixed minimum loop current typically 4 mA. It also identifies auxiliary power as applicable and describes the mode as useful for supervisory installations, not as universally interchangeable with point-to-point control.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Biffi, ICON3000 EleHRT-24 HART Bus Module Installation, Operation and Maintenance Manual
verification_refs.locator: §5, HART Protocol Previews, Multidrop
verification_refs.supports_claim: For the specific actuator bus module, describes multiple devices in parallel on one pair, unique polling addresses, fixed minimum current typically 4 mA, and required local configuration and loop-termination conditions. This confirms that electrical setup and current behavior must be checked for the selected implementation.

facts.statement: Battery-powered 무선장치는 update 요구, 송신횟수, routing 역할, 온도, battery chemistry, 교체절차와 접근성을 고려하여 전원 수명과 유지보수 계획을 수립해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: FieldComm Group / HART Communication Foundation, IEC 62591 WirelessHART System Engineering Guide HCF_LIT-161
verification_refs.locator: §8.3, network planning and device update rate, p. 31
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires selecting each device update rate to meet application specifications and battery life, explains that faster update rates shorten battery life, and advises against oversampling; it also notes faster update rates affect gateway device capacity.

verification_refs.citation: FieldComm Group, How to Develop and Register a WirelessHART Device, FCG_AG10319
verification_refs.locator: §4.1.4, Powering the Wireless Device, pp. 10–11
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists measurement, publishing process/status, configuration, network management including advertising/packet forwarding, and maintenance-port operations as power consumers. States installed temperature affects battery chemistry/life selection; replacement mechanics and safety require design consideration; remote or hazardous locations increase replacement concerns.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Rosemount 648 Wireless Product Data Sheet
verification_refs.locator: Power module specification and reference conditions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Gives a product-specific battery-life rating at a stated update interval and reference conditions, including routing data for three additional network devices, and warns that continuous exposure at ambient-temperature limits may reduce rated life; this is not a universal lifetime guarantee.

facts.statement: Device Description은 장치 parameter, menu, range, unit, method와 diagnostics를 engineering tool 또는 host가 해석하도록 제공하는 통합정보이며 DD/EDD, GSD/GSDML, EDS, ESI 등은 protocol ecosystem별로 역할이 다르다.

verification_refs.citation: FieldComm Group, Electronic Device Description Language (EDDL)
verification_refs.locator: EDDL technology scope and described component properties
verification_refs.supports_claim: States EDDL creates EDDs for concrete devices, profiles, or libraries and can describe device parameters and dependencies, functions such as simulation/calibration, menus, interactions with control devices, and persistent data.

verification_refs.citation: PROFIBUS & PROFINET International, GSDML Specification for PROFINET
verification_refs.locator: GSDML description and intended engineering-tool use
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes GSDML as the PROFINET device description covering identification, device structure, communication features, process data, parameters, and diagnosis; engineering-tool manufacturers are an intended audience.

verification_refs.citation: ODVA, CIP and the Family of CIP Networks, PUB00123R1
verification_refs.locator: §§2.7 and 3.3.17, EDS and EtherNet/IP configuration
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that EDS may describe connection options and individual parameters or a configuration assembly, while availability and use depend on EDS-based configuration tools.

verification_refs.citation: EtherCAT Technology Group, ETG.2200 EtherCAT and EtherCAT P SubDevice Implementation Guide
verification_refs.locator: Introduction and ESI section
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that EtherCAT devices are delivered with XML ESI descriptions and that configuration tools use ESI data to generate ENI network configuration, including supported process-data structures and initialization commands.

facts.statement: OPC UA는 platform-independent service, address space, information model과 method·event·subscription을 제공하여 시스템 간 의미 있는 데이터 교환을 지원하는 상호운용 아키텍처이다.

verification_refs.citation: OPC Foundation, OPC Unified Architecture Part 1: Overview and Concepts
verification_refs.locator: §1 Scope; §3.2 specification parts; §5.3.4 AddressSpace and information models
verification_refs.supports_claim: The specification calls OPC UA platform-independent, describes the server AddressSpace, and states that the AddressSpace supports information models through references, object types, and industry-specific data types. It also explains that profiles may limit which nodes are implemented.

verification_refs.citation: OPC Foundation, OPC Unified Architecture Part 3: Address Space Model
verification_refs.locator: §4.3 Object Model; §4.7 Event Model; §4.8 Methods
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines the AddressSpace object model in terms of Variables, Methods, and relationships, and describes event subscriptions and client-invoked methods. These mechanisms provide the named information and interaction constructs, without guaranteeing that every server implements every optional capability.

verification_refs.citation: OPC Foundation, OPC Unified Architecture Part 4: Services
verification_refs.locator: §4.1 Service Set model, lines 437–445
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies method-call services, MonitoredItems for monitoring attribute changes and events, and Subscription services that deliver the resulting notifications; it also describes recovery from missed messages and communication failures.

facts.statement: PROFIBUS PA는 공정계측용 fieldbus로서 PA device profile과 bus-powered 물리구성을 활용하며 DP/PA coupling 또는 linking device, segment 전원·terminator·방폭구성을 함께 설계해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: PROFIBUS & PROFINET International, PROFIBUS System Description
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines MBP as Manchester-coded Bus Powered technology, describing simultaneous device power and data over the bus cable; identifies trunk/spur segment design, DP/PA segment couplers or links, and the PA profile's standardized device functions, process data formats and diagnostics. Bus power is specific to bus-powered MBP devices, not universal to every device variant.

verification_refs.citation: PROFIBUS & PROFINET International, PROFIBUS Design Guideline
verification_refs.locator: §3.2.9, p. 127, PROFIBUS-MBP (PA) bus termination
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires segment termination at both ends to avoid reflections and distinguishes termination arrangements for hazardous and non-hazardous PA segments; notes a DP/PA converter may include the termination at the segment start and that the second termination belongs near the end of the trunk.

facts.statement: FOUNDATION Fieldbus는 현장장치의 통신, 표준화된 function block, 장치관리와 진단을 통합하며 segment 설계 시 전원, trunk·spur, terminator, barrier와 장치 수를 함께 검토해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: FieldComm Group, FOUNDATION Fieldbus Technology Explained
verification_refs.locator: Function Blocks; Physical Layer; Communication Layer; User Layer
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes the standard User Layer built from blocks and Device Descriptions; Resource, Function, and Transducer Blocks; control-in-the-field, diagnostics, alarms and status; and a physical/communication layer architecture. Device/host interoperability remains a capability to be implemented and supported by the selected components.

verification_refs.citation: FieldComm Group, FOUNDATION Fieldbus System Engineering Guidelines, Revision 3.2.1
verification_refs.locator: §5.4 User Application Blocks; §6.3 Terminators; segment component requirements
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes Resource/Transducer/Function Blocks and user-configurable schedules; requires exactly two terminators at each trunk end and details segment component, power-conditioning, coupler, spur-protection and barrier design considerations. It also directs users to verify device-function and host compatibility.

facts.statement: FOUNDATION Fieldbus function block은 장치 기능과 제어 연산을 표준화하여 분산 실행과 상호연결을 지원하지만 실제 기능 호환성은 block 종류, parameter, schedule, host 지원과 인증범위를 확인해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: FieldComm Group, FOUNDATION Fieldbus Technical Specifications, Function Block Application Process (FF-890) overview
verification_refs.edition_or_version: Current specification catalog; FF-890 Rev. FS 1.10 listed; accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: Function Block AP Part 1 (FF-890) scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: The specification catalog says FF-890 defines function-block application characteristics, a base set of function-block types, and a mechanism for specialized types by user groups and vendors. This supports standardization while showing the available set is not unlimited or identical in every implementation.

verification_refs.citation: FieldComm Group, FOUNDATION Fieldbus System Engineering Guidelines, Revision 3.2.1
verification_refs.locator: §5.4 User Application Blocks and function block availability guidance
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes function blocks as handling control strategies, distinguishes device application blocks from configuration blocks, states application block schedules and usage are user-configurable, and advises checking function-block availability with both the device manufacturer and host system before purchase.

facts.statement: Serial communication은 비트를 순차 전송하는 방식이며 물리계층의 전기적 규격, baud rate, character format, duplex, addressing과 상위 프로토콜을 구분하여 설계해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, LabVIEW User Manual: Serial Port Communication
verification_refs.locator: Serial Port Communication; Serial Hardware Overview; Connecting a Serial Device
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines serial transfer as sending one bit at a time and lists baud rate, data bits, parity, and stop bits as communication parameters; contrasts RS-232 point-to-point with differential RS-422 and multidrop RS-485, and instructs users to check the device's pinout, DCE/DTE role, and handshaking settings.

verification_refs.citation: Siemens, SIMATIC S7-1500/ET 200MP Communication Function Manual: Serial Data Transmission
verification_refs.locator: Basics of serial communication, serial data transmission
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains sequential transmission of character bits, half-duplex operation, dependence on the physical interface and selected driver, and the need to agree on transmission rate and parity settings.

verification_refs.citation: Modbus Organization, Modbus Serial Line Protocol and Implementation Guide V1.02
verification_refs.locator: §2 serial transmission modes and §2.5 RTU framing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines serial RTU framing and shows the server address, function code, data, and CRC fields; this demonstrates that addressing belongs to the selected protocol frame, not to serial transmission as a universal physical-layer property.

facts.statement: EtherNet/IP는 표준 Ethernet과 IP 위에서 CIP object·service·connection model을 사용하는 산업 통신이며 EDS, device profile, I/O connection과 controller·scanner 지원을 확인해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: ODVA, EtherNet/IP Quick Start for Vendors Handbook
verification_refs.locator: Objects, Services, and Application Data; EtherNet/IP network model
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that the CIP application layer defines application objects and device profiles and that EtherNet/IP maps CIP communication services to Ethernet and TCP/IP. It describes the CIP object model and communication services used to establish associations and access device data.

verification_refs.citation: ODVA, EtherNet/IP Adapter Class Products and Quick Start Guide
verification_refs.locator: Scanner Class and Adapter Class product descriptions; EDS-based I/O scanner configuration
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines Scanner Class as the originator of I/O connection requests and Adapter Class as the target of real-time I/O requests. The ODVA document describes EDS fields used for scanner configuration; the specific connection sizes, profile, and feature support remain device dependent.

facts.statement: PROFINET은 Ethernet 기반 산업 자동화 통신으로 cyclic I/O, acyclic parameter·diagnostics와 engineering integration을 제공하며 device role, conformance class, profile, GSDML과 controller 지원을 확인해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: PROFIBUS & PROFINET International, PROFINET System Description
verification_refs.locator: §2.3 Device Descriptions; §2.4 Communication Relations; §3 Basic Functions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes GSD as the XML-based device description of device properties, modules, submodules, communication features, parameters, and engineering data; identifies cyclic I/O, acyclic record services and alarms as separate channels and describes IO Controller/IO Device roles.

verification_refs.citation: PROFIBUS & PROFINET International, GSDML Specification and PROFINET Test Specification
verification_refs.edition_or_version: GSDML specification V2.4; test bundle versions published 2026; accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: GSDML device description scope; PROFINET conformance classes and certification procedure
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines GSDML as describing device identification, structure, communication features, process data, parameters, and diagnosis; PI specifies conformance tests for PROFINET devices, controllers and network components by conformance class. This supports checking the specific class and implementation rather than assuming all combinations support identical features.

facts.statement: EtherCAT은 Ethernet frame이 line 또는 ring을 통과하는 동안 각 slave가 지정 데이터를 처리하는 구조를 사용하며 master configuration, process data mapping, ESI와 network topology 적합성을 확인해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: EtherCAT Technology Group, EtherCAT Technology
verification_refs.locator: EtherCAT operation; topology scan and compare; SubDevice process data mapping
verification_refs.supports_claim: ETG explains that each SubDevice reads and writes its assigned data while the Ethernet frame is passing through, and that the MainDevice can compare the actual topology against the planned topology at startup. It describes line, tree, star, and ring capability subject to network design.

verification_refs.citation: EtherCAT Technology Group, ETG.2200 EtherCAT and EtherCAT P SubDevice Implementation Guide
verification_refs.locator: Introduction and ESI section
verification_refs.supports_claim: States each EtherCAT device must be delivered with an XML ESI device description; configuration tools use the ESI to compile ENI network configuration offline, including process-data structures and initialization commands. ESI describes supported device functionality and settings.

facts.statement: WirelessHART는 HART device data를 무선 mesh로 전달하기 위한 산업 무선체계이며 field device, gateway, network manager, access point, join 절차와 기존 host 연계를 함께 고려해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: FieldComm Group, WirelessHART Technology
verification_refs.locator: WirelessHART mesh operation and three main network elements
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes WirelessHART as a process-automation wireless protocol using mesh routing; identifies field devices, gateways connecting devices to host applications, and a Network Manager that configures, schedules, routes, and monitors the network. It states the manager may be integrated into a gateway, host application, or controller.

verification_refs.citation: HART Communication Foundation / FieldComm Group, IEC 62591 WirelessHART System Engineering Guide HCF_LIT-161
verification_refs.locator: §4 gateway system architecture, Figure 7 and gateway requirements
verification_refs.supports_claim: Shows host applications and process automation controllers connected through gateway functions comprising Gateway, Access Point, Network Manager and Security Manager to WirelessHART field devices in a mesh. It requires suitable host protocols and multi-vendor network management support.

verification_refs.citation: FieldComm Group, WirelessHART Security
verification_refs.locator: Device joining, gateway authentication, and join/network keys
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that gateways and devices must be configured to control network access, joining devices authenticate to the gateway, and join/network keys are provisioned for authentication and encrypted communications.

facts.statement: ISA100.11a는 산업용 무선 sensor·actuator 통신을 위한 체계로서 field device, backbone router, gateway/system manager와 application mapping을 구성하며 지원 profile과 host integration을 확인해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: International Society of Automation, ISA-100 Series of Standards, ISA-100.11a-2011
verification_refs.locator: ISA-100.11a standard scope and system management/gateway specification description
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISA identifies ISA-100.11a as specifying secure, reliable wireless communication for process control and related applications and lists system-management and gateway specifications within the series.

verification_refs.citation: Yokogawa, World's First Wireless Field Instruments Based on ISA100.11a
verification_refs.locator: ISA100.11a wireless network architecture and YFGW710 host connection
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes field instruments and gateway integration with the host system, and identifies gateway, system manager, security manager, and backbone-router functions in an ISA100.11a implementation. It notes these logical functions may be integrated in the same product, so the statement is not a universal physical-box topology.

verification_refs.citation: ISA-100.11a-2011, Wireless Systems for Industrial Automation: Process Control and Related Applications
verification_refs.locator: §5.3.5 Gateway, System Manager, and Security Manager; network architecture diagrams
verification_refs.supports_claim: The standard text describes network diagrams with field, routing and I/O devices, backbone routers, gateways and management functions, and explicitly allows gateway, system-manager and security-manager roles to be implemented on separate physical devices rather than one combined unit.

facts.statement: Cv는 valve geometry와 유동 손실을 하나의 계수로 나타낸 유량 용량 지표이며 travel, valve opening ratio 또는 line size가 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Sourcebook—Oil and Gas
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 3, pp. 3-3–3-4; Chapter 4, p. 4-3
verification_refs.supports_claim: Presents Cv in the flow-capacity equation, instructs the user to calculate required Cv and then select a valve using Cv tables; catalog tables report Cv separately by valve size and travel, showing Cv is neither travel percentage nor a line-size label.

facts.statement: Cv와 Kv는 서로 변환 가능하며 통상 Kv≈0.865Cv, Cv≈1.156Kv를 사용한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Sourcebook—Oil and Gas
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 4, p. 4-3, flow-coefficient conversion relationships
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists Kv=(0.865)(Cv); the reciprocal coefficient is approximately 1/0.865=1.15607, so the stated Cv conversion is the rounded reciprocal.

facts.statement: Cv 또는 Kv 계산에서는 flow, pressure drop, density term, coefficient와 vendor catalog의 단위계를 일치시켜야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Sourcebook—Oil and Gas
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 3, liquid sizing equations and nomenclature; Chapter 4, coefficient conversion and selection procedure
verification_refs.supports_claim: Gives sizing equations with defined units and unit-system-dependent constants, then requires selection from the matching coefficient tables; this entails converting inputs to the equation's stated unit basis before calculation and catalog comparison.

facts.statement: 동일 유량과 pressure drop에서 specific gravity 또는 relative density가 증가하면 required coefficient도 증가한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Sourcebook—Oil and Gas; direct rearrangement of its basic liquid sizing equation
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 3, p. 3-3, volumetric liquid equation Cv=q/[N1 Fp √(ΔP/Gf)]
verification_refs.supports_claim: At fixed q, ΔP, N1 and Fp, algebraic rearrangement gives Cv proportional to √Gf; therefore increasing specific gravity increases required Cv. The claim is limited to the equation's applicable non-choked liquid regime.

facts.statement: Fp는 밸브에 직접 연결된 reducer, expander, elbow 또는 tee 등의 부착 fitting이 effective flow capacity에 미치는 영향을 보정한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Sourcebook—Oil and Gas
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 3, pp. 3-2–3-4, sizing step 3 and Fp definition
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines Fp as correction for pressure losses from fittings such as reducers, elbows or tees directly attached to valve inlet/outlet; gives a calculation using attached-fitting loss coefficients.

facts.statement: Fp<1이면 부착 fitting을 포함한 assembly의 effective capacity가 bare valve capacity보다 작아진다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Sourcebook—Oil and Gas; direct interpretation of Fp equation
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 3, p. 3-4, Fp equation; fitting loss coefficient definitions
verification_refs.supports_claim: The equation gives Fp=[1+positive fitting-loss term]^-1/2 for ordinary passive attached fittings, hence 0<Fp≤1; the sizing equation multiplies bare-valve capacity by Fp, so Fp<1 lowers effective assembly capacity.

facts.statement: Fp는 valve size, pipe size, fitting type, reducer·expander geometry와 selected valve coefficient에 따라 달라질 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Sourcebook—Oil and Gas
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 3, pp. 3-4–3-5, Fp equation and definitions of K, valve size and pipe diameter
verification_refs.supports_claim: Fp equation depends on attached fitting loss coefficients, assumed nominal valve size, valve Cv and piping internal diameter; the text separately directs users to determine factors for rotary valves with reducers and other fitting styles.

facts.statement: Two-phase, slurry, non-Newtonian, polymer 또는 고형물 포함 service에는 clean single-phase liquid correlation을 무조건 적용하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-2-1:2011, Industrial-process control valves—Flow capacity—Sizing equations for fluid flow under installed conditions
verification_refs.locator: IEC official publication page, scope summary for incompressible-fluid equations
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEC states its incompressible equations are not intended for non-Newtonian fluids, fluid mixtures, slurries or liquid-solid conveyance systems; cautious use is described for non-vaporizing multicomponent liquids. This supports the anchor's caution against unconditional use of the clean-liquid correlation.

facts.statement: 고점도, 저유량, 소형 trim 또는 작은 flow coefficient에서는 valve Reynolds number가 낮아져 난류식의 오차가 커질 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Catalog 12, ANSI/ISA/IEC Valve Sizing
verification_refs.locator: Section 2, pp. 2-2, 2-6–2-7, Reynolds factor and valve Reynolds equation
verification_refs.supports_claim: States nonturbulent flow may occur with high viscosity, very low pressure differential or low flow rate; its valve Reynolds equation also depends on viscosity, flow, valve coefficient, valve style factors and passage diameter, supporting the listed geometry-sensitive screening conditions without asserting a universal threshold.

facts.statement: 비난류 조건에서 FR<1이면 동일 유량을 확보하기 위한 corrected required Cv 또는 Kv는 기본 난류식 결과보다 증가한다.

verification_refs.locator: pp. 9 and 24–25, EPL zone table and marking examples
verification_refs.supports_claim: Shows distinct ia/ib/ic applications against gas and dust EPL/Zone combinations and explains how protection level and EPL appear in equipment marking. It supports checking the certified marking rather than inferring zone solely from the protection suffix.

facts.statement: 본질안전 계측루프는 본질안전 기기, 관련기기 또는 barrier/galvanic isolator, 상호연결 배선으로 하나의 시스템을 이루므로 현장기기만 단독으로 인증되었다고 전체 루프가 자동 적합해지는 것은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60079-11:2023, Explosive atmospheres—Part 11: Equipment protection by intrinsic safety i
verification_refs.locator: Official IEC scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: The standard applies to intrinsically safe apparatus and associated apparatus intended to connect to intrinsically safe circuits entering explosive atmospheres, including associated equipment whose design affects circuit intrinsic safety.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson Fisher 846 Transducer Instruction Manual Supplement D104220X012
verification_refs.locator: Entity Parameters, loop schematic and installation conditions
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that entity apparatus may be interconnected only when the field device input and associated apparatus output parameters satisfy the entity criteria, cable capacitance/inductance are included, and installation follows national wiring practice and the barrier manufacturer's instructions.

facts.statement: Entity parameter 방식에서는 관련기기의 최대 출력 Uo, Io, Po가 현장 본질안전 기기의 허용 입력 Ui, Ii, Pi를 초과하지 않도록 Uo≤Ui, Io≤Ii, Po≤Pi를 확인한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson Fisher 846 Transducer Instruction Manual Supplement D104220X012
verification_refs.locator: Entity Parameters, interconnection criteria
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explicitly requires field-device Vmax/Ui, Imax/Ii and Pmax/Pi to be equal to or greater than the associated-apparatus Voc/Uo, Isc/Io and Po. This is the stated Uo≤Ui, Io≤Ii, Po≤Pi check.

facts.statement: 본질안전 루프의 외부 정전용량과 인덕턴스는 현장기기와 케이블 값을 포함하여 인증된 Co·Lo 또는 인증서가 정한 동시 조합 한계 이내인지 검토해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson Fisher 846 Transducer Instruction Manual Supplement D104220X012
verification_refs.locator: Entity Parameters, interconnection criteria
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires the sum of field-apparatus unprotected Ci/Li and interconnecting cable Ccable/Lcable to be less than the associated-apparatus Co/Lo limits. The anchor appropriately leaves any special combined-parameter rules to certificate and applicable standard.

facts.statement: Zener barrier와 galvanic isolator는 모두 본질안전 에너지 제한에 사용될 수 있으나 절연 유무, 접지 요구, 신호 정확도, 전원, 유지보수 및 인증조건이 달라 시스템 조건에 맞게 선정해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Pepperl+Fuchs, Zener Barriers product overview
verification_refs.locator: Zener Barriers overview
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that Zener barriers limit energy transferred to a hazardous location and identifies their required grounding to the DIN rail. It also notes accuracy and fuse replacement as product characteristics, not universal advantages.

verification_refs.citation: Pepperl+Fuchs, Intrinsic Safety Isolated Barriers product overview
verification_refs.locator: Intrinsic Safety Isolated Barriers overview
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that intrinsically safe barriers limit circuit energy and that isolated barriers additionally provide galvanic isolation. Together with the Zener product overview, this confirms a distinct grounding/isolation implementation; model-specific power, signal, maintenance, and certificate conditions still need checking.

facts.statement: IECEx 인증서 번호의 X 표시는 해당 인증서에 설치·사용·정비에 필요한 특정 사용조건이 있음을 나타내므로 이를 확인해야 한다. 본질안전 control drawing은 연결정보와 특별 설치·사용조건을 정리할 수 있으며, cable gland 선정 등 전기 설치요건은 IEC 60079-14에 따라 별도로 적용한다.

verification_refs.citation: IECEx OD 011-2, Guidance on Use of the IECEx Online Certificate of Conformity System, Part 2
verification_refs.locator: §1.2.20, Specific Conditions of Use
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that X identifies essential installation, use, and maintenance information in the certificate. It also says IEC 60079-14 governs allowable cable-gland types and certificates should be silent on gland details, directly supporting separation of certificate-specific conditions from general gland-selection rules.

verification_refs.citation: IECEx OD 017, Drawing and Documentation Guidance for IECEx Certification
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that instructions identify special installation, live-maintenance, and use requirements; recommends a control drawing for consolidating connection information and special installation/use requirements, including intrinsic-safety documentation.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60079-14:2024, Explosive atmospheres—Part 14: Electrical installation design, selection and installation of equipment, including initial inspection
verification_refs.locator: Official IEC scope description
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines the standard's scope as electrical Ex installation design, equipment selection, installation, and initial inspection; used together with IECEx OD 011-2 for the cable-gland boundary.

facts.statement: 본질안전 배선은 비본질안전 회로로부터 요구되는 분리·식별·배선조건을 유지하고, 차폐·접지 방식도 루프 설계와 인증조건에 맞춰 적용하여 고장 시 위험 에너지 유입을 방지한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Pitworthiness Considerations
verification_refs.locator: p. 13, items h–m: separation and ready identification of intrinsically safe wiring
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides a concrete regulated example of separating and identifying IS wiring from non-IS circuits. The detailed methods are context-specific and are not generalized as universal installation clauses.

verification_refs.citation: Siemens SIMATIC ET 200SP Manual Collection, Line Shielding in Hazardous Areas
verification_refs.locator: Line shielding
verification_refs.supports_claim: Directs designers to follow EN/IEC 60079-14 when designing shielding and grounding for circuits to hazardous-area field devices, and describes shield-terminal connection to functional ground. The claim remains installation- and circuit-specific rather than prescribing a universal shield topology.

facts.statement: 안전증방폭 Ex e는 아크·스파크와 과도한 온도에 의한 점화 위험을 줄이기 위해 추가 설계·구조 조치를 적용한다. IEC 60079-7은 보호수준 eb(EPL Gb/Mb)와 ec(EPL Gc)를 구분하므로, 고장 가정과 세부 요구를 모든 Ex e 기기에 동일하게 적용하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60079-7:2015+AMD1:2017 CSV, Explosive atmospheres—Part 7: Equipment protection by increased safety 'e'
verification_refs.locator: Official IEC scope summary
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines increased safety Ex e and explicitly distinguishes level eb (EPL Mb or Gb) from level ec (EPL Gc), with different included equipment components and scope.

verification_refs.citation: NSW Government TestSafe, Increased safety Ex e
verification_refs.locator: Protection principle and Equipment Protection Level sections
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes additional measures against arcs, sparks and excessive temperature and distinguishes eb (not an ignition source in normal operation or expected malfunctions) from ec (not an ignition source in normal operation). This supports retaining a level-specific fault boundary rather than the prior universal wording.

facts.statement: IEC 60534-2-1 Annex A.7은 정격계수비 C_rated/(d²N18)가 0.016 이상이면 full-size trim, 미만이면 reduced trim으로 구분한다. Annex A.8a/A.8b는 trim별 n 산정식을 다르게 정하고, 이 n은 A.6/A.7의 Reynolds factor FR 계산에 사용되므로 reduced trim에 full-size trim의 n 식을 대입하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-2-1:2011, Industrial-process control valves—Flow capacity—Sizing equations for fluid flow under installed conditions
verification_refs.locator: Annex A.7 and equations (A.6)–(A.8b)
verification_refs.supports_claim: Annex A.7 defines full-size trim as C_rated/(d²N18) ≥ 0.016 and reduced trim as the ratio < 0.016. Equations A.8a and A.8b define distinct n relations for the two regimes; n is then used in the Reynolds factor FR relations in A.6 and A.7. The claim is limited to this trim criterion and parameter relation.

facts.statement: Valve Reynolds number는 IEC 제어밸브 sizing에서 비난류 유동 여부와 보정계수 산정에 사용하며, 그 식은 유량계수·밸브 형식계수 Fd·액체 압력회복계수 FL·유량·점도·배관 직경을 포함한다. 따라서 일반 배관 유동의 Reynolds 식을 그대로 대입하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Catalog 12, ANSI/ISA/IEC Valve Sizing
verification_refs.locator: Section 2, pp. 2-6–2-7, valve Reynolds equation and Reynolds factor procedure
verification_refs.supports_claim: Gives the valve Reynolds equation and defines its inputs, including flow coefficient, valve-style modifier Fd, liquid pressure recovery factor FL, flow, kinematic viscosity and piping diameter. It then uses Rev to determine the Reynolds correction factor FR for nonturbulent flow and distinguishes valve sizing from generic pipe-flow calculation.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-2-1:2011, Industrial-process control valves—Flow capacity—Sizing equations for fluid flow under installed conditions
verification_refs.locator: Official IEC publication page and scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies the normative subject as installed-condition flow-capacity sizing equations for industrial-process control valves; specific equation and inputs are verified against Fisher's implementation guidance.

facts.statement: Fisher ENVIRO-SEAL bellows bonnet은 stem seal을 통한 대기 방출을 줄이도록 설계되며, 해당 제품 구성도에는 bellows 위쪽의 packing이 표시된다. 적용 시 제조사가 제시한 pressure-temperature rating과 pressure·temperature·travel에 따른 cycle-life 조건을 확인하며, 이 특정 제품 자료를 모든 bellows 설계의 보편 보증으로 일반화하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Product Bulletin 59.1:070, ENVIRO-SEAL Bellows Seal, D101641X012
verification_refs.locator: p. 1, features and assembly illustration; pp. 2–3, pressure-temperature and cycle-life limits
verification_refs.supports_claim: The bulletin describes the bellows bonnet as improving stem-seal sealing where atmospheric emissions cannot be tolerated; the assembly illustration labels packing above the bellows; it gives pressure-temperature limits and states that cycle life depends on pressure, temperature, and travel. Evidence is restricted to this Fisher product bulletin.

facts.statement: ANSI/FCI 70-2의 seat-leakage class는 시험 medium과 측정 basis를 정해 해석한다. Fisher Catalog 12는 Class V 시험 medium으로 water를, Class VI로 air를 제시하고 Class VI leakage를 port-size별 bubble 또는 volumetric basis로 표시한다. 따라서 medium·method·단위가 다른 시험 결과를 같은 수치만으로 직접 동등 비교하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Catalog 12, Section 2, ANSI/FCI 70-2 leakage classes
verification_refs.locator: Section 2, p. 2-1, class table
verification_refs.supports_claim: The class table identifies water as the Class V test medium and air as the Class VI medium, with Class VI leakage shown using port-size-specific bubble or volumetric values. The comparison boundary is limited to specified test media and reporting basis.

verification_refs.citation: ANSI/FCI 70-2:2021, Standard for Control Valve Seat Leakage Testing
verification_refs.locator: Official standard catalog record and abstract
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies ANSI/FCI 70-2:2021 as the current control-valve seat-leakage testing standard; detailed class media and criteria are cited to Fisher's published class table.

facts.statement: Fisher ENVIRO-SEAL live-loaded packing은 spring loading으로 packing material 수명 동안 지속 하중을 제공하도록 설계되며, 제조사는 이를 통해 packing box 조정 필요를 줄이고 일부 적용에서는 없앨 수 있다고 설명한다. 이는 해당 제품의 성능 설명이며 모든 live-loaded packing이 무정비라는 뜻은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, enhanced ENVIRO-SEAL Control Valve Packing Systems
verification_refs.locator: Improved Service Life feature
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that live-loading provides a constant load over the life of the packing material and greatly reduces, or in many applications helps eliminate, packing-box adjustment and maintenance. Claim is restricted to this documented Fisher product family.

facts.statement: Emerson이 기록한 한 boiler-feedwater control-valve 사례에서는 entrained particulate에 의한 plug-tip erosion이 plug-seat 접촉을 방해해 shutoff 성능을 낮추고 추가 trim erosion을 가속했다. 이는 해당 유동·trim의 사례이며 모든 seat damage mechanism을 일반화하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Valve Seat Life Extended in Boiler Feedwater Application Using Fisher Protected Inside Seat, D351913X012
verification_refs.locator: pp. 1–2, challenge and solution
verification_refs.supports_claim: The case describes plug-tip erosion from entrained feedwater particulates; the damage prevented proper plug-seat contact, reduced shutoff capability and led to further accelerated trim erosion. The Fact retains the source's single-application boundary.

facts.statement: Garlock packing manual은 stem runout·warping·deflection이 packing을 불균일하게 압축해 radial wear를 만들 수 있다고 설명한다. 수평 밸브에서는 stem 무게와 misalignment가 packing set의 한쪽을 더 압축할 수 있다. 이 내용은 stem-packing alignment 조건이며 seat-contact 전반의 보편 주장으로 일반화하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Garlock, Low Emission Compression Packing Product Owner Manual
verification_refs.locator: pp. 14–15, equipment condition and misalignment/runout troubleshooting
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that stem runout, warping or deflection causes radial packing wear, and that misalignment or horizontal stem weight can compress one side more than the other. Scope is restricted to the packing arrangement described.

facts.statement: Garlock packing manual은 stem의 scratch, corrosion pitting과 거친 표면이 packing sealing surface를 손상시켜 누설과 seal wear를 늘릴 수 있다고 설명한다. 이 근거는 stem-packing 접촉면에 한정하며 valve-seat lapping·경도·coating 전체를 입증하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Garlock, Low Emission Compression Packing Product Owner Manual
verification_refs.locator: p. 14, WHERE? equipment inspection guidance
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that stem scratches, corrosion pitting and general surface roughness can damage packing sealing surfaces and result in excessive leakage and quick seal wear.

facts.statement: Garlock의 지정 packing 설치절차는 stem·stuffing-box 치수와 box 깊이를 측정하고 제조사 load/torque 기준으로 packing을 압축하며 gland follower를 stem 중심에 맞추도록 한다. 이 제품별 절차는 불균일한 side-loading과 stem 접촉 위험을 줄이기 위한 것이며 수치나 압축률을 모든 packing에 적용하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Garlock, Low Emission Compression Packing Product Owner Manual
verification_refs.locator: pp. 10–12, packing installation and load procedures
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual instructs installers to measure stem/stuffing-box dimensions and box depth, compress packing using the product's recommended load/torque, center the follower, and warns of side loading or stem contact when improperly centered. It explicitly treats numeric values as product-procedure-specific.

facts.statement: Garlock Low Emission Compression Packing manual은 stem cycling에 의한 packing consolidation이 gland-load loss 가능성을 줄이는 cycle-and-adjust procedure를 설명한다. packing style·valve design·installation·운전조건에 따라 추가 consolidation이 생길 수 있어 load/torque를 확인하고 필요 시 조정하라고 한다. 이는 해당 제조사 절차이며 모든 packing의 동일한 시간·열주기 거동을 단정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Garlock, Low Emission Compression Packing Product Owner Manual
verification_refs.locator: pp. 12–15, §1.7 Cycle and Adjustment Procedure and Packing Load
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes stem cycling/consolidation and a procedure to reduce likelihood of gland-load loss; says further consolidation depends on packing style, valve design, installation and operating conditions and directs torque recheck/re-adjustment as needed. The source does not establish universal timing or behavior.

facts.statement: Fisher Control Valve Sourcebook은 rotary-shaft sealing의 기본 원리가 sliding-stem sealing과 같지만, rotary motion은 reciprocating sliding-stem motion처럼 packing을 packing box 밖으로 끌어내는 경향이 적다고 설명한다. Rotary service는 흔히 압력이 더 낮다는 설명도 해당 자료의 적용 관찰로 한정하며, 모든 밸브의 leakage path·wear mode 차이를 일반화하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Sourcebook—Oil and Gas
verification_refs.locator: §1.14 Rotary Valve Considerations, p. 1-15
verification_refs.supports_claim: The source states rotary shaft sealing follows the same basic principles as sliding-stem sealing, that rotary motion does not tend to remove material from the packing box as sliding-stem motion does, and that rotary services often operate at lower pressure. The registry claim preserves these limits.

facts.statement: Fisher sliding-stem packing 자료는 packing system을 application의 pressure·temperature envelope와 요구 성능에 맞춰 비교하고, 제품별로 single/double arrangement와 PTFE·graphite 계열 packing 및 lantern ring·spacer·anti-extrusion 부품 구성을 제시한다. 이 사례는 Fisher 제품 구성·한계에 한정되며 모든 제조사나 chemical compatibility·motion 조합의 보편 선정 규칙을 뜻하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Sliding-Stem Packing Selection Product Bulletin D101986X012
verification_refs.locator: Table 1, p. 3; component diagrams, pp. 5–6; single/double arrangements, pp. 12–15
verification_refs.supports_claim: The bulletin compares Fisher packing systems and their application pressure-temperature envelopes, names PTFE and graphite systems, illustrates single and double packing arrangements, and labels lantern rings, spacers and anti-extrusion washers. These are product-specific selections and arrangements.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Sourcebook—Oil and Gas
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides sliding-stem packing selection guidelines and typical packing arrangements; its pressure-temperature and service-performance guidance is specific to the documented Fisher packing systems.

facts.statement: Fisher EH/EHA 제어밸브 자료는 해당 제품의 seat-ring 설계가 온도 cycling에 따른 operational stress와 distortion 및 그로 인한 leakage 가능성을 줄이고, hung cage가 seat-ring gasket load에 영향을 주지 않고 열팽창하도록 설계되었다고 설명한다. 이는 Fisher 제품 설계의 설명이며 모든 밸브가 cold shop test 후 hot service에서 누설한다는 일반 법칙은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Product Bulletin 51.2:EH, EH and EHA Valves, D100042X012
verification_refs.locator: p. 6, Long Thermal-Cycle Life feature
verification_refs.supports_claim: The bulletin states the seat-ring design minimizes operational stresses and reduces chances of distortion and resultant leakage caused by temperature cycling; its hung cage allows cage thermal expansion without affecting seat-ring gasket loading.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Steam Conditioning Technologies—Critical Service
verification_refs.locator: Elevated-temperature material selection section, differential thermal expansion discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: The document explains that at temperatures significantly above ambient, differential thermal expansion can cause plug/cage binding or looseness and can reduce gasket load in body-bonnet-cage-seat-ring systems, resulting in leakage; material selection or part dimensioning must account for the difference. This is corroborative context, not a claim that every cold-tested valve will leak hot.

facts.statement: 미국 40 CFR Part 60 Appendix A-7 Method 21의 VOC equipment-leak screening은 instrument response factor, calibration precision과 response time을 평가한다. Calibration precision은 analyzer 투입 전 및 이후 3개월 또는 다음 사용 시점 중 늦은 때에 확인하고 calibration gas 값의 10% 이하로 하며, response time은 30초 이하로 한다. 이 기준은 Method 21에 따른 fugitive-emission screening에 한정하며 ANSI/FCI seat-leakage 시험이나 보편적 measurement-uncertainty 보고요건으로 확대하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: 40 CFR Part 60, Appendix A-7, Method 21, Determination of Volatile Organic Compound Leaks
verification_refs.supports_claim: Current eCFR Method 21 states response factors less than 10 unless otherwise specified; calibration precision must be tested before service and at three-month intervals or next use, whichever is later, and must be no more than 10% of calibration gas value; response time must be 30 seconds or less. Section 8.3.1.1 applies the leak survey to valve stem/packing and related interfaces. The record explicitly excludes seat-leakage testing and universal uncertainty reporting.

facts.statement: EPA Method 21의 Type II ‘no detectable emissions’ 판정은 먼저 local ambient VOC concentration을 측정하고 source 표면 농도와 비교한다. 주변 emission이 ambient 측정을 간섭하면 더 가까운 위치에서 배경을 측정할 수 있지만 source에서 25 cm보다 가까워서는 안 된다. 이 절차는 해당 VOC fugitive-emission screening 방법에 한정되며 seat-leakage 시험이나 온도 drift 등 모든 오판 원인의 일반 규칙으로 확대하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: 40 CFR Part 60, Appendix A-7, Method 21, Determination of Volatile Organic Compound Leaks
verification_refs.locator: §8.3.2, Type II—No Detectable Emission
verification_refs.supports_claim: Section 8.3.2 directs the user to determine local ambient VOC concentration, then source concentration; where nearby emissions interfere, the background may be measured closer but not less than 25 cm from the source. The evidence supports only this Method 21 procedure.

facts.statement: Special-service sealing은 적용 서비스별 설계·시험 범위로 확인해야 한다. 예를 들어 ISO 10497 fire type test는 through-seat leakage, external leakage와 operability를 평가하고, ISO 21011은 rated temperature −40 °C 이하 cryogenic valve의 설계·제조·시험 요구사항을 다룬다. Fisher EH/EHA 자료는 temperature cycling에 따른 seat-ring distortion·leakage 위험을 줄이는 제품 설계를 설명한다. 이 예들은 서로 다른 qualification/design 범위이며 상세 package 설계는 Topic 14 소유다.

verification_refs.citation: ISO 10497:2022, Testing of valves—Fire type-testing requirements
verification_refs.locator: Scope and preview abstract; criteria for through-seat leakage, external leakage, cavity relief, and operability
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISO's official abstract states the standard specifies fire type-test requirements and measurement/assessment criteria for through-seat leakage, external leakage, cavity overpressure relief, and operability. The Fact uses only those fire-test-specific boundaries.

verification_refs.citation: ISO 21011:2008, Cryogenic vessels—Valves for cryogenic service
verification_refs.edition_or_version: 2008 edition, confirmed current by ISO in 2023; under revision as of 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: Scope; rated temperature −40 °C and below
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISO's official abstract specifies design, manufacture and testing requirements for valves rated −40 °C and below. It records the standard status and scope, not an unverified universal thermal-contraction mechanism.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Product Bulletin 51.2:EH, EH and EHA Valves, D100042X012
verification_refs.locator: p. 6, Long Thermal-Cycle Life feature
verification_refs.supports_claim: The bulletin states the EH/EHA seat-ring design reduces operational stress and the chances of temperature-cycle distortion and resultant leakage, and the hung cage allows thermal expansion without affecting seat-ring gasket load. This is explicitly retained as a Fisher product example.

facts.statement: Control-valve flashing 및 liquid-gas two-phase service의 noise prediction은 확립도가 제한적이다. Fisher Sourcebook은 flashing/two-phase/out-gassing 조건의 noise prediction methods가 잘 확립되지 않았다고 밝히며, IEC 60534-8-4:2015의 hydrodynamic prediction method는 normal turbulence와 liquid cavitation을 다루고 flashing conditions 및 unstable flow noise는 고려하지 않는다고 명시한다. 따라서 이 표준의 예측값을 flashing noise·vibration의 검증으로 간주하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-8-4:2015, Industrial-process control valves—Part 8-4: Noise considerations—Prediction of noise generated by hydrodynamic flow
verification_refs.locator: Introduction and §1 Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: The official IEC page states that the method predicts hydrodynamic noise from liquid flow due to normal turbulence and/or liquid cavitation. The standard text says noise from flashing conditions, mechanical vibration and unstable flow patterns is not considered.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-8-4:2015 standard text preview
verification_refs.locator: Introduction, p. 5; §1 Scope, p. 5
verification_refs.supports_claim: The standard introduction explicitly excludes noise from flashing conditions, mechanical vibration, unstable flow patterns, and unpredictable behavior; the scope describes normal turbulence and liquid cavitation.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Sourcebook—Oil and Gas
verification_refs.locator: §5.1 noise prediction discussion, pp. 5-5–5-6
verification_refs.supports_claim: Fisher states that two-phase noise cases include inlet liquid-gas two-phase fluids, flashing fluids and out-gassing by throttling, and that noise-prediction methods for these cases are not yet well established.

facts.statement: Emerson/Fisher Control Valve Handbook은 hunting을 외부 자극이 사라진 뒤에도 지속되는 유의한 진동으로 설명하고 안정한계 부근 운전을 나타낼 수 있다고 한다. 제어밸브에서는 control system 또는 positioner 불안정이 actuator loading pressure 진동으로 나타날 수 있다. 이는 가능한 원인 설명이며 모든 현장 hunting 원인을 확정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, 6th edition, Chapter 2: Control Valve Performance
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 2, Hunting subsection
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines hunting as significant oscillation continuing after external excitation is removed; says it can indicate operation near stability limit; states control-system or valve-positioner instability can produce actuator loading-pressure oscillation. The source does not substantiate the original exhaustive list of booster gain, feedback noise, linkage looseness and pneumatic compressibility as universal causes.

facts.statement: ISO는 collaborative robotics를 특정 robot type이나 brand보다 사람과 robot system이 공유 작업공간에서 상호작용하는 application 개념으로 설명한다. 협동 application의 안전은 robot 단품만으로 판정할 수 없으며 task, end-effector와 workpiece, payload, robot speed/moving mass, speed·force 관련 safety functions, workspace 및 safeguards를 포함해 application별 hazard/risk assessment를 해야 한다. ‘collaborative’라는 제품 표기만으로 실제 application의 안전이 보장되지는 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: ISO/TS 15066:2016, Robots and robotic devices — Collaborative robots; ISO news overview
verification_refs.edition_or_version: ISO/TS 15066:2016, confirmed current in 2022; overview accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: ISO overview, collaborative robotics definition and application scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISO describes collaborative robotics as automatically operated robot systems sharing workspace with humans and states this is a system/application, not a specific robot type or brand.

verification_refs.citation: ISO 10218-2:2025, Robotics — Safety requirements — Part 2: Industrial robot applications and robot cells
verification_refs.locator: Scope and standard description
verification_refs.supports_claim: The current standard addresses integration, commissioning, operation, maintenance and decommissioning of industrial robot applications and robot cells, including integration of machines and components.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. OSHA Technical Manual, Section IV, Chapter 4: Industrial Robots and Robot System Safety
verification_refs.locator: Collaborative Robot Application Risk Reduction and End-effectors
verification_refs.supports_claim: OSHA guidance calls for comprehensive hazard analysis and risk assessment for each collaborative application; describes end-effectors/workpieces as hazard sources; and states that robot moving mass/speed and end-effector/workpiece payload are used in assessing contact-event speed, while speed/force/position/momentum limiting are safety functions.

facts.statement: OSHA의 산업용 로봇 자료는 robot system에 manipulator, controller, end-effector, sensors, power sources와 communication/sequencing interface가 포함될 수 있다고 설명한다. 주변 conveyor·process equipment 등과 workpiece·safeguards까지 결합하면 industrial robot application/cell의 범위가 된다. ISO 10218-2:2025 역시 robot 단품이 아니라 industrial robot application 및 cell의 통합·운전·정비 등을 다룬다. 따라서 robot, robot system, integrated application/cell의 경계를 구분해 위험을 평가해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: U.S. OSHA Technical Manual, Section IV, Chapter 4: Industrial Robots and Robot System Safety
verification_refs.locator: Introduction; Basic Components of Industrial Robot Systems; Glossary
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies manipulator, controller, teach pendant, end-effector, control programs, power sources, sensors and communication interfaces as robot-system components; explains that conveyors/process equipment and other machines integrate into robot applications and defines applications to include robot system, end-effector, workpiece and safeguards.

verification_refs.citation: ISO 10218-2:2025, Robotics — Safety requirements — Part 2: Industrial robot applications and robot cells
verification_refs.locator: Scope and description
verification_refs.supports_claim: The current standard concerns integration and lifecycle safety of industrial robot applications and cells, including integration of machines and components.

facts.statement: Sensor fusion of measurements taken at different times requires temporal association based on their acquisition timestamps. Exact matching, approximate timestamp matching or other time-alignment methods are implementation choices; asynchronous sensors can have different sample rates, and transport latency/clock synchronization should be handled if they make temporal error significant for the application dynamics. No universal sensor frequency or time tolerance is prescribed by these sources.

verification_refs.citation: ROS 2 message_filters documentation, TimeSynchronizer and synchronization policies
verification_refs.locator: TimeSynchronizer / ApproximateTime policy documentation
verification_refs.supports_claim: Documents timestamp-based matching, exact and approximate synchronization approaches, and queueing behavior for messages awaiting timestamp matches.

verification_refs.citation: NIST Technical Note 2258, Design and Implementation of a Closed-Loop Mobile Manipulator Control System
verification_refs.locator: Sensor fusion discussion / cited multi-sensor example
verification_refs.supports_claim: Discusses fusion of an IMU at 500 Hz and optical tracking at 30–240 Hz using an Extended Kalman Filter, evidencing different sensor rates in a robot application.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Sharing a Common Sense of Time
verification_refs.locator: Abstract
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that distributed measurement/control components sharing common time can decouple synchronization concerns from communication latency and fluctuation.

facts.statement: 아날로그 측정 신호체인의 성능을 평가할 때에는 실제 구성에 존재하는 센서·아날로그 단계·reference·ADC 등의 관련 오차와 잡음 기여를 식별하고, 회로 전달관계에 따라 공통 기준점(입력 또는 출력)으로 환산·결합해 전체 성능 요구와 비교한다. 보정·보상·신호처리로 줄일 수 있는 항목과 잔류 불확도는 신호체인 구조와 적용 조건에 따라 구분한다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Practical Input-Referred Calculations in Precision Systems
verification_refs.locator: Noise, Errors, and Referring to Input; Combining Noise Sources RTI and RTO
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that each analog stage from sensor through ADC contributes noise and errors, that these contributions are tallied for top-level performance, and that noise sources must be referred to the same point before combination. It also describes calibration, compensation and signal processing as reducing some errors while residual uncertainty remains.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, AN-1464: Calibration of AD717x/AD712x Precision ADCs
verification_refs.locator: System Offset Error and Gain Error Calibrations; When To Perform Calibrations
verification_refs.supports_claim: Shows that system calibration can include external circuitry together with ADC internal error, while calibration applicability and frequency depend on device and application conditions.

facts.statement: 아날로그 계측에서 예상과 다른 오프셋 또는 잡음이 보이면 원인을 곧바로 특정 오차로 단정하지 않는다. DAQ 입력 단자의 실제 신호를 독립 계측기로 확인하고, 입력 설정·배선·센서·샘플링 조건 및 교정 상태를 점검해 신호원과 계측 경로의 문제를 단계적으로 분리한다. 구체적인 점검 항목과 허용 기준은 장치와 측정 조건에 따른다.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Troubleshooting Offset, Incorrect, and Noisy Readings of NI Multifunction DAQ Devices
verification_refs.locator: First Steps; Troubleshooting Offset Readings; Troubleshooting Incorrect and Noisy Readings
verification_refs.supports_claim: Recommends independently verifying signal behavior at DAQ input terminals, checking calibration and hardware settings, and investigating wiring/input mode, sampling/aliasing, range and sensor condition for noisy or incorrect readings. The guidance is device-specific, so this Fact retains a conditional scope.

verification_refs.citation: National Instruments, Diagnosing & Reducing Measurement Noise in Analog Signals
verification_refs.locator: Sources of DC-Coupled Noise; Summary
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that apparent offsets/noise can arise from measurement setup and coupling paths, and recommends systematic inspection rather than assuming a single cause. Its examples are acquisition-setup guidance, not universal acceptance limits.

facts.statement: 측정시스템을 특성화하거나 요구사항 적합성을 확인할 때에는 표준값과 지시값을 비교하고, 적용되는 영향량·운전조건과 분해능·반복성을 함께 고려해야 한다. 보정·개선 후 잔류 성능의 검증 범위와 측정불확도 기록 방식은 시스템의 용도와 적용 기준에 맞춰 정한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Traceability Considerations for the Characterization and Use of Measuring Systems
verification_refs.locator: Abstract
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes measurement-system characterization methods including calibration, adjustment and verification; common elements include comparison of indications with measurement standards, specification of influence quantities and operating conditions, and statements of resolution and repeatability. It notes uncertainty treatment varies with characterization type.

verification_refs.citation: NIST OSAC Lexicon, Verification (ISO/IEC Guide 99:2007, 2.44) definition
verification_refs.locator: Verification definition and Notes 1–5
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines verification as objective evidence that specified requirements are fulfilled, including confirmation of measuring-system performance or target uncertainty; notes measurement uncertainty should be considered when applicable and distinguishes verification from calibration.

facts.statement: 아날로그 측정 신호체인의 오차·잡음 대책은 확인된 기여항목과 회로 구조에 맞춰 선택한다. Calibration·compensation·signal processing은 일부 오차를 줄일 수 있지만 모든 오차를 제거하지는 않으며, 잔류 성분은 전체 성능·불확도 평가에 포함한다. 하나의 보편적인 대책 순서를 가정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Analog Devices, Practical Input-Referred Calculations in Precision Systems
verification_refs.locator: Noise, Errors, and Referring to Input; §§ Combining Noise Sources RTI and RTO; Conclusion
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that component contributions across the actual sensor-to-ADC chain are tallied for top-level performance; calibration, compensation and signal processing can reduce some error/noise, while remaining contributions create measurement uncertainty. It does not prescribe a universal mitigation order.

facts.statement: Control valve seating force와 travel은 valve·trim 제조사 지침에 맞춰 조정한다. Fisher HP/HPA의 지정 C-seal·bore-seal trim에서는 seat ring 접촉을 위한 초기 seating force가 seal 저항을 이겨야 하며, overtravel은 actuator seat load를 줄여 shutoff에 영향을 주거나 trim damage를 일으킬 수 있다. 이 사례를 모든 trim의 보편적인 force limit로 일반화하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 8: Installation and Maintenance
verification_refs.locator: §8.5.6 Valve Travel; Figure 8.10 Bench Set Seating Force
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that proper travel is essential; overtravel can reduce actuator seat load, affect shutoff and cause trim damage.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, HP and HPA Valves Instruction Manual D101634X012, August 2024
verification_refs.locator: §3.7–3.9, pp. 42 and 46–49; C-seal and bore-seal trim seating instructions
verification_refs.supports_claim: For specified C-seal and bore-seal HP/HPA constructions, requires initial seating force sufficient to overcome seal resistance and contact the seat ring, and identifies the manufacturer-calculated full-load actuator force for that procedure; this is model/trim-specific guidance.

facts.statement: 밸브 정비 전후 누설시험을 비교할 때는 as-found와 as-left 결과를 구분하고, 시험유체·차압·온도·측정방법·단위와 적용 누설등급 등 시험기준의 비교 가능성을 확인한다. 조건이 다르면 누설 수치 차이만으로 정비 효과를 단정하지 않는다. 기록의 필수 항목은 적용 규격과 프로젝트 절차에 따른다.

verification_refs.citation: International Society of Automation, ISA-75 Series of Standards
verification_refs.locator: ANSI/ISA-75.27.01-2024 seat leakage test conditions and permissible leakage limits; ANSI/ISA-75.19.01-2024 hydrostatic testing scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Control-valve leakage assessments use defined test conditions and acceptance criteria. The shell-test and seat-leakage scopes differ; no vendor repair-report field list is inferred.

verification_refs.citation: Fluid Controls Institute, ANSI/FCI 70-2 Control Valve Seat Leakage information sheet
verification_refs.locator: Opening Q&A: leakage classes and comparison under defined test conditions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Leakage classes are comparative benchmarks under specified test conditions. This supports checking comparable test bases, not any mandatory manufacturer repair-report template.

verification_refs.citation: NIST IR 7383-2019, Selected Procedures for Volumetric Calibrations
verification_refs.supports_claim: Metrological practice distinguishes before-adjustment and after-adjustment results. Applying that comparison principle to valve-maintenance leakage data is an engineering inference, not a valve-specific NIST mandate.

facts.statement: Functional Safety Audit은 수명주기 활동과 관리체계가 계획대로 수행되는지 확인한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Functional safety guidance
verification_refs.locator: Functional safety / SIS; BS EN 61511 management processes
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes BS EN 61511 management processes as including planning, assessment, verification, monitoring and audit across the safety lifecycle; separately identifies Functional Safety Assessment as judging achieved functional safety and integrity.

facts.statement: Competence는 역할별 교육, 경험, 책임과 평가 근거로 관리한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Managing competence for safety-related systems, Part 1: Key guidance
verification_refs.locator: Principles 1, 5, 6 and 7; §§5.3–5.5
verification_refs.supports_claim: Links competence criteria to responsibilities and anticipated activities; distinguishes training and certificates from assessment; calls for assessment records including context, restrictions, development actions, validity and assessor, and personal development plans with training and experience.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Training and competence
verification_refs.locator: Why competence is important; Key principles 1–7
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines competence as a combination of skills, experience and knowledge; says assurance should link to responsibilities, activities and tasks, and that training is important but insufficient alone; assessment and training should be risk-appropriate and recorded.

facts.statement: MISRA는 안전 관련 소프트웨어의 코딩 지침이며 규칙 준수 여부는 정적 분석 등으로 확인한다. MISRA 자체를 동적 단위시험 도구로 분류하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: MISRA, MISRA Compliance:2020, Achieving compliance with MISRA Coding Guidelines
verification_refs.locator: §2.2 Framework; tool validation and static analysis discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Treats MISRA as coding guidelines within a documented development process, describes static analysis tools for checking guideline violations, and separately states that software modules are tested individually and together. The guidance itself is not a dynamic unit-test tool.

facts.statement: 다양한 기술·기능을 사용하는 것은 common-mode failure를 줄이는 한 수단이지만 제거를 보장하지 않는다. 복잡성 증가를 포함한 구현 trade-off를 함께 평가하고, 단순한 기술적 해법을 우선 검토한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: Safety-related systems / common mode failures
verification_refs.supports_claim: Recommends considering diverse technology and functionality as measures against common-mode failures, alongside independent utilities, separation and test procedures; it also says measures should favour simple technological solutions rather than complex ones. This supports a design trade-off and does not establish that diversity eliminates common causes or necessarily creates systematic errors.

facts.statement: Tool Qualification은 Tool 오류의 Safety 영향과 후속 단계의 오류 검출 가능성을 근거로 정한다.

verification_refs.citation: The 61508 Association / UL Solutions, IEC 61508 — Why Tool Qualification, T6A Symposium 2024
verification_refs.locator: Figure H.1 Tool Confidence Principle; Tool Impact Class and Tool Detection discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains tool confidence using potential impact on safety integrity and mitigation through tool detection measures; distinguishes tools that can introduce errors into a safety function from tools that detect errors and may fail to detect them. This supports the stated decision basis, not a universal qualification procedure.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61508-3:2010, Software requirements
verification_refs.locator: Scope and abstract; requirements for support tools used to develop and configure safety-related systems
verification_refs.supports_claim: Confirms IEC 61508-3 applies requirements to development and configuration support tools and grades software lifecycle measures against required systematic capability; detailed applicability must use the governing edition and tool use case.

facts.statement: 인증 제품은 인증 범위, Systematic Capability, Architecture 조건과 Safety Manual 제한을 만족할 때만 증거가 된다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: Safety integrity levels; proprietary subsystem SIL claims and architectural constraints
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that proprietary subsystem SIL claims should be associated with proof-test intervals, diagnostic coverage and fault-tolerance criteria, may assist architectural-constraint evaluation, and do not remove the need to confirm that the required integrity of the complete safety function has been achieved.

verification_refs.citation: The 61508 Association, T6A033 — Functional Safety Certificates and Safety Manuals
verification_refs.locator: Certificate review checklist, items 4–8
verification_refs.supports_claim: Advises checking applicable functional-safety standards, covered safety functions/features, alignment of certificate scope and limitations with application requirements, and linkage to the element safety manual.

facts.statement: Safety Manual의 가정, 사용조건, Diagnostic, Proof Test 및 제한사항은 SIF 설계에 반영해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Functional Safety Inspection Guide
verification_refs.locator: Appendix 6, SIS Operation & Maintenance, Proof Testing and success criteria
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that safety manuals identify potential undetected hardware failures and test methods needed to achieve stated reliability/systematic capability; proof-test procedures should incorporate manufacturer safety-manual requirements, account for installation-specific failures, and use intervals included in SRS/SIL verification.

facts.statement: Proven in Use는 식별된 Version, 대표성 있는 환경, 충분한 운전이력과 결함기록을 요구한다.

verification_refs.citation: The 61508 Association, CASS Guide 508-SW, IEC 61508-3 Software, TOE 20: Proven in Use Arguments for Pre-existing Software Elements
verification_refs.locator: TOE 20, §Guideline and Assessment Requirements
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires defined element scope, comprehensive software configuration-management records, auditable evidence of field copies/operating hours, a similar expected operational profile, fault-report database and justified fault history; differing profiles/releases require explicit analysis.

verification_refs.citation: IEC TS 61508-3-1:2016, Reuse of pre-existing software elements to implement all or part of a safety function
verification_refs.locator: Scope and abstract
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies a specific IEC technical specification for demonstrating proven-in-use claims for pre-existing software elements used in safety functions; it does not make prior operating experience alone sufficient.

facts.statement: PFD 근사 계산은 Demand Mode, 진단, Proof Test, Repair, 공통원인과 독립성 가정을 명시한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: Integrity levels; proof testing; diagnostic interval and repair
verification_refs.supports_claim: Distinguishes low-demand probability of failure on demand from high/continuous-mode failure rate; describes dependence on proof-test frequency and detection capability, diagnostic check frequency, and mean time to repair.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: Common mode failures and system independence
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies diverse technology/functionality, independent utilities, maintenance and test procedures, and physical separation as measures to consider against common-mode failures; therefore independence and common-cause assumptions require explicit treatment rather than silent omission.

facts.statement: 단위시험(Unit Testing)은 소프트웨어 모듈의 요구사항 대비 결함을 검출하는 검증 활동이며, 확률적 고장률·PFDavg·PFH로 평가하는 Random Hardware Integrity를 입증하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: MISRA, MISRA Compliance:2020, Achieving compliance with MISRA Coding Guidelines
verification_refs.locator: §2.2 Framework
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes object modules being tested individually and together to identify software errors as a development activity; it does not claim this is a random hardware failure-rate or SIF PFD/PFH calculation.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: SIL guidance; software and hardware measures; reliability model of system architecture
verification_refs.supports_claim: Separately discusses reliability modelling and hardware architectural constraints, software methods/lifecycle measures for systematic integrity, and quantitative low-demand/high-demand failure measures; these are distinct from a software module test result.

facts.statement: V-Model은 요구사항과 단위·통합·시스템 시험의 대응을 조직하는 검증 구조이지만, 적용 자체만으로 SIF의 목표 SIL 달성을 보장하지 않는다. SIL 달성에는 전체 SIF의 설계·검증·운영 증거가 필요하다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61508-3:2010, Software requirements
verification_refs.locator: Scope and abstract; software safety lifecycle and verification requirements
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines software safety lifecycle activities and graded methods to control systematic software faults; lifecycle compliance is a set of software safety measures, not a standalone demonstration of complete SIF SIL.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: SIL guidance; reliability model and verification of required risk reduction
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that the system architecture is modelled and reliability predicted against the target SIL to confirm required risk reduction, and that achieving integrity must be demonstrated across design, installation, operation and maintenance; it also says subsystem SIL claims do not eliminate confirmation of integrity for the safety function.
