facts.statement: Siemens Safety Integrated의 재사용 F-block은 시험·승인된 block signature와 사용 instruction version을 기록하고, 재사용 시 일치 여부를 확인한다. 기록된 instruction version이 달라지면 기능 차이를 검토하고 block을 재시험·재승인한다. 이 절차를 모든 제조사 library의 보편 규칙으로 확대하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Siemens, Commissioning Manual Safety Integrated (with SINAMICS S120), A5E46305916B AD
verification_refs.locator: §4.9 Using libraries, pp. 96 onward
verification_refs.supports_claim: For reusing previously tested and accepted fail-safe blocks, directs recording the compiled/tested block signature and system library instruction versions; on reuse, signatures and versions are checked. If instruction versions differ, the differences are identified and the block is retested and accepted. This is Siemens-specific guidance.

facts.statement: Leakage class, test procedure와 emission qualification은 적용 standard, edition, amendment와 purchaser requirement를 exact citation으로 확인한다.

verification_refs.citation: Fluid Controls Institute, Control Valve Standards catalogue, ANSI/FCI 70-2-2021
verification_refs.locator: Control Valves standards list
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies ANSI/FCI 70-2-2021 as the control-valve seat-leakage testing standard, demonstrating why a contract should identify the applicable edition rather than rely only on an unqualified class label.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-4:2021, Industrial-process control valves — Part 4: Inspection and routine testing
verification_refs.locator: Scope and publication details
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines the scope and edition of IEC 60534-4 inspection/routine testing requirements for control valves; it is separate from ANSI/FCI 70-2 and its applicable scope must be identified.

verification_refs.citation: ISO 15848-1:2015 and ISO 15848-2:2015, Industrial valves — Measurement, test and qualification procedures for fugitive emissions
verification_refs.locator: Part 1 type-testing and Part 2 production-acceptance test catalogue entries and current-status records
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies separate fugitive-emission type-test and production-acceptance scopes for external leakage at valve stem/shaft seals and body joints, distinct from control-valve seat-leakage class testing. Current status and applicable amendment are verified against ISO's live catalogue.

facts.statement: Vendor datasheet, quotation guarantee, purchase specification와 acceptance test procedure의 class, medium, pressure, unit와 direction을 일치시킨다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-4:2021, Industrial-process control valves — Part 4: Inspection and routine testing
verification_refs.locator: Scope and seat-leakage test requirements; table fields previewed in IEC publication sample
verification_refs.supports_claim: The standard specifies leakage-class test media, test procedure and maximum seat leakage; purchaser-defined service differential pressure may determine the test basis in specified procedure. Thus the contractual acceptance documents need a consistent, explicitly agreed basis.

verification_refs.citation: Fluid Controls Institute, ANSI/FCI 70-2 informational sheet
verification_refs.locator: Purpose and importance of ANSI/FCI 70-2
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that the standard defines maximum allowable seat leakage under defined test conditions and that during valve specification the user selects benchmarks suitable for the application; the manufacturer uses a specific test procedure to demonstrate conformance.

verification_refs.citation: ISO 15848-2:2015, Industrial valves — Measurement, test and qualification procedures for fugitive emissions — Part 2: Production acceptance test of valves
verification_refs.locator: Scope and abstract
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines production acceptance testing for external leakage at valve stems/shafts and body joints, demonstrating that this external-emission acceptance is distinct from seat-leakage acceptance.

facts.statement: ISO 23247의 제조 맥락에서 digital twin instance는 observable manufacturing element의 fit-for-purpose digital representation이며 physical element와 digital representation 간 synchronization을 제공한다. 이는 제조 분야 표준의 정의다. NIST는 여러 분야에서 단일 통일 digital-twin 정의가 없다고 설명하므로, 이 정의와 목적·수명주기 요소를 모든 분야의 보편 요건으로 확대하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: ISO 23247-1:2021, Automation systems and integration — Digital twin framework for manufacturing — Part 1: Overview and general principles
verification_refs.locator: Scope and terms/definitions; definition excerpt cross-referenced in ISO publications
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines the framework specifically for manufacturing. The ISO 23247 definition describes a fit-for-purpose digital representation of an observable manufacturing element with synchronization at an appropriate rate.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Digital Twins: Definitions and State of the Art
verification_refs.locator: Introduction
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that a single unified digital-twin definition is lacking across industries and research fields, and notes real-time bidirectional exchange and lifecycle connection as characteristics emphasized by some approaches rather than a universal definition.

verification_refs.citation: ISO, Smart Manufacturing White Papers, digital twin definitions from ISO 23247 and related standards
verification_refs.locator: Annex A, Robotics/Smart manufacturing definitions excerpt
verification_refs.supports_claim: Reproduces the ISO 23247 manufacturing digital-twin definition as fit-for-purpose digital representation of an observable manufacturing element, synchronized at an appropriate rate; adjacent entries show other standards formulate related definitions differently.

facts.statement: FTA는 정의된 Top Event에서 시작하여 AND/OR Gate로 원인 고장조합을 하향 전개하는 실패논리 모델이다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA NPR 8621.1, Appendix I-3.5 Fault Tree Analysis
verification_refs.locator: §1.1 Method, lines 19-32
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines FTA as analysis of an undesirable end event and potential causes, describes it as top-down, requires definition of the top event, and connects contributors through Boolean logic gates.

facts.statement: Minimal Cut Set은 Top Event를 발생시키는 최소 기본사건 조합이다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA, Fault Tree Handbook with Aerospace Applications, Version 1.1
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines a cut set as basic events that result in the top event and a minimal cut set as the smallest such combination; removing any event means that combination no longer causes the top event.

facts.statement: PFDavg와 PFH의 선택은 SIF의 demand mode 정의에 근거해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: Demand mode definitions and failure likelihood metrics, lines 109-110
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines low demand as occasional demand and high demand/continuous modes separately; says low-demand likelihood is expressed as probability of failure on demand, while high/continuous demand is expressed as failure rate per hour.

facts.statement: 저수요 SIF의 정량 목표는 일반적으로 평균 요구시 실패확률인 PFDavg로 표현한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: Demand mode definitions and failure likelihood metrics, lines 109-110
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that the likelihood of failure for a low-demand system is expressed as probability of failure on demand; average PFD is the corresponding integrity measure over the relevant test interval.

facts.statement: 고수요 또는 연속수요 SIF의 정량 목표는 일반적으로 시간당 위험고장 빈도 지표인 PFH로 표현한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: Demand mode definitions and failure likelihood metrics, lines 109-110
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that high-demand and continuous-mode safety-related systems are characterized by dangerous failure rate per hour, the PFH metric family.

facts.statement: 단순 저수요 1oo1 근사에서 검출되지 않은 일정 위험고장률과 완전 Proof Test를 가정하면 PFDavg는 위험고장률과 시험주기에 비례한다.

verification_refs.citation: First-order derivation from the constant-rate exponential failure model
verification_refs.locator: For constant λDU and full periodic test interval T, q(t)=1−exp(−λDU·t); PFDavg=(1/T)∫₀ᵀq(t)dt=1−(1−exp(−λDU·T))/(λDU·T)≈λDU·T/2 when λDU·T≪1
verification_refs.supports_claim: The integral yields a first-order term λDU·T/2, proving proportionality to the dangerous undetected failure rate and proof-test interval only under the stated rare-event, constant-rate, full-test reset assumptions. This does not validate the approximation for architectures or conditions that violate those assumptions.

facts.statement: Diagnostic Coverage는 위험고장 중 자동 진단으로 검출되는 비율과 관련되며 Proof Test Coverage와 동일하지 않다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, OG-00054 Appendix 1: Process for Defining SIS Proof Testing Requirements
verification_refs.locator: §20 Diagnostic Functions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explicitly distinguishes diagnostic coverage, which detects dangerous failures within the assumed MTTR, from proof testing, which reveals undetected dangerous failures at the defined proof-test interval.

facts.statement: Proof Test는 Online Diagnostics가 검출하지 못한 잠복 위험고장을 발견하기 위해 수행한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, OG-00054 Appendix 1: Process for Defining SIS Proof Testing Requirements
verification_refs.locator: §20 Diagnostic Functions; §§13-16 failure-mode identification
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that proof testing reveals dangerous failures left undetected by online diagnostics and advises procedures to record the methods used to reveal identified undetected dangerous failure modes.

facts.statement: Proof Test Interval이 길어지면 잠복 위험고장의 평균 노출시간이 증가할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: System integrity, lines 165-167
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE states that where diagnostic coverage is low, integrity is critically dependent on proof-test interval. Under the stated constant-rate latent-failure model, the average undetected exposure time is T/2, so a longer interval increases that exposure; the claim is conditional and not a universal PFD result for every architecture.

facts.statement: Partial Proof Test 또는 PST는 전체 위험고장모드를 검출하지 못하므로 Coverage와 잔여고장을 명시해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, OG-00054 Appendix 1 and Appendix 3
verification_refs.locator: Appendix 1 §§35-40; Appendix 3 partial-proof-test example
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE says partial testing may be used when some dangerous failure modes cannot be revealed by the partial procedure; it requires identifying which modes each interval tests, retaining the remaining contribution in PFD calculations, and ensuring all undetected dangerous modes are eventually revealed.

facts.statement: RBD는 시스템이 성공하기 위한 기능경로를 직렬·병렬 블록으로 표현하는 성공논리 모델이다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA, System Engineering Tools and Techniques
verification_refs.locator: §3.8 Reliability Block Diagrams, pp. 3-30 to 3-31
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes RBD as illustrating system reliability and component success/failure relationships; presents series and parallel success structures and cautions that complex systems may require more complex diagrams.

facts.statement: 직렬 성공경로는 구성요소 하나의 실패가 기능실패로 이어지며, 병렬 성공경로는 요구된 성공조건을 만족하는 대체경로를 가진다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA, System Engineering Tools and Techniques
verification_refs.locator: §3.8 Reliability Block Diagrams, series and parallel system relations
verification_refs.supports_claim: Gives the series-system reliability as the product of component reliabilities and parallel-system reliability as one minus the product of component unreliabilities, under stated independence assumptions; these relations encode the series and alternative success-path meanings.

facts.statement: Markov model은 분석할 시스템의 상태와 상태 간 전이확률 또는 전이율을 정의해 상태확률의 변화를 모델링한다. 상태 집합은 분석 경계와 운전·고장거동에 맞춰 정하며, SIS 모델에서는 필요한 경우 정상/운전, 고장·검출, 수리, proof-test, bypass 또는 degraded 상태를 포함할 수 있다. 모든 모델에 공통인 고정 상태 목록이나 반드시 시간변화 전이율을 써야 한다는 뜻은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA/CR-1998-207660, Reliability Modeling Method
verification_refs.locator: Markov Modeling and §4.2 single-component model
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines reliability Markov modeling as probabilities over system states evolving over time, with transitions and rates representing failure, repair, and redundancy-management behavior; the model's state vector and transition equations are explicitly constructed for the system.

verification_refs.citation: Modelling framework for performance analysis of SIS subject to degradation due to proof tests, Reliability Engineering & System Safety
verification_refs.locator: Abstract and model description
verification_refs.supports_claim: Presents an SIS-specific multiphase Markov framework with degraded states associated with proof-test-related degradation, supporting the use of relevant test/degraded states without implying a universal fixed state list.

facts.statement: Markov 신뢰도 모델은 구성요소 상태와 상호작용을 포함해 상태공간이 커지면 상태·전이 분석의 계산 및 검증 부담이 증가할 수 있다. 증가 정도는 모델 구조와 분석기법에 따라 달라진다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA, Techniques for Modeling the Reliability of Fault-Tolerant Systems with the Markov State-Space Approach, NASA-RP-1348
verification_refs.locator: State-space modeling method and model construction
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes enumerating system states and transitions for reliability models; increased component state combinations expand the state-space that must be represented and analyzed.

verification_refs.citation: Reliability effects of test strategies on safety-instrumented systems in different demand modes
verification_refs.locator: Abstract and comparison of Markov and Petri-net modeling
verification_refs.supports_claim: Discusses state explosion as a frequent issue for Markov methods as state counts increase; this supports only the qualified possibility of increased burden, not the former universal claim of rapid increase.

facts.statement: CCF는 중복 채널을 동시에 무력화하여 독립고장 가정의 이점을 감소시킨다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: Protection against common-mode failures and independence
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires common-mode failure to be considered when systems share utilities, environment, interfaces, or management arrangements, and recommends independence/diversity measures; this means redundant-channel benefits cannot be assumed from independent failures when common causes remain.

facts.statement: 물리적 분리, 독립 전원·배관·환경, 다양성, 독립 교정·정비 절차는 CCF 저감 근거가 될 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: Common-mode failure measures and independence
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists diverse technology/functionality, independent utilities and maintenance/test procedures, and physical separation as measures to consider against common-mode failures; the claim says these can be mitigation grounds, not guarantees.

facts.statement: RBD, FTA와 Markov Model은 표현 관점과 가정이 다르며 하나를 다른 하나와 동일하게 취급하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA, System Engineering Tools and Techniques
verification_refs.locator: §3.8 Reliability Block Diagrams
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes RBD as system success/reliability block logic.

verification_refs.citation: NASA NPR 8621.1, Appendix I-3.5 Fault Tree Analysis
verification_refs.locator: §1.1 Method
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes top-down FTA using Boolean failure logic to decompose an undesirable top event.

verification_refs.citation: NASA/CR-1998-207660, Reliability Modeling Method
verification_refs.locator: Markov modeling section
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes Markov reliability models as system states and transitions with time-dependent state probabilities.

facts.statement: RRF는 정의된 조건에서 위험 감소 요구를 나타내며 저수요 모드에서는 PFDavg의 역수 관계로 설명할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Functional Safety Inspection Guide
verification_refs.locator: SIL bands and Table 3; RRF defined as PFDavg⁻¹
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explicitly defines RRF as the inverse of PFDavg in the guide's low-demand SIL bands; this relation is not generalized to unrelated risk-layer or high-demand metrics.

facts.statement: Voting 구조와 HFT는 SIL 달성의 한 요소이며 단독으로 SIL을 보장하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: System integrity and SIL verification, lines 162-168
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes subsystem fault tolerance and diagnostic coverage as architectural guidance, while separately requiring system reliability modeling against target SIL and confirmation that the complete safety function achieves its required integrity.

facts.statement: 전체 SIF의 정량 평가는 Sensor, Logic Solver, Final Element와 필요한 Utility·Interface의 기여를 포함한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: Safety function elements, lines 106-110
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that all elements required to perform the safety function, including utilities, are safety-related and should be considered part of the safety-related system; HSE functional-safety overview identifies sensors, logic functions, and final elements.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Functional safety
verification_refs.locator: SIS overview
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes SIS as typically including sensors, logic functions, and final elements such as valves.

facts.statement: 개별 구성요소 인증은 전체 SIF의 Achieved SIL을 자동 결정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: System integrity and subsystem SIL claims, lines 164-168
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that quoted SIL levels for proprietary subsystems are useful for architectural evaluation but do not eliminate the need to confirm the required safety integrity of the safety function provided by the complete system.

facts.statement: 정량 하드웨어 무결성 계산은 체계적 무결성, 소프트웨어 V&V, 형상관리와 독립성 증거를 대체하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: Protection against random and systematic/common-mode failures; system integrity, lines 144, 162-168
verification_refs.supports_claim: Separates random-failure protections from systematic/common-mode protections and requires software methods and lifecycle measures; integrity must be demonstrated through design, installation, operation, and maintenance rather than by a random-hardware calculation alone.

facts.statement: β-factor 모델은 전체 위험고장률 중 공통원인 기여분을 단순화해 분리하는 대표 모델이다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA/SP-2011-3421, Probabilistic Risk Assessment Procedures Guide for NASA Managers and Practitioners
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes beta factor as one of the simplest CCF models, defines total component failure frequency as independent plus common-cause frequency, and defines β as the common-cause fraction of the total rate. The guidance also discusses other, more detailed models, so this is not asserted as universal.

facts.statement: PFDavg 근사식은 일정 고장률, 독립성, 시험 복구, 수리와 진단 조건을 명시해야 하며 모든 구조에 그대로 적용하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: System integrity and SIL verification, lines 164-168; proof testing and repair, lines 316-339
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires a reliability model of the system architecture and comparison with target integrity; identifies proof-test interval, diagnostic coverage, diagnostic frequency and mean time to repair as material to integrity. Thus a simplified formula must state applicable assumptions and cannot be transferred unchanged across architectures.

facts.statement: 정량 SIS 신뢰도 결과에는 모델 경계·수요모드와 적용한 입력·가정을 재현할 수 있도록 기록한다. 해당 모델에 사용한 고장자료 출처 및 적용환경, 진단/coverage, proof-test 주기·coverage, 수리 가용성·시간, CCF, bypass/override 및 근사·제외조건을 포함하되, 관련 없는 항목은 무조건 계산요소로 요구하지 말고 미모델링·제외 여부를 명시한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: System architecture model and SIL confirmation, lines 164-168; diagnostics/proof testing/repair, lines 316-339; overrides, lines 324-328
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires modeling the system architecture and comparing predicted reliability to the target; identifies test intervals, diagnostic coverage/frequency, repair time, and override management as relevant. The anchor limits the list to items applicable to a selected model and calls for omitted effects to be identified rather than universally included.

facts.statement: 구조적 커버리지 분석은 Requirement–Design–Code–Test–Result 추적 후 Coverage Report를 확인하고 미달 항목의 원인을 분석하여 시험 추가, 요구사항 보완, 코드 제거 또는 정당화로 종결한다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-189, Code Coverage Measurements
verification_refs.locator: §7.4 guidance; §8 objective evidence
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires selecting, tracking, recording, and reporting coverage measurements; the guidance analyzes uncovered code, identifies missing tests or requirements, and documents risk analysis/rationale for uncovered code. The anchor's exact requirement-to-result trace chain is a workflow synthesis, not a verbatim NASA-mandated sequence.

facts.statement: 미실행 코드가 발견되면 누락 시험, 누락 요구사항, 잘못된 방어코드, Dead Code, Deactivated Code 또는 도구·계측 한계 중 원인을 분류하고 승인된 처분과 재시험 증거를 남겨야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-189, Code Coverage Measurements
verification_refs.locator: §7.2 software assurance products; §8 objective evidence
verification_refs.supports_claim: Calls for risk analysis and rationale for uncovered code, classification of extraneous/deactivated/untestable code, and documentation of whether uncovered code is acceptable. This is lifecycle guidance; the applicable project's approval authority and standard govern formal approval.

facts.statement: 정적분석은 프로그램을 실행하지 않고 Control Flow, Data Flow, 복잡도, Coding Rule과 잠재적 도달불가 코드를 찾으며 MC/DC 실행 증거를 직접 대체하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA NPR 7150.2D, Appendix C, Requirement 4.4.4
verification_refs.locator: Appendix C, Req. 4.4.4
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies static analysis tools as analysis performed during development and testing for defects, security, code coverage, and complexity; NASA SWE-190 separately defines coverage verification through analysis of test execution results. The distinction is based on those separate evidence mechanisms, not a claim that static tools can never report any coverage-related property.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-190, Verify Code Coverage
verification_refs.locator: §7.1 software assurance tasking
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines code coverage verification as analysis of test execution results and assessment of uncovered code; complements the NPR static-analysis description.

facts.statement: 1oo1, 1oo2, 2oo2, 2oo3 등 Voting Architecture는 요구 성공조건에 따라 위험고장과 Spurious Trip 특성이 달라진다.

verification_refs.citation: UK Health and Safety Executive, Control systems: technical measures guidance
verification_refs.locator: Protection systems; logic systems; random failure protection
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that logic-system architecture is determined by hardware fault-tolerance requirements, redundancy protects against random failure, and diagnostics/voting can change handling of a faulty element. It supports architecture dependence but does not prescribe a universal voting choice.

verification_refs.citation: ISA, Essentials of Modern Measurements and Final Elements, Chapter 1
verification_refs.locator: §1.5, voting architectures
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that 1oo2 can improve protection against a dangerous sensor failure while increasing false/spurious trip susceptibility, and that 2oo3 is sometimes used to balance these effects. This supports a conditional trade-off, not a quantitative guarantee or universal ranking.

facts.statement: Dead Code는 어떤 정상 구성과 허용 입력에서도 실행될 수 없고 요구 기능도 수행하지 않는 코드이므로 원칙적으로 제거하고 영향분석과 회귀시험을 수행해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-189, Code Coverage Measurements
verification_refs.locator: §7.2, uncovered code classification and extraneous/dead code
verification_refs.supports_claim: Distinguishes extraneous/dead code from deactivated code intended for another configuration and recommends analysis, refactoring/removal of extraneous code, or documented risk rationale where full coverage is not achieved.

facts.statement: Compiler 최적화, 자동 생성코드 또는 Source와 Object 간 구조 차이가 안전 관련 동작을 추가하거나 제거할 수 있으면 적용 표준과 계획에 따라 Object Code Coverage 또는 등가 분석이 필요할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: FAA DOT/FAA/AR-02/113, Issues Concerning the Structural Coverage of Object-Oriented Software
verification_refs.locator: §2.4.2, Tool Issues
verification_refs.supports_claim: Discusses compiler/linker-generated object code and explains that source-level coverage may not reveal additional object-level functionality; object-code coverage/equivalence analysis is a standard-dependent structural-coverage issue, not a universal requirement for every application.

verification_refs.citation: FAA Advisory Circular AC 20-115D
verification_refs.locator: §2, recognized ED-12C/DO-178C
verification_refs.supports_claim: Recognizes DO-178C as an acceptable means for airborne software assurance; the anchor correctly leaves the detailed source/object treatment to the applicable standard and project plan.

facts.statement: Coverage Tool 오류가 미실행 코드를 실행된 것으로 잘못 보고하고 그 결과를 독립적으로 검출하지 못할 수 있으면 Tool Qualification, 검증 또는 독립 확인 수준을 정해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: FAA Advisory Circular AC 20-115D, Airborne Software Development Assurance Using ED-12/DO-178
verification_refs.locator: §2, DO-330 recognition and Table 2
verification_refs.supports_claim: Directs the airborne certification applicant to use the software level, tool use, and potential life-cycle impact to determine Tool Qualification Level and applicable DO-330 objectives; this supports scoped qualification rather than blanket qualification of every tool.

verification_refs.citation: FAA DOT/FAA/AR-06/54, Software Verification Tools Assessment Study
verification_refs.locator: §1, tool qualification of structural coverage analysis tools
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that coverage tools used to automate or reduce verification processes are subject to qualification when their output is not independently verified, and discusses the risk of incorrect coverage results.

facts.statement: Compiler의 Boolean 변환, 조건 병합과 최적화는 Source 수준 Test Pair와 실행 Object 구조의 대응을 바꿀 수 있으므로 Compiler Version·Option과 생성물의 추적성을 통제해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: FAA DOT/FAA/AR-02/113, Issues Concerning the Structural Coverage of Object-Oriented Software
verification_refs.locator: §2.4.2, Tool Issues
verification_refs.supports_claim: Documents compiler/linker generation of additional object-code structures and explains that coverage requirements depend on how those structures correspond to source-level constructs; the finding is scoped to the language/toolchain behavior considered and is not a claim that every optimization changes every Test Pair.

verification_refs.citation: FAA DOT/FAA/AR-06/54, Software Verification Tools Assessment Study
verification_refs.locator: §3, short-circuit compiler mapping conditions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Shows that claimed equivalence between object-code condition coverage and MC/DC depends on compiler behavior across applicable optimization levels and the expression structure; therefore source/object correspondence must be demonstrated rather than assumed.

facts.statement: Coverage Instrumentation은 실행시간, 메모리, Task Scheduling과 최적화에 영향을 줄 수 있으므로 Target 환경 대표성, Probe Effect와 결과 재현성을 평가해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA/TM-2015-218675, A Flexible and Non-intrusive Approach for Computing Complex Structural Coverage Metrics
verification_refs.locator: Abstract and §I Introduction
verification_refs.supports_claim: Reports that instrumentation-based approaches for complex structural metrics such as MC/DC can incur considerable runtime overhead and must be handled carefully to avoid changing original-code behavior. The exact memory, scheduling, and target effects depend on the specific instrumentation and target; those are kept as application assessments rather than universal measured effects.

facts.statement: Short-circuit Evaluation에서는 앞 조건의 결과에 따라 뒤 조건이 실행되지 않을 수 있으므로 실제 평가된 조건과 Instrumentation 결과를 기준으로 Test Pair를 설계해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: FAA DOT/FAA/AR-06/54, Software Verification Tools Assessment Study
verification_refs.locator: §3, Object Branch Coverage and short-circuit operations
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines short-circuit evaluation as evaluating the left operand first and not evaluating the right operand when the left result determines the Boolean result; explains that evidence of MC/DC equivalence depends on compiler flow-graph behavior and expression form. The anchor therefore correctly requires accounting for actual evaluation rather than assuming every source condition executed.

facts.statement: Coverage 시험은 가능한 한 Target Processor, Compiler, Runtime과 실제 Scheduling을 대표해야 하며 Host 시험만 사용하면 Hardware·Compiler·Timing 차이를 별도 보완해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-065, Test Plan, Procedures, Reports
verification_refs.locator: §3.3, Testing in the Target Environment
verification_refs.supports_claim: Recommends qualification/final testing on hardware closely matching the target configuration, including processor architecture, memory, timing, performance, interfaces and I/O rates; high-fidelity simulations may be used as identified.

verification_refs.citation: FAA AC 20-148, Advisory Circular for Integrated Modular Avionics
verification_refs.locator: §4, reverification questions for processor/compiler/target changes
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies processor, compiler/options, target environment, libraries, and structural coverage as reverification-impact considerations; this supports supplemental analysis when host/test and target configurations differ, within the avionics context.

facts.statement: MC/DC는 소프트웨어 수명주기 검증·확인에서 사용하는 구조적 커버리지 증거이며, 요구사항 추적성·독립성·검증·확인 활동을 대체하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-189, Code Coverage Measurements
verification_refs.locator: §3.1, code coverage definition and purpose
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines code coverage as a structural testing metric measuring source code exercised by test cases; it is a measure of test structure and does not itself establish requirement completeness.

verification_refs.citation: FAA Advisory Circular AC 20-115D
verification_refs.locator: §2 and §6, DO-178C lifecycle objectives and life-cycle data
verification_refs.supports_claim: FAA guidance recognizes DO-178C as a means of compliance requiring applicable life-cycle objectives and data; structural coverage is one verification objective and does not replace the other life-cycle objectives.

facts.statement: Defensive Code는 비정상 입력과 내부 오류를 안전하게 처리하기 위한 코드이며 해당 동작을 Derived Requirement로 명세하고 정상·오류 경로 시험과 Safe State 근거를 연결해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-134, Safety-Critical Software Design Requirements
verification_refs.locator: NPR 7150.2D SWE-134 items j-l and assurance tasks
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires safety-critical software to respond to off-nominal conditions, provide error handling, and be capable of placing the system into a safe state; software assurance assesses source code against these requirements at inspection and test-review milestones.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-192, Software Hazardous Requirements
verification_refs.locator: Hazard requirements flow-down and abnormal-scenario testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Calls for tests derived from hazardous software requirements and abnormal scenarios including invalid inputs and hardware failures, with traceability from hazard to software requirement and test result. This supports the requirement/test linkage without implying that every defensive code path has the same safe state.

facts.statement: MC/DC는 Boolean Decision의 구조를 집중 평가하므로 초기화 누락, Data Coupling, 경계값, Overflow, Timing과 Race Condition은 정적분석·Data Flow·동적시험으로 별도 보완해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-189, Code Coverage Measurements
verification_refs.locator: §3.1, definition of structural code coverage
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines coverage as a structural metric of source code exercised by tests; it does not claim to establish data integrity, arithmetic limits, timing behavior, or concurrency properties.

verification_refs.citation: FAA DOT/FAA/AR-07/19, Object-Oriented Technology Verification Phase 2 Handbook—Data Coupling and Control Coupling
verification_refs.locator: Introduction and verification criteria
verification_refs.supports_claim: Treats data coupling and control coupling as distinct verification analyses beyond structural statement/decision coverage. The exact complementary method for overflow, timing, or race conditions remains requirement- and platform-specific.

facts.statement: Boolean 식, Compiler, 생성도구, Library 또는 Configuration이 변경되면 영향받는 요구사항과 Decision의 Test Pair 및 Coverage Report를 갱신하고 회귀시험해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-066, Perform Testing
verification_refs.locator: §7.4.3, Regression Testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Calls for regression testing after software modifications and for tests to cover safety-critical functions and affected requirements; the anchor scopes retesting to change impact rather than requiring every test for every change.

verification_refs.citation: FAA AC 20-148, Advisory Circular for Integrated Modular Avionics
verification_refs.locator: §4, reverification considerations for compiler, options, target, libraries, and structural coverage
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists compiler/options, target system, runtime libraries, and structural coverage as reverification-impact questions when software or its execution environment changes; details remain subject to project certification context.

facts.statement: 양자컴퓨팅은 qubit의 양자상태와 quantum operation을 이용해 특정 계산문제를 처리하는 계산 패러다임이며 모든 문제를 보편적으로 더 빠르게 푸는 범용 가속기가 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: IBM Quantum Learning, Quantum bits, gates, and circuits
verification_refs.locator: §1 Introduction and §3.1 Quantum state and Bloch sphere
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes quantum computation with qubits and gates and represents a qubit state using complex amplitudes over the computational basis; supports the qubit-state and quantum-operation basis of the claim.

verification_refs.citation: IBM Quantum Learning, Which problems are quantum computers good for?
verification_refs.locator: Overview of problem suitability and quantum speedup
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that quantum computing is not suitable for every problem and discusses potential advantage for particular applications, supporting the explicit limitation against universal acceleration.

facts.statement: Classical bit는 측정 가능한 0 또는 1 상태를 사용하지만 qubit는 복소확률진폭으로 표현되는 양자상태를 가지며 측정 결과는 고전적 outcome으로 얻어진다.

verification_refs.citation: IBM Quantum Learning, Quantum bits, gates, and circuits
verification_refs.locator: §3.1 Quantum state and Bloch sphere; §3.3 Measurement
verification_refs.supports_claim: Represents a qubit as a normalized state with complex amplitudes for basis states and explains measurement outcomes as classical 0/1 results with probabilities determined by squared amplitude magnitudes.

facts.statement: Superposition은 여러 basis state의 amplitude가 결합된 양자상태 표현이며 계산상 유용성은 이후 gate와 interference가 원하는 outcome의 확률을 증폭하도록 구성될 때 나타난다.

verification_refs.citation: IBM Quantum Learning, Quantum Coins — a module on superposition and interference
verification_refs.locator: Introduction; Quantum coin; The quantum phase
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines superposition as a combination of possible quantum states with complex amplitudes, distinguishes it from a classical coin mixture, and explains that relative phase enables constructive or destructive interference.

facts.statement: Quantum measurement는 상태를 고전적 결과로 투영하므로 일반적으로 반복 실행과 sampling을 통해 결과 분포를 추정하며 내부 amplitude 전체를 한 번에 직접 읽을 수 없다.

verification_refs.citation: IBM Quantum Learning, Quantum bits, gates, and circuits
verification_refs.locator: §3.3 Measurement and repeated circuit shots
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that measurement projects the qubit to a basis outcome with probability set by the state amplitudes and demonstrates repeated shots to estimate outcome frequencies.

facts.statement: Quantum interference는 계산경로의 amplitude가 강화 또는 상쇄되도록 설계해 원하는 결과의 측정확률을 변화시키는 핵심 메커니즘이다.

verification_refs.citation: IBM Quantum Learning, Quantum Coins — a module on superposition and interference
verification_refs.locator: The quantum phase; double-Hadamard example
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that relative phases determine whether amplitudes add constructively or destructively and demonstrates that phase-sensitive gate sequences change measurement outcomes.

facts.statement: Gate-based quantum computing은 초기화된 qubit에 quantum gate sequence를 적용하고 측정하는 회로모델로서 범용 알고리즘 표현을 지향한다.

verification_refs.citation: IBM Quantum Learning, Quantum bits, gates, and circuits
verification_refs.locator: §1 Introduction and §2 Computation as a diagram
verification_refs.supports_claim: Introduces circuit-model quantum computation using qubits and gates, with input operations represented by gates and outputs obtained through measurement.

facts.statement: 실제 quantum hardware는 gate·readout error, decoherence 등 noise 영향을 받으므로 circuit depth와 fidelity, 반복성, error mitigation 또는 correction 요구가 적용성에 직접 영향을 준다.

verification_refs.citation: IBM Quantum Learning, Noise and errors
verification_refs.locator: Overview and characterization of quantum errors
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes gate and state-preparation/measurement error categories and quantum noise affecting circuit execution; the statement properly treats impact and mitigation requirements as workload/hardware dependent.

facts.statement: Error mitigation은 noisy result의 bias를 줄이는 기법군이고 quantum error correction은 logical information을 보호하기 위해 redundancy와 correction을 사용하는 별도 개념이므로 서로 동일시하면 안 된다.

verification_refs.citation: IBM Quantum Learning, Error mitigation
verification_refs.locator: Overview of error mitigation techniques; comparison with error correction
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines mitigation as reducing effects of errors in computations and distinguishes correction by encoding information across physical qubits and checking consistency to preserve logical information.

facts.statement: Quantum annealing은 주로 최적화 문제를 energy landscape의 낮은 상태 탐색으로 매핑하는 접근이며 gate-based quantum computing과 동일한 하드웨어·알고리즘 모델이 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: D-Wave Quantum Computing Products Documentation, What D-Wave Does
verification_refs.locator: Gate-model and quantum annealing architecture overview
verification_refs.supports_claim: Separately describes gate-model computing as gate-sequence algorithms and quantum annealing as an energy-state approach and identifies them as distinct architecture candidates.

verification_refs.citation: D-Wave Quantum Computing Products Documentation, What is Quantum Annealing?
verification_refs.locator: Quantum annealing overview and energy landscape
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that qubit biases and couplers define an energy landscape and the annealer seeks low-energy states; it notes returned states can be low-energy rather than necessarily the exact minimum.

facts.statement: DLR은 EtherNet/IP 계열 device-level ring에서 supervisor와 ring node가 beacon 또는 announce를 이용해 고장을 감지·복구하며 모든 Ethernet protocol의 범용 ring 표준으로 보아서는 안 된다.

verification_refs.citation: ODVA, Guidelines for Using Device Level Ring (DLR) with EtherNet/IP, PUB00316R2
verification_refs.locator: §2 Overview of DLR, Ring Supervisor and Beacon-/Announce-based Ring Node
verification_refs.supports_claim: ODVA defines DLR for EtherNet/IP ring topologies and describes a Ring Supervisor plus Beacon-based and Announce-based ring nodes that detect faults and reconfigure the ring; this is not a generic protocol-independent Ethernet ring claim.

facts.statement: PRP는 동일 frame을 독립된 두 LAN으로 동시에 보내고 수신 노드가 중복을 제거하여 단일 LAN 고장 시 재수렴 없이 통신을 지속하도록 설계한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 62439-3:2021, Industrial communication networks — High availability automation networks — Part 3: PRP and HSR
verification_refs.locator: Scope and protocol description
verification_refs.supports_claim: The standard specifies PRP and HSR to provide seamless switchover with zero recovery time in the event of failure of a network element.

verification_refs.citation: Siemens, Reyrolle 7SR5 Communication Protocol Manual, Edition 04.2023
verification_refs.locator: § PRP
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes sending the same indication via two separated networks, receiver duplicate filtering/discard, and no network switchover; the separate networks are an explicit architectural requirement.

facts.statement: HSR은 ring 양방향으로 frame을 중복 전송하고 node가 frame을 전달·중복제거하여 단일 고장에 대한 seamless communication을 목표로 하며 node forwarding과 traffic overhead를 고려해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 62439-3:2021, Industrial communication networks — High availability automation networks — Part 3: PRP and HSR
verification_refs.locator: Scope and protocol description
verification_refs.supports_claim: The standard specifies HSR for seamless switchover with zero recovery time for network element failure; it does not promise immunity to arbitrary common-cause or endpoint failures.

verification_refs.citation: Siemens, Setup and Configuration of Redundancy Using PRP and HSR, V3.0
verification_refs.locator: Communication in a redundant network with HSR, Send/Receive
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes duplicate transmission clockwise and counterclockwise, HSR-node forwarding, first-frame delivery and duplicate discard, and the resulting bandwidth overhead.

facts.statement: Jitter는 반복 전송 또는 도착시각 간 지연의 변동이며 평균 Latency와 구분하여 최대값, 범위 또는 통계분포로 관리해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Demichelis & Chimento, RFC 3393: IP Packet Delay Variation Metric for IP Performance Metrics
verification_refs.locator: §1.1 Terminology and §1.2 Definition
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that packet delay variation is sometimes called jitter, warns that jitter is used ambiguously, and defines IPDV as the difference between one-way delays of selected packets.

verification_refs.citation: RFC 8238: Data Center Benchmarking Terminology
verification_refs.locator: §3 Jitter
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines data-center jitter as packet delay variation and describes assessment using max-minus-min range or a high percentile, distinguishing it from a single mean-latency value.

facts.statement: Frame preemption은 긴 저우선 frame이 고우선 frame을 지연시키는 blocking time을 줄이지만 양단 지원, fragment overhead와 검증이 필요하다.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802.1Qbu, Frame Preemption (incorporated into IEEE 802.1Q-2018)
verification_refs.locator: Purpose and specified procedures
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines suspension of a non-time-critical frame to transmit time-critical frames, resumption afterward, and discovery/configuration/control; preemption is only enabled on a link when both partners support it.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802.1 TSN Task Group, Introduction to IEEE 802.1 & P802.1CM, Frame Preemption overview
verification_refs.locator: Slide 23, MAC Merge and minimum fragment size
verification_refs.supports_claim: Shows separate express and preemptable MAC paths through MAC Merge and a minimum fragment size, supporting the need to account for fragmentation overhead and validate the link implementation.

facts.statement: Throughput은 단위시간당 전달 가능한 데이터량이며 낮은 Latency나 Determinism을 자동 보장하지 않으므로 대역폭과 시간성능을 분리해 평가해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: RFC 1242: Benchmarking Terminology for Network Interconnection Devices
verification_refs.locator: §3.17 Throughput
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines device throughput as the maximum rate at which no offered frames are dropped and gives frame/s or bit/s as measurement units.

verification_refs.citation: RFC 8239: Data Center Benchmarking Methodology
verification_refs.locator: Benchmark reporting guidance for throughput, packet drops, latency and jitter
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires distinct reporting units and measures for throughput, packet drops, latency and jitter; it permits throughput, latency and jitter trials to be independent, confirming that throughput alone is not evidence of bounded delay or deterministic timing.

facts.statement: PTP는 분산 clock의 시간 또는 위상을 맞추는 protocol이며 측정, sequence of events와 scheduled communication을 지원하지만 자체만으로 control deadline을 보장하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61588:2021, Precision Clock Synchronization Protocol for Networked Measurement and Control Systems
verification_refs.locator: Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines PTP as a network protocol enabling precise synchronization of real-time clocks in distributed networked systems and scopes it to measurement and control systems.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802.1AS, Timing and Synchronization for Time-Sensitive Applications in Bridged Local Area Networks
verification_refs.locator: Scope and application description
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes network time synchronization for time-sensitive applications and maintenance of synchronized time across network reconfiguration.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802.1Qbv, Enhancements for Scheduled Traffic
verification_refs.locator: Purpose and scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies additional time-aware queue-draining procedures to schedule frames using timing derived from IEEE 802.1AS; this shows that synchronization is an input to, not a replacement for, transmission scheduling and latency assurance.

facts.statement: TSN은 단일 protocol이 아니라 시간동기, scheduling, shaping, policing, redundancy, 자원예약 등 서로 다른 IEEE 802.1 기능의 기술군이다. 실제 산업망에서는 적용 profile과 요구 성능에 맞춰 필요한 기능 및 경로 구성을 선택한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802.1 Time-Sensitive Networking Task Group, Published Standards for Time-Sensitive Networking
verification_refs.locator: Published standards list: 802.1AS, Qav, Qbv, Qbu, Qci, Qca, 802.1CB
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists distinct IEEE 802.1 TSN standards for time synchronization, credit-based shaping, scheduled traffic, frame preemption, per-stream policing, path control/reservation and redundancy; supports treating TSN as a family of mechanisms rather than one protocol.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE P802.1Qci, Per-Stream Filtering and Policing
verification_refs.locator: Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines separate per-stream frame counting, filtering, policing and service-class selection functions and says these mitigate disruptive transmissions.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802.1Qca, Path Control and Reservation
verification_refs.locator: Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies explicit path control, bandwidth/stream reservation, redundancy and distribution of time-synchronization and scheduling control parameters.

verification_refs.citation: IEC/IEEE 60802, TSN Profile for Industrial Automation
verification_refs.edition_or_version: Industrial automation TSN profile project; accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: Profile purpose
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes the need for guidelines selecting and using IEEE 802 standards/features to deploy interoperable bridged time-sensitive networks for industrial automation.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802.1Qat, Stream Reservation Protocol
verification_refs.locator: Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines stream descriptors and signaling of resource reservation along the end-to-end path of streams, supporting the stated need to configure paths and resources across the network.

facts.statement: PTP 설계에서는 시간원과 Grandmaster 선정, 사용 장치에 해당하는 ordinary·boundary·transparent clock 역할 및 network path를 식별한다. 시간원 상실 시 holdover 요구는 장치·profile·운전 목적에 맞춰 별도로 검토하며 모든 clock 유형이 모든 망에 필요한 것은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61588:2021, Precision Clock Synchronization Protocol for Networked Measurement and Control Systems
verification_refs.locator: Scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines the PTP network protocol for precise synchronization of real-time clocks in distributed networked systems including Ethernet-based measurement and control.

verification_refs.citation: Cisco, Precision Time Protocol configuration guide
verification_refs.locator: Message-based PTP synchronization, Figure 1 PTP clock hierarchy
verification_refs.supports_claim: Shows grandmaster, boundary/transparent and ordinary clock positions in a PTP hierarchy; role selection is profile/device-specific.

verification_refs.citation: Cisco, Precision Time Protocol configuration guide, holdover traceability suppression
verification_refs.locator: PTP holdover traceability suppression and boundary-clock grandmaster-loss example
verification_refs.supports_claim: Product-specific example shows that loss of a primary clock changes traceability/class behavior after a configured holdover duration; holdover cannot be assumed from PTP alone.

verification_refs.citation: Cisco, Configuring Clocking and Timing, PTP BMCA and holdover
verification_refs.locator: BMCA selects server and grandmaster; server-clock loss starts holdover timer
verification_refs.supports_claim: Device documentation directly ties BMCA grandmaster selection and holdover behavior to clock-role configuration.

facts.statement: IEEE 802.1Qbv Time-Aware Shaper는 공통 시간기준에 따라 queue gate를 개폐해 scheduled traffic의 송신창을 만들며 guard band, schedule cycle과 clock accuracy를 함께 설계해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802.1Qbv, Enhancements for Scheduled Traffic
verification_refs.locator: Purpose and scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Specifies time-aware queue-draining procedures that schedule frame transmissions using timing derived from IEEE 802.1AS, supporting the common-time and scheduled-transmission-window portions of the claim.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802.1AS, Timing and Synchronization for Time-Sensitive Applications in Bridged Local Area Networks
verification_refs.locator: Scope and application description
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines synchronization procedures and time-synchronization requirements for time-sensitive applications in bridged LANs, supporting evaluation of clock accuracy against the application timing requirement.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802 Tutorial, Deterministic Ethernet – Quality of Service, Time Aware Shaper
verification_refs.locator: Time Aware Shaper gate schedule and transmission-window diagram
verification_refs.supports_claim: Illustrates time-aware gates, timed scheduled-traffic windows, repeating schedule intervals, and guard-band treatment for other traffic; it supports these as schedule design considerations, not a universal fixed guard-band value.

verification_refs.citation: Worst-case traversal time analysis of TSN with multi-level preemption, Computer Communications
verification_refs.locator: IEEE 802.1Qbv gate-control list and guard-band description
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes cyclic precomputed gate-control schedules with queue transmission slots and guard bands that protect scheduled traffic from interference; this supports treating cycle and guard-band configuration as schedule-design inputs.

facts.statement: State Estimator의 성능은 Sensor 배치와 Motion에 따른 Observability에 제한되며 관측되지 않는 상태는 Model만으로 확정할 수 없다.

verification_refs.citation: Continuum Reconfigurable Parallel Robots for Surgery: Shape Sensing and State Estimation with Uncertainty
verification_refs.locator: Sensor-placement and observability discussion; observability-matrix rank condition
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that sensors must be selected and placed to make the modeled states observable, identifies full rank of the observability matrix as the local-estimation condition, and shows sensor placement changes position uncertainty.

verification_refs.citation: Sensor Selection and State Estimation for Unobservable and Non-Linear System Models
verification_refs.locator: Introduction and unobservable-state/sensor-selection discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Gives an application example in which vehicle-position states are unobservable without GPS and discusses model-dependent sensor selection and covariance consequences, supporting that estimator limits depend on the available measurement set and model.

verification_refs.citation: Observability-based Placement of Inertial Sensors on Robotic Manipulators for Kinematic State Estimation
verification_refs.locator: Abstract and sensor-placement method
verification_refs.supports_claim: Analyzes inertial-sensor placement for kinematic-state estimation and predicts the resulting velocity/acceleration estimation quality, directly supporting sensor configuration as an observability and estimator-performance design factor.

verification_refs.citation: RGBD-Inertial Trajectory Estimation and Mapping for Ground Robots
verification_refs.locator: Observability analysis for motion-dependent unobservable directions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies motion cases such as uniform linear motion at constant velocity that produce an unobservable scale direction in RGB-D-inertial estimation, directly supporting that observability depends on the motion trajectory and estimator model.

facts.statement: Entanglement는 복수 qubit 사이에 고전적 독립변수로 분해하기 어려운 상관구조를 만들 수 있지만 정보의 초광속 전달을 허용하는 수단은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, NIST Team Proves 'Spooky Action at a Distance' is Really Real
verification_refs.locator: Bell-test result and no-faster-than-light communication discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Reports an entangled-photon Bell test demonstrating correlations that violate local-realistic limits, while explaining that the measurements do not permit faster-than-light communication.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Quantum and Dance: It Takes 2 to Entangle
verification_refs.locator: Entanglement explanation, no-faster-than-light communication statement
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that entanglement cannot be used to communicate faster than light, supporting the anchor's explicit no-signaling boundary.

facts.statement: Quantum processor의 결과는 measurement와 sampling을 거쳐 고전적 값으로 해석되므로 필요한 confidence와 shot 수, 후처리 비용을 end-to-end latency와 정확도 평가에 포함해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: IBM Quantum Documentation, Estimator inputs and outputs
verification_refs.locator: Estimator result data and metadata examples (shots, target_precision, standard deviations and ensemble standard error)
verification_refs.supports_claim: The documentation shows shot count, target precision and statistical error information in execution results, supporting that accuracy/precision targets and sampling configuration are part of the workload result and evaluation.

verification_refs.citation: IBM Quantum Documentation, Readout error mitigation for the Sampler primitive using M3
verification_refs.locator: Background and limitations: finite-sampling statistical error and shot overhead
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that distribution estimates have statistical error due to finite sampling, that increasing shots reduces this error subject to hardware drift, and that mitigation estimation has additional time/memory costs; this supports evaluating sampling and classical post-processing in an end-to-end accuracy/resource assessment rather than assuming more shots solve all error.

verification_refs.citation: IBM Quantum Documentation, Construct circuits—Measure qubits
verification_refs.locator: Measure qubits section
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines measurement as sampling qubit states and transferring outcomes into classical registers, supporting the quantum-measurement-to-classical-result portion of the pipeline.

facts.statement: Latency는 데이터가 송신 지점에서 수신 지점까지 전달되는 지연이며 serialization, switching, queueing, propagation과 protocol processing 지연의 합으로 평가해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: IETF RFC 7928, Characterization Guidelines for Active Queue Management (AQM)
verification_refs.locator: §2 and §2.6, end-to-end metrics and latency/jitter
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines latency as one-way packet delay, describes end-to-end delay as propagation, serialization, switch service, medium-access and queueing delays summed over network elements, and notes signal-processing, transmission and processing delay beyond queueing.

verification_refs.citation: ITU-T Recommendation Y.2617, Performance parameters and allocation in packet data networks
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines packet delay from first bit entering the network to first bit arriving at the user as transmission, propagation and node-processing delay (including queueing), identifies edge-device processing such as encapsulation and security inspection, and defines end-to-end delay as the sum across concatenated network domains and interfaces.

facts.statement: Cycle time은 제어 또는 통신 작업이 반복되는 주기이며 패킷 1개의 전송시간과 동일하지 않고 생산자·네트워크·소비자의 주기와 위상관계를 포함한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802.1, IEC/IEEE 60802 Industrial Use Cases, V1.3 working-group document
verification_refs.edition_or_version: V1.3, 2018-09-13; accessed 2026-10-12; use-case development document, not final normative standard
verification_refs.supports_claim: Separates application cycle times from network cycles using reduction ratios, defines phase as the starting network cycle for consecutive transmissions, and distinguishes frame transfer time (frames exchanged between controller and devices) from network cycle time. The isochronous cyclic model separately describes periodic controller tasks, synchronized device data transmission, deadlines and working-clock synchronization.

verification_refs.citation: Siemens, SIMATIC ET 200AL Manual Collection—Basic terminology of communication
verification_refs.locator: Update time, Send clock and Relationship between update time and send clock sections
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines PROFINET update time as the recurring interval for cyclic input/output exchange between IO controller and IO device, defines send clock as the interval between communication cycles, and describes per-device update periods as reduction ratios of the send clock. This provides an implementation example, not a universal timing value or all-vendor rule.

facts.statement: Derating은 component stress를 rating 한계에서 충분히 떨어뜨려 reliability margin을 확보하는 설계수단이며 적용 비율은 부품종류·manufacturer data·프로젝트 requirement에 따라 정하므로 모든 부품에 하나의 고정 percentage를 적용하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA/GSFC, EEE-INST-002: Instructions for EEE Parts Selection, Screening, Qualification, and Derating, Addendum 1 incorporated
verification_refs.edition_or_version: NASA/TP-2003-212242; May 2003, Addendum 1 incorporated April 2008; accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: §§1.0, 3.0, 5.0, 6.0, pp. 1–6; part-category derating tables in §§C1–W1
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines derating as reducing electrical and thermal stresses during normal operation to decrease degradation and prolong expected part life. Instructions apply to EEE parts on GSFC space-flight projects, are organized by 18 part categories and reliability levels, and require project MARs to specify exceptions/additions. The part-specific structure supports tailoring rather than a universal fixed percentage; it is not a general rule imposing NASA space-flight levels on industrial controls.

facts.statement: Staged pressure reduction은 total pressure drop을 여러 restriction에 분배하여 각 stage의 velocity와 energy concentration을 낮추는 방향으로 사용한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, DST-G Trim product documentation
verification_refs.locator: Product description and key features
verification_refs.supports_claim: For DST-G trim in dissolved-gas outgassing service, states that the trim stages pressure drop to prevent cavitation and that its lower cage separates the stream into smaller, lower-energy jets to control erosion. This supports the intended mechanism in that product, not universal reduction at each restriction in all valves.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Noise-Attenuation Technologies for Control Valves, D351989X012
verification_refs.locator: pp. 12–13, Fisher Control Valve Trims; pp. 13–14, Cavitation Control
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes pressure-drop staging in specific Fisher trims; examples include splitting overall pressure drop into stages, flow restrictions and expansions, successively larger flow areas that allocate pressure drop among stages, and smaller independent jets. These product-specific passages substantiate geometry-dependent staged design rather than a universal performance guarantee.

facts.statement: Liquid high-flow service의 hydraulic power는 pressure drop과 flow의 곱으로 screening할 수 있으나 실제 damage는 pressure staging, cavitation, flashing, material와 geometry에 의존한다.

verification_refs.citation: University of Florida, Hydraulic Systems, Chapter 11 teaching material based on Goering, Off-Road Vehicle Engineering Principles
verification_refs.locator: slide 10, PDF page 9, Pump Power
verification_refs.supports_claim: States hydraulic power change across a circuit with equal inlet/outlet flow as pressure rise or drop multiplied by flow rate, with units and the sign convention for pressure-drop devices. Applied here only as a liquid hydraulic-power screening measure; it does not quantify valve damage.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 5, Control Valve Sizing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that flashing erosion occurs at high-velocity regions and cavitation damage depends on where vapor bubbles collapse, including downstream pressure recovery. It identifies pressure, fluid, and valve conditions as material to the phenomenon; no hydraulic-power scalar is presented as a damage predictor.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Cavitrol III Trim product documentation
verification_refs.locator: Product description and operating principle
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes staged pressure drop and specially shaped flow passages as design features used to control cavitation effects in the stated Fisher trim application, supporting the caveat that pressure staging and geometry affect damage behavior rather than the simple power proxy alone.

facts.statement: Response time은 입력 변화 또는 사건 발생부터 필요한 출력 또는 조치가 완료될 때까지의 end-to-end 시간으로 센싱, 연산, 통신, 출력 갱신과 장치동작을 포함한다.

verification_refs.citation: Siemens, S7-1500 Cycle and Response Times, Function Manual A5E03461504-02
verification_refs.supports_claim: For cyclic/time-driven S7-1500 process response, lists input/output module delays, PROFINET IO or PROFIBUS DP update times, process-image input/output transfer, user-program processing and sensor/actuator switching times; gives shortest/longest calculations and notes network/configuration dependence.

verification_refs.citation: Siemens, SIRIUS ACT with PROFINET IO, Manual
verification_refs.locator: §10.2 Response times, p. 105
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines error-free reaction time as the time until system output response after an input change—the event-to-action interval, with sensor-to-actuator operational switching as an example—and says application-configured reaction time must be determined.

verification_refs.citation: Siemens, PROFINET System Description, System Manual A5E00298288-06
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes synchronized input acquisition, PROFINET transfer, CPU program execution and output update; presents minimum and maximum input-to-output process reaction times as TI + T_DC + TO and TI + 2×T_DC + TO for the stated isochronous configuration.

facts.statement: Low flow, high viscosity와 small passage에서는 Reynolds effect와 laminar correction을 확인하고 일반 turbulent-flow sizing을 그대로 적용하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-2-1:2011, Industrial-process control valves—Part 2-1: Flow capacity—Sizing equations for fluid flow under installed conditions
verification_refs.locator: Scope and edition-change summary for non-turbulent flow corrections
verification_refs.supports_claim: The standard covers sizing equations for compressible and incompressible fluids; its incompressible equations are based on Newtonian incompressible fluids and are not intended for non-Newtonian fluids, mixtures, slurries or liquid-solid conveyance; the 2011 revision includes changes to non-turbulent flow corrections.

verification_refs.citation: Valmet, Flow Control Manual, Liquid Flow
verification_refs.locator: §3.3.1, Reynolds number factor
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that the Reynolds number factor affects non-turbulent flow, which commonly occurs with high-viscosity fluids, low flow velocities and small valve sizes; it describes determining the factor from the valve Reynolds number.

facts.statement: Low-flow service는 catalog minimum Cv가 아니라 installed system에서 안정적으로 반복 제어할 수 있는 minimum controllable flow를 확인한다.

verification_refs.citation: Valmet, What is the rangeability of a control valve?
verification_refs.locator: Inherent and installed rangeability definitions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Distinguishes inherent rangeability as maximum/minimum controllable Cv from installed rangeability as maximum/minimum flow within an installed-characteristic tolerance, and notes that the smallest signal change the valve can respond to affects controllability and vendor definitions vary.

verification_refs.citation: Valmet, Flow Control Manual, Control Valve Installed Performance
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that selection depends on actual process conditions; installed flow characteristic depends on both pipeline pressure behavior and inherent valve characteristic; installed gain affects controllability and accuracy; and mechanical valve error alone does not define controlled-flow accuracy.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 1
verification_refs.locator: §1.5 Process Control Terminology, Rangeability
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines rangeability by the maximum and minimum flow coefficient within stated deviation limits and notes controllable flow range; this supports distinguishing a catalog coefficient limit from the installed application flow range.

facts.statement: Cryogenic service에서는 body, trim, stem와 seal material의 thermal contraction 차이가 clearance, alignment와 sealing load를 변화시킨다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA SP-8097, Liquid Rocket Valve Assemblies
verification_refs.locator: Cryogenic valve design discussion, pp. 58–59
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that cryogenic startup thermal transients can cause dimensional changes in mating parts due to differing heat-transfer rates, locations or mass; these may create misalignment or stress. It identifies poppet/seat misalignment and seat distortion as critical in metal-to-metal cryogenic poppet valves, and describes sealing-load design to compensate thermal changes.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Tech Brief 20040001048, Innovative, High-Pressure, Cryogenic Control Valve: Short Face-to-Face, Reduced Cost
verification_refs.locator: Cryogenic body-seat material and contraction discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: In one documented design, the seat-ring alloy has a lower thermal-expansion coefficient than the stainless body; on cryogenic cooldown the body contracts more than the seat ring, and the chosen joint geometry uses this differential contraction to maintain body-seat sealing. This is an example of a design-dependent effect, not a universal direction of leakage or clearance change.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 6: Special and Severe Service Control Valves
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 6, Cryogenic Applications
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes cryogenic valve-specific materials, seals and extended-bonnet design; packing-box temperature and extension length depend on application temperature and insulation, supporting application-specific thermal design rather than ambient-only assumptions.

facts.statement: Trapped cryogenic liquid가 warming되면 thermal expansion과 vaporization으로 cavity pressure가 상승할 수 있으므로 relief path와 cavity design을 검토한다.

verification_refs.citation: Valmet/Jamesbury, Flexible Lip Seat Design for Jamesbury Ball Valves, B100-0EN
verification_refs.locator: Cavity Relief, pp. 1–2; cites ANSI B16.34 §2.3.3 Thermal Fluid Expansion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that trapped process fluid in a valve cavity is subject to pressure increase and describes seat designs that relieve cavity pressure toward the higher-pressure side or piping system. It quotes ANSI B16.34 §2.3.3 assigning the user responsibility to ensure valve pressure does not exceed the permitted limit at attained temperature.

verification_refs.citation: Valmet/Jamesbury, Series 6FRF Ball Valve Installation, Maintenance and Operating Instructions, IMO-R24EN
verification_refs.locator: Safety Precautions, trapped-fluid warning
verification_refs.supports_claim: Warns that certain double-seated ball-valve designs can trap fluid in the ball cavity and that raising the trapped-fluid temperature causes internal valve pressure to rise.

verification_refs.citation: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, EHS Manual, Chapter 29: Safe Handling of Cryogenic Liquids
verification_refs.locator: Cryogenic system pressure relief requirements
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires pressure relief for isolatable cryogenic-system sections that could contain cryogenic liquid or gas, to prevent rupture/explosion from trapped cryogen; this supports relief-path review but does not prescribe one universal valve-cavity relief construction.

facts.statement: Cryogenic fluid는 heat leak와 pressure reduction으로 vaporization, flashing와 two-phase flow가 발생할 수 있으므로 phase state와 sizing assumption을 확인한다.

verification_refs.citation: Valmet, Flow Control Manual, Liquid Flow
verification_refs.locator: §3.3.3 Flashing of liquids
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that when control-valve downstream pressure is below the liquid vapor pressure, part of the liquid vaporizes and remains vapor downstream, creating liquid-vapor two-phase flow; where upstream pressure is near vapor pressure, two-phase upstream flow can occur and dedicated sizing should be used.

verification_refs.citation: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Pressurization and Explosion Hazards for Cryogenic Liquids
verification_refs.locator: Cryogenic-liquid heat input and closed-container pressure behavior
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that heat from ambient air or materials causes cryogenic liquids to boil and convert to gas; in a closed container pressure rises as the liquid is heated.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60534-2-1:2011, Industrial-process control valves—Part 2-1: Flow capacity—Sizing equations for fluid flow under installed conditions
verification_refs.locator: Scope and sizing-equation applicability
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines control-valve sizing equations for compressible and incompressible fluid conditions and identifies limitations for mixtures, slurries and liquid-solid conveyance; sizing assumptions must match the actual fluid regime and applicable method.

facts.statement: High-temperature service는 body·trim material의 allowable strength, pressure derating, oxidation, scaling와 creep 가능성을 함께 검토한다.

verification_refs.citation: ASME B16.34-2025, Valves—Flanged, Threaded, and Welding End
verification_refs.locator: Scope: pressure-temperature ratings and materials
verification_refs.supports_claim: ASME identifies B16.34 as covering valve pressure-temperature ratings and materials. The code rating must therefore be checked against the applicable material group and design temperature rather than assuming a temperature-independent pressure limit.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Steam Conditioning Technologies, Materials of Selection
verification_refs.locator: Trim for High Temperature and Pressure; Alloy Steel Bodies and Bonnets, p. 14
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that elevated temperature/pressure can make standard trim inadequate because of yield strength, creep resistance or sliding wear; alloy selection depends on valve style and actual operating conditions. It identifies molybdenum for high-temperature strength and chromium for strength and oxidation resistance, and notes resistance to creep and corrosion.

verification_refs.citation: National Board of Boiler and Pressure Vessel Inspectors, Creep and Creep Failures
verification_refs.locator: Elevated-temperature oxidation, scale and creep discussion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes how scale can raise metal temperature and how elevated temperature accelerates creep deformation, oxidation and corrosion; damage rates depend on exposure conditions, so these are mechanisms to assess rather than universal outcomes.

facts.statement: Corrosion은 chemical·electrochemical material loss이고 erosion은 mechanical wear이며 erosion-corrosion은 두 mechanism의 상호작용이다.

verification_refs.citation: ASTM G40-25a, Standard Terminology Relating to Wear and Erosion
verification_refs.edition_or_version: ASTM catalog lists G40-25a as active; accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: Scope §§1.1–1.4 and erosion terminology
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines the scope of wear/erosion terminology as mechanical interactions such as cavitation and liquid/solid-particle impingement, and generally excludes material loss principally due to chemical action.

verification_refs.citation: AMPP, What is Corrosion?
verification_refs.locator: Corrosion definition and reaction mechanism
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines corrosion as gradual material deterioration, most often of metals, through reaction with the surrounding environment; describes the reactions as chemical or electrochemical.

verification_refs.citation: ASTM G119-09(2016), Standard Guide for Determining Synergism Between Wear and Corrosion
verification_refs.locator: Scope §1.1 and combined wear-corrosion interaction
verification_refs.supports_claim: Provides a method to determine increased material-loss rate attributable to interaction when wear and corrosion coexist, including synergistic effects beyond their separate contributions.

facts.statement: Slurry와 abrasive service의 wear는 particle momentum, impingement angle, local velocity, concentration와 material hardness에 의존한다.

verification_refs.citation: Elucidating the specific and combined effects of particle size, impact angle, velocity and stress from an external load on the slurry erosion of mild steel S275JR, Journal of Materials Research and Technology 14 (2021), 1052–1064
verification_refs.locator: Abstract and experimental variables
verification_refs.supports_claim: Reports that particle velocity, particle size, impact angle and material properties including particle/target hardness affect erosion rate, and experimentally studies velocity, angle, size and target stress for slurry erosion of mild steel.

verification_refs.citation: Yadav et al., Insights to improve the tribo-performance of materials used under slurry erosion applications: A review, Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers, Part J (2023), DOI 10.1177/14644207221108565
verification_refs.locator: Abstract, slurry erosion influencing parameters
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies impact velocity, impingement angle, erodent shape/size, slurry concentration and material properties as influencing factors, while emphasizing that these differ by application and materials are selected for the specific wear severity.

verification_refs.citation: ASTM G40-25a, Standard Terminology Relating to Wear and Erosion
verification_refs.edition_or_version: ASTM catalog lists G40-25a as active; accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: Scope §1.1 and impingement erosion terminology
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines erosion terminology within mechanical interactions including cavitation and liquid-jet/drop or solid-particle impingement, distinguishing these mechanisms from loss principally caused by chemical action.

facts.statement: High flow와 high velocity는 trim·body·downstream erosion, flow-induced vibration와 mechanical fatigue를 유발할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Valmet, Flow Control Manual, Liquid Flow
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that erosion associated with cavitation/corrosion depends strongly on velocity, flashing two-phase flow may cause erosion and vibration, and velocity limitation is used to prevent excessive erosion; damage also depends on material, medium and piping layout.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson/Fisher, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 5: Control Valve Sizing
verification_refs.locator: §§5.14.1–5.14.2, flashing flow and erosive velocity
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes flashing as a source of severe erosive wear and recommends considering flow velocity and downstream geometry/materials; it treats sizing and location as service-specific.

verification_refs.citation: Ziada, Sperling and Fisker, Vibration of a High-Pressure Piping System Due to Flow in a Spherical Elbow, Journal of Fluids and Structures 15(5) (2001), 751–767
verification_refs.locator: Abstract and commissioning case study
verification_refs.supports_claim: Reports a high-pressure steam-piping flow-induced vibration case that caused fatigue damage to attached components, including a bypass-valve stem; tests traced excitation to an upstream elbow and showed piping layout, not valve redesign alone, controlled the vibration.

verification_refs.citation: Japan Atomic Energy Agency, R&D Review 2006, Vibration Characteristics of Piping Excited by Turbulent Flows
verification_refs.locator: Flow-induced vibration of large-diameter piping under high-velocity conditions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Analyzes high-velocity-flow-excited piping vibration and explicitly evaluates stress against material fatigue limits; the cited case remained below its design fatigue limit, demonstrating that high flow alone does not prove fatigue failure.

facts.statement: Low-temperature service는 material toughness, minimum design metal temperature와 brittle-fracture risk를 확인한다.

verification_refs.citation: ASME B31.3-2024, Process Piping
verification_refs.locator: Official ASME catalog description; process piping scope includes cryogenic plants
