verification_refs.locator: §3.2.3, Limitations of Current Explainable AI Models
verification_refs.supports_claim: Discusses limitations of current explanation methods and notes they do not provide explicit representations of causal mechanisms; supports not treating a model explanation as causal proof.

facts.statement: 재현·감사를 위해 배포 Model Version을 학습 run, 사용 Dataset/Feature, Code·Hyperparameter·Threshold 및 Runtime 환경과 연결해 기록한다. MLflow 같은 registry/tracking 도구는 model version, source run, parameters, metrics, artifacts와 dataset metadata를 연결하는 기능을 제공하지만, feature·threshold·실제 배포환경 항목은 시스템에서 명시적으로 기록해야 하며 자동 수집된다고 가정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: MLflow Tracking documentation
verification_refs.locator: Runs, Models, and Tracking Datasets
verification_refs.supports_claim: Documents logging run parameters, metrics and artifacts, tracking training/evaluation datasets and their metadata, and model tracking.

verification_refs.citation: MLflow Model Registry
verification_refs.locator: Version Control and Model Lineage and Traceability
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that registered model versions are linked to the MLflow run/logged model that produced them, supports versioning, stage/alias management and rollback to prior states; this is tool capability, not a claim that every deployment field is automatically recorded.

facts.statement: 운영 중 AI는 사전평가와 운영환경 간의 성능·입력/출력 분포 차이, 데이터·센서 품질, 시스템 기능과 이상을 모니터링하고 실제 정답이 확보되면 성능을 재평가한다. 감시 항목·임계치·조치는 위험과 배포 맥락에 맞게 정하고, 모든 시스템에 동일한 고정 metric 목록이 적용되는 것은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0, Measure 2.4
verification_refs.locator: §5.3 Measure 2.4
verification_refs.supports_claim: Calls for monitoring the functionality and behavior of AI systems and components in production and regular monitoring while operating.

verification_refs.citation: NIST AI RMF Playbook, Measure 2.4
verification_refs.locator: Measure 2.4 suggested actions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Suggests comparing production metrics/performance against pre-deployment tests, examining input/output distribution differences, alerting on deviations, evaluating outputs against new ground-truth as it becomes available, and using human review for unexpected data; describes suggestions to tailor to context, not a mandatory universal monitor list.

facts.statement: 일반적인 supervised prediction의 taxonomy에서 input/covariate drift는 입력분포 P(X)의 변화이고 concept drift/shift는 target 관계 P(Y|X)의 변화로 구분할 수 있다. 문헌에 따라 drift 용어와 범주화가 다르며 class prevalence P(Y) 변화도 별도 shift 유형이 될 수 있다. 제품·운전모드·센서·정비정책 변화는 원인 후보이므로 실제 drift 유형을 데이터·공정 맥락에서 진단해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Moreno-Torres et al., A unifying view on dataset shift in classification
verification_refs.locator: Definitions and taxonomy of dataset shift
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines taxonomy of covariate shift, prior probability shift, concept shift and dataset shift by which distributions change, and discusses terminology/definition variation in the literature.

verification_refs.citation: NIST AI RMF Playbook, Measure 2.4
verification_refs.locator: Measure 2.4 suggested actions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Recommends monitoring differences in production input/output distributions relative to predeployment test environments, but treats them as signals to assess rather than automatic proof of model failure.

facts.statement: MLOps는 ML 개발과 운영을 연결하는 관행·아키텍처로, 적용 수준에 따라 데이터/모델 검증, code·pipeline test, experiment/metadata와 model version 관리, 배포, 운영 모니터링 및 필요 시 재학습·rollback을 연결한다. 자동화 수준과 승인·재학습 trigger 구성은 조직의 위험·배포 맥락에 따라 달라지는 구현 선택이며 모든 ML 시스템에 동일한 필수 도구 목록은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: Google Cloud Architecture Center, MLOps: Continuous delivery and automation pipelines in machine learning
verification_refs.locator: MLOps definition; CI/CD/CT; MLOps level 1 data/model validation and pipeline triggers
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines MLOps as unifying ML development and operations, with automation/monitoring across integration, testing, release, deployment and infrastructure; describes data/model validation, metadata management, retraining triggers, performance comparisons before promotion, and options for manual versus automated operation.

verification_refs.citation: MLflow Model Registry Workflows
verification_refs.locator: Model version details and environment promotion
verification_refs.supports_claim: Documents model version inspection, aliases/tags, and promotion across development, staging, and production environments, while illustrating one implementation rather than a universal required component list.

facts.statement: 모델 배포 전에는 목표 Runtime에서 입력 Schema와 전처리·Prediction API의 일관성 및 필요한 인프라·의존성 호환성을 검증한다. Training과 Serving 환경의 차이는 오류나 Training-Serving Skew를 일으킬 수 있으므로 실제 배포 조건에 가까운 검증이 중요하다. Sensor·Hardware·Latency의 개별 허용기준과 시험범위는 모델·플랫폼·위험 요구에 따라 정한다.

verification_refs.citation: Google Cloud Architecture Center, MLOps: Continuous delivery and automation pipelines in machine learning
verification_refs.locator: Data and model validation; model deployment testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes validating deployment infrastructure compatibility and prediction-service API consistency before model promotion, and comparing a newly trained candidate with current production/baseline models.

verification_refs.citation: scikit-learn User Guide, Model persistence
verification_refs.locator: Replicating the training environment in production; dependency compatibility
verification_refs.supports_claim: Documents that differing training and production dependency versions can cause unexpected behavior or errors, recommends recording dependencies and reconstructing compatible environments, and notes hardware portability depends on the persistence method/model.

verification_refs.citation: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0, Measure 2.3
verification_refs.locator: §5.3 Measure 2.3
verification_refs.supports_claim: Calls for measuring performance or assurance criteria under conditions similar to the deployment setting.

facts.statement: 재학습 trigger는 사용 맥락에 따라 정하며 일정, 새 학습자료의 확보 또는 관측된 성능 저하 등이 선택 가능한 예다. Drift나 공정변경은 재평가를 촉발할 수 있는 신호이지 자동 재학습·배포의 충분조건은 아니다. 새 모델은 배포 전에 자료와 모델을 검증하고 기존 baseline과 비교해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Google Cloud Architecture Center, MLOps: Continuous delivery and automation pipelines in machine learning
verification_refs.locator: ML pipeline triggers; data and model validation
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists on-demand, scheduled, new-training-data-available, and model-performance-degradation triggers as use-case-dependent alternatives; requires data/model validation and candidate comparison before deployment.

verification_refs.citation: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0, Manage 4.1
verification_refs.locator: §5.4 Manage 4.1
verification_refs.supports_claim: Calls for post-deployment monitoring plans that include change management and incident response; it does not prescribe one universal retraining trigger or automatic retraining rule.

facts.statement: 산업 적용에서는 문제 전처리·데이터관리·최적화 outer loop·검증을 classical system이 담당하고 quantum processor가 일부 subproblem을 처리하는 hybrid quantum-classical 구조가 현실적인 평가 단위가 될 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: IBM Research, Unveiling the first reference architecture for quantum-centric supercomputing
verification_refs.locator: Hybrid quantum-classical orchestration and closed-loop optimization
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes a hybrid workflow with quantum/classical processors and closed-loop classical/quantum orchestration; this demonstrates a possible architecture, not a universal pattern requirement.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Quantum Computing Explained
verification_refs.locator: Introduction: quantum and classical computers working together
verification_refs.supports_claim: Explains that quantum computers are not replacements for classical computers and may work together for selected problems.

facts.statement: Classical plant data를 quantum state로 encoding하는 비용과 구조는 전체 이득을 제한할 수 있으므로 input preparation을 계산복잡도와 interface 설계에 포함해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Quantum, Quantum state preparation via piecewise QSVT
verification_refs.locator: Abstract and popular summary on classical data loading/state preparation cost
verification_refs.supports_claim: States that loading classical data can be a major bottleneck and may cost more than executing the quantum algorithm, while structured data may admit efficient preparation; this supports a conditional, not universal, bottleneck claim.

verification_refs.citation: Quantum, Fast Black-Box Quantum State Preparation
verification_refs.locator: Abstract: state preparation and data loading in quantum algorithms
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies state preparation/data loading as a crucial step for many quantum algorithms and applications, including optimization.

facts.statement: 물리 qubit 수만으로 산업 적용성을 판단할 수 없으며 connectivity, gate/readout quality, usable circuit depth, logical resource overhead와 workload 적합성을 함께 봐야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Logical quantum processor based on reconfigurable atom arrays
verification_refs.locator: Abstract: physical qubits, gate fidelity, connectivity, logical encoding
verification_refs.supports_claim: Reports physical-qubit count, two-qubit gate fidelity, connectivity, readout and logical encoding as distinct processor properties; logical encoding can improve algorithmic performance beyond physical-qubit fidelities alone.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Theory: Turning noisy intermediate scale quantum information processing into practical quantum computing
verification_refs.locator: Quantum error correction and fault-tolerance resource overhead
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes resource tradeoffs involving qubit overhead, noise rates, and circuit depth to accomplish a specified algorithm/task.

facts.statement: Quantum sensing은 quantum state의 민감도를 이용하는 측정기술 영역이고 quantum computing은 계산처리 영역이므로 관련 신기술이라는 공통점이 있어도 동일 기술로 취급하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Quantum Sensing Explained
verification_refs.locator: What makes a quantum sensor quantum?
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines quantum sensors by using quantum properties to measure physical quantities; contrasts their measurement purpose with quantum computing's information processing purpose.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Quantum Computing Explained
verification_refs.locator: Qubits, input/output, information processing and memory
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes quantum computers as information-processing devices that use qubits for computation.

facts.statement: Fieldbus는 다수의 현장장치와 제어시스템 사이에 측정값·명령·상태·진단을 디지털로 교환하고 장치구성 및 자산정보를 통합할 수 있게 하는 산업 통신체계이다.

verification_refs.citation: FieldComm Group, FOUNDATION Fieldbus Technology Explained
verification_refs.locator: Technology overview, field-level integration, process variables, diagnostics and asset information
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes FOUNDATION Fieldbus as bidirectional digital field communication between intelligent instruments and host systems; device/user layers provide process values, status, diagnostics, function blocks and asset/engineering information. The specific feature set is protocol/profile-dependent.

verification_refs.citation: FieldComm Group Support, Field Diagnostics
verification_refs.locator: FOUNDATION fieldbus diagnostic profiles and host/asset-management integration
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes profile-based communication of device diagnostic data to host and asset-management systems, with features dependent on Device ITK Profile.

facts.statement: OPC UA는 controller·SCADA·MES·gateway·cloud 사이의 정보통합에 강점이 있지만 모든 현장 I/O bus를 자동 대체하거나 정량적 실시간성을 보장하는 것은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: OPC Foundation, OPC Unified Architecture Part 1: Overview and Concepts
verification_refs.locator: §§1, 4.1–4.3: scope, information model, communication model, interoperability and application domains
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines OPC UA as platform-independent industrial information exchange spanning devices through enterprise/cloud, with information, message, communication, and conformance models; it does not state that every deployment replaces field I/O wiring or guarantees a timing bound.

verification_refs.citation: OPC Foundation, OPC UA Client Function Blocks for IEC 61131-3, Scope
verification_refs.locator: Scope and controller client functionality
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes horizontal controller and vertical MES/ERP/cloud exchange and explicitly states that the specified controller client functionality does not provide hard deterministic real time; this limitation is specific to that function-block scope, not every OPC UA profile.

facts.statement: For Emerson FIELDVUE/ValveLink diagnostics, in-service monitoring observes operating signals while an offline signature is a planned diagnostic test; the modes differ in test conditions and process risk, and the available functions depend on device/software configuration.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Diagnostics
verification_refs.locator: In-service diagnostics and Valve Total Scan/Step Response/Signature features
verification_refs.supports_claim: Separately describes in-service monitoring parameters/status and diagnostic signature/step-response tests; exact functions are offered with specified FIELDVUE diagnostic levels and ValveLink.

facts.statement: A documented FIELDVUE diagnostic configuration can expose input/setpoint, travel, pressure and device-status information for valve-condition monitoring; the exact variables depend on controller model, diagnostic tier, sensors and configuration.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Diagnostics
verification_refs.locator: Status Monitor and diagnostic level descriptions
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists online parameters including input current, travel setpoint, travel and pressures, and states diagnostic availability depends on FIELDVUE diagnostic level.

facts.statement: Diagnostic variable, alert code와 test definition의 제공 범위와 의미는 설치된 기기 모델 및 해당 소프트웨어·펌웨어 문서에서 확인한다. 다른 기기나 버전에 같은 이름이 있다는 이유만으로 동일한 기능·기준값이라고 단정하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, ValveLink Pro Software Instruction Manual D104836X012
verification_refs.locator: Alerts and reference to DVC7K instruction manual for specific alert information/default settings
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual directs users to the matching DVC7K instruction manual for specific alert information/defaults and enumerates device alerts, demonstrating model-specific semantics.

facts.statement: Emerson describes creating a FIELDVUE valve signature for a new valve and comparing later signature results with it; this is a product-specific baseline practice, not a universal requirement or proof that later deviations identify a unique fault cause.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, News Brief: 3 Millionth Emerson Digital Valve Controller Purchased
verification_refs.locator: Description of offline new-valve signature and comparison with future signature test results
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes using an offline signature on a new valve to capture packing friction, air usage, travel and other parameters for comparison with future test results; examples highlight issues but do not establish unique causal diagnosis.

facts.statement: For a symmetric up/down pressure-band test with unchanged process force and actuator geometry, the estimated friction force is approximately effective actuator area times the pressure-band width divided by two; it is a friction proxy, not a complete diagnosis.

verification_refs.citation: First-principles actuator force-balance derivation
verification_refs.locator: At direction reversal, pressure-force separation balances the difference of opposing friction forces: ΔP·Aeff ≈ 2Ffriction, hence Ffriction ≈ Aeff·ΔP/2
verification_refs.supports_claim: Under the stated symmetry and constant-load assumptions, subtracting the opening and closing force-balance equations cancels the common process load and yields the half-band relation.

facts.statement: Safe failure와 spurious trip은 위험감소 기능에는 보수적일 수 있지만 생산 중단과 secondary hazard를 유발할 수 있다. Dangerous failure와 별도로 분류하고 nuisance-trip consequence를 평가한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
verification_refs.locator: Failure measures, reliability and speed of response
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE distinguishes protection against random and systematic failures and its control-system guidance discusses spurious trip/failure consequences; the exact process consequence remains application-specific.

facts.statement: ESD valve package는 valve body와 trim, actuator, solenoid-operated valve, position indication, accessories와 utility interface로 구성될 수 있다. 각 component의 failure mode와 testability를 분리해 평가한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
verification_refs.locator: Actuators and signal conversion; Functional Safety
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE defines final elements as actuators such as valves manipulated to achieve safe state and says actuator safety function can encompass valve, actuator, positioner, power and required utilities.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 12: Safety Instrumented Systems
verification_refs.locator: §12.9 Digital Valve Controller Use for Partial Stroke Testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes valve, actuator, digital valve controller, position feedback and pneumatic pressures as relevant components in a configured final-element assembly; package architecture is application-specific.

facts.statement: Valve가 정상 운전 위치에 장기간 머물면 corrosion, deposit, stiction, packing friction, actuator seal degradation와 linkage fault가 demand 전까지 숨을 수 있다. Hidden failure는 diagnostics와 proof test의 핵심 대상이다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 12: Safety Instrumented Systems
verification_refs.locator: §12.7 Partial Stroke Testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes PST as detecting selected dangerous undetected modes including shaft sticking, packing issues and actuator air-line issues; it does not assert universal coverage of all listed degradation modes.

facts.statement: Seat leakage는 모든 SIF에서 동일하게 중요하지 않다. SRS가 tight isolation, inventory limitation 또는 fire escalation 방지를 요구할 때 leakage acceptance를 final-element safety requirement로 포함한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 12: Safety Instrumented Systems
verification_refs.locator: §12.6 Proof Testing of Final Elements
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes a full stroke as part of final-element proof testing and says valve leakage may also be verified, supporting that leakage testing is a specified/application-dependent element rather than a universal identical limit.

facts.statement: Low-demand SIF에서는 final element의 average probability of failure on demand(PFDavg) 기여를 평가한다. 단순식은 constant failure rate, low demand, specified proof-test interval과 coverage 가정에서만 사용한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61508-1:2010, Functional safety of E/E/PE safety-related systems
verification_refs.locator: §7.6 target failure measures by mode of operation
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEC distinguishes low-demand average probability of dangerous failure on demand from high-demand/continuous dangerous failure frequency. HSE partial-proof example explicitly limits its simplified PFD equation to low-demand assumptions.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Appendix 3 Partial Proof Testing Example
verification_refs.locator: Equation and assumptions for PFDavg
verification_refs.supports_claim: The worked example states PFDavg≈λD·Ti/2 and explicitly limits the simplified equation to low-demand mode under stated assumptions.

facts.statement: High-demand 또는 continuous-mode에서는 dangerous failure frequency per hour(PFH) 관점이 필요하다. Low-demand PFDavg 식을 demand mode 확인 없이 그대로 적용하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61508-1:2010, Functional safety of E/E/PE safety-related systems
verification_refs.locator: §7.6 target failure measures by mode of operation
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEC specifies average probability of dangerous failure on demand for low-demand mode and average frequency of dangerous failure for high-demand/continuous mode.

facts.statement: Sensor, logic solver와 final element가 모두 성공해야 하는 series SIF에서 subsystem PFD를 결합한다. Exact independent expression과 small-probability approximation을 구분하고 dependency를 별도 검토한다.

verification_refs.citation: Independent series-system probability derivation
verification_refs.locator: P(no subsystem failure)=∏(1−PFD_i); PFD_SIF=1−∏(1−PFD_i), reducing to ΣPFD_i when probabilities are small
verification_refs.supports_claim: Derives exact complement-product formula under independent subsystem failures and notes the first-order small-probability approximation; dependence invalidates the independence assumption.

facts.statement: Diagnostic Coverage(DC)는 관련 dangerous failure 중 online diagnostic으로 검출되는 비율의 개념이다. Diagnostic test의 detectable failure set, detection latency, response와 repair action을 명시한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61508-6:2010, Guidelines on application of IEC 61508-2 and IEC 61508-3
verification_refs.locator: Annex C, worked example of calculating diagnostic coverage
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEC 61508-6 includes a worked example for diagnostic coverage calculation; coverage is tied to the dangerous failure population and diagnostic capability, not a device label alone.

facts.statement: Proof Test Coverage(PTC)는 proof test가 otherwise undetected dangerous failure 중 검출 가능한 비율이다. Procedure 이름이 아니라 failure-mode-to-test-step mapping으로 근거를 제시한다.

verification_refs.citation: ISA-TR96.05.02-2022, In-Situ Proof Testing of Automated Valves
verification_refs.locator: Introduction and discussion of proof-test coverage and test approaches
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISA describes proof-test coverage in terms of how effectively a testing process identifies failures/degradation and requires the test method and assumptions to be considered; coverage depends on the actual test and failure scope.

facts.statement: Partial Stroke Test(PST) coverage는 PST가 검출할 수 있는 dangerous failure subset에 대한 coverage이다. Vendor value는 valve type, stroke fraction, instrumentation, test logic와 mission profile 가정을 확인한다.

verification_refs.citation: ISA-TR96.05.01-2017, Partial Stroke Testing of Automated Valves
verification_refs.locator: Overview of PST methods, coverage, diagnostic approaches and risks
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISA describes multiple PST methods and diagnostic coverage levels, dependent on selected method and failure-detection approach.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 12: Safety Instrumented Systems
verification_refs.locator: §12.7 Partial Stroke Testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: States PST interval extension varies with SIL target, test frequency and diagnostic coverage, and separately notes full-stroke testing is required for valve seating.

facts.statement: PST는 일부 sticking, solenoid 또는 actuator path fault, movement 시작 실패와 selected position-feedback fault를 검출할 수 있다. 실제 detectable set은 architecture와 procedure에 따라 달라진다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 12: Safety Instrumented Systems
verification_refs.locator: §12.7 Partial Stroke Testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists shaft sticking, packing issues and actuator air-line issues as examples PST may reveal; notes full-stroke testing remains needed for valve seating.

verification_refs.citation: ISA-TR96.05.01-2017, Partial Stroke Testing of Automated Valves
verification_refs.locator: Scope: four PST methods and diagnostic coverage approaches
verification_refs.supports_claim: Describes different PST mechanisms and coverage levels, confirming detectable failure scope varies with method and diagnostic approach.

facts.statement: Imperfect proof test 후에도 검출되지 않는 dangerous failure가 남는다. Residual failure rate와 untested failure modes를 명시하고 다음 full test까지의 risk contribution을 평가한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Appendix 3 Partial Proof Testing Example
verification_refs.locator: Worked low-demand partial-proof example and residual failure-rate model
verification_refs.supports_claim: The example models partial test coverage and residual failure contribution separately, demonstrating that partial proof testing does not reveal all dangerous failures.

verification_refs.citation: ISA-TR96.05.02-2022, In-Situ Proof Testing of Automated Valves
verification_refs.locator: Introduction: coverage and failure modes outside test scope
verification_refs.supports_claim: Emphasizes coverage is method-dependent and that proof-testing strategies must detect degradations associated with the entire automated valve system.

facts.statement: Bypass, override와 inhibit는 SIF의 risk reduction을 일시적으로 감소시킨다. Authorization, time limit, compensating measure, alarm, operator communication와 removal criterion을 관리한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 12: Safety Instrumented Systems
verification_refs.locator: §12.8 Online Testing Methods for the Final Element
verification_refs.supports_claim: States bypass testing can leave the process unprotected during a safety demand and notes risk of leaving bypass/mechanical lock in place after test.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
verification_refs.locator: Operation: override management
verification_refs.supports_claim: Lists authorization, security, recording, monitoring, review and reset requirements for overrides; exact site implementation remains risk- and procedure-dependent.

facts.statement: Random hardware failure 계산과 별도로 specification, design, configuration, software, procedure와 human error의 systematic capability를 관리한다. PFDavg 수치만으로 systematic integrity를 증명할 수 없다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 61508-1:2010, Functional safety of E/E/PE safety-related systems
verification_refs.locator: Introduction and §§7.4–7.6: systematic fault control and systematic capability
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEC explains systematic failure probability cannot generally be quantified, separately sets requirements to avoid/control systematic faults and introduces systematic capability.

facts.statement: Safe direction, trip time, final position, leakage, diagnostic alarm, test coverage와 restoration criterion은 SRS requirement에 trace한다. Pass/fail은 측정 uncertainty와 test condition을 포함해 정의한다.

verification_refs.citation: ISA-TR96.05.02-2022, In-Situ Proof Testing of Automated Valves
verification_refs.locator: Introduction: performance measurements compared with established acceptance criteria; proof-test assumptions consistent with safety analysis
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires performance measurements to be compared with established acceptance criteria and test approach/frequency to align with safety analysis assumptions; specific criteria depend on the application.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Control Systems—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
verification_refs.locator: Proof testing: procedures specify success/failure criteria and safe test performance
verification_refs.supports_claim: Calls for proof-test procedures that state success/failure criteria and safe test conditions; does not mandate the Anchor's identical criteria list for every installation.

facts.statement: FAT는 공급자 또는 통제된 시험환경에서 승인된 하드웨어·소프트웨어 구성과 문서 baseline을 대상으로 기능, 시퀀스, HMI, Alarm·Interlock, 통신과 복구를 검증한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 62381:2024, Automation systems in the process industry—FAT, SAT and SIT
verification_refs.locator: ISA-105 summary of IEC 62381:2024 FAT/SAT/SIT planning and checklists
verification_refs.supports_claim: The standard framework covers FAT/SAT/SIT with pre-test planning, procedures and checklists for documentation, hardware, software, operator interfaces and communication paths; exact test scope remains project-agreed.

facts.statement: FAT는 Simulation과 I/O 모사를 활용할 수 있으나 실제 현장 배선, 설치환경, 공정 부하와 최종 인터페이스를 완전히 증명하지 못한다.

verification_refs.citation: ISA-105 Series of Standards, overview of IEC 62381:2024 and IEC 62382:2024
verification_refs.locator: FAT/SAT/SIT and separate loop-check/commissioning scopes
verification_refs.supports_claim: The published summary distinguishes vendor-site FAT from site SAT and separately identifies loop checks and commissioning as outside FAT/SAT scope, supporting that FAT alone does not establish all installed field conditions.

facts.statement: SAT는 현장 설치 후 실제 배선·전원·네트워크·설비 인터페이스와 설치조건에서 기능, 통신, Alarm·Interlock과 운전 연계를 확인한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 62381:2024, Automation systems in the process industry—FAT, SAT and SIT
verification_refs.locator: ISA-105 summary: validation at vendor site and continued integration on location before startup
verification_refs.supports_claim: The standard covers SAT and site integration after vendor-site validation, with checklists including hardware, software, HMI and communications; project-specific acceptance criteria remain applicable.

facts.statement: FAT와 SAT는 수행 장소와 확인 가능한 설치·통합 조건이 다른 단계다. 프로젝트에서 두 시험을 요구한다면 FAT 합격만으로 현장 SAT를 완료한 것으로 간주하지 않는다. 실제 시험 범위와 필수 여부는 승인된 프로젝트 시험계획에 따른다.

verification_refs.citation: ISA-105 Series of Standards, overview of IEC 62381:2024
verification_refs.locator: FAT at vendor site, SAT/site integration on location; loop checks and commissioning separately scoped
verification_refs.supports_claim: Distinguishes vendor-site FAT from on-location SAT/SIT and states FAT/SAT do not cover loop checks or commissioning; project contract determines exact required stages.

facts.statement: Loop test는 해당 Loop의 현장 입력 또는 출력 종단에서 배선·I/O·스케일링·제어기·HMI까지 신호의 방향, 범위와 동작을 종단 간 확인한다. 폐루프 제어 Loop는 센서부터 제어기와 최종요소까지 확인하며, 최종요소가 없는 정보·감시 Loop는 해당 입력 종단까지 확인한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 62382:2024, Control systems in the process industry—Electrical and instrumentation loop check
verification_refs.locator: Scope and intent of loop-check procedures
verification_refs.supports_claim: Defines loop-check activities after loop construction/installation and before cold commissioning, applies to PLC/DCS/panel/field instrumentation, and provides scope for parties to agree; it describes what is intended to be tested, not a single method.

facts.statement: Commissioning은 안전조건과 승인된 절차 아래 Energization, 정적점검, Loop·기능시험, 단계별 기동, Tuning, 부하시험과 안정화 순으로 수행한다.

verification_refs.citation: UK HSE, Operating Procedures—COMAH Technical Measures Guidance
verification_refs.locator: Commissioning procedures: logical progression to verify installed plant function and fitness for purpose
verification_refs.supports_claim: HSE describes commissioning procedures as a logical progression to verify installed plant function, with written instructions, safety precautions and instrumentation/alarm/trip checks; the precise sequence is site-specific.

facts.statement: Impulse tubing/line은 압력 전달 지연·오차·누설을 줄이도록 가능한 짧고 단순하게 배치하고 충분히 지지하며, pocket·고점/저점·열영향·진동·기계적 손상을 process service에 맞게 관리한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Rosemount 3051 Pressure Transmitter Reference Manual, July 2024
verification_refs.locator: §3, Hardware installation—Impulse piping, p. 55
verification_refs.supports_claim: States impulse piping should accurately transfer pressure; identifies leaks, friction loss, trapped gas/liquid and density variation as error sources; recommends keeping piping short and adapting layout to service.

facts.statement: Impulse line의 slope와 transmitter elevation은 gas, liquid, steam 등 service와 condensate/gas pocket 거동에 따라 달라지므로 모든 service에 동일 방향의 slope를 적용해서는 안 된다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Rosemount 3051 Pressure Transmitter Reference Manual, July 2024
verification_refs.locator: §3, Hardware installation—Impulse piping, p. 55
verification_refs.supports_claim: Gives upward slope from transmitter toward process for liquid service, downward slope for gas service, and cautions against high points in liquid lines and low points in gas lines; placement is service-dependent.

facts.statement: Liquid pressure/DP service에서는 impulse path가 액으로 유지되고 trapped gas가 측정오차를 만들지 않도록 routing·venting·transmitter 위치를 service 조건에 맞게 구성한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Rosemount 3051 Pressure Transmitter Reference Manual, July 2024
verification_refs.locator: §3, Hardware installation—Liquid service; Impulse piping, p. 55
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies trapped gas in a liquid line as a pressure-transfer error and gives liquid-service routing guidance to avoid high points; transmitter positioning is selected for process conditions.

facts.statement: Gas service에서는 condensate가 impulse path에 고여 hydrostatic error를 만들지 않도록 condensate 배출 방향과 transmitter 위치를 process 조건에 맞게 구성한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Rosemount 3051 Pressure Transmitter Reference Manual, July 2024
verification_refs.locator: §3, Hardware installation—Gas service; Impulse piping, p. 55
verification_refs.supports_claim: Identifies liquid in a gas line as a pressure-transfer error, recommends gas-service line slope to avoid low points and says transmitter placement depends on process.

facts.statement: Steam service에서는 transmitter를 고온 steam에 직접 노출하지 않고 condensate를 이용한 pressure transmission과 양측 hydrostatic head의 일관성을 확보하도록 설치 철학을 적용한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Rosemount 3051S Reference Manual, April 2024
verification_refs.locator: §3, Installation—Steam flow measurement, p. 36
verification_refs.supports_claim: Recommends mounting the transmitter below steam taps so impulse piping remains condensate-filled, filling lines with water to prevent direct steam contact, and balancing liquid head on both DP legs; guidance is product/application-specific.

facts.statement: DP measurement의 high/low impulse paths는 불필요한 길이·elevation·thermal 차이를 최소화하고 동일 service condition을 유지하여 두 경로의 hydrostatic/dynamic bias가 과도하게 달라지지 않게 한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Rosemount 3051S Reference Manual, April 2024
verification_refs.locator: §3, Installation—Liquid flow measurement and DP impulse piping
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manual calls for balanced liquid head on both impulse legs and identifies density variation between the legs as an error source, supporting control of differential hydrostatic/thermal bias.

facts.statement: 본질안전 회로 등 특별 분리·식별이 요구되는 회로는 승인된 hazardous-area/IS 설계와 적용 규정에 따라 cable route, terminal, gland와 segregation을 구현하며 설치자가 회로 분류를 임의 변경하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 60079-14:2024, Explosive atmospheres—Electrical installation design, selection and installation of equipment, including initial inspection
verification_refs.locator: Scope: Ex electrical design, selection, installation, initial inspection, documentation and competence
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEC 60079-14:2024 applies to electrical Ex equipment and installations in explosive atmospheres, covering design, selection, installation and initial inspection; specific installation requirements depend on equipment and area classification.

verification_refs.citation: OSHA 29 CFR 1926.407(b), Hazardous (classified) locations
verification_refs.locator: §1926.407(b)(1)–(2), intrinsically safe or approved hazardous-location equipment/wiring
verification_refs.supports_claim: Requires equipment and associated wiring in covered hazardous locations to be approved for the classified location or intrinsically safe within listed/labeled scope; installer cannot unilaterally change the approved protection classification.

facts.statement: 서로 다른 material의 differential growth와 mechanical constraint는 binding, galling, stroke loss 또는 seat leakage를 유발할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Fisher Steam Conditioning Technologies—Critical, D352003X012
verification_refs.locator: Differential thermal expansion discussion for plug/cage and body-bonnet-cage-seat systems
verification_refs.supports_claim: The manufacturer explains that at elevated temperature differential expansion between plug and cage can cause binding or excessive looseness, while expansion in body/bonnet/cage/seat systems can reduce gasket load and cause leakage; material selection or dimensional allowance addresses the effect.

facts.statement: Cage와 multi-hole trim은 pressure staging과 noise control에 유리할 수 있지만 particle·fibrous service에서는 small passage blockage와 wear concentration을 검토한다.

verification_refs.citation: Emerson, Control Valve Handbook, Chapter 6: Special and Severe Service Control Valves
verification_refs.locator: §6.5, Cavitation and Fluids with Particulate; Figures 6.6–6.7
verification_refs.supports_claim: The handbook states that dirty fluid can clog small holes used for cavitation mitigation and describes trim intended for entrained particulate that could plug passages or erode conventional anti-cavitation trim. This supports a service-specific plugging/erosion review, not universal performance of all cage or multihole designs.

facts.statement: 단위시험은 함수·모듈·FB 등 최소 설계단위의 정상, 경계, 오류 경로와 인터페이스 계약을 격리하여 검증한다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-067 Verify Implementation
verification_refs.locator: Verification activities during coding and testing; unit completion, integration testing and system testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: NASA identifies completion of code units, integration testing and system testing as implementation verification activities and requires planned tests against software requirements, including interfaces and fault responses. The specific unit granularity remains architecture-dependent.

facts.statement: 통합시험은 모듈·태스크·통신·데이터베이스·장치 인터페이스 간 데이터, 순서, 타이밍과 오류전파를 검증한다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-067 Verify Implementation
verification_refs.locator: Software interface requirements; integration and system testing
verification_refs.supports_claim: NASA calls for verification of software interface requirements using actual or high-fidelity simulated interfaces, and lists integration and system testing among implementation verification activities. The chosen interface/timing cases must trace to the applicable requirements.

facts.statement: 시스템시험은 통합된 제어 소프트웨어가 시스템 요구사항, 운전모드, 성능, 장애복구와 외부 인터페이스를 충족하는지 확인한다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-067 Verify Implementation
verification_refs.locator: Operational environment, scenarios, target hardware, fault detection/isolation/recovery, stress and resource tests
verification_refs.supports_claim: NASA requires software test cases to verify requirements under conditions close to the operational environment, including operational scenarios, interfaces, fault detection/isolation/recovery, stress and resource usage; the project test plan allocates these tests across levels.

facts.statement: Verification은 각 산출물이 해당 단계의 명세와 설계기준에 맞게 만들어졌는지를 확인하는 활동이다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-028 Verification Planning
verification_refs.locator: Definition and software lifecycle verification processes
verification_refs.supports_claim: NASA describes verification as determining whether work products conform to their requirements and identifies analysis, evaluation, review, inspection, assessment and testing across software lifecycle phases.

facts.statement: Validation은 통합된 시스템이 의도된 사용목적과 운전환경에서 사용자 요구를 충족하는지를 확인하는 활동이다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-028 Verification Planning
verification_refs.locator: Definition of software verification and validation
verification_refs.supports_claim: NASA distinguishes validation as determining whether software satisfies intended use and user needs, separately from work-product conformance verification.

facts.statement: Verification과 Validation은 상호보완적이며 어느 하나의 성공이 다른 하나를 자동으로 보장하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-028 Verification Planning
verification_refs.locator: Definition distinguishing verification of product requirements from validation of intended use/user needs
verification_refs.supports_claim: NASA gives separate questions for verification (work products conform to requirements) and validation (software satisfies intended use and user needs); therefore evidence must be judged against the distinct objective rather than treated as interchangeable.

facts.statement: Requirement Traceability Matrix는 요구사항에서 설계·코드·시험·결과로의 순방향과 시험·결과에서 요구사항으로의 역방향 추적을 제공한다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA Software Engineering Handbook, SWE-052 Bidirectional Traceability
verification_refs.locator: Required trace links among system/software requirements, design, implementation and test procedures/cases
verification_refs.supports_claim: NASA describes bidirectional links from software requirements to architecture/design, code implementation, test procedures/cases and hazards, supporting verification coverage and change-impact analysis.

facts.statement: Connectivity와 Syntactic Interoperability는 data transport·format 호환성을 의미할 수 있지만, Semantic Interoperability는 asset, property, unit, quality와 관계의 의미까지 공통으로 해석할 수 있어야 하므로 단순 protocol 연결만으로 달성되지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: OPC UA Specification, Part 1: Overview and Concepts, §§2.1.17, 4.4.2 and 5.3.4.4
verification_refs.locator: Information Model definition, AddressSpace interoperability structure, and Information Model support
verification_refs.supports_claim: OPC UA distinguishes information modelling from transport-level connectivity: its AddressSpace uses typed Nodes, References, and industry-specific data types to represent semantic relationships. The standard notes that industry groups define the specific information models; mere connection does not itself specify a shared domain model.

facts.statement: Information Model은 Asset, component, property, event, command와 관계를 구조화하고 identifier·unit·semantic definition을 연결하여 서로 다른 시스템이 동일한 제조 객체를 일관되게 해석하도록 한다.

verification_refs.citation: OPC UA Specification, Part 3: Address Space Model, §§1 and 4
verification_refs.locator: Scope, Object Model and Node Model
verification_refs.supports_claim: The specification defines Objects in terms of Variables and Methods, Nodes with Attributes, and References connecting Nodes; it describes the AddressSpace as a model for representing objects and their relationships to clients.

verification_refs.citation: OPC UA Specification, Part 1: Overview and Concepts, §5.3.4.4
verification_refs.locator: Support for information models
verification_refs.supports_claim: OPC UA Information Models use Node References, ObjectType semantic information, exposed DataTypes and industry-specific model definitions.

facts.statement: Asset Administration Shell(AAS) 같은 표준화된 digital representation은 asset identification, submodel과 property/relationship 구조를 이용해 cross-system exchange를 지원할 수 있으나, 특정 표준 하나를 사용했다는 사실만으로 semantic completeness나 interoperability가 자동 보장되는 것은 아니다.

verification_refs.citation: Industrial Digital Twin Association, AAS Specifications
verification_refs.locator: Overview of AAS software structure, interfaces and semantics
verification_refs.supports_claim: The IDTA describes AAS specifications as defining the AAS structure, interface and semantics as a basis for standardized digital representations; the specification ecosystem contains multiple parts and submodels, so exchange requires choosing compatible semantics and implementation scope.

verification_refs.citation: OPC UA for Joining Systems, Part 1: Base, §4.3.3
verification_refs.locator: Information modelling and Profiles
verification_refs.supports_claim: The specification states that not all Clients/Servers need support all functionality; Profiles define testable/certifiable subsets, and companion specifications describe domain models. This supports the boundary that adopting a framework alone does not prove every implementation interoperable or semantically complete.

facts.statement: Digital Thread는 요구·설계·구매·설치·시운전·운전·정비·변경에 걸친 동일 Asset의 identifier, model, configuration, document와 operational data를 추적 가능하게 연결하는 lifecycle data continuity 개념이다.

verification_refs.citation: NIST, Enabling the Digital Thread for Smart Manufacturing
verification_refs.locator: Project overview: information reuse, traceability and lifecycle-phase exchange
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST describes the smart-manufacturing digital-thread project as enabling repurposing, reuse and traceability of information throughout the product lifecycle, with exchange between lifecycle phases, particularly engineering, manufacturing and quality.

verification_refs.citation: Hedberg et al., Using graphs to link data across the product lifecycle for enabling smart manufacturing digital threads, NIST publication record
verification_refs.locator: Abstract: product lifecycle data linking and traceability
verification_refs.supports_claim: NIST reports a method for linking and tracing data throughout the product lifecycle across engineering, manufacturing and quality domains, while also noting there is no single uniform generalized deployment method.

facts.statement: Alarm은 비정상 상태를 운전자에게 알리고 정해진 시간 안에 판단 또는 조치를 요구하는 기능이며, 조치가 필요하지 않은 단순 Event·Status·Notification과 구분한다.

verification_refs.citation: ISA-18 Series of Standards, overview of ANSI/ISA-18.2 and ISA-TR18.2.8
verification_refs.locator: ANSI/ISA-18.2 alarm lifecycle and ISA-TR18.2.8 non-alarm notifications
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISA describes the alarm-management framework as covering alarms and separately identifies a report for non-alarm notifications; ISA rationalization guidance specifies alarm consequence, operator response time and action. This supports the actionable-alarm distinction within process-industry alarm management.

facts.statement: Alarm philosophy는 Alarm의 목적, 역할, 우선순위 기준, 상태표현, 승인권한, Shelving·Suppression, 성능지표, 변경관리와 주기적 검토 원칙을 조직 차원에서 정의한 상위 정책이다.

verification_refs.citation: ISA-TR18.2.1-2018, Alarm Philosophy; ISA-18 Series overview
verification_refs.locator: ISA-TR18.2.1 description and ANSI/ISA-18.2 lifecycle framework
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISA identifies an alarm philosophy as a documented guiding basis for alarm objectives, prioritization, classification, design, performance benchmarks and operator expectations within the alarm lifecycle.

verification_refs.citation: ISA/PAS, Understanding and Applying ANSI/ISA-18.2, section 8
verification_refs.locator: §8 p. 4, roles, definition, prioritization basis, HMI guidance, performance, MOC and training; §§8.2, 13 discuss shelving/access and acknowledgement. This is explanatory guidance, not a claim that every item is universally mandatory.
verification_refs.supports_claim: A site alarm philosophy governs alarm definition, prioritization, HMI/status presentation, operational controls and lifecycle management; local implementation details remain site-specific.

facts.statement: Alarm rationalization은 후보 경보의 필요성을 철학서 기준으로 정당화하고 결과, 운전자 조치, 응답시간, 우선순위·설정값 등 필요한 속성을 기록한다. Deadband·Delay·Shelving 허용조건은 해당 설계와 현장 정책상 필요한 경우에 검토한다.

verification_refs.citation: ISA-TR18.2.2-2016, Alarm Identification and Rationalization; ISA alarm management Q&A
verification_refs.edition_or_version: ISA article describing ISA-18.2 practice; accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: Alarm rationalization: need/justification, attributes, consequence, response time and operator action
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISA describes rationalization as reviewing/justifying candidate alarms, documenting limit, priority, classification and type, and documenting consequence, response time and operator action; ISA-18.2 lifecycle guidance includes rationalization under the alarm philosophy.

facts.statement: Shelving은 운전자가 경보를 임시로 표시·알림에서 억제하는 기능이다. 허용 권한, 시간 제한, 사유·사용자·시작·만료 기록의 구체적 요건은 적용 표준과 현장 alarm philosophy·구현 사양으로 정한다. Shelving은 경보 정의를 삭제하거나 원인을 제거하지 않는다.

verification_refs.citation: ISA, Process Automation: From managing to optimizing alarms
verification_refs.locator: Types of suppression: shelving and designed suppression
verification_refs.supports_claim: The ISA article describes shelving as an operator manually suppressing an alarm temporarily and distinguishes it from designed suppression based on system conditions. Exact time limits, records and operator permissions are determined by the site's alarm philosophy and implementation.

facts.statement: Suppression은 설비상태, 운전모드 또는 논리조건상 의미가 없는 Alarm을 설계된 조건에 따라 자동으로 발생하지 않게 하거나 표시대상에서 제외하는 기능이며, 운전자 임의 Shelving과 구분한다.

verification_refs.citation: ISA, Process Automation: From managing to optimizing alarms
verification_refs.locator: Types of suppression: shelving and designed suppression
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISA distinguishes operator-manual temporary shelving from designed suppression in which the automation system suppresses alarms under specified conditions, including process/equipment state or dynamic rules.

facts.statement: Alarm flood는 짧은 시간에 많은 Alarm이 집중되어 운전자의 인지·진단·조치를 방해하는 상태이고, Chattering은 같은 Alarm이 반복 발생·해제되는 현상이므로 원인 제거, 합리화, Deadband·Delay와 상태기반 Suppression으로 개선한다.

verification_refs.citation: ISA, Process Automation: From managing to optimizing alarms
verification_refs.locator: Alarm flood definition and types of suppression
verification_refs.supports_claim: ISA describes alarm floods as excessive simultaneous alarm activations that overwhelm operators and discusses rationalization, designed suppression, deadband and on/off delay as alarm-management mechanisms. Site thresholds and selected corrective action remain context-specific.

facts.statement: Per-stream filtering and policing은 stream별 rate·burst·gate 위반을 제한하여 faulty talker의 영향을 격리하지만 정책 오설정에 따른 정상 traffic 차단을 시험해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEEE 802.1Qci, Per-Stream Filtering and Policing
verification_refs.edition_or_version: Published Sep 28, 2017; incorporated into IEEE 802.1Q-2018; accessed 2026-10-12
verification_refs.locator: Project overview: filtering, policing, service class selection and disruptive transmissions
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEEE states that a bridge can count, filter, police and select service class per stream, using stream identification and synchronized schedules to mitigate disruptive transmissions; configuration determines which traffic is permitted.

facts.statement: MRP는 일반적으로 ring manager와 ring client가 상태를 감시하고 고장 시 blocked path를 전환하는 방식이며 구성 profile과 ring 조건에 따른 복구시간을 검증해야 한다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 62439-2:2021, Industrial communication networks—High availability automation networks—Part 2: Media Redundancy Protocol (MRP)
verification_refs.locator: Scope: deterministic ring recovery under a dedicated media redundancy manager after single inter-switch link or switch failure
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEC describes MRP as a ring-based recovery protocol controlled by a dedicated media redundancy manager and designed for deterministic reaction to a single inter-switch link or switch failure. The specific claimed configuration profile and recovery time still require verification against the implemented ring and devices.

facts.statement: PRP와 HSR의 seamless 특성은 정의된 단일고장과 적합한 node·path 구성에서 성립하며 공통 전원, shared switch, configuration error와 다중고장은 별도 보호가 필요하다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 62439-3:2021, Industrial communication networks—High availability automation networks—Part 3: PRP and HSR
verification_refs.locator: Scope: seamless switchover with zero recovery time in the event of failure of any network element
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEC specifies PRP and HSR as protocols providing seamless switchover with zero recovery time for network-element failure in their defined topologies. This does not claim elimination of shared-resource common causes, misconfiguration or faults beyond the protocol's modeled scope.

facts.statement: Ring redundancy는 link 또는 node 고장 시 대체경로를 제공하지만 recovery time은 protocol, ring size, supervision interval, switch implementation과 fault type에 따라 달라진다.

verification_refs.citation: IEC 62439-2:2021, Industrial communication networks—High availability automation networks—Part 2: MRP
verification_refs.locator: Scope and stated single-failure ring recovery behavior
verification_refs.supports_claim: IEC specifies the relevant MRP single inter-switch link or switch failure behavior under a dedicated manager; it does not assign one universal recovery time independent of the selected profile and implementation.

facts.statement: Congestion은 ingress traffic이 link 또는 queue service capacity를 초과할 때 지연·drop을 발생시키며 buffer 증설만으로 deadline을 보장할 수 없고 traffic engineering이 필요하다.

verification_refs.citation: RFC 7567, IETF Recommendations Regarding Active Queue Management (BCP 197)
verification_refs.locator: Sections 1.2 and 2.3, queue arrival/egress relationship, buffer sizing, queue-induced latency and full-queue loss
verification_refs.supports_claim: RFC 7567 states that queueing occurs when ingress arrival rate exceeds current egress rate; excessive queues add delay and a full drop-tail queue causes loss. It recommends sizing buffers to expected normal bursts based on traffic burstiness and egress rate, not treating buffer growth as a deadline guarantee. RFC guidance is generic packet-network evidence; application deadlines still require the actual traffic profile and path.

facts.statement: 회전 좌표계에서 상대속도 v를 가진 질점의 코리올리 가속도 크기는 2|Ω||v|sinθ이다. Ω와 v가 수직이면 2|Ω||v|이다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA technical report, Chapter 2, Coriolis acceleration and force
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 2, Coriolis-force discussion preceding equation (4) and equation (4)
verification_refs.supports_claim: The report gives the Coriolis term as twice the cross product of angular velocity and relative velocity, explains its dependence on the sine of their included angle, and gives F=2mωv for perpendicular vectors. Taking the cross-product magnitude yields 2|Ω||v|sinθ.

facts.statement: Ω와 상대속도 v(t)가 수직일 때 코리올리 힘의 순간 크기는 2m|Ω||v(t)|이다. m>0이고 |v(t)|>0인 순간에만 |Ω|=|F_C(t)|/(2m|v(t)|)로 역산할 수 있다.

verification_refs.citation: NASA technical report, Chapter 2, Coriolis force equation
verification_refs.locator: Chapter 2, equation (4), F=2mωv, and preceding cross-product explanation
verification_refs.supports_claim: For perpendicular vectors the report gives force magnitude F=2mωv. Replacing v by instantaneous relative speed v(t) and algebraically rearranging is valid only when m and |v(t)| are nonzero; this is a physical force relation, not a calibrated gyro output equation.
